name: One Hundred Times Me
input:
Dive into abstract atmospheric world where your every move is recorded. Destroy your inner demons while your past selves try to stop you, but hurry up you only have 30 seconds. One Hundred Times Me is a game where you are your own greatest enemy.

The basic objective of One Hundred Times Me is pretty simple: destroy demons on every round in less than 30 seconds. But here is a twist - your every move of all the rounds you’ve beaten is recorded and played back by your past selves.

With each round the board gets more and more crowded. It is also scientifically proven that colliding with your past self is lethal and thus you become your own greatest enemy.

- Fast-paced action game with a little touch of blood and guts.
- Over 50 types of demons to kill.
- Steam Leaderboard.

summary.핵심플레이: 매 라운드 30초 안에 데몬을 처치하며, 이전에 클리어한 라운드에서 했던 자신의 모든 움직임이 기록되어 과거의 자신들로 재생된다.
summary.특징: 라운드가 진행될수록 화면에 과거의 자신들이 늘어나 붐비며, 과거의 자신과 충돌하면 죽는다. 50종 이상의 데몬과 스팀 리더보드를 지원한다.

name: Archimedes: Eureka!
input:
The great researcher Archimedes had been living in Syracuse when one of his experiments destroyed the entire city.
He was tasked to recover the land. Ancient Greece. The city of Syracuse.

The great researcher Archimedes starts a field test of his new invention, which is a winch powered by wind. Hercules competes with the mechanism, and loses!

All of a sudden, a gush of wind breaks the device which, in turn, destroying the whole city.

It’s now Archimedes task to recover the land. He succeeds, but who says he has no more inventions?

Features:

- Build estate & get revenue

- The game is easy to learn, yet challenging to master

- An alternative point of view to great researcher Archimedes

- 100 different levels to discover

- Devices, bridges, portals, zip lines

- Marvellous comics

Want to translate Archimedes into your own language? Let us know!

summary.핵심플레이: 파괴된 시라쿠사를 복구하며 건물을 지어 수익을 얻고, 장치·다리·포털·집라인 등을 활용해 각 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 고대 그리스를 배경으로 아르키메데스를 다룬 100개의 레벨과 만화 형식의 연출을 포함한다.

name: Dead Grid
input:
Just Updated

About the Game

Recruit a squad of elite mercenaries, experts in post-apocalyptic zombie combat. Battle relentless hordes of the undead as you explore a 3D world revealed through the cards.

Choose your tactical approach.

» Go silent to keep the noise down to face the enemy one by one.
» Go loud with explosives and guns, taking on the alerted undead all at once!
» Set them on fire, blow them to pieces, slice and dice your orchestrated zombie funeral.

summary.핵심플레이: 용병 분대를 모집해 좀비 무리와 전투를 벌이며, 카드를 통해 드러나는 3D 세계를 탐험한다. 조용히 적을 하나씩 상대하거나 총과 폭발물로 다수의 적과 한꺼번에 맞서는 등 전술적 접근 방식을 선택한다.
summary.특징: 포스트 아포칼립스 좀비 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 카드로 맵과 상황이 공개되는 방식과 소음 관리, 화염·폭발·근접 공격 등 다양한 처치 수단을 결합한 전투 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: A Lost Whisker
input:
Discord Community

About the Game
Due to some unforeseen circumstances, you have lost your kid whose name is Milo to some bigger authority which has more power but now you have to take the revenge and go on the journey to find your kid in this cruel world.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 잃어버린 아이 Milo를 찾기 위해 세계를 탐험하며 여정을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 더 큰 권력을 가진 세력에게 아이를 빼앗긴 후 복수하고 아이를 되찾는다는 서사를 중심으로 한다.

name: HPRZ: The Syndrome
input:
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/welcome.png [/]
HPRZ mentions the end of the apocalypse for some time, where it is necessary to resist in the world devastated by a deadly syndrome, which quickly mirrored the human race. Parallel to the disease, a war breaks out among humanity's last immune survivors, in a dispute over scarce territories and resources.

THE GAME
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/line.png [/]
Explore in an open world with * 64 km², with rural areas, factories, military bases and several other points of interest, contained in farms, villages, cities and connected by tracks and roads.

To survive the syndrome and war, players will have to develop basic survival technologies, such as culinary, pharmaceuticals, clothing, and weaponry from items collected in public areas now transformed into war zones.

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/openw.png [/]
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/line.png [/]
Differentiated sandbox experience in exploring the HPRZ world, through realistic graphics provided by Unreal Engine, with plains, mountains, edens and also dark and possibly inhospitable places.

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/base.png [/]
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/line.png [/]
Base building system never seen in survival games, extremely intuitive with a logic similar to the real world. And against a magnificent work, there will always be a big explosion through a spectacular invasion, with explosives.

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/vehicles.png [/]
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/line.png [/]
Equipping a vehicle with armor and a war weapon in the body will be incredible. Much more than a simple vehicle for exploration, but a real “war machine” modified and prepared for combat.

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/pvp.png [/]
{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/line.png [/]
Wide variety of customizable weapons for all tastes, as well as accessories and explosives that will not let the war end. Based on an innovative group formation system, which will provide absolutely tactical and dynamic battles.

{STEAM_APP_IMAGE} /extras/survivalspirit.png [/]
HPRZ is being developed by gamers from the community itself, and fans of games of the survival genre. Therefore, we will always be aiming for a balance between logic and reality, where success in the evolution of the game will be based on dedication and a spirit of survival, as ideal for our players.

Survival Spirit, is a term given by the developers of HPRZ: The Syndrome, regarding the gameplay and immersiveness mechanics directly applied in the multiplayer experience.
Soon you will have the opportunity to enter the HPRZ world, and encourage the Survival Spirit that lives within you!

summary.핵심플레이: 약 64km²의 오픈월드에서 자원을 수집하고 요리, 의약품, 의류, 무기 등 기본 생존 기술을 발전시키며 살아남는다. 다른 생존자들과 영토와 자원을 두고 전투를 벌이고 기지를 건설한다.
summary.특징: 치명적인 신드롬으로 황폐화된 세계를 배경으로 하며, Unreal Engine 기반의 그래픽과 기지 건설 시스템, 장갑과 무기를 장착해 개조하는 차량, 그룹 편성 시스템을 활용한 PvP 전투를 제공한다.

name: Myth Finders
input:
Open the door to the world of MythFinders - an exciting adventure through magical lands full of secrets and mysteries. Explore Faerie with its forests and fairies, Dragonia with dragons and treasures, Gigantea with mighty giants, cozy Gnomeria, gloomy Unicornia, where vampires rule, and underwater Nocturia with mermaids and sunken ships. Hidden objects, challenging puzzles and rare artifacts await you, which will help you uncover ancient legends. Become a hero of amazing worlds where myths come to life and adventures never end. MythFinders is waiting for you!

Are you ready to uncover even more secrets? Wonders await you!

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 판타지 세계를 탐험하며 숨은 물건을 찾고 퍼즐을 풀어 희귀 아티팩트를 모은다.
summary.특징: 요정의 Faerie, 용의 Dragonia, 거인의 Gigantea, Gnomeria, 뱀파이어의 Unicornia, 수중 세계 Nocturia 등 신화를 테마로 한 여러 지역을 배경으로 한다.

name: In Their Shoes
input:
In Their Shoes is a collection of slice-of-life, stereotype-breaking short stories set in a city of contrasts like present-day Milan. 7 shoes for 7 characters equals 49 everyday, hyper-realistic, choice-based “Moments”, each lasting about 5 minutes, challenging our perceptions of gender, culture, and lifestyle by (literally) stepping into someone else’s shoes.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 7명의 등장인물의 시점에서 진행되는 약 5분 분량의 선택 기반 '순간' 49개를 플레이하며, 일상 상황에서 선택을 내린다.
summary.특징: 현대 밀라노를 배경으로 한 슬라이스 오브 라이프 단편 모음으로, 다른 사람의 신발을 신어보는 방식으로 성별·문화·생활 방식에 대한 고정관념을 다룬다.

name: Haunting At Cliffhouse
input:
Your husband is dead in a tragic accident. Your life seems pointless and without direction. Lost in your sadness, you find an invitation to Cliffhouse Bed and Breakfast, a sanctuary of peace and serenity in your time of grief. It seems like an idyllic retreat from the world... a place to unwind, relax and let go of the misery that haunts you. But from the moment you ring the check-in bell, you are thrown into a world of mystery, family secrets and tragic history that will take you through time to unravel the buried scandals of the long-dead family dynasty who shaped the very coastline on which you stay. Logging and love, mythology and magic, art and artifice; all conspire to turn your dream into a nightmare. Confirm your reservation now.



A traditional point and click adventure game

Beautiful Victorian style rooms to explore

Walk in a luscious Japanese Garden

Discover a rain forest

Learn about the shipwrecks from the dangerous waters that surround the lighthouse

Solve many puzzles

Interact with ghosts

Solve the haunting

summary.핵심플레이: 빅토리아 양식의 방, 일본식 정원, 열대우림 등을 탐색하며 사물과 유령을 상호작용하고 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어 나간다. 이를 통해 저택에 얽힌 사건을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 남편을 사고로 잃은 주인공이 Cliffhouse라는 숙소에 머물며 가문의 비밀과 과거의 비극을 밝혀 가는 이야기로, 등대 주변 해역의 난파선과 가문의 역사를 다룬다.

name: Pick My Heart Chapter 1
input:
Take part in the lottery and embark on the vacation of your life alongside your best friend: Yuina, where you'll also be a judge in a beauty contest. On the island you will be joined by the competitors – the artistic Eimiko, serious and elegant Haru, commanding Tomoe, and flirty Aimi. Get your flirt game on, the competition starts now!

WHAT IS THEIR SECRET?

While spending time with the girls, you'll notice their weird behavior. Are they hiding something from you? Why did you specifically win the competition? Does it have to do with your memory loss?

LET THEM CHARM YOU

During your stay on the island, you'll have the opportunity to spend time with each of the girls. Get to know their stories and personalities better during various activities such as jogging or swimming. They might try to bribe you and play unfairly… but that can stay just between you and them. Will you keep their secrets?

ONLY ONE WINNER

Despite the beauty and charm of all the girls, only one will be able to win the competition. Which one of them will impress you enough to award her the golden apple? Are you going to go with your heart or will you play fair?

And most importantly: will you find love in Pick My Heart?

KEY FEATURES:

-
An amazing story waiting for you

-
5 endings to discover = 5x more gameplay

-
Unique personalities and temperaments of the girls

-
Many dialogue options you can choose from

-
Breathtaking island full of magical places

-
Different reactions of girls depending on what you say

summary.핵심플레이: 미인 대회 심사위원이 되어 섬에서 여러 참가자들과 시간을 보내며 대화 선택지를 고르고, 최종적으로 한 명에게 우승을 주는 상대를 결정한다.
summary.특징: 기억 상실과 참가자들의 수상한 행동을 둘러싼 이야기가 전개되며, 선택에 따라 여성들의 반응이 달라지고 5개의 결말로 분기된다.

name: Chibi Ninja Shino-kun 2
input:
The Ninja returns!

Dive into a new ninja adventure with new skills, new enemies and lots of kickass ninja action! Chibi Ninja Shino-kun is back, and he's ready to ninja it up. Jump, run and hookshot your way through a forest, a crystal cave and more in this 16bit-inspired platformer. Along the way you'll run up walls, climb along ceilings and throw shurikens at  demons inspired by Japanese folklore!

Are you ninja enough to take on the challenge and get back your treasure?

Features

-
All the ninja classics are here: Wall-jumps, dive kicks, ceiling-running... Nothing can stand in your way!

-
New Skills: Run up walls and use the diagonal hookshot to launch yourself across the levels!

-
Pick up and hurl shurikens at enemies to snipe them from afar!

-
Enemies inspired by Japanese folklore, such as Oni, Hone-Onna and lantern demons!

-
Compete with others for the best times on the Steam Leaderboards!

What are you waiting for? Jump back into your ninja pants and show the world what you got!

summary.핵심플레이: 점프, 달리기, 후크샷을 이용해 숲과 크리스탈 동굴 등의 레벨을 이동하며, 벽 오르기와 천장 이동을 하고 슈리켄을 주워 적에게 던져 처치한다.
summary.특징: 16비트 스타일의 플랫포머로, 벽 점프·다이브킥·천장 달리기 등의 닌자 액션과 오니, 호네온나, 등불 악마 등 일본 민담에서 영감을 받은 적이 등장하며, Steam 리더보드로 기록 경쟁이 가능하다.

name: Habitants
input:
Once, humanity fought ceaselessly over trivial matters, and now they face dire consequences: alien races from distant stars have observed the conflicts raging on this planet. Today, three powerful extraterrestrial civilizations continue their endless war for their respective purposes, turning the planet into a wasteland where humanity struggles to survive amidst their power struggles.
Your village has been destroyed by the war. To survive in this chaotic world, you must quickly familiarize yourself with the technologies and skills upon which humanity relies, unite reliable companions, and build and defend your own camp.
As you establish your foothold, chaos and mysteries will assail you, and the fate of you and your people will depend on your choices.

Gather resources from the surroundings, fill your belly, and then build your own base. You can cultivate various crops to ensure a food supply for yourself and your companions. Utilize the limited resources on the wasteland to build comfortable houses.

Reputation reflects your influence in this world, which you can gradually accumulate through various actions. Reputation is crucial; for instance, when you need to recruit companions, they will judge whether you are a competent leader based on your reputation level. It's worth noting that reputation is a double-edged sword: the higher your reputation, the more attention you will attract from powerful factions, which could potentially bring you into crisis.

Players can utilize a wide array of weapons and equipment for combat, including melee and ranged weapons. Master various weapons to enhance your proficiency and prepare to face even stronger enemies on the battlefield.

The control of this planet is no longer in human hands, and the alien races do not regard humanity highly. Perhaps you can take full advantage of this opportunity to gradually establish your own power from scratch.

You can build your own armed forces and become a dominant force. You can also seek the protection of powerful factions, or use strategy and diplomacy to turn enemies into allies. In times of chaos, no one can criticize your choices: for survival, all means are fair!

summary.핵심플레이: 주변에서 자원을 채집하고 작물을 재배해 식량을 확보하며 집과 기지를 건설한다. 근접·원거리 무기를 사용해 전투를 벌이고 동료를 모아 자신의 진영을 구축하고 방어한다.
summary.특징: 세 외계 문명이 지구를 차지하려 벌이는 전쟁으로 황폐해진 세계에서 인류가 생존하는 설정이다. 명성 시스템이 있어 명성이 높을수록 동료 모집에 유리하지만 강력한 세력의 주목을 받아 위기를 초래할 수 있으며, 무장 세력을 키우거나 특정 세력의 보호를 받는 등 외교적 선택이 가능하다.

name: Welcome Back To 2007

summary.핵심플레이: Emo Boy를 조작해 31개 레벨을 진행하며, 눈물을 발사해 적을 공격하고 담배를 모아 제트팩 연료를 채운다. 최종 보스전을 포함해 3가지 난이도로 플레이할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 2007년을 배경으로 한 세계관에서 할머니, 시큐리티, 고스족 등 다양한 적이 등장하며, 실제 물리 모델로 작동하는 제트팩과 Girl with Guitar 캐릭터의 조언, 오리지널 사운드트랙, 리더보드와 컨트롤러 지원을 갖췄다.

name: 他の男の精液で孕むとき２ ―　障子に映る、快感に悶え狂った妻の影　―
input:
■ストーリー
とある小村の名家、小池家の次期当主『賢太朗』に無精子症が発覚する。
世継ぎを作るためにやむを得ず、実父である一郎に妻の『梓』を抱かせることになる。
かくして子作りのために一郎に抱かれる梓であったが、
障子を挟んで隣室に控えていた賢太朗は大きな絶望に突き落とされる事になる。

”一郎のカラダにしがみつき、無我夢中で背中を掻きむしる妻の影”
”接吻にて口を塞がれながら、絶頂の快感に細かく痙攣する妻の影”

障子に映った妻の肢体は、その行為がいかに激しい快感を
伴うものであったのかを如実に伝えていた。

やがて梓は子を宿し、絶望の夜は終わりを迎える。
しかし妻のカラダに刻まれた快楽の記憶は、そう簡単に消えるものではなかった……
■登場キャラクター

●小池 梓 （CV：葉村夏緒）
主人公の妻。専業主婦。小池家に嫁いだ和服美人。
見た目も性格もとても穏やかな、大和撫子のような女性。
落ち着いた雰囲気から実年齢よりも年上に見られることがあるが、
話しかけると、ワンテンポ遅れて返事が返ってくるような所があります。
かなりのおっとり系です。
男性経験は主人公1人のみです。
主人公はそこまでテクニックがあるわけではないので、イッたことはありません。
なので、そもそもそんなにセックスが好きというわけでも無いです。
ただ、肌と肌を重ねるようなスキンシップは好みます。

●小池 一郎
主人公、小池賢太郎の実父。ヒロインの梓を孕ませる役です。
村を代々治めてきた豪族の子孫で、小池家の家長。
豪毅な性格で、権力を背景に何でも押し通してしまうようなとても我の強い人物。
妻は賢太郎を出産した際に亡くし、以後独身のまま。
性欲旺盛で、家の外に愛人を何人も持っています。
●小池 賢太郎
主人公。梓の夫。村役場の職員。
小池家の次期当主で、小池一郎の一人息子。
妻の梓と跡取り作りをしていたのだが、ある日無精子症であることが発覚する。
一族の血を絶やすわけにはいかないため、梓に一郎の子種を仕込むことを渋々認める。
■ゲームについて
クリックで読み進めるノベルゲーム

選択式ビジュアルノベル

summary.핵심플레이: 클릭으로 텍스트를 읽어 나가는 노벨 형식이며, 선택지를 통해 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 무정자증이 발각된 남편을 대신해 아내가 실부의 아이를 임신하게 되는 상황을 다룬 성인 스토리로, 장지문에 비친 그림자를 통한 연출과 등장인물들의 관계를 중심으로 전개된다.

name: Prisoner
input:
You are a Prisoner. In a strange place with many rooms. You hear a noise, as if something is moving around. Move from one room to another, avoid deadly traps and try to escape.
Features

An enormous amount of levels. All of the rooms inside of the Complex are moving, and you never know what they are gonna be like next time.

Deadly traps. Be careful, there can be a variety of traps inside of the rooms: from steel blades to laser launchers.

Uncover the Complex step by step. Before starting the most difficult trials, discover the two endings that will give you an access to the new levels.

Trials. After finishing the game, you will get an access to the special trials, that shall give you an opportunity to gain the additional rewards and achievements.

Steam achievements.

Controller support.

summary.핵심플레이: 수감자가 되어 여러 방으로 이루어진 공간을 이동하며, 치명적인 함정을 피해 탈출을 시도한다.
summary.특징: 복합 시설 내부의 방들이 계속 움직여 매번 구성이 달라지며, 강철 칼날이나 레이저 발사기 등 다양한 함정이 배치된다. 두 가지 엔딩을 발견하면 새로운 레벨이 열리고, 게임을 완료하면 추가 보상과 도전 과제를 얻을 수 있는 특별 시련이 개방된다.

name: Floor 13: Deep State
input:
Floor 13: Deep State is a dynamically generated dystopian thriller, inspired by the 90’s classic Floor 13 and created by its original team.



In a free society, citizens make their own decisions, can challenge authority, and are able to speak their truth. Your job is to put a stop to that.



Return to the elusive 13th floor in a London you think you know, wielding your resources and the power of the pen to redefine “the truth.” Fake news, illegal surveillance, assassination - it doesn’t matter how you get the job done, all you need to do is sign the order. At the helm of the machinery of the deep state, you will encounter characters and events inspired by today’s political climate. It is up to you to uphold the status quo.

summary.핵심플레이: 딥 스테이트 조직의 수장으로서 각종 명령서에 서명해 여론을 조작하고 위협 요소에 대응한다. 가짜뉴스 유포, 불법 감시, 암살 등 다양한 수단을 동원해 체제를 유지하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 90년대 작품 Floor 13의 원 제작진이 만든 후속작으로, 동적으로 생성되는 디스토피아 스릴러 구조를 가진다. 현대 정치 상황에서 영감을 받은 인물과 사건이 등장하는 런던을 배경으로 한다.

name: Nocturne FX
input:
Nocturne FX™ starts simple—dodge pipes, fly with precision—but the skies won’t stay calm for long. Chaos builds with each moment: sudden storms, unpredictable power-ups, shifting rules, and unseen forces that punish complacency.

This is a fast-paced, score-chasing arcade game where your actions shape the challenge. Easy to learn, brutally adaptive, and constantly evolving—Nocturne FX™ isn’t here to be fair. It’s here to test your limits.

summary.핵심플레이: 파이프를 피하며 비행하고 정확한 조작으로 점수를 쌓아가는 아케이드 플레이를 진행한다. 플레이어의 행동에 따라 난도가 변화한다.
summary.특징: 진행 중 갑작스러운 폭풍, 예측하기 어려운 파워업, 변하는 규칙 등이 등장하며 시간이 지날수록 상황이 복잡해진다.

name: It's A Farmer Thing
input:
Welcome to It's A Farmer Thing

Your ticket to a stress-free farming adventure!

In this relaxed farming simulator, you purchase a beautiful island that you can slowly make your own at your own pace. While you do need to pay off the debts associated with the purchase, there's no rush – the island remains your home, whether you're working hard or taking a break.

There are countless ways to build your farming empire: raise animals, tend to your crops, mine for valuable resources, or enjoy the peaceful life by picking apples. Each activity brings you closer to your goal.

Base Building

Yes, that too! Shape the world exactly how you like it.

The best part? Everything is 100% optional. Everything you need is already available in the world.

But if you don’t like your house, you can simply tear it down and rebuild it to your taste.

With a wide variety of building parts and decorative items, you can create your dream home. And if one house isn’t enough, there’s plenty of room for a second or even third ... Maybe you want a house for every day of the week, and two on Sundays? No problem!

You won’t have to chop down half the forest just to build a wall. Nope! All building parts come at a small cost, easily earned by picking a few apples.

Single and Multiplayer

Play solo or with your friends in online multiplayer – the choice is yours. Together, you can explore the island, earn money, or simply relax and take in the views.

Multiple Characters

Choose from four (for now) charming playable characters, and make use of a variety of helpful vehicles to get your tasks done and customize your farm to your liking.

It's A Farmer Thing offers a relaxed, humorous atmosphere, with funny character interactions and charming details that brighten up the experience. Whether you're working hard or simply unwinding, you set the pace. No losses, no stress – just progress and fun!

Additionally, It's A Farmer Thing doesn’t follow a strict graphical style, but combines a charming low-poly aesthetic with modern techniques. By utilizing advanced features like Global Illumination, it creates a unique blend of simple, playful graphics and modern visual effects, making the experience both vibrant and atmospheric.

The game is playable in all languages, as players can translate the language files themselves. Plus, controller support is in the works, making the gameplay experience even more versatile!

"You’ll be surprised by the secrets your island holds – who knows what else might fly across the sky."

summary.핵심플레이: 섬을 구매해 구매에 따른 빚을 갚아가며, 동물 사육, 작물 재배, 자원 채굴, 사과 수확 등의 활동으로 농장을 키운다. 건물 파트와 장식 아이템을 이용해 집과 농장을 자유롭게 짓고 허물고 다시 지을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 시간 압박이나 패배 없이 플레이어가 진행 속도를 정하는 방식이며, 모든 활동이 선택 사항이다. 솔로와 온라인 멀티플레이를 지원하고 네 종의 플레이어블 캐릭터와 다양한 탈것을 제공하며, 로우폴리 스타일에 글로벌 일루미네이션 등 기법을 결합한 그래픽을 사용한다.

name: Five Nights At Smog's
input:
You are taking a night shift, in a poutinerie restaurant in The York, a large city in a undisclosed location. This restaurant is named "Smog's Poutinerie".
Throughout the night your job is to maintain the poutinerie, listen to the calls you receive, as your co-worker on the day shift will help you throughout each night.
But be careful, As your co-worker speaks of this unknown monster, and the weird traits it has, and of course, how to keep safe from it.
Will you be able to survive 5 nights at Smog's Poutinerie? keeping track of your Sanity, Audibility, and the monster? Find out on July 8th
Don't keep the monster waiting my friend.

Early Access will only have one playable night

Smog's History

The idea for Five Nights At Smog's Originally came from Maxwell, who then put together a team to create this project.
Five Nights At Smog's was originally done as a school project, but we three developers want to take this game to the next level.

Developers: Maxwell, Aiden, Ben : ForReal Game Studios.

Music Producer: Aiden Desjarlais

summary.핵심플레이: The York라는 도시의 푸틴 레스토랑 Smog's Poutinerie에서 야간 근무를 하며 가게를 관리하고, 주간 근무 동료의 전화를 들으며 정체불명의 괴물로부터 살아남는다. Sanity, Audibility, 괴물의 위치를 관리하며 밤을 넘긴다.
summary.특징: 5일간의 야간 생존을 목표로 하며, 동료의 통화를 통해 괴물의 특성과 대처법을 전달받는 구조다. 원래 학교 프로젝트로 제작되었으며, 얼리 액세스에서는 한 개의 플레이 가능한 밤만 제공된다.

name: Book of Sophia
input:
Book of Sophia is a fast-paced action adventure game with roguelike elements. As the protagonist of the Book of Sophia, you'll pick up your sword and bow to break free from the mysterious world of darkness.

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 검과 활을 사용해 적과 싸우며 어둠의 세계에서 벗어나기 위해 진행한다.
summary.특징: 로그라이크 요소를 포함한 빠른 템포의 액션 어드벤처로, 주인공이 되어 어둠의 세계를 탐험한다.

name: ShipLord
input:
ShipLord is a survival game based on an asteroid dodging mechanics and energy collection, combined with interactive boss fights. The main goal of the game is to survive a specific period of time, collect as much energy as possible, so you can progress further into the vast and fully unique space.

LEVELS

- unique boss fights with different difficulty levels and advance mechanics

- complete different asteroid levels to unlock new boss levels

REWARDS

- medal based system that awards you with upgrades, medal system ranges from wood to diamond

- completing a game on harder difficulty level rewards you with more upgrade points and rewards

ABILITIES

- player can use 3 different abilities, shield, energy tractor and force field to help him in critical situation

UPGRADES

- there is over 100 available upgrade points, which you can use to upgrade:

- decrease shield cool down time

- increase shield duration time

- decrease force field cool down time

- increase force field duration time

- decrease energy spawn time

- decrease energy collection time

UNLOCKABLES

- you can unlock levels, boss fights, ships and upgrades

GUI - OPTIONS AND CONTROLS

- advanced GUI with customizable preferences which include controls, graphics and audio

GRAPHICS

- amazing space graphics

- high resolution planets

- over 100 different asteroid models with different textures

summary.핵심플레이: 소행성을 회피하고 에너지를 수집하며 일정 시간 동안 생존하고, 소행성 레벨을 완료해 보스전을 진행한다. 위기 상황에서는 실드, 에너지 트랙터, 포스 필드 세 가지 능력을 사용한다.
summary.특징: 나무부터 다이아몬드까지의 메달 기반 보상 시스템으로 업그레이드 포인트를 얻으며, 100개 이상의 업그레이드 포인트로 능력 쿨다운·지속 시간과 에너지 관련 수치를 강화한다. 레벨, 보스전, 함선, 업그레이드를 해금할 수 있고 컨트롤·그래픽·오디오 설정을 조정할 수 있다.

name: Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~
input:
"Anomalous Crossing ~Shibuya~" is an escape game similar to 'The Exit 8' & 'Platform 8', with the theme of liminal space.
A variety of abnormalities occur, from those that are horror, hard to find to those that affect the entire city, so carefully observe them and aim to escape.

---
Suddenly, you find yourself standing at an empty ticket gate at Shibuya Station.

- Exit Shibuya Station, cross the scramble crossing, and head towards Center Street.

- Please check carefully to see if there are any anomalies.

- Escape from the looping Shibuya by making the right choices.

List of Anomalies
.The list of cleared anomalies can be found in the list.
Please find all the anomalies.
Play time
.30 to 60 minutes.
If you find all the anomalies, it will take more.
About play video distribution
.You are free to distribute your play videos to any individual or corporation.
You do not need to contact the developer, but we ask that you include a link to the Steam page in the summary section or elsewhere.
If you'd like, it would be helpful if you could post your thoughts and reviews on Steam.
How to enjoy
・Enjoy the eerie and desolate atmosphere of Shibuya.
・The direct horror expressions are relatively restrained, so even those who aren't good at horror should enjoy it.
・Not only fear, but also surprises, beauty, stories you've seen elsewhere, and a wealth of other anomalies are waiting for your visit.
3D Sickness Prevention
.We have implemented a feature that prevents the view from swaying up and down as the player moves. It is relatively easy to play even for those who get easily intoxicated.
If you are still prone to motion sickness, please turn on “Center Point Display” in the settings. (A dot will be displayed in the center of the screen to prevent sickness.)

* More than 70 types of anomalies are planned.
--Additional note--
・Respect works *Works that have influenced me. Without these works, this work would not have been created. I would like to once again express my deep respect for ...
"The Exit 8" "Platform 8" by KOTAKE CREATE
"False Dream" by TenkaiGames
"nibansen" by MFC STUDIO
If you enjoyed these works, I think you will also enjoy this one. Please note that this is not related to this work.
・Once you clear an anomaly, the appearance rate will decrease during the same play. In addition, the appearance rate of undiscovered anomalies is set to be high after the second play.
・If you clear all the anomalies, a certain function will be unlocked. After clearing, please check the title screen.
--Requests--
・In order to continue our development activities, we require reviews from everyone. We appreciate your cooperation in posting customer reviews and ratings, even if it is just a simple impression.
・Please let us know what you found interesting, requests for the next version, and if you would like to make something different! We'll be expecting you.
Thank you.

summary.핵심플레이: 시부야역 개찰구에서 시작해 스크램블 교차로를 건너 센터 거리로 향하며, 주변에 이상 현상이 있는지 관찰하고 올바른 선택을 통해 반복되는 시부야에서 탈출한다.
summary.특징: 경계 공간을 테마로 한 게임으로, 호러적인 것부터 도시 전체에 영향을 미치는 것까지 70종 이상의 이상 현상이 계획되어 있으며, 직접적인 공포 표현은 비교적 절제되어 있다. 이동 시 화면 흔들림을 방지하는 3D 멀미 방지 기능과 중앙점 표시 옵션을 제공하며, 클리어한 이상 현상은 목록에서 확인할 수 있다.

name: Chambara
input:
Chambara is a universe you have never seen before — and if you are not careful, you’ll never see your foes either. Hide in the shadows and strike from the light in a dazzling black and white world. This nail-biting competitive stealth brawler will be your home for unforgettable local multiplayer.



Play locally in intense 1-on-1 matches, or party up for 2v2 across 9 unique maps! Master your shuriken snare to trap your opponents before dealing a deadly blow with your sword, or your umbrella, or your… fish?? The world is striking, and so must you! Customize your outfit and weapon, but make sure your stylish hat doesn’t give you away!



Chambara features full controller support outside of the launcher. All major Xinput gamepads are supported.

summary.핵심플레이: 흑백 배경에 몸을 숨기고 상대에게 접근해 검, 우산, 물고기 등 다양한 무기와 표창으로 공격한다. 1대1 또는 2대2 로컬 대전으로 진행된다.
summary.특징: 명암 대비를 이용해 그림자에 은신하고 밝은 곳에서 공격하는 흑백 세계를 배경으로 하며, 9개의 맵과 복장·무기·모자 커스터마이징, Xinput 게임패드 지원을 제공한다.

name: Erased
input:
"Erased" is an action-packed psychological whirlwind in a post-apocalyptic sci-fi world. Explore an open-world with fast combat, rail grinding, parkour, pets, and graffiti. Embrace hip hop, Afro-beats, and K-pop while following a dream based lore in single player mode or face others in online PVP.

GAME FEATURES

-
Parkour System

-
Rail Grinding

-
Single Player Story Mode

-
Online PvP

-
Fast Paced Combat

-
Pet System

-
Graffiti

-
Open World

-
Dance System

-
Hip Hop, Afro -beats and K- Pop culture

-
Character Customization

-
Large Scale War Battles

-
Emotional, Dream Based, Story line

-
Karma System

-
Giant Dynamic Boss Battles

-
Live Tournaments/ Concerts

summary.핵심플레이: 오픈 월드를 탐험하며 빠른 전투, 레일 그라인딩, 파쿠르를 수행하고, 싱글플레이 스토리 모드를 진행하거나 온라인 PvP로 다른 플레이어와 대결한다.
summary.특징: 포스트 아포칼립스 SF 세계를 배경으로 하며, 힙합·아프로비트·K-pop 문화, 펫 시스템, 그라피티, 댄스 시스템, 카르마 시스템, 대규모 전투와 보스전, 라이브 토너먼트 및 콘서트를 포함한다.

name: hgmGame-bee
input:
This is a casual and puzzle puzzle game where the complete image is randomly shuffled into 4 * 4 small images each time. The position of each small image is random, and you need to assemble them into a complete image (in order to make the image move, the final puzzle will be 1/16 smaller).

Suitable for: Those who enjoy puzzles or have free time to exercise their brainpower can repeat the challenge.

Features included:

Game interface composition: one image divided into 16 pieces, The position of each pieces is random

Game steps: Click the left mouse button on the image around the black square, and the image and black square will switch positions. The goal is to assemble all the small images into a complete image. The complete image is as follows:

summary.핵심플레이: 4x4로 나뉘어 무작위로 섞인 16개의 이미지 조각 중 검은 칸 주변 조각을 마우스 왼쪽 클릭해 검은 칸과 위치를 바꾼다. 조각들을 순서대로 맞춰 완전한 이미지를 완성하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 이미지를 움직일 공간을 위해 완성 이미지는 원본보다 1/16 작게 구성되며, 매번 조각 위치가 무작위로 섞여 반복 도전이 가능하다.

name: Another Adventure
input:
Another Adventure is a narrative video game.
Adventures come and go.
Maybe this is just another stupid adventure game.
Maybe it's not.

There are 4 chapters in this game. Each of them tells a separate and distinct story with interactivity.
Jonny is an ambitious college student and he has a dream. Every night he sets the alarm to 6:00 am the following morning. "The college lessons have been obsoleted for years" Jonny thinks. But as another productive day goes down the drain, he just manages to "learn a lot on Twitter and Quora".
Jack is a programmer who dreams of changing the world. He doesn't like the company he works for very much. His current plan is to gain the experience at a big company, and gather the strength to change the world in the future.
Robert finds work really boring, so he quits his job and sets out on his enlightening journey to Tibet
Kevin believes that he's an artist. He thinks great art is seldom easy to understand and art is our only chance to achieve immortality. In fact, most people would call him a game developer. But Kevin believes that games are the "Ninth Art", and it's more accurate to just call him an artist.

"He was longing for tomorrow, whereas everything in him ought to reject it. That revolt of the flesh is the absurd. "

Play time between 50 – 60 minutes.

summary.핵심플레이: 4개의 챕터로 나뉜 각기 다른 이야기를 상호작용을 통해 진행하며 등장인물들의 서사를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 조니, 잭, 로버트, 케빈 등 서로 다른 인물의 독립된 이야기를 다루며, 전체 플레이 시간은 약 50~60분이다.

name: 爱坤消消乐
input:
Overview

Welcome to iKun Crush a hilarious casual game that wildly stitches together the "Kun-style meme universe" with classic match-3 gameplay!When "Basketball," "You Bing(Oil Cake)," and "Bao Guo(A person's name)" fill the puzzle board,and the remixed "Ji Ni Tai Mei" BGM loops nonstop,you’ll unlock a brand-new way to enjoy Kun-style memes in an experience where laughter and quick reflexes fly hand in hand!

Core Gameplay: Match-3 , Memes , Every Move is a Meme

-
Modified Match-3, Meme Power Maxed Out:
Classic match-3 rules lay the foundation, but every "match tile" hides a surprise —
Basketball Bomb:Chain matches trigger screen-clearing blasts, sending basketballs flying everywhere for a crazy, satisfying rush!
Oil Cake Obstacle:Failing to clear "Oil Cakes" in time triggers a chain reaction, watching them flood the screen in absurdity!
Bao Guo Interference:Suddenly appearing "Bao Guo" tiles disrupt your matches — counter them to make them plummet into the board’s abyss!

-
Parade of Meme Elements:
Over 50 Kun-style plot elements —— meme images,the "69-year-old elder" map, the "Lightning Five-Whiplash" meme, microphone props…even hidden "Ji Ni" voice easter eggs. Longtime fans will feel their DNA tremble at the sight!

-
BGM: Earworm Loops That Won’t Quit:
Two remixed Kun-style BGMs are built in,automatically switching when you toggle between "Little Blackie" and "Brother Kun" characters.The more you play, the more addicted you get — you simply can’t stop!

summary.핵심플레이: 고전 매치3 규칙에 따라 타일을 맞추며, 농구공 폭탄으로 화면을 정리하거나 유병(오일 케이크) 장애물과 갑자기 나타나는 바오궈 타일을 제거해 방해 요소를 처리한다.
summary.특징: 이른바 'Kun 스타일 밈' 세계관을 매치3와 결합해 50종 이상의 밈 이미지, '69세 노인' 맵, '번개 다섯 채찍' 밈, 마이크 소품, 숨겨진 음성 이스터에그 등을 담고 있으며, 'Little Blackie'와 'Brother Kun' 캐릭터 전환에 따라 리믹스된 두 종류의 BGM이 자동으로 바뀐다.

name: Outracer
input:
Do you have what it takes to outrace them all?

Outracer is a high speed futuristic racing game where you must race against aggressive opponents on massive race tracks suspended high in the air.

You must master your machine to get through these races. Drive with care and precision while boosting with reckless abandon! If the enemy racers don’t defeat you, the unpredictable turns of the courses will certainly try!
Features

- Race anti-gravity vehicles across massive roller coaster-like race tracks!

- Over 20 high speed tracks to test your skills!

- Over 8 unique vehicles to choose from!

- Race against up to 30 formidable AI opponents!

- Race with your friends in four player splitscreen!

- Create your own race tracks using the powerful built-in track editor!

- Play Hyperspeed Mode and reach speeds never before seen, if you can survive long enough!

- Race to your own music using Custom Soundtracks!

summary.핵심플레이: 공중에 떠 있는 대형 트랙에서 반중력 차량을 몰아 AI 상대 및 다른 플레이어와 경주한다. 부스트를 활용하며 예측하기 어려운 코스를 통과해야 한다.
summary.특징: 20개 이상의 트랙과 8종 이상의 차량, 최대 30명의 AI 상대와 4인 분할 화면 대전을 지원한다. 트랙 에디터로 코스를 제작할 수 있고, 하이퍼스피드 모드와 커스텀 사운드트랙 기능이 있다.

name: Gambol
input:
Gambol is a wall-hopping, ceiling-slapping jaunt of a platformer with straight forward controls, and buttery smooth movement. You control the Gambol Gumball through a gauntlet of levels designed with flow and rhythm in mind to test your platforming grit. But don't be too nervous, because along with the slick controls you also have a triple jump that's energy is reset upon touching any (non-lethal) surface, including the ceiling. Holy cow, that sounds great. The controls are simple enough that you could play it on a NES controller, with only run, jump, left, right, down-boost, and [REDACTED] to worry about. What's that “[REDACTED]” all about? Hah, don't think too much about it, it's probably nothing.

“Whoa!” you say, “this looks crazy hard, is this one of those games that Poo-Dee-Pah yells at on the YouVideo?” Nah, it's not too bad, the levels appear a bit tougher than they really are since I had to put in more obstacles to make up for all that sweet, juicy, player agency you have. Oh, and when you inevitably meet your demise at the hands of a spike, laser, bomb, floating-shock-ball-of-hurt, or whatever else, you re-spawn within a couple seconds (or just hit the level-restart button if you're fidgety like me), so it's no biggie if you have to re-run a level a few times before you get the hang of it. But for all you hardcore platforming buffs out there, I've made a second, harder difficulty with special levels, and normal mode levels with more hazards added. Oh my!

Inconsequential! It's probably about candy or jellybeans or some such nonsense. Honestly, the story is just a vehicle to move the action along, so it's not super important, but I'll work something in there, just you see, and chapter four will shock you!

- super-smooth Modern Platforming Action!

- A triple jump that's energy is reset upon collision with any non-lethal surface. Wowie!

- 130+ Levels, designed to flow in a way so that they can be (fairly) easily speedran once mastered NO AUTOSCROLLERS! !

- Wild hazards to avoid!, and one to use to your advantage if you're gutsy enough to experiment (hint: not the spikes, those just kill you. Don't try using those for anything. Except to die. Which you will do if you touch them. Avoid at all costs).

- No weird gravity mechanics, or things to make you motion sick. Back in my day we liked our colors bright and our gravity linear (only going down, baby!)

- Simple, customizable controls that anyone can master. Cool beans!

- Two difficulties: One for normies like myself, and one for people who, I don't know, like losing? It's super hard, but whatever! Yay!

Q: What Platforms Will the Game Run On?
A: Windows/PC. It is possible (though not promised) that Linux and Mac versions may come in the future, though they will certainly not be available at launch.

Q: How Many People Are Working On This Game?
A: Just this guy!, Mike. Catch me on the Tweeterverse @ACEJester <3 Oh, and Andrew Lippens is the composer. He's super cool, too.

Q: What Inspired Gambol?
A: I love games with wall-jumping, but I haven't found one with the mechanic done how I'd like it done, so I've made my own!

summary.핵심플레이: Gambol Gumball을 조작해 벽 점프와 트리플 점프를 이용해 130개 이상의 레벨을 통과하며, 스파이크·레이저·폭탄 등의 장애물을 피한다. 사망 시 몇 초 내에 리스폰되어 반복 도전이 가능하다.
summary.특징: 치명적이지 않은 표면에 닿으면 트리플 점프 에너지가 초기화되며, 오토스크롤이 없고 흐름과 리듬 위주로 설계된 레벨을 갖췄다. 일반 난이도와 더 어려운 난이도 두 가지가 제공되며, 달리기·점프·이동·다운부스트 등 단순한 조작을 사용한다.

name: HUNTED
input:
Survival horror game with a single run. The game does not have a save system. The challenge is to get to the end without getting a game over. The game has two types of weapons: rifle and pistol. Wear a vest to reduce the damage.

KNIFE: You can use knives to free yourself from enemies that can grab you in the game.

ABOUT THE GAME: The game is in Portuguese-PTBr and English-En, with no audio dubbing. 3 (three) levels of graphic quality: low, medium and auto.

This game does not condone any drug use, sexual assault/non-consensual sex, BDSM, drug/alcohol abuse and/or self-harm.

Try to survive until the end in a single attempt. If you fail, you will return to the beginning of the game over and over again. Do you think you can do it?

summary.핵심플레이: 라이플과 권총으로 적에 맞서고, 방탄조끼로 피해를 줄이며, 붙잡는 적에게서는 칼을 사용해 벗어난다. 세이브 없이 한 번의 시도로 끝까지 생존하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 저장 시스템이 없어 게임 오버 시 처음부터 다시 시작한다. 포르투갈어와 영어 텍스트를 지원하며 음성 더빙은 없고, 저·중·자동 3단계의 그래픽 품질 옵션을 제공한다.

name: Last Box Standing May Go On
input:
Try yourself on a handful of levels in a grid-based puzzle game; no large commitments required.

Once you push them, these box creatures won't stop moving until they hit either a wall or another box. Be careful where you send them, or you won't get them back out!

summary.핵심플레이: 격자 기반 스테이지에서 상자 생물을 밀어 이동시키며, 밀린 상자는 벽이나 다른 상자에 부딪힐 때까지 멈추지 않으므로 이동 방향을 계산해 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 짧은 분량의 여러 스테이지로 구성되며, 밀면 계속 미끄러지는 상자 이동 규칙을 활용한다.

name: One Sex Night
input:
“ONE SEX NIGHT” is our new Point And Click game, where you must survive the night. With awesome 3D animation, this is a must play!

You will have to survive one night, taking care of the old mansion of the city. The sensual spirit of a clow will attack you all night long.
You must manage your skills wisely if you want to survive. Or maybe let her to catch you...

What you can find in the game:
• A challenging enemy that wants to catch you.
• Beautiful pictures and animations. 4 Scenes and 6 loop animations.
• Incredible sound and visual effects.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 오래된 저택에서 하룻밤을 버티며, 밤새 공격해 오는 적을 상대로 자신의 능력을 관리해 생존을 시도한다.
summary.특징: 광대 형태의 영혼이 등장하는 밤 생존 콘셉트로, 3D 애니메이션과 4개의 장면 및 6개의 루프 애니메이션을 포함한다.

name: Holbrook Hotel
input:
Foreword

Holbrook Hotel is an atmospheric horror game that embodies the dreams and passion of a young developer. The 14-year-old developer used his imagination and love for retro style to create this unique horror world, dedicated to those who love games and horror experiences.

About This Game

Holbrook Hotel is an atmospheric horror game that embodies the dreams and passion of a young developer. The 14-year-old developer used his imagination and love for retro style to create this unique horror world, dedicated to those who love games and horror experiences.

In the atmospheric horror game Holbrook Hotel, you will come to the hotel as a guest, and after hearing strange noises from the next room, you can't help but embark on an adventure. As you explore, the dark secrets of the town of Holbrook Oaks gradually surface. Under the quiet surface of the town, there is anxiety and fear, and you must find a way to survive and escape the unknown danger that is about to come.

Game Feature

-
Immersive escape experience: In the process of avoiding being chased, players need to collect items, use tools in the scene, and find an effective escape route.

-
Exploration and puzzle solving: Not only escaping, there are also hidden clues and puzzles in the hotel waiting to be solved to reveal the shocking truth of the town.

-
Retro visuals and sound effects: The classic PS1-style low-polygon graphics and eerie sound effects make people feel like they are in a horror masterpiece of the last century.

-
Deep horror atmosphere: The combination of weird sound effects and dim environment creates an immersive horror experience.

-
Self-challenge: Explore, escape, solve puzzles, and test your wisdom and courage.

The game creates a unique environment in a classic retro style, combined with weird sound effects and dark scenes, to bring you an immersive horror experience. You need to use all your wisdom and courage to escape from danger and pursuit, get rescue, and escape from this dangerous place!

How To Control

summary.핵심플레이: 호텔에 투숙한 플레이어가 옆방에서 들려온 소리를 계기로 탐험에 나서, 추격을 피하며 아이템을 수집하고 장소의 도구를 사용해 탈출 경로를 찾는다. 숨겨진 단서와 퍼즐을 풀어 마을의 진실을 밝힌다.
summary.특징: PS1 풍의 로우 폴리곤 그래픽과 음향 효과, 어두운 배경을 사용한다. Holbrook Oaks 마을의 비밀을 배경으로 하며, 14세 개발자가 제작했다.

name: TransmuTowers
input:

summary.장르: 타워 디펜스, 불릿 헤븐, 전략, 액션
summary.핵심플레이: 타워를 배치하고 관리하며 몰려오는 적을 방어한다. 캠페인을 진행하며 왕국의 위기 상황에 대응한다.
summary.특징: Valber 왕국을 배경으로 불안에 시달리는 왕과 왕비가 등장하는 스토리 기반 캠페인을 제공한다. 개발 중인 인디 프로젝트로, Discord를 통한 얼리 액세스와 피드백 참여를 지원한다.

name: 星の欠片の物語。しかけ版
input:
Story

A lone girl stands abandoned on a broken star.
With the star deprived of its power, she can neither use it to escape nor inform others of her plight.
However, there exists a point on this star that intersects with another world.
The player, by standing on this convergence point and wearing the Otherworld-Viewing Device (VR unit), can enter the parallel world and communicate with the girl.
Together, they cooperate to solve the puzzle of restoring the star's power so she may be able to leave.

Character

Game Concept

Although sight is highly intuitive in VR, the same cannot be said for most other aspects, leading to irritation from clumsy controls.
We designed this game around directing a character through glances to circumvent this and change that annoyance into a game element.

How to play.

Match the red dot in the center of the screen to the object you are interested in, and its outline will be circled.
The girl will then examine and move the object for the player.
Through trial and error, you can solve the mystery and lead the girl to escape from the planet.

Operation.

Can be played with HMD only, no controller.
Hold down the SHIFT key to start the game to set the resolution/quality.

Controller operation

Keyboard Operation Options

Operation description: M/ESC
Recenter: R/ENTER
Snap Turn: ←/→
Crouch: ROLLUP／ROLLDOWN
Skip previous action: SHIFT
Switch subtitles: C/TAB
MOVE: WADX
Fix focus: SPACE
Hint mode: H/DEL

Saving/Deleting Data

This game has an autosave feature.
Restart game before deleteing “SingleFragmentVersion_SaveData.json” stored as below.
%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\jitensyasougyou\Tale of the Fragmented Star_ Four Puzzling Pieces

Staff

Concept Art: Irohamu

Object Modeling: ばね＠まじめもでら (Vane @ Majimemodera) / 銀獅 (Ginjishi) / しえら(Sierra)
Character Animation: ポンポコP (Ponpoko P) / フレディ (Freddy)
Character Texture Setting: SoraTokikaze
Casting Assistance: アーツビジョン株式会社 (ARTSTVISION)

summary.핵심플레이: 화면 중앙의 빨간 점을 관심 있는 사물에 맞춰 소녀에게 조사와 이동을 지시하고, 시행착오를 통해 별의 힘을 복원하는 퍼즐을 풀어 소녀가 별을 떠날 수 있도록 돕는다.
summary.특징: 부서진 별에 남겨진 소녀와 평행세계의 플레이어가 협력하는 VR 전용 작품으로, 컨트롤러 없이 HMD와 시선만으로 캐릭터를 조작하도록 설계되었다.

name: Second Dimension RetroPak Vol. 1
input:
About this game
The Second Dimension RetroPak Vol. 1 brings the Second Dimension NES library to the PC - you'll get 7 games with this collection!
Game List

- AO: If you like puzzle games and you're up for a challenge, AO is the game for you. The objective is to roll the brick around the game board and drop it through the goal pit.

- Beer Slinger: Can you survive your first week as a bartender? You'll need to serve your customers the correct beer with the swiftness.

- Blow'em Out: You'll have to blow out all of the candles on your cake while avoiding angry fireballs and flames in this festive platforming adventure.

- Family Picross: Family Picross is a picture crossword puzzle game featuring over 100 puzzles. Family Picross will keep you entertained for hours!

- Get'em Gary: The neighborhood ruffian has gone on a rampage and started destroying the buildings in Westspring Manor. Equipped with the Mystical Squeegee of Maintenance, Gary is the only one who can repair the carnage caused by Rusty. Can you repair the windows and close the shutters before time runs out?

- NES Virus Cleaner: The NES console has become infected by Virii, so it's up to Clik to clean out the viruses once and for all. You'll need to make your way through each of the NES hardware components, facing enemies along the way.

- Perfect Pair: You'll have to collect hearts in order to give these 2 love birds their happy ending.

summary.장르: 액션, 어드벤처, 캐주얼, 인디, 전략, 퍼즐
summary.핵심플레이: 블록 굴리기 퍼즐, 픽로스, 손님 응대, 플랫폼 이동 등 7종의 게임을 개별적으로 플레이하며 각 게임의 목표를 달성한다. 예를 들어 블록을 굴려 구멍에 떨어뜨리거나 100개 이상의 픽처 크로스워드 퍼즐을 풀고, 시간 내에 창문을 수리한다.
summary.특징: Second Dimension의 NES용 게임 7종을 PC로 모은 컬렉션으로, AO, Beer Slinger, Blow'em Out, Family Picross, Get'em Gary, NES Virus Cleaner, Perfect Pair가 포함된다.

name: Tompi Jones
input:
"Tompi Jones" is a fun old style platform game in 2.5D where you will help Tompi across six worlds: the Aztec Pyramid, the Enchanted Forest, the Kingdom of Arkan, the Mysterious Jungle, the Dark Cemetery and the Fortress of Edom.



Tompi can walk, jump, roll on the ground, he can plan with the propeller he has in his hat, throw many types of projectile weapons, defend himself with a shield, fight with a sword, use a jetpack, climb the lianas, cling to ceilings, climb walls and jump between walls.



He can also use special items as stop the time, become invisible, super speed, enhance his projectile weapons or use the invulnerability.



Collect all the secret pieces and coins scattered throughout the levels to improve your skills, and to buy and improve your weapons and special items.



The game has an Online World Ranking. If you get enough coins you will be in the top 50!.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Tompi를 조작해 걷기, 점프, 구르기, 벽 오르기, 밧줄 타기 등으로 여섯 개 월드의 레벨을 진행한다. 투척 무기와 검, 방패, 제트팩을 사용해 전투하고, 레벨에 흩어진 비밀 조각과 코인을 모아 능력·무기·특수 아이템을 강화하거나 구매한다.
summary.특징: 아즈텍 피라미드, 마법의 숲, 어두운 묘지 등 여섯 개 테마 월드를 배경으로 한 2.5D 구성이며, 시간 정지·투명화·초고속·무적 등의 특수 아이템과 온라인 월드 랭킹 시스템을 제공한다.

name: Flower in Us
input:
Flower in Us is a short, story-driven mystery adventure that invites players to unravel hidden secrets.



The first thing you notice is the darkness of the basement as you awaken, your memory wiped clean by a brutal attack. Nearby, a young woman is tied up, her eyes filled with a familiarity you can’t place – she seems to know who you are, but you don’t remember her.



Explore the basement, examine the objects around you, and search for clues that might lead to your escape from this mysterious place. If you’re unsure where to start, try talking to the girl. She may hold unexpected insights.



Can you break free from the cycle of this basement and uncover the dark secrets of your past? And will you unravel the truth behind the girl's hidden darkness, forging a genuine bond with her along the way?

summary.핵심플레이: 지하실을 탐색하며 주변 사물을 조사하고 단서를 찾아 탈출을 시도한다. 묶여 있는 여성과 대화하며 정보를 얻을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 기억을 잃은 채 지하실에서 깨어난 주인공이 자신의 과거와 여성이 감춘 비밀을 밝혀가는 짧은 스토리 중심의 게임이다.

name: 东方龙华传 - The Gatekeeper of Scarlet's Mansion
input:
-
A Touhou doujin STG game where you play as Hong Meiling, the gatekeeper of the Scarlet Devil Mansion.

-
This game might feel different from other STG games you've played as you can't shoot bullets. Instead, rely on your fists, fairy maids, and powerful Spell Cards to fight.

-
Given this unique mechanic, it's recommended to follow the in-game full tutorial to master the controls, the scoring techniques, and other details (a brief tutorial is also available for players who prefer shorter ones).

-
No life stock limit. As long as the head maid's mood doesn't hit zero, you can't Game Over no matter how many times you get hit.

-
Featuring 40+2 waves of meticulously designed enemies. Each session lasts about 38 minutes.

-
In your first session, get familiar with the game. Second session, unleash your creativity and design a high-scoring route. Third session and beyond, keep refining your strategies. Perfect for players who enjoy planning their own route!

-
If you prefer, you can enable bullet invulnerability in the settings—then no need to overthink, just charge in and attack!

summary.핵심플레이: Scarlet Devil Mansion의 문지기 Hong Meiling을 조작해 탄막을 쏘는 대신 주먹, 요정 메이드, 스펠 카드로 적과 싸운다. 40+2 웨이브의 적을 상대하며 한 세션은 약 38분간 진행된다.
summary.특징: 동방 프로젝트 기반의 도진 슈팅 게임으로, 라이프 스톡 제한이 없고 헤드 메이드의 기분 수치가 0이 되지 않는 한 게임 오버되지 않는다. 반복 플레이로 고득점 루트를 설계하도록 설계되었으며, 설정에서 탄막 무적을 활성화할 수 있다.

name: Phantasie Memorial Set
input:
PHANTASIE I:

When sorcery ruled, and trolls and minotaurs still walked this Earth, a party of six intrepid adventurers set out to find the Nine Rings and use them to destroy the Dark Lord. This is your quest. This is your... Phantasie.

A multiple-character role-playing game, PHANTASIE transports you to the medieval isle of Gelnor for the adventure of your dreams. You command a group of one to six characters with such roles as monk, priest, wizard, ranger, thief, or fighter. Your companions need not be human; they may be gnomes, elves, orcs, or lizardmen — just to name a few exotic races.
With this motley crew, you search the lands for the Nine Rings to help you wipe out the scourge of Gelnor — the Dark Lord and his evil minions. You'll map out new terrain, explore maze-like dungeons, solve puzzles, learn spells, gain experience, and battle countless monsters. In every town you visit, you can recruit new members to replace lost or unneeded comrades.

Beautiful 90s color graphics and a spell-binding storyline suspend reality and launch you into our magical world. No computer-carrying adventurer will want to miss out on the glorious excitement and enchanting experience that is PHANTASIE.

PHANTASIE II:

For no reason other than to embellish his title, the Dark Lord Nickademus fashioned an evil orb. With it, he cast a curse on a beautiful island and enslaved its people. Now, six travelers brave his wrath to find and destroy his nefarious handiwork in… Phantasie II.

A NEW ADVENTURE BEGINS...

Your quest to remove the evil warlock's curse will be no easy task since there are precious few clues. All you know is that locating the orb requires a danger-filled search of a vast wilderness and of dungeons, a trip to the Astral Plane and the Netherworld — wherever they are.

You command a band of one to six adventurers, each endowed with the skills of a monk, priest. wizard, ranger, thief, or fighter. You can recruit new members to replace unneeded or fallen comrades. During this quest, you'll help your heroes gather treasure, solve puzzles, learn spells, and battle the Dark Lord's countless hordes. With all these magical distractions and obstructions, don't forget that finding the orb will do you no good. You'll still have to find a way to destroy it!

IMPORTANT: Note that Phantasie II was never released for PC, and we had to use the Apple II emulator to make this game playable on Windows. Thus, when asked to “INSERT DUNGEON DISK AND PRESS A KEY” in Phantasie II, please ensure to press F5 to continue playing.

PHANTASIE III:The Wrath of Nikademus

The Final Confrontation Against The Dark Lord!

Phantasie III: The Wrath of Nikademus is a fantasy adventure game far greater in scope, complexity, and challenge in the world of Phantasie.
This time, the Dark Lord Nikademus has set his evil sights on conquering — not only an island — but the entire world! He must be stopped, and you've been chosen to undertake this difficult and dangerous quest. Assemble and guide a band of six brave souls (human and otherwise) to search for and destroy Nikademus. Your group will traverse an entire continent, battling the Dark Lord's ugly hordes and exploring dungeons for clues that will ultimately lead you to Nikademus — and to the Final Confrontation.

Travel to the astral Planes of Light and Darkness where you will meet some of the most powerful beings that inhabit the Phantasie Universe — including the legendary Lord Wood. From these encounters, you hope to gain the knowledge and power with which to destroy the Dark Lord.
This pivotal game boasts a number of new and improved features. Bows and arrows and ever more potent spells have been added to the long list of weapons. During combat, you can move each character to the front, middle, or back of the party. You can also aim your spells at different ranks of the enemy. You determine which skills an individual character should improve on as he gains experience. Wounds are specified by body location and extent of injury.
You'll enjoy the enhanced graphics display of characters and monsters, and the increased speed of play as you travel across the wilderness and dungeons.  The Wrath of Nikademus promises a spell-binding storyline with enough twists and turns to satisfy your wildest fantasies!

summary.핵심플레이: 1~6명으로 구성된 파티를 편성해 대륙과 던전을 탐험하고, 지형을 지도화하며 퍼즐을 풀고 주문을 익히면서 몬스터와 전투를 벌인다. 마을에서 새로운 동료를 모집해 파티를 교체할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 수도사, 성직자, 마법사, 레인저, 도둑, 전사 등의 역할과 인간·놈·엘프·오크·리자드맨 등 다양한 종족을 조합할 수 있는 판타지 세계 Gelnor를 배경으로 한 시리즈 모음이다. 3편에서는 활과 화살, 전열 배치, 적 대열 지정 공격, 부위별 부상 표시 등의 시스템이 추가되었으며, 2편은 원래 PC 미출시작으로 Apple II 에뮬레이터를 통해 Windows에서 플레이할 수 있게 수록되었다.

name: Malazard: Magic Defense
input:
Malazard: Magic Defense is an action-filled tower defense game, where you are able to step into the role of a wizard.

With the help of Virtual Reality, the game's main purpose is to give you the feel of wielding destructive sorcery in pair with a fast-paced combat system. Besides your magical abilities it is still important to be ready to dodge an attack any time in order to prepare your own.

In the time of need, demonic creatures are sieging the last resort of the planet. You are the only hope to keep this world from getting torn apart!
We need a powerful mage immediately, more than ever!

(HTC Vive required)

summary.핵심플레이: 마법사가 되어 파괴적인 주문을 사용해 밀려오는 적을 막아내며, 빠른 전투 속에서 공격을 피하고 반격을 준비한다.
summary.특징: HTC Vive 기반 가상현실로 마법을 직접 시전하는 방식이며, 악마 생명체가 행성의 마지막 거점을 포위하는 세계관을 배경으로 한다.

name: Fairy Tale TD 2 童话塔防2
input:
This game has a high level of difficulty and is suitable for people who enjoy using their brains and challenges. Come and test your intelligence.

this is a 3D cartoon style tower defense game with many levels. At the beginning of each level, a small amount of resources are given, and more resources can be obtained by killing monsters.

The health and movement speed of each monster in the game are different. When they have an energy shield, their health will increase

Pumpkin turrets deal higher damage to shields, while other turrets deal lower damage to shields

There is an explosive magic in the game that can deal damage to a group of monsters, with damage to high health monsters being percentage damage

features:

6 upgradable defense turrets

1 magic

Skill tree that can be used to upgrade turrets and magic

16 types of monsters (8 ordinary monsters+8 ordinary monsters with shields)

25 levels

summary.핵심플레이: 각 레벨에서 제공되는 자원과 몬스터 처치로 얻는 자원을 사용해 방어 포탑을 배치·업그레이드하고, 서로 다른 체력과 이동 속도를 가진 몬스터의 진행을 막는다. 스킬 트리로 포탑과 마법을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 3D 카툰 스타일 그래픽에 25개의 레벨을 갖추고 있으며, 에너지 실드를 가진 몬스터는 체력이 증가한다. 호박 포탑은 실드에 높은 피해를 주고, 고체력 몬스터에게 비율 피해를 주는 폭발 마법이 있다. 6종의 업그레이드 가능한 포탑, 1종의 마법, 16종의 몬스터가 등장한다.

name: KILLCOLOR
input: Take control of a triangle ship thing that really does not like colors in this top-down arcade shooter with rougelite elements and kill procedurally-animated color enemies to unlock upgrades to kill more colors

summary.핵심플레이: 삼각형 형태의 함선을 조종해 색깔 적을 처치하고, 이를 통해 업그레이드를 해제하며 더 많은 적을 제거하는 아케이드 방식으로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 절차적으로 애니메이션되는 색깔 기반의 적이 등장하며, 로그라이트 요소를 통한 업그레이드 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Sofie: The Echoes™
input:
UNCOVER THE PAST. FACE THE DARKNESS. FIND YOUR FAMILY.

Embark on an emotionally charged, third-person action-adventure where you step into the life of Sofie, a strong mother and determined college professor on a relentless journey to find her missing husband and son. In a world teetering between haunting reality and mystifying echoes of the past, Sofie confronts twisted landscapes, dangerous enemies, and secrets buried deep within her family’s history.

Narrative-Driven Experience

Delve into a story that brings you to the edge, with a powerful narrative that unfolds as Sofie battles both physical foes and inner demons. Guided by the memories of her loved ones and her unbreakable resolve, every step Sofie takes unravels dark mysteries that push her closer to the truth – and to the choices that will ultimately shape her family’s fate.

summary.핵심플레이: 3인칭 시점에서 주인공 Sofie를 조작해 실종된 남편과 아들을 찾아 여정을 이어가며, 적과 싸우고 가족의 과거에 얽힌 비밀을 파헤친다.
summary.특징: 현실과 과거의 잔상이 뒤섞인 세계를 배경으로 한 서사 중심 게임으로, 대학교수이자 어머니인 Sofie의 이야기가 진행되며 그녀의 선택이 가족의 운명에 영향을 미친다.

name: Brick Breaker Infinity
input:
In Brick Breaker, players can control a paddle to bounce a ball and hit bricks. Each brick has a different color representing its level of difficulty. Breaking bricks can make power-up pills drop, granting players different abilities. Clearing all bricks allows players to advance to the next level.

One unique feature of this game is that in subsequent levels, the bricks are randomly arranged, and there are unlimited levels to challenge players. Try to achieve higher scores and see how far you can go in this endless brick-breaking adventure!

Players must have quick reflexes and precise control to guide the ball to hit the bricks effectively. Utilize power-ups strategically to overcome tougher challenges as the game progresses. Compete with friends or challenge yourself to beat your own high score in this addictively fun and engaging game.

Brick Breaker offers a mix of classic arcade gameplay and modern challenge, making it a perfect choice for players looking for a casual yet exciting gaming experience. Are you ready to test your skills and see how far you can go in this brick-breaking adventure? Let's play!

summary.핵심플레이: 패들을 조작해 공을 튕겨 색상별로 난이도가 다른 벽돌을 부수고, 모든 벽돌을 없애면 다음 레벨로 진행한다. 벽돌을 깨면 다양한 능력을 주는 파워업 아이템이 떨어진다.
summary.특징: 이후 레벨은 벽돌 배치가 무작위로 구성되며 레벨 수에 제한이 없어 계속 높은 점수에 도전할 수 있다. 파워업을 활용해 진행할수록 어려워지는 난이도에 대응하며 자신이나 친구의 점수와 경쟁한다.

name: 7D Game （VR for VIVE）
input: Essentially it will be a social game based on players' own creation, where players can make their own game rules in their own created WORLDs and share the WORLDs to everyone else to play or clear through social networking services. You can see it as a VR version Minecraft or Besiege, but more than them.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어가 자신만의 WORLD를 제작하고 그 안에서 자체적인 게임 규칙을 만든다. 제작한 WORLD를 SNS를 통해 다른 플레이어들과 공유하여 함께 플레이하거나 클리어한다.
summary.특징: HTC VIVE용 VR 게임으로, Minecraft나 Besiege와 유사한 플레이어 창작 기반 소셜 게임을 지향한다.

name: Trivia Vault: Art Trivia
input:
Now Available

About the Game
Welcome to the Trivia Vault contestant! Play as a contestant in a gameshow called Trivia Vault Art Trivia and bring your thinking hat. Answer art trivia questions as quickly as you can, the faster you answer the higher the cash value. Correct answers lock in the digit code for the vault, 10 correct answers cracks the vault and awards bonus cash. Track your progress and aim for higher scores to accomplish higher ranks. Challenge yourself to beat your high score by playing multiple times and completing all 25 levels with a total of 250 unique trivia questions.

Features:

3 Codebreaker Lifelines
25 Vaults to Crack(levels)
250 Unique Trivia Questions
Timer Based Questions
Obtain Cash Multipliers Based on Correct Answers in a Level
3 Ranks of Accomplishment per Level

summary.핵심플레이: 게임쇼 참가자가 되어 예술 관련 퀴즈 문제에 답하며, 빠르게 정답을 맞출수록 높은 현금 가치를 얻는다. 정답은 금고의 숫자 코드를 잠그고, 10개의 정답을 맞추면 금고를 열어 보너스 현금을 획득한다.
summary.특징: 250개의 고유 퀴즈 문제로 구성된 25개의 레벨, 3개의 코드브레이커 라이프라인, 타이머 기반 문제, 정답 수에 따른 현금 배수, 레벨당 3단계 등급 시스템을 제공한다.

name: Timothy Leary's Mind Mirror
input:
Timothy Leary Wants to Take You on a Mind Adventure
From the mind of Dr. Timothy Leary comes Mind Mirror, a trippy journey through your own mind.

Mind Mirror is not just a game, it is a valuable tool to help you explore your own mind, make decisions, and to envision your ideal self.

Play it by yourself or with a group of people to learn more about yourself and others.

Mind Mirror is a fun and nostalgic blast from the 80s, while still serving as a useful tool for self-reflection and exploring your own personality!

No matter what, we guarantee that Mind Mirror will be unlike any game you have ever played!

About Dr. Timothy Leary
Dr. Timothy Leary was a legendary and controversial psychologist, author, revolutionary thinker, and pop icon mostly known for his experimentation with LSD and other psychedelic drugs. What many people don't know is that Dr. Leary was a serious researcher, educator, and thinker. In the 80s, Dr. Leary had moved on to exploring cyberculture and the potential of computers and digital technology for the examination of personality and to expand the mind. Out of the many ideas Dr. Leary had for software, Mind Mirror is the only completed product.

"I think of this game as a thought processor, headware for the computer generation. It allows you to interface with virtually any concept of personality, and helps put your thoughts into digital form. Try playing with your friends or loved ones. Gather around the firelight of the computer, and the chances are that you'll learn more about them in 5 minutes than you ever thought would be possible in a lifetime"
--Dr. Timothy Leary

From the Original Mind Mirror Packaging

Tune In, Turn On, Boot Up
Mind Mirror is an innovative, dynamic game bringing a whole concept to "personality" software. Written by Dr. Timothy Leary, famous Harvard psychologist, author, and lecturer, Mind Mirror combines the science of Leary's psychometric studies with his own inimitable wit and charm. Part tool, part game, and part philosopher on a disk, Mind Mirror is a provocative game perfect for parties or social gatherings.

The Rating Games

Rate any person, place, or concept with the numeric rating scales. Mind Mirror evaluates your ratings, gives you a brief text analysis, and plots your input on comparison charts called Mind Maps. You can even use the ratings scales to create your own characters and personalities.

Try comparing yourself to your ideal self, yourself to a friend or loved one, even Reagan to Gorbachev. Be creative, have a partner rate you while you rate yourself ... you'll be surprised at the differences.

Mind Play & Mind Tools

You can play the game using either Mind Play or Mind Tools. In Mind Play, applications are ligh-hearted, allowing you to explore topics and celebrities from areas like T.V., films, athletics, and more. In Mind Tools, applications are somewhat more serious, focusing on Psychological Insight, Career Productivity, and Education.

Life Simulations

Life Simulations gives you the opportunity to take any of the subjects of personalities used in the rating games on humorous, interactive text odysseys written by Dr. Leary.

You can play dozens of different life simulations in any of four psychological realms. For example, enter the realm of emotional insight and go back to kindergarten to face the class bully. Or try the realm of social interaction and spend an evening in a punk rock bar or a snooty bankers club.

summary.핵심플레이: 수치 척도를 사용해 인물, 장소, 개념 등을 평가하면 게임이 이를 분석해 짧은 텍스트 해설과 'Mind Map'이라는 비교 차트로 보여준다. 자신과 이상적인 자아, 친구나 지인 등을 비교하거나 직접 성격과 캐릭터를 만들 수 있다.
summary.특징: 심리학자 Timothy Leary가 1980년대에 제작한 성격 탐구 소프트웨어로, 가벼운 주제를 다루는 Mind Play와 심리 통찰·직업·교육에 초점을 둔 Mind Tools 모드를 제공하며, 네 가지 심리 영역에서 진행되는 텍스트 기반 Life Simulations를 포함한다.

name: Roman Empire vs. Barbarians
input:
Defend the grandeur of the Roman Empire against relentless Barbarian hordes in this immersive tower defense game. Assume the role of a Roman commander tasked with safeguarding the empire's borders from waves of invading enemies.

As the protector of Rome, strategically position your defenses along the frontier, erect mighty fortifications, and deploy disciplined Roman soldiers. Plan your defensive layout with precision, exploiting the strengths of each unit to repel the Barbarian onslaught.

Upgrade your defenses, enhance your troops' abilities, and research new technologies to stay one step ahead of the Barbarians. Unlock specialized Roman units to unleash devastating counterattacks.

Witness the spectacle of intense battles as the Barbarians relentlessly assault your fortifications. Marvel at the clash of steel and the thunderous roar of catapults as you command your troops to hold the line and protect the heart of the empire. Coordinate defensive strategies, adapt to enemy tactics, and make strategic decisions that will determine the fate of Rome.

Immerse yourself in a variety of historically inspired locations, from the misty forests of Germania to the sun-drenched deserts of Gaul. Confront legendary Barbarian warlords, and overcome their unique challenges to ensure the survival of the empire.

Experience the thrill of defending Rome in a tower defense game that combines strategic planning, resource management, and thrilling combat. Can you stand firm against the relentless Barbarian hordes and safeguard the glory of the Roman Empire? Prepare your defenses, rally your troops, and embark on an unforgettable battle to preserve the empire's legacy.

Gameplay:

Roman Empire vs. Barbarians is a base defense game that challenges you to destroy the enemy’s base.

Barbarians keep expanding all over the place and you’ve been summoned as the hero who’s going to stop them. You’re provided with a Roman Empire tower that comes with a powerful catapult and a team of warriors. Will that be enough to stop the barbarian invasion?

You can easily tell that the game is pretty straightforward in the beginning. But as you progress further, it can be challenging.

Features:
- Pay for an army of warriors to protect your lands from the invading barbarian hordes
- Collect coins and increase the capacity of your treasury
- End the threat by destroying the enemy base
- Play through all 50 stages
- Survival mode

summary.핵심플레이: 로마군 지휘관이 되어 국경에 방어 시설과 병력을 배치하고, 진격하는 바바리안을 막으며 최종적으로 적 기지를 파괴한다. 코인을 모아 방어를 강화하고 병력을 배치하는 것이 핵심 루프다.
summary.특징: 로마 제국과 바바리안의 대립을 배경으로 하며, 게르마니아 숲과 갈리아 사막 등 역사에서 착안한 지역들을 무대로 한다. 카타펄트를 갖춘 로마 타워, 병력·기술 업그레이드, 50개 스테이지와 서바이벌 모드를 제공한다.

name: 逃家少女〜蜜梨與巧克力〜
input:
On my usual way home, in the corner of the street, You found a kitten waiting for adoption... but not only! There was a girl?

The reason behind her running away home appears to be more than just a whim. What follows is a heart-pounding cohabitation, and a gradual unveiling of the girl’s mysterious background. The once quiet and ordinary life takes a dramatic turn.

Where will this forced cohabitation, and the "dream," ultimately lead?

Main Character - Mili

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공이 집을 나온 소녀 밀리(Mili)와 동거하며 스토리를 진행하고, 소녀의 배경과 사연을 점차 밝혀 나간다.
summary.특징: 길거리에서 만난 가출 소녀와의 강제적인 동거를 다루며, 소녀의 숨겨진 배경과 '꿈'을 중심으로 이야기가 전개된다.

name: UDONGEIN X
input:
Lunarians Are Up to Something Again!
A small group of Moon Rabbits has crash landed in Gensokyo. They have been left on their own! It's up to Reisen to (reluctantly) rescue each one of her former comrades and beat some sense into Lunarians once and for all. Do your best, Udon-chan!
14 Unique and Engaging Boss Fights
Every Boss has a gimmick of their own and requires a different strategy! In addition to dodging bullets, you have to respect each Boss' different mechanics if you want to have a chance at winning.
Make Reisen Stronger!
You can invest Power Up items you get from Stages and Bosses into upgrades to make Reisen more powerful. This ranges anywhere from increasing max health to giving you the ability to erase entire screens worth of bullets in your path! Of course, you can ignore this system if you want to challenge yourself.
3 Difficulty Settings
Feel like the game is too hard? You can set the difficulty to Easy if you want a more traditional platformer experience with less bullets on screen. Alternatively you can choose Lunatic for a true test of skill and patience. DISCLAIMER: You have to beat the game at least once to unlock Lunatic difficulty. Changing a difficulty setting requires a reset of your current playthrough.
An Additional Mode
SURVIVAL is a Boss Rush mode where you can select different perks in between fights. It will get progressively harder, so stay sharp! Who knows, maybe if you get a big enough win streak, you might unlock something interesting...

summary.핵심플레이: 레이센을 조작해 스테이지를 진행하며 탄막을 회피하고 각기 다른 공략법이 필요한 14종의 보스와 전투한다. 스테이지와 보스에서 얻는 파워업 아이템을 최대 체력 증가나 화면 탄막 제거 같은 업그레이드에 투자할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 동방 프로젝트의 겐소쿄 세계관과 문토끼 캐릭터를 배경으로 하며, Easy·Normal·Lunatic 3단계 난이도와 전투 사이에 퍽을 고르는 보스 러시 방식의 SURVIVAL 모드를 제공한다. Lunatic 난이도는 최소 1회 클리어 후 해금된다.

name: BANNED TAPES
input:
You're a filmmaker and you recently purchased a box of VHS tapes at a flea market.

Now you need to look through them and select tapes on which occur supernatural, violent, inexplicable scenes, in general everything that can interest the viewer.

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 영화 제작자가 되어 벼룩시장에서 구입한 VHS 테이프 상자를 살펴보고, 초자연적이거나 폭력적이거나 설명할 수 없는 장면이 담긴 테이프를 선별한다.
summary.특징: VHS 테이프 영상을 검토하며 시청자의 흥미를 끌 만한 장면을 골라내는 방식으로 진행된다.

name: Giraffe Town
input:
Take control of a giraffe who has had enough of being held back in life
by his weird feet as you slide your way through the town in a courageous
pursuit of love.

Experience:

- Motivation

- Determination

- Dedication

- Devastation

- Frustration

- Elimination

Welcome to Giraffe Town...

Created entirely by Samer Khatib, Giraffe Town aims to deliver a unique, one-of-a-kind, memorable indie game experience presented with an eye-catching visual style, lovely sounds, and a beautiful story.

Developer note:
Putting my egotistical persona aside, I would like to say a few more things since I am fortunate enough for having the opportunity of publishing my second game here on Steam. This isn't relevant to the game page but, I would just like to say that this is a very special game that comes from a place of true passion, respect and a love for the art form that is video games. After releasing my first game on here in 2016, I decided to take a step back for a bit to learn more and really improve upon my skill sets to become the best game developer that I could be. Games should have a certain level of polish and quality to them and I now understand the importance of that. Because just like grandma's cookies, games should be made with love and care. Nobody wants to eat sloppily made, poorly put together rushed out cookies. My experience developing this game over the course of nearly 2 years has taught me a lot and I feel that I have greatly matured as a video game developer and artist. To me, Giraffe Town is much more than another one of my silly ideas. It is a personal love letter expressing how I feel about indie games and what indie games are to me. And that is crazy, over-the-top, extremly ridiculous and very ambitious ideas that would never be accepted or created by most mainstream triple-A developers. This is where indie devs come in. Thanks for stopping by and here's to independent artist everywhere! I look forward to bringing more of my ideas to life in the future. Enjoy!

-Samer Khatib (Snowconesolid)
(Greatest independent game developer of all time and space)

summary.핵심플레이: 기린을 조작해 마을을 미끄러지듯 이동하며 사랑을 찾아가는 여정을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 기린을 주인공으로 한 스토리 중심 인디 게임으로, 개발자 Samer Khatib가 단독으로 제작했으며 독자적인 비주얼 스타일과 사운드를 갖추고 있다.

name: Awakening
input:
Awakening is powerful rapid application authoring tool for efficiently creating interactive 3D content. With it, you can easily creating eye-catching interactive 3D presentations, animated 3D web, brief film, game...



Awakening 3D solution include three modules: Scene Editor ( Awakening.exe ), Scene Player ( WindsPlayer.exe ) and Web3D Player ( supports IE & Firefox family ).



Awakening presentations are typically used for making short movies, product and architectural visualizations, e.g. for sales, support and e-learning purposes, or, for product branding or prototyping.



* Compact & flexible runtime，you can custom features by c++ sdk, or extend script functions.



* You can still use Fixed Function Pipeline to get high-performance rendering on low-end video cards, this features especially useful in VR ( VR will be supported soon ).

summary.장르: 3D 저작 도구, 애니메이션 및 모델링, 유틸리티
summary.핵심플레이: Scene Editor로 인터랙티브 3D 콘텐츠를 제작하고, Scene Player 및 Web3D Player를 통해 이를 재생·배포한다. 3D 프레젠테이션, 애니메이션 웹 콘텐츠, 짧은 영상, 게임 등을 만든다.
summary.특징: Scene Editor, Scene Player, Web3D Player(IE·Firefox 계열 지원) 세 모듈로 구성되며, C++ SDK와 스크립트 함수 확장을 통한 기능 커스터마이즈를 지원한다. 저사양 그래픽 카드에서 고정 기능 파이프라인을 사용할 수 있고 VR 지원이 예정되어 있다.

name: Sunset of Death
input: Sunset of Death is a cooperative survival horror game where you can play not only as a human, but also as a demon. Explore locations, look for useful items for survival, help your friends, survive until dawn and save the whole team, or destroy all people and make sure they are dead before sunrise.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 인간 또는 악마로 플레이하며, 장소를 탐험하고 생존에 필요한 아이템을 찾는다. 인간은 동료를 도와 새벽까지 생존해 팀을 구하고, 악마는 해가 뜨기 전에 모든 인간을 제거하는 것을 목표로 한다.
summary.특징: 인간과 악마 진영으로 나뉘어 진행되는 멀티플레이 구조로, 생존과 파괴라는 상반된 목표를 두고 대립한다.

name: Neon Shadow
input:
Neon Shadow is a fast paced Cyber Punk FPS inspired by classic shooters. Suit up and grab your shotgun. Your mission: Save humanity from the dark mechanoids who have taken control of your space station and soon the rest of the galaxy!

Everything in the Steam version has been improved from the controls to the graphics, we would like to think of it as Neon Shadow 2.0. Please shout if there are additional features you would like to see!

Planned additions so far are; split-screen up to 4, chat functions, player names (over head) and Tobii support.



Features:

• Multiplayer.

• Old school first person shooter game-play.

• Single player campaign.

• Online multiplayer death-match mode

• LAN multiplayer death-match.

• Cyber Punk soundtrack from Abducted by Sharks.

summary.핵심플레이: 샷건 등의 무기를 들고 우주 정거장을 장악한 기계 생명체와 전투하며 인류를 구하는 싱글플레이 캠페인을 진행한다. 온라인 및 LAN 데스매치 멀티플레이 모드도 지원한다.
summary.특징: 고전 슈터에서 영향을 받은 사이버펑크 세계관을 배경으로 하며, Abducted by Sharks의 사이버펑크 사운드트랙을 사용한다. Steam 버전은 조작과 그래픽이 개선되었고 최대 4인 분할 화면, 채팅, 머리 위 플레이어 이름, Tobii 지원 등이 추가 예정으로 계획되어 있다.

name: 无尽星海(Endless Stars)
input:
Warm tip: this game was made in junior high school in the past. Now it's just released in the first year of senior high school

Language setting: "设置" ->"English"

---------------------

In the 32nd century, the breakthrough of hyperspace technology enabled mankind to get rid of the limit of light speed, leave the solar system and the first 50 interstellar colonies, and move towards the further unknown deep space. Shortly after the hyperspace technology was put into use, the Earth Federal Government invested heavily to set up a fleet of starships equipped with hyperspace engines to explore the galaxies 100 light years away that were hard to reach by previous sub light speed spacecraft. However, due to the course deviation caused by the failure of the central computer, the starship you command did not reach the target galaxy, but headed in an unknown direction. You will play the captain of one of the starships. On the voyage, you may encounter various emergencies, cosmic wonders and cultural relics. In addition, exploration of deep space and colonization require resources, so you need to collect resources on various planets to meet your needs and finally find your way home and explore the forbidden area of the universe.





Resource system: the most critical resources are metal and hydrogen. Metal can build facilities and repair ship bodies. Hydrogen is the main source of energy for starships. Other resources such as methane can also produce energy, but the efficiency is extremely low and can only be used as backup energy.



Construction system: on a starship, you can use metal to build or upgrade your facilities. Different facilities have different functions.



Science and technology system: in the late stage of extremely abundant resources, you can use a large number of metals to study science and technology to greatly facilitate your navigation





Inspiration: this game was originally designed because there was no money to buy "Out there Omega", so I wanted to imitate a similar game

summary.핵심플레이: 우주선 함장이 되어 은하를 항해하며 금속, 수소 등 자원을 수집하고, 이를 사용해 시설을 건설·업그레이드하며 항로를 이어간다. 항해 중 발생하는 각종 돌발 상황과 우주 현상, 유물을 마주하며 귀환로와 우주의 금지 구역을 탐사한다.
summary.특징: 32세기 초광속 하이퍼스페이스 기술을 배경으로, 항로 이탈로 미지의 방향으로 향하게 된 우주선을 다룬다. 금속과 수소를 중심으로 한 자원 시스템, 시설 건설 시스템, 후반부 자원을 소모해 항해를 돕는 과학기술 연구 시스템을 포함한다.

name: Victim 10 PM
input:
Highlights

About the Game

Calling the emergency room on the 13th of every month is no longer a good choice. The 911 emergency room system has been hacked and has become a human resource for a satanist doctor. The devil wants sacrifices and Doctor W, a slave to the devil, ruthlessly offers innocent people to him. Our player, a journalist, aims to escape from the hospital and destroy this organization by collecting evidence. Are you ready for this fearful, puzzle-filled and suspenseful struggle?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 기자가 되어 병원에서 탈출하고, 증거를 수집해 조직을 파괴하는 것을 목표로 한다. 퍼즐을 풀며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 매달 13일 응급실 시스템이 해킹되어 악마를 숭배하는 의사가 무고한 사람들을 제물로 바치는 세계관을 배경으로 한다. 공포와 퍼즐, 서스펜스 요소가 결합되어 있다.

name: Shiny
input:
IGN: Best Brazilian Game at BGS

IGN Brasil selected Shiny as the best Brazilian game at BGS 2016!

About the Game

Robots can have a heart!
