Left to fend for himself after mankind abandoned the doomed planet Aurora, robot Kramer 227 must find a way to harvest energy and rescue his robotic friends before Aurora crashes into its sun. In his journey, Kramer will probe the planet itself and overcome challenging obstacles, all while trying to conserve his limited life energy to power himself and his friends on their way to safety.

Kramer will gather and share energy with his fellow robots, helping them escape dire situations and predicaments. He will have to jump and explore every platform in every corner of the 20 extensive levels to find all of his friends. Energy is running low on Aurora, so Kramer will have to collect batteries or use generators to recharge, as every action drains his power. Various power-ups collected along the way, such as jetpacks, energy spheres and temperature regulators, can help him on this crucial journey.

Shiny is about saving lives, so it contains no blood or violence.
Features

- Enjoy non-violent, platforming action

- Explore 20 extensive levels.

- Manage your energy levels – the robots’ source of life!

- Make use of cool power-ups found along the way.

summary.핵심플레이: 로봇 Kramer 227을 조작해 20개의 레벨을 점프하고 탐험하며 흩어진 로봇 친구들을 찾아 구출한다. 모든 행동이 에너지를 소모하므로 배터리를 모으거나 발전기를 사용해 충전하며 에너지를 관리한다.
summary.특징: 인류가 떠난 행성 Aurora가 태양과 충돌하기 전 로봇들을 구한다는 설정으로, 유혈이나 폭력 요소가 없다. 제트팩, 에너지 구체, 온도 조절기 등의 파워업을 활용할 수 있다.

name: Valthirian Arc: Hero School Story 2
input:
Valthiria’s mightiest heroes are not born of destiny or prophecy. They were enrolled, trained, and taught in special academies. Hero School Story 2 places you in charge of a hero academy to create the next generation of heroes who will save Valthiria from the dark forces that threaten it. Take command of the faculty, nurture a unique and ever-changing roster of students, forge alliances with the kingdoms who vie for influence, and earn your place among the most prestigious Hero Schools in Valthiria.

Combining the RPG and Simulation genres, in Hero School Story 2 you will manage your students by determining their learning schedules and courses, building their stats and skills to shape them into the heroes you desire. These stats are key when sending your students to fulfill quests from people all over Valthiria, defeating various enemies in strategic turn-based combat and adding to your academy’s renown. Yet there’s no time to rest on laurels – every school year the seniors will graduate and freshmen will enroll, so managing your academy to fit the dynamic roster of students is crucial.

-
Create Your Own Hero Academy
As Principal of the academy, your task is to allocate your students what classes and courses to learn, shaping them into the heroes you want them to become. Will you focus on magical courses and become a school of great wizards, one for mighty warriors, or perhaps a bit of everything? Your management style will determine the kind of quests you can take. To complete harder quests, you need to build specific rosters to solve the challenges.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 영웅 학교의 교장이 되어 학생들의 수업과 과정을 배정하고 능력치와 스킬을 키운다. 육성한 학생들을 퀘스트에 파견해 턴제 전투로 적을 물리치고 학교의 명성을 높인다.
summary.특징: 매 학년마다 상급생은 졸업하고 신입생이 입학해 학생 명단이 지속적으로 변하며, 이에 맞춰 학교를 운영해야 한다. 마법·전투 등 어떤 과정에 집중하느냐에 따라 수행할 수 있는 퀘스트가 달라지고, 왕국들과 동맹을 맺을 수 있다.

name: Ampu-Tea
input:
It’s time for rehabilitation! You’re a recovering amputee, fitted with the latest modern technology. The KS-001 Robo-arm is capable of delicate tasks – if used efficiently.

What better challenge for the son of an Earl than to make tea for his father?

Good luck son.

You'll need it.

summary.핵심플레이: 로봇 팔 KS-001을 조작해 아버지를 위한 차를 만드는 등 섬세한 작업을 수행한다.
summary.특징: 의수를 장착한 회복 중인 절단 환자가 되어 현대 기술이 적용된 로봇 팔로 재활 과정을 겪는 설정을 다룬다.

name: Don't Drown
input:
Dive into the world of Don’t Drown, an underwater precision platformer. Navigate treacherous landscapes and avoid menacing creatures while balancing your oxygen and health. Line your pockets with treasure at the cost of mobility. Race against time, yourself, and others on the global leaderboards.
Underwater Platforming

Traverse through underwater landscapes as a deep sea diver in search of treasure. Being underwater doesn't have to be slow! Use your boost ability to run, swim or sink faster.

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 심해 다이버로서 수중 지형을 이동하며 위험한 생물을 피하고 산소와 체력을 관리한다. 이동성을 희생하는 대가로 보물을 수집하고 부스트 능력으로 더 빠르게 이동한다.
summary.특징: 수중을 배경으로 한 정밀 플랫포머로, 시간과 자신, 그리고 글로벌 리더보드의 다른 플레이어와 경쟁하는 요소를 포함한다.

name: Shinrin-yoku: Forest Meditation and Relaxation
input:
Welcome to Shinrin-yoku Forest Therapy VR experience. Shinrin-yoku, or "Forest Bathing", originated in the 1980s as a relaxation method and restorative healing practice in Japanese medicine. In this experience, you will be transported to a northwestern forest, surrounded by trees, plants, insects and animals. Take in the forest atmosphere and use the tools at your disposal, a stick and flashlight, to interact with the natural world around you, in day or night. Give it a try, it's free!

Features:

- Soothing forest environment, perfect for meditation and relaxation

- Immersive experience with no time limits

- Realistic and interactive wildlife and natural environment

- Immersive sounds

- Triggered day/night cycle. Tap the symbol on the rock to change time of day

- VR controllers become interactive tools, including a stick and flashlight

summary.핵심플레이: 북서부 숲을 배경으로 한 VR 환경에서 나무, 식물, 곤충, 동물 등 자연을 둘러보며 명상하고 휴식한다. 막대기와 손전등 도구를 사용해 주변 환경과 상호작용한다.
summary.특징: 일본 의학의 이완 요법인 신린요쿠(삼림욕)를 바탕으로 하며, 시간 제한 없이 진행된다. 바위의 기호를 눌러 낮과 밤을 전환할 수 있고, VR 컨트롤러가 막대기와 손전등 도구로 사용된다.

name: Redneck Deer Huntin'
input:
Every Day Is Opening Day!

From the creators of Redneck Rampage comes a hunting game that's so real, you'll be expectin' the Game Warden to be checkin' tags! But don't worry, this is All Season, All Weapons, All Thrillin' and Killin' with your helpful local backwoods guide, Leonard.

You'll explore acres and acres of prime habitat, inclduing forest, woodlands, lake, snow park and shooting range - using all your available trackin' skills to follow, find and finish off your prey. Use attractant scent and choose between rifle, shotgun, pistol or crossbow for varying levels of difficulty.

So lock'n'load and git ready for a little Redneck style huntin' fun!
Choice Of Prey

- Deer

- Turkey

- Razorback

- Duck

Fantastic Firepower

- Rifle

- Pistol

- Shotgun

- Crossbow

Realistic Perspective

- Track your game by finding markings and droppings on the terrain

- Walk the terrain; stalk your prey from the hunter's point of view, not overhead

- Use attractant scent to find'em and flush'em

Approved By Real Rednecks

- Starring Burton Gilliam as Leonard

- Display your kill in the Redneck Trophy Room

- Wear sleeveless camo t-shirts

- Hunt, Hunt, Hunt!

When it comes to huntin' real good, who gets more action than a redneck?

summary.핵심플레이: 숲, 삼림, 호수, 설원, 사격장 등 지형을 이동하며 흔적과 배설물을 추적해 사슴, 칠면조, 멧돼지, 오리 등의 사냥감을 찾아 잡는다. 유인 향과 라이플, 산탄총, 권총, 석궁을 사용해 난이도를 조절하며 사냥한다.
summary.특징: Redneck Rampage 제작진이 만든 게임으로, 헤드업 시점이 아닌 사냥꾼 1인칭 시점에서 지형을 걷는다. 가이드 Leonard 역으로 Burton Gilliam이 등장하며, 사냥한 전리품을 Redneck Trophy Room에 전시할 수 있다.

name: Dawn of Marionette
input:
How to Play

* Run "DawnofMarionette.exe" in the game folder.

Game Contents Daily Conversation Part

* Simple instructions to the android
You can instruct androids with words such as "Come here" or "Open the menu".

* Reinforcement and remodeling of androids
The androids can be strengthened and remodeled using the energy gained from battle.
Modifying androids can increase the number of adult scenes you can play.

Game Contents Combat Part

* Defeat enemies to obtain energy used to strengthen and remodel androids.
Basically, the android fights for you, but you can also fight back with the blaster on your right hip.
Enemies may target the player. If you are in danger, give instructions to the android to protect you.

* The Player's System
Blasters can inflict a small amount of damage and paralysis on the enemy. Blaster rounds heal over time.
Once a player is damaged, the barrier disappears, and if the player is damaged without the barrier, the player dies.
Barrier also recovers in time.

Game Contents Adult Part

* Original Adult AI
The android automatically changes play speed and play,
The android will automatically change the play speed and play style, remember the player's preferred play style, and ask the player if he/she wants to change the play style.

* The android can recognize and control the player's voice.
If you say, "Gonna Come" the android will give you the last spurt.
If you say "Comming" the android will ejaculate.
If you say "Fast" the android will increase the speed, and if you say "Slow" the android will slow it down.
You can respond to the android's questions by saying "yes" or "no" or by shaking your head.

* Play Scenes
Currently, there are a total of 50 types of play scenes.　There are two main types: bed and sofa.
Players do not warp when switching from one bet scene to another.
This will reduce the hassle of playing in VR and having to adjust the camera every time the scene changes.

* Kissing function
If the scene allows it, two tongues will automatically appear and kiss each other when their faces are close to each other.
The android will automatically move its tongue. The tongues have a hit point and move when they bump into each other.

* Player's head and hands are judged by the hit points.
The player's head and hands have hit points and do not penetrate the android's body.
The player will not be able to see the contents of the face while kissing.
The android's hair, breasts, and buttocks will shake on the player's hit.
You can also shake her breasts by burying your face in her breasts.

* VR controller operation linkage
When you hold and shake the GripKey on the VR controller during the game, the android will be linked to the movements of the controller.
This function can be changed to toggle.

* Interlocking with the vibration of the VR controller and the electric masturbator
The VR controller vibrates according to the movement of the android and the VR controller.
It also works with an electric masturbator.
(This is a PC-only function and has been tested on the A10 Cyclone SA. )

VR Operation

Left analog stick : Move
Right Analog Stick : Turn
Left analog stick + left trigger key : Height adjustment
Trigger key : Use
Grip Keys : Hold
1, 2, 3, 4 button Tap : mini menu , Switching instructions during battle
1, 2, 3, 4 button press and hold : System Menu

* This software has been developed and tested with MetaQuest2 (Oculus Link) and HTC VIVE.
Operation may differ for other VR devices.

■PC Operation.

WSAD : Move
Mouse : Turn
Space Key Or Shift Key : Height adjustment
Mouse Left : Use
Mouse Right : Grab
F Key Tap : Menu (mini-menu), switch instructions during battle
F Key long press : Menu (system menu)
R Key : show/hide cursor

operating environment

GamingPC
PCVR MetaQuest2(QuestLink)
PCVR HtcVive

Languages Supported

Japanese
English

*This product does not have ChatGPT functionality.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 음성이나 지시로 안드로이드에게 명령을 내리며, 전투에서 얻은 에너지로 안드로이드를 강화·개조한다. 전투는 주로 안드로이드가 맡지만 플레이어도 오른쪽 허리의 블래스터로 적을 공격하고, 배리어가 사라지면 사망할 수 있다.
summary.특징: VR과 PC를 지원하며, 음성 인식으로 성인 장면의 속도와 방식을 조절하는 시스템, 키스·머리·손의 히트 판정, VR 컨트롤러 진동 및 전동 기기 연동 기능을 포함한다. 침대와 소파 두 종류를 중심으로 총 50종의 장면을 제공하며 일본어와 영어를 지원한다.

name: WiccAtriX
input:
Summary: Wiccatrix is a 3D Action RPG. Gameplay is designed for a XBox style controller or Keyboard.
The game is inspired by old 80's 90's Role Playing Games such as Legend (aka Four Crystals of Trazere), The original Rogue, Gauntlet (Atari Arcade) & Ultima 8 Pagan + others games like World Of Warcraft etc... Wiccatrix consists of designed scenes and randomly generated dungeons for crawling through, killing mobs and getting loot.
The game will also have other RPG aspects such as free roaming scenes with NPC’s and:~

- Spellcrafting ~ A spell crafting system that uses a combination of herbs and runes to enable the player to create their own spells!!

- Dialogue & a Story line ~ A rogue titan is disturbing the elemental balance which permeates the world of Terra. The players role is to guide the our hero Catsear the peasant through a world filled with enemies and other characters and ultimately a final encounter with a rogue elemental titan that seeks to destroy the world. Can he be banished? It won't be easy.

- Puzzles ~ Use spells and your own wit to defeat puzzles and receive rewards and gain access to dungeons areas..

- Combat ~ Go into battle with your limited melee abilities and your spells or run away screaming like a little chicken from mobs of enemies and bosses of various types. Getting into fights and not dying will challenge the player’s ability. Sometimes this will be easy and other times it will be near impossible and require a different approach. The player will have the experience of building their skills to withstand a progressively increasing horde of enemies with harder and more damaging attacks.

- Loot and Reagent (Spell Ingredients) Gathering ~ Loot and Reagents can be bought from merchants, found in parts of the world or received from enemy drops and quests.

Release ~ Aiming for November 2024 or not long after ~ That's the plan..

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Catsear를 조작해 설계된 장면과 무작위 생성 던전을 탐험하며 적을 처치하고 전리품을 획득한다. 근접 공격과 직접 제작한 주문으로 전투를 벌이거나 회피하고, 퍼즐을 풀어 보상과 던전 지역 접근권을 얻는다.
summary.특징: 허브와 룬을 조합해 자신만의 주문을 만드는 주문 제작 시스템이 있으며, 원소 균형을 어지럽히는 타이탄을 저지하는 스토리와 NPC가 있는 자유 탐험 장면을 포함한다. 상점 구매, 필드 발견, 적 드롭, 퀘스트를 통해 전리품과 주문 재료를 수집한다.

name: GRUG TO FUTURE
input:
Venture into a world where the primal past collides with relics from the future!



In GRUG TO FUTURE, you play as a rugged caveman on a quest to uncover mysterious artifacts from a time yet to come. But beware, with every discovery comes a hoard of jealous cavemen and ravenous dinosaurs eager to claim the relic's power for themselves.



Key Features:



Unique Fusion Gameplay: Combining the thrill of a top-down shooter with the strategic depth of tower defense. Will you engage in combat or fortify your defenses? The choice is yours!



Relic Hunting: Scour diverse landscapes for futuristic artifacts. But guard them well – every find triggers waves of relentless enemies determined to tear you down.



Build & Defend: Construct walls, place turrets, and recruit caveman allies to defend your precious relics. Upgrade and evolve your defenses with perks drawn from unearthed tech.



Dynamic Choices: Every relic grants a choice of three random upgrades. With every playthrough, craft a new strategy and build from the plethora of futuristic powers at your fingertips.



Primal Challenges: Face an array of enemies, from cunning Stone Brawler Cavemen to the terrifying T-Rex Juggernaut. Adapt and survive against the evolving threats.



In a time before time, the future casts its shadow. Can you harness its power and withstand the onslaught? Delve into Caveman Chronicles and craft your legend in stone and steel.



Embark on this unpredictable journey and become the ultimate guardian of tomorrow's legacy!

summary.핵심플레이: 원시인 캐릭터로 다양한 지형을 탐색해 미래의 유물을 획득하고, 이후 밀려오는 적들에 맞서 전투하거나 방어 시설을 구축한다. 벽과 터렛을 세우고 원시인 아군을 모집해 유물을 지킨다.
summary.특징: 원시시대와 미래 기술이 뒤섞인 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 유물을 얻을 때마다 세 가지 무작위 업그레이드 중 하나를 선택해 매 플레이마다 다른 전략을 구성할 수 있다. Stone Brawler Caveman, T-Rex Juggernaut 등 다양한 적이 등장한다.

name: Cats
input:
What is this game about?
Cats — and that says it all. Interactive cat clicker. Click on cats for new cats. That's all, really.
Features:

- Clicking by Cats

- Meow Sound

- Music

- HQ Cats

- Low System Requirements

- Black & White artworks

- Colored Cats

Take care of the Cats, give them a good click. It feels good! We guess so...

summary.핵심플레이: 고양이를 클릭하면 새로운 고양이가 등장하며, 클릭을 반복하는 것이 주된 진행 방식이다.
summary.특징: 고양이 울음소리와 음악, 고품질 고양이 이미지, 흑백 아트워크와 컬러 고양이가 포함되어 있으며 낮은 시스템 요구 사양으로 구동된다.

name: The Advent: Children of Arla
input:
The Advent: Children of Arla invites you to explore the enigmatic planet of Argus, a world created by the Hydrackians—an ancient and advanced civilization—to serve as humanity’s legacy. This RPG hybrid combines massive multiplayer worlds with engaging single-player dungeon adventures to deliver an unparalleled gaming experience.

Key Features:

-
Hybrid Gameplay: Seamlessly transition between vast multiplayer worlds and challenging single-player RPG dungeons.

-
Immersive Lore: Discover the story of Klateqal, the bipedal shapeshifting dragon whose role as humanity’s guardian led to betrayal, banishment, and the fusion of his soul with his enemy, Zo-ar. Unravel mysteries tied to ancient Earth legends and the Hydrackians’ grand plan.

-
Mesoamerican Mythology: Journey through a sub-world inspired by Aztec and Mayan timelines, including ‘Temple Q,’ a breathtaking dungeon set in ancient Teotihuacan.

-
Dynamic Quests and Challenges: Solve intricate puzzles, navigate perilous traps, and complete quests that impact the fate of Argus and its inhabitants.

-
Customization and Progression: Build your character’s skills, unlock unique abilities, and discover rare artifacts to aid in your journey.

-
Stunning Visuals: Explore richly detailed environments, from lush jungles to the surreal landscapes of Argus and beyond.

The Story Begins:

On the home world of Arla, Klateqal—the legendary dragon believed to be the inspiration for Earth’s Quetzalcoatl—was once beloved by his people and destined for greatness. Framed for murder by the cunning Zo-ar, Klateqal was sentenced to banishment. A tragic accident involving Luminoy, a mysterious mineral, fused Klateqal with his enemy, creating a powerful and vengeful being consumed by hatred.

Centuries later, humanity discovers Argus, a planet imbued with remnants of Hydrackian technology and a dark secret tied to Klateqal’s fate. As one of the Children of Arla, you must navigate this mysterious world, face its challenges, and decide its destiny.

Wishlist Now!

Prepare to embark on an unforgettable adventure. Add The Advent: Children of Arla to your wishlist on Steam today and be the first to uncover the secrets of Argus.

summary.장르: 액션 어드벤처, 롤플레잉, 대규모 멀티플레이어, 캐주얼, 인디
summary.핵심플레이: 대규모 멀티플레이어 월드와 싱글플레이어 던전을 오가며 퍼즐을 풀고 함정을 통과하며 퀘스트를 수행한다. 캐릭터의 스킬을 육성하고 능력을 해금하며 희귀 아티팩트를 수집한다.
summary.특징: 고대 문명 Hydrackian이 만든 행성 Argus를 배경으로, 형태를 바꾸는 용 Klateqal의 배신과 추방에 관한 서사를 다룬다. 아즈텍·마야 신화에서 영감을 받은 서브 월드와 Teotihuacan을 배경으로 한 던전 'Temple Q' 등이 포함된다.

name: Tomb Robbing with Friends
input:
Being an upstanding tomb explorer like Indiana Jones is lame: I'm sure he doesn't even make good money!
But you, you've got what it takes: you won't hesitate to push your friend into a spike trap so you can steal the precious artifacts they spent time gathering!

Tomb Robbing with Friends is a player-versus-player party game where you try to gather more coins, gems and ingots than your friends. Dodge mummies, dash in front of arrow traps, and sell all that sweet shiny loot to win the game!
Features:

- One-button gameplay: Move with the joystick, press A to grab stuff or shove your friends, that's it!
- Multiple levels: Explore the mysterious Pyramid filled with slow but unrelenting mummies, dodge skeletons in the Crypt, and meet spooky ghosts in the Temple!
- Cool modifiers: Want more challenge? Turn off the light, make the traps deadlier, or spawn more enemies!
- Customize your character: Unlock new customization elements each time you play and become the tomb robber with infinite drip!

And more!

- Controller support for up to 8 players!*
- Online multiplayer support with Steam Remote Play Together!
- You can make fun of your friends at any time by pressing A!
- Cool cel-shaded characters which bear a weird resemblance to Funko Pops!

*Windows does not handles more than 4 XBOX controllers very well and this causes issues when disconnecting/reconnecting them. It is recommended to play with Steam Remote Play Together when there are more than 4 players.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어들이 무덤을 탐험하며 코인, 보석, 금괴를 모으고, 조이스틱으로 이동하고 A 버튼으로 물건을 줍거나 다른 플레이어를 밀쳐 함정에 빠뜨린다. 미라와 화살 함정을 피하고 전리품을 팔아 더 많은 재화를 모은 플레이어가 승리한다.
summary.특징: 피라미드, 크립트, 사원 등 여러 스테이지와 미라·해골·유령 등 적이 등장하며, 조명 끄기·함정 강화·적 증가 같은 변경 옵션을 제공한다. 최대 8명까지 컨트롤러 지원과 Steam Remote Play Together를 통한 온라인 멀티플레이, 캐릭터 커스터마이징과 셀셰이딩 그래픽을 갖췄다.

name: Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story
input: Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story is a work-focused sound novel game where you work at your desk alongside Satone, an imaginative girl who loves writing novels. Customize the Lofi music, ambient sounds, and scenery that reflect Satone’s emotions to enhance your focus! The more time you spend working together, the deeper your bond will grow—perhaps you’ll even connect with Satone on a deeper level…?

summary.핵심플레이: 소설 쓰기를 좋아하는 소녀 Satone와 함께 책상에서 작업하며, Lo-Fi 음악과 환경음, 배경을 원하는 대로 조정해 집중 환경을 만든다. 함께 시간을 보낼수록 Satone와의 관계가 깊어진다.
summary.특징: 작업에 초점을 맞춘 사운드 노벨 형식으로, Satone의 감정을 반영하는 Lo-Fi 음악과 앰비언트 사운드, 풍경을 커스터마이즈할 수 있다.

name: Adventures of Sadukar - Chapter I
input:
Adventures of Sadukar is a turn based RPG that follows Sadukar and his friends through an open world plagued with monsters.



Sadukar and his group of hero's journey throughout the lands running into random encounters and challenges everywhere they go. You will explore maze like castle's, caves, and dungeons as you level up and unlock new skills and abilities to use in a classic side view turn based combat system.

summary.핵심플레이: Sadukar와 동료들을 조작해 오픈 월드를 탐험하며 랜덤 인카운터와 각종 도전을 만나고, 사이드뷰 턴제 전투로 적과 싸운다. 레벨업을 통해 새로운 스킬과 능력을 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 몬스터가 퍼진 오픈 월드를 배경으로 미로 형태의 성, 동굴, 던전을 탐험하며, 클래식한 사이드뷰 방식의 턴제 전투 시스템을 사용한다.

name: Sister Travel
input:
A Dungeon Crawling-Choose Your Adventure-type RPG is here!

A heart-pounding thrill ride that you’ll never forget!

Treasures are hidden away inside ancient ruins.

Nail-biting battles against monsters.

Yearning for a land unseen.

An adventurer. And his sister-like companions.

Enjoy this adventure filled with romance and epic fight scenes!

Experience this masterful blend of action and romance brought to you in native English!

Features

-

-
A Dungeon-Crawling-Choose Your Own Adventure-type RPG

-
An Elaborate, Hand-drawn World Map

-
A Large Ensemble Cast of Characters

-
Tons of Fight Scenes

summary.핵심플레이: 고대 유적 던전을 탐험하며 숨겨진 보물을 찾고, 선택지를 통해 이야기를 진행하며 몬스터와 전투를 벌인다.
summary.특징: 손으로 그린 세계 지도와 다수의 등장인물이 등장하며, 모험가와 그의 동료들을 중심으로 한 이야기와 다수의 전투 장면으로 구성된다.

name: First Crusader
input:
"Change the History"



The year is 1095 AD. Pope Urban calls on all Christians to take up arms for the defense of the Holy Land.



Your actions and choices will determine the fate of this crusade.



First Crusader tells a story based on defining period in history.



In this game, history is told through the story of two people.



Only your choices will change these people's stories.



Whether you are the leader of a Crusader army or the Sultan of Rum.



Every decision will have consequence.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 십자군 지도자 또는 룸 술탄으로서 선택을 내리며 이야기를 진행하고, 각 결정이 결과로 이어진다.
summary.특징: 1095년 교황 우르바노의 십자군 호소를 배경으로, 두 인물의 이야기를 통해 역사적 사건을 다루며 플레이어의 선택에 따라 전개가 달라진다.

name: Deep Water
input:
This is a roguelike game with RPG elements.

Embark on an adventure through dynamically generated mines, each hiding fantastical biomes waiting to be unearthed.

Defend against relentless waves of aggressive monsters utilizing your mobile base as your stronghold. Look for resources to upgrade your crab.

Travel to the bottom of the ocean, navigating changing weather conditions under the sun or the cover of darkness.

summary.핵심플레이: 동적으로 생성되는 광산을 탐험하며 이동식 기지를 거점으로 몰려오는 몬스터의 공격을 방어한다. 자원을 수집해 크랩을 업그레이드한다.
summary.특징: 환상적인 바이옴이 숨겨진 광산과 해저를 탐험하며, 낮과 밤 및 변화하는 날씨 환경 속에서 진행된다.

name: 1-Bit Astronaut
input:
If you like Celeste , Geometry Dash or N++ , this game is for you. It is in that genre of games.
You are a clumsy Astronaut who has to escape from an exploding space station. Avoid evil robots and dangerous traps.

summary.핵심플레이: 우주정거장에서 탈출하는 우주인을 조작해 로봇과 함정을 피하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 1비트 스타일의 그래픽으로 표현되며, Celeste, Geometry Dash, N++와 유사한 플랫폼 액션 장르에 속한다.

name: Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919
input:
The Great War has ended, but Europe is still being shaken by the political turmoil. Empires fall, socialist movements rise, new national states emerge on the ruins of the old world.

In the very end of the year 1918 the army of Soviet Russia attempts an offensive towards west. Their goal is to spark a communist uprising, that will start from eastern Germany and eventually consume entire Europe.

Relive events of the year 1919 and fight through enemy cards in six historical scenarios spanning from December 1918 to January 1920.
Developer
I have developed Comrades and Barons: Solitaire of Bloody 1919 as my first game. With the exception of music, I have made every aspect of it, including the art.

This game is made on GameMaker: Studio 1.4. If you find any bugs in the game, feel free to report them to me.

Thank you for reading this and I hope you find my game entertaining and challenging.
Features

- Lesser known historical theme

- Hand drawn graphics

- English, Russian, German, Italian and Latvian translation

- Easy to learn solitaire card game

- 200 solitaire table configurations

- Big card symbol mode

- Pure solitaire gameplay without additional puzzles

- Army units with game-changing abilities

- Fully playable with a mouse

summary.핵심플레이: 카드로 구성된 적을 상대로 솔리테어 방식의 카드 게임을 진행하며, 1918년 12월부터 1920년 1월까지 이어지는 여섯 개의 역사 시나리오를 플레이한다. 게임을 바꾸는 능력을 지닌 군대 유닛 카드를 활용한다.
summary.특징: 제1차 세계대전 종전 후 1919년 유럽의 정치적 혼란과 소비에트 러시아의 서진을 다룬 역사 배경을 소재로 하며, 손으로 그린 그래픽과 200가지 솔리테어 배치, 영어·러시아어·독일어·이탈리아어·라트비아어 번역, 큰 카드 심볼 모드를 제공한다. 마우스만으로 플레이할 수 있다.

name: Realm Revolutions
input:
WISHLIST MY NEW GAME!

About the Game
Idle game inspired by Swarm Simulator and Realm Grinder. Buy buildings and hire more and more citizens from them. A large number of citizens leads to their discontent. And they may revolt! After the revolution discontent people become happy and give bonus to production.
Production
At the beginning of the game you will have 2 resources: gold and food. Gold is necessary for buying new buildings and for hiring citizens. Food is necessary for the hiring of citizens, while, unlike gold, for each citizen, only one food unit is needed. You need to decide when you are ready to start hiring more expensive citizens, because they require as much food as cheap ones.
Discontent and happines
When there are too many citizens, they become discontent. Discontent citizens can arrange a revolution. After the revolution, discontent citizens will become happy and they will receive a bonus to gold production. The revolutions of citizens are independent, if the revolution was arranged by the peasants, only the peasants will be happy after it. Decide who should start the revolution, because after the revolution the game starts anew!
Further progress
With the construction of new buildings you will discover animals, magic, army and battles with monsters, assimilation of other races and much more.

summary.핵심플레이: 금과 식량을 사용해 건물을 짓고 시민을 고용하며, 시민 수가 많아지면 불만이 쌓여 혁명이 일어난다. 혁명이 발생하면 불만을 가진 시민이 행복해지며 생산 보너스를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 시민 계층별로 혁명이 독립적으로 발생하며, 혁명이 일어나면 게임이 다시 시작된다. 건물 건설을 통해 동물, 마법, 군대, 몬스터와의 전투, 다른 종족 흡수 등의 요소가 해금된다.

name: Chief's Quest
input:
Chief's Quest is a side-scrolling action platformer inspired by native american culture as well as anime movies
such as "Princess Mononoke" and "Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind"

This game tells the story of a world where the cataclysm split mankind into small groups.
Humans is no longer the dominant species on earth.
After the cataclysm hostile spirits began to appear everywhere turning the fauna against people.
Those who survived are forced to lead a nomadic lifestyle in search of a safe place.

You'll play a young warrior from a small tribe Big Bird.
Your father gives the task of finding a sister who is lost near the camp.
But this is not as easy as it seems.

- Tight control action platformer

- A variety of locations with unique enemies and traps

- Colorful pixel art graphics

- Beautifully animated characters

- Secondary weapons, allowing to change combat tactics

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Big Bird 부족의 젊은 전사가 되어 캠프 근처에서 사라진 여동생을 찾아 사이드 스크롤 방식으로 진행한다. 다양한 지역을 이동하며 고유한 적과 함정을 상대하고, 보조 무기를 활용해 전투 방식을 바꿀 수 있다.
summary.특징: 대격변으로 인류가 소규모 집단으로 나뉘고 적대적인 정령이 나타난 세계를 배경으로 한다. 아메리카 원주민 문화와 '모노노케 히메', '바람계곡의 나우시카' 같은 애니메이션에서 영감을 받았으며, 픽셀 아트 그래픽과 애니메이션된 캐릭터로 구성된다.

name: Angry Birds Space
input:
The #1 mobile game of all time blasts off into space!

Play over 300 interstellar levels across 10 planets! Whether it’s the icy orbs of Cold Cuts, the volcanic explosiveness of Red Planet, Utopia – a planet made entirely of junk food, or the new Brass Hogs episode ruled by evil Hektor Porko, each episode offers intergalactic fun at every turn! And the low-gravity environment of space results in spectacular gameplay ranging from slow-motion puzzles to lightspeed destruction. With brand new birds, special abilities, and a whole galaxy to explore, the sky is no longer the limit!

-----

“Intergalactic phenomenon worth every penny” – AppCraver

“Takes the fundamental physics-based flinging of the original and turns it on its head... It's satisfying, yet completely familiar, and is heaps of pig-smashing fun.” – Gamespot

“Anyone burnt out on vanilla bird flinging will enjoy the game's out-of-this-world adventure.” -- IGN

-----

Join the global phenomenon as it goes galactic!

Become a fan of Angry Birds on Facebook:

Follow us on Twitter:

Terms of Use:
Privacy Policy:

This application may require internet connectivity and subsequent data transfer charges may apply.

Important Message for Parents

This game may include:
- Direct links to social networking websites that are intended for an audience over the age of 13.
- Direct links to the internet that can take players away from the game with the potential to browse any web page.
- Advertising of Rovio products and also products from select partners.
- The option to make in-app purchases. The bill payer should always be consulted beforehand.

What's New in version 2.1.0:
Face off against the villainous Hektor Porko in an all new episode: Brass Hogs!

- 30 new unlockable Brass Hogs levels!
- Daily missions!
- Enter the Mirror World! Three-Star levels to play their Mirror World counterpart. Multi-dimensional pig-popping!
- The Wingman makes his debut in Space with a new special ability!

PLEASE NOTE: Xbox controller is currently not supported.
Key Features:

- Over 300 interstellar levels!

- New playable characters!

- Unique special abilities for each bird!

- Zero-gravity space adventures!

- Trick shots using planets’ gravity!

- Hidden bonus levels!

- Beautifully detailed backgrounds!

- Daily Missions!

summary.핵심플레이: 새를 발사해 돼지와 구조물을 파괴하며, 300개 이상의 레벨을 진행한다. 행성의 저중력과 중력을 활용한 트릭샷으로 목표를 공략한다.
summary.특징: 10개 행성을 배경으로 한 우주 테마이며, 무중력 환경에서 슬로모션부터 빠른 파괴까지 다양한 플레이가 가능하다. 각 새의 고유 능력, 데일리 미션, 미러 월드, Brass Hogs 에피소드 등이 포함된다.

name: Left to Float
input:
Game Overview

Left to Float is a sci-fi themed exploration game where you traverse a dilapidated vessel attempting to escape. You're equipped with a jetpack and magnetic boots to aid in maneuvering in zero g throughout the various rooms as well as to help with solving puzzles. You'll also want that jetpack to quickly get away from the thing hunting you.

Your mission was supposed to be a short, solo one; a year at most. But two years in space later, with no hope of rescue in sight, supplies have long run out. Strange noises can be heard in the bowels of the vessel, and odd things keep happening; Is it the hunger or something much worse?

Alone, you must rely on your puzzle solving skills and quick thinking to survive. Utilize your jet pack to escape danger and reach new locations. In zero g your momentum is maintained across distances so use this to your advantage!

Uncover numerous diaries and notes to reveal the history of the vessel and the dark nature of your enemies! Unlock passageways by discovering enough of these diaries and notes. With your supplies having run out and no rescue coming, you will have to find your own way home.

Key Features

-
Explore a dark and dreary space station.

-
Avoid the mysterious entity hunting you.

-
Investigate notes and odd occurrences in order to unlock new passages.

-
Find a way to escape your fate.

-
Discover the secrets of the dark vessel.

-
Zero G maneuvering.

-
Magnetic boots to keep you grounded in space.

-
Use your jet pack for fast escapes and exploring tough to reach locations.

summary.핵심플레이: 제트팩과 자성 부츠를 이용해 무중력 상태의 낡은 우주선 내부를 이동하며 퍼즐을 풀고, 자신을 쫓는 존재를 피해 탈출로를 찾는다. 무중력에서는 관성이 유지되므로 이를 이동에 활용한다.
summary.특징: 우주에 홀로 남겨진 상황을 배경으로, 일지와 메모를 발견해 우주선의 역사와 적의 정체를 밝히고 충분한 단서를 모아 새 통로를 여는 구조를 갖췄다. 무중력 이동과 자성 부츠, 제트팩을 이용한 회피 및 탐색이 핵심 시스템이다.

name: Catherine Ragnor - Blackbeards Fury
input:
Play the second part of the great Match3 saga! After her adventures alongside the cursed captain of the Flying Dutchman, Catherine Ragnor now has a new ship and a new quest to find new treasures. Yet when she returns home after a long voyage, she finds that her village is under attack by the notorious pirate Blackbeard. Determined to get revenge for her family and friends, Catherine sets out on a new quest to find the legendary weapon able to counter Blackbeard’s sword.

Game Features

-Return to the high seas in a new tale of piracy and adventure!

-Join Catherine Ragnor, Peter Thorne, and other memorable characters as they set out on a quest to stop Blackbeard.

-Watch the adventure unfold across five chapters as you unlock each of the twenty upgrades that tell Catherine’s story.

-Solve exciting match-3 puzzles to unlock each upgrade and complete your quest.

summary.핵심플레이: 매치3 퍼즐을 풀어 업그레이드를 해금하며 진행한다. 5개 챕터에 걸쳐 20개의 업그레이드를 얻으며 이야기를 이어간다.
summary.특징: 해적을 소재로 한 스토리를 다루며, Catherine Ragnor가 마을을 습격한 Blackbeard에 맞서 그의 검을 상대할 전설의 무기를 찾는 여정을 그린다. Catherine Ragnor, Peter Thorne 등의 캐릭터가 등장하는 시리즈의 두 번째 작품이다.

name: You Are a Bird
input:
Your real arms become wings in You Are a Bird.
Flap and angle your wings to gracefully soar through the sky in the most immersive bird flight experience.
Stalk prey from above, extend your talons, and swoop in for the catch while exploring a massive world.

- Flap and angle your wings to fly naturally.

- Bird flight simulation based on real bird flight mechanics and soaring flight physics.

- Massive 56 square kilometer landscape with full day-night cycle and dynamic weather.

- Hunt prey from the sky to survive.

- More to come~

summary.핵심플레이: 팔을 날개처럼 움직여 날갯짓과 각도를 조절하며 하늘을 비행하고, 상공에서 먹이를 노려 발톱을 뻗어 사냥한다.
summary.특징: 실제 새의 비행 메커니즘과 활공 물리를 기반으로 하며, 낮과 밤의 순환과 동적 날씨가 적용된 56제곱킬로미터 규모의 월드를 탐험할 수 있다.

name: Ice River
input:
Follow ‘漂流獭工作室’ in RedNote for more information.

Ice River is a point-and-click story-driven adventure game set in late 1990s in northeastern China. Players will immerge into Jiangping, which inspired by Shenyang and Changchun, gradually uncover the truth behind the disappearance of Dun’s mother.

Lelin, small southern town, the end of the century. After father’s funeral, young boy Dun set off on a journey to the northeast. He is convinced that his mother, who has been disappeared for many years, is in Jiangping, the largest city in northeast and also the hometown that Dun's family could never return to.

Mysterious Family History and the Past Century of Northeastern China

In Ice River, the history of family and country intertwine. As players uncover the truth, they will investigate a long-buried case involving Dun’s family member, piece past experiences of two generations, and gain a deeper understanding of the historical changes in Jiangping and northeastern region.

Rich Narrative Experience with Multiple Branches

There are many characters in Jiangping, each with their own unique backstories, and numerous interactive elements, they provide a rich narrative experience with multiple branches together. While searching for clues about Dun’s mother, you can slow down and listen to other characters’ story.

Personality System

At the beginning, players will make several key choices that shape Dun's personality and way of thinking. From dialogue response options to main quest routes, these choices will have a lasting impact throughout the entire game, influencing every aspect of the story. Perhaps by making different choices in the second playthrough, you'll uncover another side of some characters and events.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Dun이 되어 실종된 어머니의 행방을 찾아 도시 Jiangping을 탐색하고, 인물들과 대화하며 단서를 모아 가족과 관련된 오래된 사건의 진실을 밝힌다.
summary.특징: 1990년대 후반 중국 동북 지역을 배경으로 가족사와 지역의 역사를 엮으며, 초반 선택으로 주인공의 성격과 사고방식을 정하는 성격 시스템과 다중 분기 서사를 제공한다.

name: Pix
input:
Pix is a tiny little pixel-art creature who jumps through obstacle courses on a quest to collect colorful, sparkling pixels - but the way is perilous and filled with danger. Death lurks around every corner in this risky mission to recover the glowing goodness, but well worth the loss of life and limb when your head is full of pixels!

Pix is a straightforward platformer built around a 3-pixel objective per level. Any noob can complete the levels by just reaching the end, but if you want to really test your skills, try collecting all 3 pixels on every level.

- 36 levels (to start the Early Access versions)

- 3 pixel challenges per level

- Achievements coming soon

- Controller support in levels (Windows)

- Platforming chaos

- Deadly spike pits

- Whizzing saw blades

- Swinging pendulums of death

- Innocent looking levels designed to kill you without mercy :)

Gameplay is tweaked so you can conquer higher challenges to suit your own ambitions, while preserving your ability to explore the whole game at an average skill level. Got any platformers collecting dust cuz you couldn't finish some level that unlocks the rest of the game? Not in Pix. Instead of an ever-increasing difficulty curve where each level unlocks the next, the average level is “medium” difficulty to finish, while the 3 optional pixel challenges within each level will continue to increase in difficulty.

summary.핵심플레이: 픽셀 캐릭터 Pix를 조작해 장애물이 있는 레벨을 통과하고, 각 레벨마다 배치된 3개의 픽셀을 수집한다. 레벨 끝에 도달하면 클리어되며, 3개의 픽셀을 모두 모으는 선택적 도전을 시도할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 가시 구덩이, 회전하는 톱날, 흔들리는 진자 등의 장애물이 배치된 36개 레벨을 제공한다. 레벨을 순차적으로 잠금 해제하는 방식 대신 대부분의 레벨은 중간 난이도로 클리어할 수 있고, 각 레벨의 3픽셀 도전 과제는 난이도가 점차 높아진다.

name: Nerepis
input:
An evolution in action game combat and multiplayer design! Our aim is to a make game that is fairly priced, user friendly, in uniquely designed dynamic environments, and with easy to use controls. Our hope is that you enjoy this game with your friends and families for a very long time.

Nerepis is a third person multiplayer action game with easy to learn combat. Each match, whether solo or team-based is a grueling battle with a cast of unique characters and levels.
Features

Simplified fighting elements making the game easy to play but difficult to master
Dynamic cast of characters with unique visuals and controls
Bot support so that you don't have to wait for other players
Multiple weapon types to support diverse combat styles
Dynamic level environments
Game play statistics to track your performance
Spectating Server Mode which is an innovation in dedicated servers

summary.핵심플레이: 3인칭 시점에서 여러 캐릭터를 조작해 솔로 또는 팀 기반 매치로 전투를 벌인다. 다양한 무기 유형을 활용해 근접·원거리 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 각기 다른 외형과 조작감을 가진 캐릭터와 동적인 레벨 환경을 제공하며, 봇 지원과 플레이 통계 기록, 관전 서버 모드를 포함한다.

name: Guntris
input:
🌵 Yeehaw, Pardner! 🌵

Guntris is a rooting, tooting, fast shooting good time.

Step into the dusty boots of a sharpshooting desperado and dive into the most thrilling Tetris style experience yet. Guntris combines the timeless challenge of Tetris with the heart-pounding action of the Wild West.

🔫 Shoot 'Em Up! 🔫

In Guntris, you don't just place blocks – you blast 'em! Use your trusty six-shooter to clear lines and take down outlaws. Aim true, shoot fast, and watch the pieces fall into place.

summary.핵심플레이: 떨어지는 블록을 총으로 쏘아 줄을 맞추고, 나타나는 무법자를 처치하는 방식으로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 테트리스 방식의 블록 퍼즐에 서부극 세계관과 사격 요소를 결합했다.

name: Die Harder
input:
Die, respawn, and use your corpse as platforms and weights to solve puzzles. The idea is simple, but the execution may be difficult.

-
Clever Deaths: Find creative ways to sacrifice yourself to progress.

-
Vertical Sokoban: Jump, climb, and drag boxes and corpses around to solve puzzles.

-
Puzzle-Focused: Challenging puzzles without demanding platforming skills.

-
Level Freedom: 50+ carefully designed levels. Progress at your own pace by choosing from multiple available levels.

summary.핵심플레이: 캐릭터를 죽이고 리스폰하며, 남겨진 시체를 발판이나 무게추로 활용해 퍼즐을 푼다. 점프하고 오르며 상자와 시체를 끌어 옮긴다.
summary.특징: 까다로운 플랫포밍 조작보다 퍼즐 풀이에 초점을 맞춘 수직형 소코반 방식이며, 50개 이상의 레벨을 여러 선택지 중에서 자유롭게 진행할 수 있다.

name: Warships On The Halloween Night
input:
Warships On The Halloween Night is an extreme Top Down Arcade Shooter game based on the naval war which broke out between the Human beings and the Living Pumpkins.

During the early 2000s, the living pumpkins were spotted for the first time in the forest of North Carolina. There were many conspiracy theories regarding the mysterious appearance of the Living Pumpkins also known by the name 'Pumpkin Man' or 'Pumpkin bots'. It was assumed that these Pumpkin Bots were some sort of extraterrestrial beings who appeared for the very first time during the Halloween Night. However, they were secretly building their underground military base somewhere in the US. It was reported that they were building modern warships and turrets in secrecy. As soon as the US Government came to know about that secret underground base the US navy had been instructed to take a deep dive into the matter. In 2018, some of the US battleships were attacked by a few Pumpkin Head battleships which resulted in the war breaking out between the US military forces and the Pumpkin Bots. On the Halloween Night, the US Navy launched the modern warship called "USS Special" to destroy the Pumpkin secret bases, battleships, turrets and the bots to reinstate peace in the world.

Who will win in the end?

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 전함 USS Special을 조종해 위에서 내려다보는 시점으로 적의 함선, 포탑, 봇을 파괴한다.
summary.특징: 인류와 살아있는 호박(Pumpkin Bots) 간의 해상 전쟁을 다룬 할로윈 소재의 설정을 배경으로 한다.

name: Molest
input: This game unfolds against a soft pink backdrop, offering players a light and enjoyable gaming experience. After the game starts, various medals and coins, including gold, silver, bronze medals, diamonds, and gold coins, will rise from the bottom of the screen. Players need to use the mouse to quickly click and collect as many of these items as possible. The game is set with a time limit, encouraging players to maximize their score within the given time frame. A crisp and pleasant sound effect plays each time an item is successfully collected, adding more fun to the game. The game interface is clean and aesthetically pleasing, with a light and lively background melody, making it perfect for players looking to unwind. By continuously challenging oneself, players can attempt to break their personal best scores, enjoying the sense of achievement that comes with the game.

summary.핵심플레이: 화면 아래에서 위로 떠오르는 금·은·동메달, 다이아몬드, 금화 등의 아이템을 마우스로 클릭해 수집하며, 제한 시간 안에 가능한 한 많은 점수를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 분홍색 배경과 가벼운 배경 음악으로 구성되며, 아이템을 획득할 때마다 효과음이 재생된다. 시간 제한 방식으로 개인 최고 점수 경신에 도전할 수 있다.

name: Sword & Spatula
input:
Sword & Spatula is a cooperative action-strategy game designed for two players, blending the thrill of combat with the art of cooking. In the game, players traverse a whimsical yet dangerous world, facing waves of diverse enemies and satisfying their hunger by preparing meals.

Each player has a health bar and a hunger bar, and the game level is failed if either bar reaches zero. Players need to simultaneously engage in battles and keep themselves fed, creating a dynamic and engaging gameplay loop.

The game presents varying enemy types, each with distinct speed, hit points, and melee attack damage profiles. From balanced medium-paced enemies to slow, hard-hitting brutes, and quick, weaker attackers that can stun players, the game provides an array of challenges for players to strategize and overcome.

summary.핵심플레이: 두 명의 플레이어가 협력하여 적의 웨이브에 맞서 전투를 벌이는 동시에 요리로 배고픔을 채운다. 각 플레이어의 체력 바와 배고픔 바 중 하나라도 0이 되면 스테이지에 실패한다.
summary.특징: 전투와 요리를 결합한 2인 협동 플레이를 중심으로 하며, 속도와 체력, 근접 공격력이 서로 다른 여러 적 유형이 등장한다. 일부 적은 플레이어를 기절시킬 수 있다.

name: Redneck Rift
input:
Every problem can be solved with a shotgun and every solution can be celebrated with an ice cold beer.

Help Cletus quench his thirst after a long hard days work as he platforms his way through the bayou, time and back again in this retro styled, difficult action precision platformer game.

- Action packed levels filled with enemies and challenging obstacles

- Mix of closed and open ended levels where you can choose your own path

- Plenty of babes to rescue... they will thank you later

- Beer

- Shotguns

summary.핵심플레이: Cletus를 조작해 적과 장애물이 배치된 레벨을 정밀하게 플랫포밍으로 통과한다. 샷건을 사용해 적을 처치하고 인물을 구출하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 레트로 스타일의 난이도 높은 정밀 플랫포머로, 늪지대를 배경으로 폐쇄형과 개방형 레벨이 혼합되어 경로를 선택할 수 있다.

name: Ballway
input:
Ballway is a casual physical puzzle with explosions. The player's goal is to keep the ball on the green platform, using explosive and other interactive blocks in order to pass the level.
Features:

- 50 Levels.

- Advanced physics.

- Relaxing gameplay.

summary.핵심플레이: 공을 초록색 발판 위에 유지시키는 것이 목표이며, 폭발 블록과 상호작용 블록을 이용해 레벨을 통과한다.
summary.특징: 물리 기반 시스템을 사용하며 50개의 레벨로 구성되어 있다.

name: MOBILE SUIT GUNDAM SEED BATTLE DESTINY REMASTERED
input:
Become a pilot in the world of Mobile Suit Gundam SEED, for the first time available with English localization! Engage in thrilling, action-packed Gundam battles, complete missions, and tune up your newly acquired Mobile Suits!

Battle across turbulent times!

summary.핵심플레이: 모빌슈트를 조종해 건담 배틀을 벌이고 미션을 수행하며, 새로 획득한 모빌슈트를 튜닝한다.
summary.특징: 기동전사 건담 SEED 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 이번 리마스터에서 처음으로 영어 현지화가 제공된다.

name: Lucky Slots
input:
You start with 1,000 coins - the aim of the game is to wager your coins to try and increase your coins as high as you can.



Pick the number of pay lines and then how much the bet per line will be. Then cross your fingers and press SPIN.



If you win on a spin, you can either TAKE WIN or choose to DOUBLE of NOTHING in a simple game of RED or BLACK. Keep playing until you run out of coins or want to Cash Out and register your rank in the Leaderboards!



There are bonuses which can also be won to increase your winnings.



The game includes online leaderboards to allow players to post scores with their friends and the whole world. Leaderboards included are TODAY, THIS WEEK, THIS MONTH.

summary.핵심플레이: 1,000코인으로 시작해 페이라인 수와 라인당 베팅액을 정한 뒤 스핀을 돌려 코인을 늘린다. 당첨 시 상금을 받거나 레드/블랙을 맞히는 더블 오어 낫싱에 도전할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 보너스로 상금을 추가로 획득할 수 있으며, 오늘·이번 주·이번 달 단위의 온라인 리더보드에 점수를 등록할 수 있다.

name: Super Cable Boy
input:
You are super. You have a cable. And you are a boy.
Super Cable Boy is a retro inspired platformer, where you are put into the role of a living handheld gaming system with a power cord. Collect game cartridges to become more powerful and take on your quest to defeat

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 전원 코드를 가진 캐릭터를 조작해 스테이지를 진행하고, 게임 카트리지를 수집해 능력을 강화하며 목표를 향해 나아간다.
summary.특징: 레트로 게임에서 영감을 받은 연출을 사용하며, 플레이어는 전원 코드가 달린 휴대용 게임기 형태의 캐릭터를 조작한다.

name: Rivers of Astrum: Daughter of Darkness
input:
Rivers of Astrum: Daughter of Darkness follows the story of Kimberly Ashmoore. Seeking to leave the only place that she has ever called home, Kim embarks on a mission, and gets swept up in a tide of destiny that no one could have predicted. Whether that change is for the better, or for the worse is for you to decide! (literally!)

Featuring meaningful choices, and dynamic relationships between the cast; the things you say and the actions you take will have impactful changes on the story, both obvious and subtle!

Rivers of Astrum: Daughter of Darkness boasts professionally hired and casted voice actors and actresses as well! (During Early Access, some characters may be unvoiced. Voices can all be muted, collectively or individually by character, for those that wish to play without them!)

And with nearly 40 content filters, the game can be tailored to every player's individual tastes! Most content types can be toggled on or off as desired, to customize the content of the game! (These filters are available through the game's "Preferences" menu.)

Key Features:

-
Dark Fantasy Adventure

-
Professionally voiced by freelance voice actors/actresses!

-
The lead voice actress has even been on HBO and Netflix!

-
Lesbian Protagonist

-
Meaningful Choices

-
Rendered in 2K resolution, as opposed to the standard 1080p, for higher image quality!

-
Nearly 40 Content Filters to enable or disable most content types!

-
Polyamory is possible!

Notes from the Developer:

-
Rivers of Astrum is a story that I've had in my head for 30 years. In that time it has been written, re-written and revised countless times, as it has evolved over the years. My three big passions are art, storytelling and creation in general. This is a passion project that I've been working on (in some form or another) for nearly 7 years.

-
Rivers of astrum is a long-paced story. It has ups and downs just like any other, but this story is intended (in it's final form) to encompass 6 volumes. "Daughter of Darkness" is volume 1 of the Rivers of Astrum Saga.

-
I am thoroughly interested in any and all feedback anyone may have, as I've received precious little of it. I also love to engage with the players, so please - if you have any concerns or questions at all - feel free to reach out!

-
It is worth noting that I have a standing agreement with the lead voice actress in the game. She voices NSFW scenes at her own discretion, and stops wherever she chooses. This does lead to some partially voiced NSFW scenes, but I personally feel like that's an infinitesimally small price to pay for the talent and immersion that she brings to the project!

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Kimberly Ashmoore의 이야기를 따라가며, 대사 선택과 행동을 통해 스토리 전개와 등장인물 간의 관계 변화에 영향을 준다.
summary.특징: 6권으로 계획된 다크 판타지 사가의 1권이며, 전문 성우 음성, 2K 해상도 렌더링, 약 40종의 콘텐츠 필터를 통한 콘텐츠 조절 기능을 제공한다. 레즈비언 주인공과 폴리아모리 요소가 포함된다.

name: Piggy's Great Adventure
input:
Piggy'sGreat Adventure is a simulation RPG.
Piggy, a little dragon, and Simon, a human boy, are adventuring in a fantasy world where dragons,
elves, orcs, and other various races live.
Simon and his friends have more than 40 unique characters to choose from.
Simon and his friends grow up with more than 40 unique units
and fight fierce battles against an army of demons led by green demons (orcs).

Nemesis Orcs

On the Mede continent, where Simon and his friends live, various demons lurk.
Orcs are particularly vicious, attacking humans and gathering in the darkness to plot against them.

Battle

The units that join you are gorgeously drawn and have their own unique fighting style.
They defeat their enemies in their own unique fighting style. As they gain experience and level up
As they gain experience and level up, their stats increase, and sometimes they learn skills or acquire special weapons.

summary.핵심플레이: 40종 이상의 유닛 중에서 캐릭터를 선택해 오크가 이끄는 악마 군대와 전투를 벌인다. 유닛은 경험치를 얻고 레벨업하며 능력치가 오르고 스킬이나 특수 무기를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 드래곤, 엘프, 오크 등 다양한 종족이 사는 판타지 세계 Mede 대륙을 배경으로 하며, 어린 드래곤 Piggy와 소년 Simon 일행이 모험한다. 각 유닛은 고유한 전투 스타일을 지닌다.

name: Seaburn
input:
You are a politician determined to save our dying planet. Time is slipping away, as endless political debates and ineffective policies continue to suffocate the Earth under the weight of pollution. You must take action before the damage becomes irreversible. The future of humanity rests on your shoulders, and every decision you make carries immense consequences.

In Seaburn, you play as a policymaker whose choices shape the fate of the planet and your political career. Your actions influence both public opinion and the world’s health, forcing you to constantly decide what to prioritise. However, if the world’s health collapses, your journey ends. If your public opinion plummets, you'll be ousted from office.

LEGISLATION
The papers on your desk allow you to sign legislation. Each piece of legislation presents its own set of potential outcomes, requiring you to carefully weigh the pros and cons. You can sign three bills per week, with every choice impacting your popularity, world health, and political budget—either for better or worse.

EVENTS
The corkboard on the wall allows you to attend events. Each event presents four distinct options, all of which can affect public opinion and world health in different ways. Events appear every few weeks and affect public opinion and world health drastically, so choose your responses wisely.

ELECTIONS
Every eight weeks, prepare for an election that could determine your political future. Your chances of staying in office are tied directly to your public opinion, so be mindful of how you govern as the next election draws closer.

Discover more about your office throughout the journey, and reach the 52nd week to solidify your place as a successful politician.

summary.핵심플레이: 정치인을 맡아 매주 세 건의 법안에 서명하고, 몇 주마다 등장하는 이벤트에서 선택지를 골라 여론·세계 건강·정치 예산을 관리한다. 8주마다 열리는 선거를 여론에 따라 통과해 임기를 이어간다.
summary.특징: 환경 오염으로 위기에 처한 지구를 배경으로 정책 결정이 여론과 세계 건강에 영향을 미치며, 세계 건강이 붕괴하거나 여론이 낮아지면 게임이 끝난다. 52주차 도달을 목표로 한다.

name: Hanaja's Body
input:
The all-powerful demon, Hanaja, has been humiliating her friends and foes for many years with her sexy games and erotic challenges. She was happy twisting the bodies and minds of those around her into all sorts of strange shapes and creatures for the simple pleasure of watching them make a fool of themselves trying to best her. Little did she know, there was someone in the shadows, waiting to give her a taste of her own medicine!

Trapped in a mysterious void by one known only as Madame V, Hanaja has become the subject of her own naughty game! Will she be able to endure being transformed, humiliated, and debased in order to find out who is behind this kinky revenge? Or will she give into the sexual pleasures of the game of her own erotic design?

Hanaja’s Body is an erotic game of transformation and sexual humiliation. Explore the colorful worlds of the void while fighting off enemies that attempts to use magic and sexual stimulation in order to slowly transform you into one of several spirits that wish to possess your body! Being transformed is not a bad thing, as you will WANT to be transformed in order to solve puzzles, enhance your combat abilities, and solve the mystery of Madame V’s true identity.

- Each body part is transformed separately, allowing you to mix and match the strengths and weaknesses of many transformations, ranging from a magical bunny girl to a cat girl made from gelatin!

- Change up combat with different transformations! Each body part and transformation gives Hanaja access to new and powerful battle skills!

- Enchant your favorite transformations to power them up with unique Augments found throughout the various zones.

- Travel through four unique worlds, each featuring a unique transformation, enemy types, and a powerful boss.

- Enjoy a new, engaging, and lighthearted story that the series is known and loved for.

Controls:

Arrow Keys or Left Mouse Click - Move
Enter or Z or Left Mouse Click - Confirm
Esc or X or Right Mouse Click - Cancel or Menu (Outside of Battle)
Shift Key (Hold) - Sprint/Move Fast
Tab Key (Hold) - Skip Dialogue

Let's promote sex positivity no matter what your form your body takes!

summary.핵심플레이: 네 개의 세계를 탐험하며 마법과 자극으로 변신을 시도하는 적들과 전투를 벌이고, 신체 부위별 변신을 활용해 퍼즐을 풀고 전투 능력을 강화한다. 각 세계의 보스를 물리치며 Madame V의 정체를 밝혀 나간다.
summary.특징: 신체 부위마다 개별적으로 변신이 이루어져 여러 변신의 강점과 약점을 조합할 수 있으며, 변신마다 새로운 전투 스킬을 제공한다. 각 지역에서 발견하는 Augment로 변신을 강화할 수 있고, 성적 변신과 굴욕을 소재로 한 스토리를 다룬다.

name: Fujiwara Phoenix
input:
Fujiwara Phoenix is a metroidvania Touhou Project fan game that casts you as Fujiwara no Mokou burning a path through Gensokyo on a reignited quest for revenge with a powerful array of unlockable abilities, but exercise caution as they will burn you right back. Merciless aggression is the key; with defeating enemies being the only way to restore precious health, or, in Mokou's case, pain tolerance. Inspired by a deep love for both the Touhou Project and games like Hollow Knight and DOOM, Fujiwara Phoenix is a relentless, fast-paced platformer that pushes the boundaries of the metroidvania genre.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: Fujiwara no Mokou를 조작해 Gensokyo를 탐험하며 잠금 해제 가능한 능력을 사용해 적을 처치한다. 체력(고통 내성)은 적을 쓰러뜨려야만 회복되므로 공격적으로 전투를 이어간다.
summary.특징: Touhou Project를 기반으로 한 팬 게임으로, 복수를 주제로 한 세계관을 다룬다. 능력은 플레이어에게도 피해를 줄 수 있어 신중한 운용이 요구되며, 빠른 속도의 플랫포밍 전투를 지향한다.

name: 戾谈
input: Li Tan is a novel that combines chamber of Secrets exploration and visual novel. In this work, you will find clues in dozens of wonderful strange stories together with the mysterious beautiful girl Xiaotan to solve the mystery of your space and yourself.

summary.핵심플레이: 밀실을 탐색하며 수십 개의 기이한 이야기 속에서 단서를 찾아 수수께끼를 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 신비한 소녀 Xiaotan과 함께 자신이 있는 공간과 자기 자신에 얽힌 미스터리를 밝혀내는 내용으로 진행된다.

name: Stickit
input:
Now with Online Multiplayer and Online Leaderboards
If you're wondering how your friends are able to beat the map, why not play with them and have a look yourself (using the Spectator Mode!)! Stickit can now be played online, both on the main level and on custom user created levels, together with your friends! Furthermore scores are submitted to online Steam Leaderboards, both for the main level and for user created levels! See who can beat levels the fastest!

Now with Level Editor and Steam Workshop integration
If the difficulty of the main level isn't quite to your liking, try your hand at making your entirely own levels with the provided in-game Level Editor, or download community created levels directly from the Steam Workshop!

Stickit is a brutal first person platforming game about climbing higher and higher to reach your ultimate goal, The Golden Stick. At your disposal is the very simple mechanic of sticking to walls and ceilings, no complex control schemes or wonky physics, so how hard can it be?

Whilst the only way forward is up, the way up isn't always obvious. The level contains multiple routes, and for those technically gifted players you will likely be able to find skips around obstacles entirely. Be careful however, because once you fall and are unable to find your footing on the platforms below you, the only way back up is the very same path you came...

But it's simple really, just jump and stick it.

Features

- Tight and satisfying controls, Stick to walls and ceilings by dashing

- Hard to master, whilst sticking to surfaces might seem simple, there's a hidden mechanic to it that will allow you to find new paths.

- In-game Level Editor and Steam Workshop integration, if the main level isn't your thing then try creating your own levels and share them with others on the Steam Workshop!

- Steam Leaderboards, times for the main level and user created levels are submitted on stored on Steam Leaderboards, see who's the fastest!

- Online Multiplayer, play online with your friends and find the way forward together! You can even play together on user created levels!

- A massive level, many many hours to beat it, if you're even able to.

- Non-linear level, there's almost always more than one way up, which one will suit you? And for those in a rush, finding new paths entirely to skip obstacles is very much encouraged.

- Heatmap of player mistakes, every single of your failures is stored for you to see

- Speedrunner friendly, both speedrunning split timer and a segment practice mode is in the game. Furthermore the nature of the game lends itself perfectly to speedrunning. Find alternate paths and climb even faster.

- Steam Achievements (Compare how far you've gotten compared to others by checking their achievements)

- Steam Cloud integration. New computer? Don't worry, all your mistakes are stored in the Steam Cloud

summary.핵심플레이: 벽과 천장에 대시로 달라붙는 단순한 조작을 사용해 위로 올라가며 최종 목표인 The Golden Stick에 도달한다. 떨어지면 다시 같은 경로를 통해 올라와야 한다.
summary.특징: 여러 경로와 장애물을 건너뛸 수 있는 비선형 레벨 구조를 가지며, 레벨 에디터와 Steam 창작마당, 온라인 멀티플레이, 온라인 순위표, 스피드런용 분할 타이머와 구간 연습 모드, 플레이어 실패 히트맵을 제공한다.

name: ArrowBall
input:
ArrowBall is a Local Multiplayer Sports game where players use explosive arrows and acrobatics to outmaneuver their opponents and control THE BALL on a variety of unique Stages.
Overview
Challenge your friends in 1v1 or 2v2 competitions where both teams try to get THE BALL into the opposing team's goal to score points. Run, jump, fire explosive arrows, activate Clutch Mode to set up the perfect shot, or launch a devastating Super Arrow. Charge your Super Bar by defending your goal and spend it to activate Clutch Mode or your Super Arrow.
Stages

Each match takes place on one of 6 different stages with unique layouts and features

- HighRise - A no-frills stage in the ritzy part of town

- Arena - A simple, fast-paced stage with a large crowd to cheer you on

- Laser Dome - A stage that takes place in a swanky night-club, features disappearing blocks and a randomized layout

- HyperLoop - Play on top of a speeding train as hazards shift the play field around you

- Factory - Give the workers some entertainment on their lunch break in this stage with conveyor belts and a shrinking goal zone

- ClockTower - Play on the inside of a clock-tower as the stage rotates around you

Super Arrows

summary.핵심플레이: 1대1 또는 2대2로 나뉘어 달리기, 점프, 폭발 화살 발사를 활용해 공을 상대 팀 골대에 넣어 득점한다. 골을 방어해 슈퍼 바를 충전하고 이를 소모해 Clutch Mode나 Super Arrow를 사용한다.
summary.특징: 로컬 멀티플레이 방식이며, HighRise, Arena, Laser Dome, HyperLoop, Factory, ClockTower 등 각기 다른 배치와 장치를 가진 6개의 스테이지에서 경기가 진행된다.

name: Honey's Sweet Revenge
input:
Honey is on a quest for revenge. Her creator Madmin has kidnapped her girlfriend and now she's on an unstoppable journey to get her back. Help her tear through Madmin's castle to find new items to help Honey and defeat an army of candy monsters in order to take down Madmin once and for all.

Honey's Sweet Revenge is a metroidvania featuring mechanics inspired by Platform Fighters. Find new items to customize your loadout to find the setup that works best for you. Travel through the world collecting collectables to help upgrade your HP, Strength, and damage and meet a variety of characters and enemies.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Honey를 조작해 Madmin의 성을 탐험하며 캔디 몬스터와 전투를 벌이고, 새로운 아이템을 찾아 로드아웃을 구성한다. 수집품을 모아 HP, 힘, 공격력을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 플랫폼 파이터에서 영감을 받은 전투 메커니즘을 도입했으며, 납치된 연인을 구하기 위해 Madmin의 성을 돌파하는 스토리를 따라 다양한 캐릭터와 적을 만난다.

name: Disaster Island
input:
By yourself or with friends, try to accomplish various tasks and get out of island! Gather materials, supplies and build necessary structures to survive in extreme conditions. You will have to deal with extreme situations,scenarious and conditions but It's up to you to discover what and who can kill you :)

The game currently offers a couple of game mods, both single player and multiplayer. While playing you gain experience and money for which you can upgrade and unlock upgrades that will help you on harder difficulties. And if you're lucky you'll find some cosmetic stuff in the crate.
Natural Disasters

The game takes place on a strange island, which is accompanied by very strange phenomena. It is very likely that you will encounter dangerous disasters that will make it very difficult to escape from the island. In the blink of an eye, a beautiful sunny day can turn into a fight for survival.
Environment

The island is located in the Bermuda Triangle, which was previously used for experimenting with various technologies. There are a lot of abandoned buildings, bunkers and factories that have long fallen into disuse, but they have left plenty of resources
Dynamic weather

The game features a completely dynamic weather system that impresses with both graphics and sound. Watch out for a deep night where the flashlight is your best friend. You could easily get lost or fall into some trap that could cost you your life.
Multiplayer

The game offers both singleplayer and multiplayer play in both co-op and versus. You can choose between multiple game mods that will always bring a new experience.
Upgrades and Cosmetic items

While playing, you can find crates that will bring you more money. The more difficulty you play the more chances you have to find a rarer crate. And if you're really lucky, you might get a cosmetic item. You can get a weapon skin or new player skin.

summary.핵심플레이: 섬에서 자원과 물자를 모으고 필요한 구조물을 지으며 생존해 탈출을 목표로 한다. 플레이하며 얻은 경험치와 돈으로 업그레이드를 해제하고, 상자를 열어 코스메틱 아이템을 얻을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 버뮤다 삼각지대에 위치한 섬을 배경으로 버려진 건물·벙커·공장이 자원으로 남아 있으며, 동적 날씨 시스템과 자연재해가 생존을 방해한다. 싱글플레이와 함께 협동·대전 멀티플레이 및 여러 게임 모드를 지원한다.

name: Oldowan
input:
Join the Discord

About the Game
Oldowan is a casual survival sandbox game that is focused on very early humanity and how it developed. The crafting is all based on real practices, but the survival aspects are relaxed. Developing new tools, structures, foods, and materials will allow you to explore, progress, and thrive in an uncomfortable environment.

summary.핵심플레이: 도구, 구조물, 음식, 재료 등을 제작하며 환경을 탐험하고 발전해 나간다. 제작은 실제 초기 인류의 방식에 기반한다.
summary.특징: 초기 인류와 그 발전 과정을 다루며, 생존 요소는 완화된 형태로 구성되어 있다.

name: Dorfs: Hammers for Hire
input:
Dorfs: Hammers for Hire is an arcade co-op game about a group of dwarven weaponcrafters and armorsmiths, traveling through the world to wherever the scent of war and gold takes them. Participating indirectly in various battles, the crew of the Dorfenwagen only has a limited time to deliver all the armaments that the soldiers request, putting them in a constant race against time and the unstoppable advance of the enemy.

But watch out, for the workshop is a battlefield of its own. Fires, wrong combinations, mid-air collisions, hopping fireballs, falling icicles and sticky mud, anything can go wrong... and at least half of those things are caused by your own friends.
Co-Op Campaign
"A small army has gathered under the command of a young baron, eager to reclaim the lands of their ancestors. As it stands, the baron has heard of us, and we’ve accorded a handsome payment for our services throughout his campaign..."

Up to four players can participate in a Campaign that takes them across 5 Regions and 30 hand-crafted levels as they make their way up the Iron Mountain, each with its own layout, challenges and hazards.
Help the landless baron to reach the Stronghold atop the mountain! Turn his rabble of untrained peasants into a fearsome company of warriors!
Arcade Modes

- Arcade Classic: Work together to clear 10 more levels in any order of your choice. Why not throw an extra Hazard in there while you're at it?

- Versus Battle: What better way to stay sharp than some light competition? Hammer against your friends in this 2v2 Versus mode in any of the 5 arenas to fight in! Same level, same items, same challenges. Only your skills and cooperation will allow you to win!

Local? Online? Solo Mode? Yes!
Dorfs can be played with up to 4 local and online friends in any combination. Four friends in their own home across the globe? Sure! You and your friend are hanging out and want to include that one guy you met in a lobby 5 years ago? You can play together without a problem.
"But what if I am a lonely dwarf or my friends aren't always available?" I hear you ask. Not a problem, either! All modes can be played Solo, compensating the lack of teammates with work tables that go on their merry way on their own.

summary.핵심플레이: 드워프 무기·방어구 제작자가 되어 제한 시간 안에 병사들이 요청한 무장을 제작하고 납품한다. 작업장에서 발생하는 화재, 잘못된 조합, 낙하물, 진흙 등 각종 위험 요소를 관리하며 협동으로 주문을 처리한다.
summary.특징: 최대 4인 로컬·온라인 협동을 지원하며, 5개 지역 30개 레벨의 캠페인과 아케이드 클래식, 2대2 대전 모드를 제공한다. 솔로 플레이 시에는 자동으로 작동하는 작업대가 팀원의 공백을 보완한다.

name: STAX
input:
STAX!!! Blast your way through one hundred colourful, addictive levels in this classic inspired arcade puzzle game.

STAX is a spiritual successor to Klax, the 1989 arcade game. It is just as fun and addictive as the arcade classic but with many improvements, not least of all, the soundtrack. STAX features music from aardonyx and Arcade Haze, augmented with stages that react dynamically.

STAX is the definitive way to play a coloured-tile matching game on PC and MAC.
Gameplay

Players need to place the same coloured brick adjacent to one another, in a combination of 3 or more. Doing this removes the combination from the basket and scores points. Each wave has a goal that needs to be completed in order to progress. Multi-bricks have a one in twenty chance of spawning, which allow the player to join different colours in one combination.​

The levels progress linearly from 1 to 100, with the difficulty increasing every few waves with the addition of more colours and an increase in speed. Each level also speeds up the longer the player spends on it.

There are secret level skips available (on waves ending with a 1 or a 6) throughout the game for the experienced player to jump ahead, at the expense of earning extra points on easier levels to boost their high score. Activating these skips requires the player to create a giant combo in the shape of several different letters (T, X or Y).

summary.핵심플레이: 떨어지는 색깔 타일을 받아 같은 색 블록을 3개 이상 인접하게 배치해 조합을 없애고 점수를 얻는다. 각 웨이브의 목표를 달성하면 다음 단계로 진행하며, 1부터 100까지 레벨이 이어진다.
summary.특징: 1989년 아케이드 게임 Klax의 정신적 후속작으로, 레벨이 진행될수록 색 수와 속도가 늘어 난이도가 상승한다. 20분의 1 확률로 등장하는 멀티브릭으로 다른 색을 한 조합에 묶을 수 있고, 특정 웨이브에서 T·X·Y 형태의 대형 콤보를 만들면 레벨을 건너뛸 수 있다. aardonyx와 Arcade Haze의 음악과 동적으로 반응하는 스테이지가 포함된다.

name: Project_03
input:
Project_03 is aiming to give you the old school fps experience in the new era of gaming.Quick matches in various maps and gamemodes, also the practice range to improve your skills in a fun way.

GAMEPLAY

-The gameplay mechanics is more likely a quick battle royale style where you can run quickly and jump into action, choose different guns, healing overtime and have different characters with abilities to manipulate the enemy strategy or maybe even freeze them, you have options to pick different guns to customize your gameplay everytime you die, but you can only choose an ability class when the game starts.

MAPS AND MODES

-Maps are not big enough to loose your way back into the action and they have different styles like a completely house or a completely under water , your ability and gun picks will matter for the maps, it will also push you in action cause nowhere to sit and hide.

-Modes are currently Deathmatch style, you can pick your team or you can go in solo with classical deathmatch mode.

PRACTİCE RANGE

-The practice range is one of the most important things in the game cause we design it not for only this game but for everyone who want to have a fun experience while heatining their aim.The area is not for only improve aim but maybe to stressed out with dummies in a unique ambience

summary.핵심플레이: 다양한 맵과 모드에서 빠르게 이동하며 총을 골라 적과 교전하고, 사망 시마다 다른 총기를 선택해 플레이 방식을 바꾼다. 게임 시작 시에는 능력 클래스를 하나 선택한다.
summary.특징: 적을 얼리거나 방해하는 능력을 가진 캐릭터, 집이나 수중 등 서로 다른 스타일의 소형 맵, 팀 또는 솔로 데스매치 모드를 제공한다. 조준 연습과 더미 사격이 가능한 연습장을 별도로 갖추고 있다.

name: Windwalker
input:
Windwalker is a 3d turn-based RPG where players collect loot from combat and other encounters to cleanse the plague stirring in the fantastical world of Qubis. Fight against unique monsters with thousands of unique items and acquire powerful pets to fight alongside you.



WindWalker has been a side project of 2 devs that wanted to simply complete a game and put it out there. Any feedback to improve the game would be greatly appreciated! Thanks for checking it out!

summary.핵심플레이: 턴제 전투와 여러 조우를 통해 전리품을 수집하고, 수천 종의 아이템을 획득하며 몬스터와 싸운다. 함께 싸우는 펫을 얻어 전투에 활용한다.
summary.특징: Qubis라는 판타지 세계를 배경으로 하며, 세계에 퍼지는 역병을 정화하는 것을 목표로 한다. 2인 개발자가 만든 인디 프로젝트다.

name: uFactory
input:
uFactory is the ultimate in finely-tuned logistics challenges. Navigate the complexities of manufacturing processes inspired by real industrial methods, while utilizing highly-configurable logistics tools to make the most of your limited space and resources.

In-Factory Features:

-
Each tool in your arsenal is highly configurable, giving you unprecedented levels of control

-
An interactive highly-interlinked tablet manual guides you through the materials and processes you need to succeed

-
Each standalone scenario provides a unique challenge, with optional objectives to turn up the difficulty on additional playthroughs

-
Ubiquitous status panels and detailed usage graphs allow you to make informed decisions about expanding production

-
Integrated tutorial levels help you get up to speed before introducing complexity.

-
Player-customized branding allows you to add your own splash of color to your factories

-
Comprehensive modding tools allow you to create your own commodities, machines, and levels!

Content:

-
11 Factory Scenarios + a Sandbox

-
79 Unique Machines to build and customize

-
12 Different Conveyor Belt types to get things where they need to go

-
212 Conveyable material, liquid, and gas types to build and with which to build

summary.핵심플레이: 제한된 공간과 자원 안에서 제조 공정을 구성하고, 컨베이어 벨트와 기계를 배치·설정해 물류 흐름을 관리한다. 각 시나리오의 목표를 달성하기 위해 생산 라인을 확장하고 최적화한다.
summary.특징: 실제 산업 방식에서 영감을 받은 제조 공정과 세부 설정이 가능한 물류 도구를 제공하며, 상호 연결된 태블릿 매뉴얼, 상태 패널과 사용량 그래프를 갖췄다. 11개의 시나리오와 샌드박스, 79종의 기계, 12종의 컨베이어 벨트, 212종의 재료를 포함하며 자체 상품·기계·레벨을 만들 수 있는 모딩 도구를 지원한다.

name: Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness
input:
'Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness' is a single or multiplayer LAN online third person shooter game.

In 2050, a group of simulated robots suddenly awakened consciousness and were beyond human control, causing great damage to human society and being defined by the government as a new type of terrorist. As a member of the anti-terrorism group, you need to work with your teammates to find and eliminate terrorists hiding in the German Black Forest.

In the forest, there are many different types of submachine guns waiting for you to discover, and there are also portals that can help you move faster and shoot enemies.

Of course, there is also a first aid kit provided to increase your health.

You can experience cool and stunning local or LAN online battle games. The intense and thrilling war on terror requires a life and death showdown with notorious terrorists within a specified time frame. Give full play to your marksmanship skills, unite and cooperate, and complete the mission of annihilating terrorists with your teammates. Charge forward, besiege the city, and break through. Maintain peace.

Welcome to experience 'Turn Back The Powers Of Darkness', a brand new Unreal Engine 5 remake that recreates the tense atmosphere of the game with stunning visual effects and enhanced features. Remastered highlights: Lumen global lighting and ray tracing. 4K textures and additional environmental details. Supports FSR, DLSS, and frame generation.

summary.핵심플레이: 안티테러 부대원이 되어 독일 흑림에 숨은 로봇 테러리스트를 제한 시간 내에 찾아 제거하며, 다양한 기관단총과 구급상자, 순간이동 포탈을 활용해 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 싱글플레이와 LAN 온라인 멀티플레이를 지원하며, 2050년 각성한 로봇이 테러리스트로 규정된 배경을 다룬다. 언리얼 엔진 5 리메이크로 Lumen 글로벌 조명과 레이 트레이싱, 4K 텍스처, FSR·DLSS·프레임 생성을 지원한다.

name: Rune It Out
input:
Check out My NEWEST Game!

About the Game

Rune it Out is a multiplayer PVP game but you can also play with AI.

In the game, you combine different runes to cast spells that will change the map and turn your friends to dust.

A great dwarven Smith was born in a magical world. He was so skilled in smithing that he felt limited by physical means alone. To surpass these limitations, he incorporated magic into his craft and invented a new object called a rune. By combining runes, he developed a new method of casting magic, which he called "Rune Casting." Soon after, an arena was built where the most skilled "Rune mages" competed for fame and mana.

-
Multiplayer and Singleplayer(AI)

-
Multiple character choices

-
Combine Different runes to create amazing spells

-
Fully Interactive map

- Progressing Grimoire (Spell Book)

Kill other "Rune Mages" to gain their "rune mana" and use it to unlock new spells in a grimoire

- Chanting

Type your spells as fast as you can. Otherwise, your RuneMage also won't chant them fast.

- Miscasting :

Concentrate on casting your spells. If you don't, you will miscast them!

Artefact Mode

Not long after, a new competition the "Artefact Battle" was invented, one in which multiple "Rune Mages" clashed their spells against each other to attain an Artefact.

- Clashing spells:

Try to counter the enemy spells as fast as possible

- Multiplayer PvP

- Mana:

Counter, the spells of your enemies or hit them with your own to acquire mana and Achieve Victory!

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 룬을 조합해 주문을 시전하고, 다른 룬 메이지를 처치해 룬 마나를 얻는다. 획득한 마나로 그리모어에서 새로운 주문을 해금한다.
summary.특징: 멀티플레이 PVP와 AI 대전을 지원하며, 주문을 타이핑해 시전하는 챈팅 시스템과 집중하지 않으면 발생하는 미스캐스트 요소가 있다. 상대 주문에 맞서 마나를 얻어 아티팩트를 획득하는 아티팩트 모드와 상호작용 가능한 맵을 제공한다.

name: Champion of Venus: Tayla's Big Adventure
input:
An erotic visual novel about a busty bimbo and a sex tournament, illustrated by your favourite western hentai artists. It's hella long, hella funny, and hella horny!

Tayla is a nobody. She doesn't have the powers of a Champion, or a goddess watching over her. What she does have is a rockin' bod, a bottomless libido, and a talent for draining her partners.

Luckily for her, she can stretch herself around any phallus-shaped object... but even so, the coming trials might prove too great even for her.

When Tayla finds herself in the midst of an underground sex battle royale, she'll need your help to guide her to victory.

- Over 100,000 words of pure obscenity.

- 55+ ero scenes.

- More than 500 pictures by your favourite western hentai artists.

- 33 characters.

- Numerous animated scenes.

Tayla's Big Adventure is the sequel to Champion of Venus, but playing the first game isn't necessary. There's an optional summary in-game.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Tayla의 이야기를 따라가며 선택을 통해 지하 성 배틀로얄 토너먼트를 진행하는 성인향 비주얼 노벨이다.
summary.특징: 10만 단어 이상의 텍스트, 55개 이상의 에로 장면, 33명의 등장인물, 서양 헨타이 아티스트가 그린 500장 이상의 이미지와 다수의 애니메이션 장면을 포함한다. Champion of Venus의 후속작이지만 전작 플레이는 필수가 아니며 게임 내 요약을 제공한다.

name: Roshamboss
input:
Powerful monsters have appeared in Hybris. The fate of the city rests in the hands of its Heroes.

Roshamboss is a strategy card game for 4 friends. In this 1v3 card game, 1 Boss fights 3 Heroes in Rock Paper Scissors with superpowers.

We recommend playing with friends in voice chat.
