summary.핵심플레이: 1명의 보스와 3명의 히어로가 초능력이 더해진 가위바위보로 대결하는 카드 게임을 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 몬스터가 나타난 도시 Hybris를 배경으로 하며, 4명이 함께 즐기는 1대3 방식으로 진행되고 보이스 챗을 이용한 플레이가 권장된다.

name: Wild West VR
input:
Wild West VR is a first-person shooter unfolding in a western setting. Two gamepads are used as weapons. The interface is maximum smooth. Game features have been enhanced with the introduction of the waves of attacks of various levels of difficulty.
Game Features

- An artificial intelligence (AI) provides the player with a challenging battle against a virtual opponent

- Lightweight game design that would deliver an entertaining interactive experience to the player

- Game design shifted to controllers to make the gameplay feel natural

- Leaderboard

summary.핵심플레이: 서부를 배경으로 두 개의 게임패드를 무기로 사용해 적과 전투를 벌인다. 다양한 난이도의 공격 웨이브를 상대하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: VR 컨트롤러 조작에 맞춘 게임 디자인과 인공지능 기반의 가상 적 전투, 순위표를 제공한다.

name: Booty Barrage
input:
Ahoy, Captain! Embark on a daring high-seas adventure in "Booty Barrage," where you command the defense of a pirate haven against relentless waves of enemy ships. As the guardian of your treasure-laden island, it's up to you to man the cannon and repel the invaders before they breach your defenses!
🏴‍☠️ Command the Cannon:
Take control of a formidable cannon and strategically unleash cannonballs upon the approaching enemy fleet. Precision and timing are key as you target and sink each ship.
⚓Protect the Pirate Base:
Defend your pirate base at all costs! Enemy ships will relentlessly advance, and if they get too close, they'll cause havoc on your beloved haven. Keep a sharp eye on the horizon and thwart their advances to secure your loot.
💣 Upgrade and Customize:
As you sink enemy ships, earn coins and gems for completing waves. Use these riches to enhance your arsenal! Upgrade your cannon for increased firepower, unlock special shots, and fortify your defenses to withstand fierce assaults.
🌊 Face Challenging Waves:
Navigate through increasingly challenging waves of adversaries. From nimble raiders to massive warships, each wave presents a unique threat. Adapt your strategy, improve your aim, and prove that you're the ultimate defender of the pirate's cove.
🌐 Online Co-op:
Team up with your mates in online co-op mode! Invite up to 3 friends to join the fray, protect your booty and share the loot.

summary.핵심플레이: 대포를 조작해 다가오는 적 함대를 조준하고 포격해 격침시키며, 적 함선이 기지에 접근하지 못하도록 방어한다. 웨이브를 완료해 얻은 코인과 젬으로 대포 화력과 방어력을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 해적 기지를 지키는 웨이브 방어 구조로, 소형 습격선부터 대형 전함까지 다양한 적이 등장한다. 최대 3명의 친구와 함께하는 온라인 협동 모드를 지원한다.

name: Slime Age: Parody MMORPG Clicker
input:
The slime era has arrived!

Slimes have captured all locations and hold valuable loot for adventurers!

Which slime catches your fancy? Classic pink, slime-dog, or cat slime? Or perhaps slime-panda?

Collect loot, uncover endearing characters, and explore locations in this clicker game parody.

A game for people who like slimes and cute catgirls!

summary.핵심플레이: 슬라임을 클릭해 처치하고 전리품을 수집하며, 여러 지역을 탐험하고 캐릭터를 발견한다.
summary.특징: 슬라임이 모든 지역을 점령한 설정의 패러디 클리커 게임으로, 클래식 핑크 슬라임, 슬라임 개, 고양이 슬라임, 판다 슬라임 등 다양한 슬라임이 등장한다.

name: Mysterium: A Psychic Clue Game
input:
The official adaptation of the famous board game Mysterium!



Mysterium is a cooperative deduction game set in the 1920s in which a ghost guides a group of psychics to uncover a murderer, as well as the weapon and location of the murder, using only visual clues. Choose your way to play: take on the role of the ghost who gives others clues, or as one of the psychics trying to decipher the abstract "Vision Cards".



In this digital version, you will find:

• A Pass & Play mode

• A faithful adaptation of the original game with gorgeous graphics

• A game variant with or without clairvoyancy

• Additional cases and dream cards from expansions in the in-game shop

• A story mode to discover the background of each psychic

• Solo play with AI partners

• Multiplayer support up to 7 players using online (cross-platform: tablet / mobile / computer)

• Worldwide Leaderboards



Languages available: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian.

summary.핵심플레이: 1920년대를 배경으로 유령이 시각적 단서 카드를 제시하면, 심령술사 역할의 플레이어들이 추상적인 비전 카드를 해석해 살인자, 흉기, 장소를 추론한다. 유령이 되어 단서를 주거나 심령술사가 되어 단서를 해독하는 방식 중 선택할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 보드게임 Mysterium의 공식 디지털 각색으로, 패스 앤 플레이 모드, 예지 유무 변형 룰, 각 심령술사의 배경을 다루는 스토리 모드, AI 파트너와의 솔로 플레이, 최대 7명 크로스플랫폼 온라인 멀티플레이, 세계 순위표를 제공한다.

name: Call of the Void
input: Upgrade skills such as picking locks, explosives, combat, manipulation and charisma in order to overcome various obstacles along the way and gain favors with characters who may be willing to help you.

summary.핵심플레이: 자물쇠 따기, 폭발물, 전투, 설득, 카리스마 등의 스킬을 강화해 경로상의 다양한 장애물을 극복한다. 스킬을 활용해 도움을 줄 수 있는 캐릭터들의 호감을 얻는다.
summary.특징: 여러 종류의 스킬 성장을 통해 장애물 해결과 캐릭터 상호작용을 진행하는 방식을 갖춘다.

name: Manga Maker's Mega Milkers
input:
Online you are 'ORE', a veteran pursuer of the arts, known among your peers as the 'Breast Hunter'. In reality you're just an average joe, going about your day until a fateful encounter! You bump into a girl, and as you are helping her collect her notebook, you notice its full of drawings. Not just any drawings—these are Yon_Yon’s drawings! You could tell immediately by the juicy curves of the breasts, the deep valley of cleavage, and of course the promise of big, leaky, milky titties!

As ecstatic as you are to meet one of your favorite artists, she seems just as excited to meet you, the legendary breast hunter. Thanking you for all the comments on her work that you post, what could have ended as a coincidental meet-and-greet with Yon_Yon, she asks you, her loyal fan, a favor... to help her as an "anatomy" reference for her drawings!

Of course, you agree to help her out! Fast track back to her place, the trade offer has been made; she'll show you her boobs and you'll show her your cock, Yon-Yon's got a passion for porn and will do anything for a good artistic reference. Before too long, feelings between you and Yuko blossom and what was strictly "drawing references", quickly evolves into a part kinky, part cute story of you and Yuko living out some fantasies to help her make the most magnificent ero-manga the world has ever seen!

- Translated version of the original Japanese Visual Novel

- Yuko is fully voiced with original Japanese dialogue

- Original artwork HD upscaled with 16:9 and 4:3 variants

- Hours of story content

- Audio including music and special effects

- Enhanced with character sprite animations

- Gallery and Scene selections

- 14 scenes with Yuko researching naughty activities for her manga!

Manga Maker's Mega Milkers Is the English localization of a Visual Novel originally created by prolific Japanese developer Norn. We at Cherry Kiss aim to provide an authentic Japanese Visual Novel experience to gamers outside of Japan.

**PLEASE NOTE**
All characters described and visually represented in this game are over 18 years of age, and no actual, nor identifiable minor was used in the production of this game.

summary.핵심플레이: 텍스트 기반 스토리를 따라가며 여성 만화가 Yuko와의 이야기를 진행하고, 갤러리와 장면 선택 기능으로 콘텐츠를 감상한다.
summary.특징: 일본 개발사 Norn의 작품을 영어로 현지화한 성인 비주얼 노벨로, Yuko의 일본어 풀보이스, HD 업스케일 원화의 16:9 및 4:3 버전, 캐릭터 스프라이트 애니메이션, 14개의 장면을 포함한다.

name: Future Perfect
input:
Development Updates

To receive updates on Future Perfect's development progress, subscribe to the Dev Updates mailing list by clicking here.

About the Game

Future Perfect breaks down the barrier between having an idea for a game, and playing it with friends. The Future Perfect interface allows you to create, play, and share multiplayer games quickly and easily.

Games created with Future Perfect are published on Steam Workshop. You can browse, rate, and download games that interest you. Models, animations, textures, effects and other assets are also shared, so you can pick and choose the compents you want to create your game.

Future Perfect is in the early stages of development. It's not ready for Alpha, Beta, or Early Access.

summary.핵심플레이: 인터페이스를 통해 멀티플레이어 게임을 직접 제작하고, 친구들과 함께 플레이하며, 만든 게임을 공유한다.
summary.특징: 제작한 게임을 Steam Workshop에 게시하며, 모델·애니메이션·텍스처·효과 등의 에셋을 공유하고 원하는 구성 요소를 골라 게임을 만들 수 있다. 초기 개발 단계로 알파, 베타, 앞서 해보기 상태가 아니다.

name: Skylark 64
input:

Play as Skylark, A flying squirrel who must save The World's Tree from King Murasaki! You must collect all of the Soul Leaves before It's too late! Can you collect them all?

name: Mall control
input:
Start from the bottom. Rise to the top. Alone or with friends.

In Mall Control, you begin broke in a shady hideout, staring at the glowing lights of a shopping mall that could one day be yours. Work your way up by buying your first shop, stocking it with just enough products to attract curious customers… and maybe bending a few rules along the way.

🛠️ Build your empire by day
💻 Hack your way to power by night.

🧩 Features:

-
🎮 Solo or Co-op: Build your mall empire alone or team up with friends online.

-
🏪 Own Shops: Purchase, manage, and customize stores to increase revenue.

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 낮에는 상점을 구매하고 상품을 채워 손님을 끌어들이며 매장을 관리하고, 밤에는 해킹을 통해 세력을 키운다. 은신처에서 시작해 쇼핑몰을 점차 확장해 나간다.
summary.특징: 솔로 또는 온라인 협동으로 진행할 수 있으며, 상점을 구매·관리·커스터마이즈해 수익을 늘리는 요소를 갖추고 있다.

name: Tales of Mist
input:
Tales of Mist is a survival game integrating strategy and adventure in a decaying world. Plagued by the presence of witches and the tyranny of creatures straight out of fairy tales, take command of a city to bring light to this fog-filled world. This game with detailed pixel art aesthetics will lead you into a universe where the spirit of its inhabitants is as failing as the environment that inhabits them.



Machines, inventions, clocks, heroes, soldiers, tactics, religions, several elements will be necessary for you to defeat the many threats of this dismal tale of which you will be the hero and the commander.

summary.핵심플레이: 안개로 뒤덮인 쇠퇴한 세계에서 도시를 지휘하며 여러 위협에 맞서 도시를 운영하고 방어한다. 기계, 발명품, 시계, 영웅, 병사, 전술 등 다양한 요소를 활용해 위협을 물리친다.
summary.특징: 마녀와 동화 속 생물들이 지배하는 어두운 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 세밀한 픽셀 아트 스타일로 표현된다.

name: Sorrow Asylum
input:
Dark thoughts, sadness, loneliness, depression.

The unsafe parts of your mind.

Do not explore them for too long.



Sorrow Asylum is a looping horror game, a mix of an abandoned asylum and your mind's prison. The longer you stay, the deeper you sink.

Explore the asylum of sadness, where time stops, unless you progress by taking the calendar pages into your room down in the basement of the asylum. The longer you stay in this place, the more horrors will try and stop you, fix you, change you, the more the whole place gets affected by your presence.



You'll meet the creatures of such a place: Lara and Plague Doctor.



Lara seems like just another patient, who's room is right next to yours, but it is not always clear whether she's helping or going against you.

The Plague Doctor may try to treat you, but he also does it painfully or simply stopping you from making the time move and damaging you in the process.



The game has 15 day cycles to offer, where the asylum gets progressively more and more sinister and dangerous. The player has the options to run and hide, but often needs to simply confront the unknown and keep learning the story of this place and its citizens.



The evil can be locked up.

Prison. Grotto. Asylum.

These unsafe places will manifest through you.

summary.핵심플레이: 버려진 정신병원을 탐험하며 지하실의 자기 방으로 달력 페이지를 가져와 시간을 진행시킨다. 위협에서 달아나거나 숨을 수 있지만, 종종 미지의 대상과 맞서며 장소와 등장인물의 이야기를 알아가야 한다.
summary.특징: 정신병원과 마음의 감옥이 결합된 루프형 구조로, 머무는 시간이 길어질수록 장소가 점점 위험해진다. Lara와 Plague Doctor 등 등장인물이 도움과 방해를 오가며, 총 15일의 사이클 동안 병원이 점차 위협적으로 변한다.

name: GORILLA TOWN
input:
Inspired by the classic Qbasic GORILLAS, Worms, and that one Tank flash game everybody played in middle school.

GORILLA TOWN is a challenging, fantastical artillery game of GORILLAS vs ROBOTS set in a 1920s Art Deco world. Play a fast-paced single player story mode that tests both your reaction time and brain as you juggle multiple enemies, powerups, and environmental changes, then try the nail-biting and rage-inducing turn-based local multiplayer with friends.

No bamboozling or shenanigans. We don't like micro-transactions of any sorts. You buy the game, you get all of the game, and all the stuff we will add to it!
1 player mode

Help Victor escape GORILLA TOWN! Use your basic understanding of physics, luck, and a computer keyboard to launch yellow fruit of fury through twenty-two cityscapes filled with the most dangerous robots the 1920s has to offer. Collect powerups from looky-loo zeppelin spectators and relish in their delights!

- Twenty-two (22) battles against unique robot adversaries that engage you with varying degrees of hostility and vigor.

- Three difficulty level to choose from for all skill levels for players aged 5 to 500. Easy-Peasy, Just Right, and Over The Top.

- Boost your chances of success with one of nine amazing powerups such as the ever effective "Building buster", "Banana split", and science defying Tele-Port Oil™!

- Enhance your skills as you progress using the patented Upgrade-o-Rama.

2 - 4 player mode

Pull up a chair & take turns battling your friends for supremacy of GORILLA TOWN. Play 1-on-1 or 2-on-2 with any GORILLA TOWN resident. Earn powerups by destroying blimps and get one over on your opponent!

- Show your friends what's what with your firm grip on the use of angles and guesswork!

- Take turns throwing bananas at each other using your keyboard, mouse, or XBOX style gamepads.

- Choose from 9 different characters to be destroyed as: Victor, B.O.X.M.A.N, Gortron, Model-G, Beep, Boop, Steambot, Panzeraffe, & Servoback!

- An infinite amount of variability! A million cityscapes each with their own unique wind from a cool summer breeze to a hurricane on Jupiter. Float easy with Moon gravity or fight under the punishing force of a black hole!

summary.핵심플레이: 각도와 힘을 조절해 바나나 같은 발사체를 던져 적을 맞히는 턴 기반 포격 게임으로, 물리와 조준 감각을 활용해 플레이한다. 1인용 스토리 모드에서 로봇 적들과 싸우거나 2~4인 로컬 멀티플레이로 대전할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 1920년대 아르데코 풍의 세계에서 고릴라와 로봇이 대결하는 설정이며, 22개의 스테이지와 9종의 파워업, 캐릭터 선택, 바람·중력 등 다양한 환경 변수를 제공한다. 마이크로트랜잭션 없이 구매 시 모든 콘텐츠를 제공한다.

name: Motorcycle Mechanic Simulator 2021

Steam Exclusive Offer

search for special/custom parts in the junkyard location

summary.특징: 여러 종류의 차고를 선택해 꾸밀 수 있고, 폐차장에서 특수·커스텀 부품을 찾으며, 도색이나 워터 트랜스퍼 프린팅으로 부품을 커스터마이즈하고 테스트 트랙에서 오토바이 작동을 확인할 수 있다.

name: Polar Shift
input:
After crashing onto a cold, icy, planet and finding a strange crystal that grants you the ability to flip your own gravity, you must escape an icy prison in order to make your way back to home and safety.

Polar Shift is a puzzle-based game where you must decode a foreign language, escape from a violent alien, and help allies with their requests, all while exploring a unique and daunting prison. Explore the gym, cafeteria, and even the notorious "pit" as you adventure inside the gated jail, all while formulating a plan to escape.

"Polar Shift" is also the name of an ability that allows you to flip gravity, and is a tool paramount to your success. Evade capture, gain access to blocked off areas, dodge dangerous obstacles and much more with this unique ability in your hand.

-- Key Features --

• Multiple Endings

• Game unique language

• Randomized code for replayability

• Unique models, textures, and characters

-- Playtime --

A short but humorously wild experience!

(30 min ~ 60 min)

-- Engine --

Unreal Engine 5.4

summary.핵심플레이: 중력을 뒤집는 능력을 사용해 얼음 감옥 내부의 여러 구역을 탐험하며 장애물을 피하고 막힌 지역에 접근한다. 외계 언어를 해독하고, 동료들의 요청을 돕고, 적대적인 외계인을 피하며 탈출 계획을 세운다.
summary.특징: 차가운 행성에 추락한 뒤 중력을 뒤집는 크리스탈 능력 'Polar Shift'를 얻어 탈출을 시도하는 설정으로, 게임 고유 언어와 무작위화된 코드, 다중 엔딩을 제공한다. 30~60분 분량의 짧은 플레이 경험이며 Unreal Engine 5.4로 제작되었다.

name: Aurora
input:
Set in a beautiful forest clearing “AURORA” gives the audience space to experience the majesty of nature through a time-lapse style narrative of day to night, spring to winter and life to death.



This visually rich cinematic animated VR short follows the lives of a young family and all who inhabit it’s vividly coloured landscape. “AURORA” draws the viewer into the emotive storyline by allowing them to get up close and personal with the characters.



Fleeting awe-inspiring moments of presence and gentle interaction invite us to reflect on the very nature of time itself. “AURORA” is an uplifting visual feast that packs an emotional punch.

summary.핵심플레이: 숲속 빈터를 배경으로 한 애니메이션 VR 단편을 감상하며, 등장인물들에게 가까이 다가가거나 가벼운 상호작용을 한다.
summary.특징: 낮에서 밤, 봄에서 겨울, 삶에서 죽음으로 이어지는 타임랩스 방식의 서사를 통해 한 가족과 주변 생명체의 이야기를 시간의 흐름과 함께 보여준다.

name: Eleven Eleven
input:
Their fates have been decided, but how you watch is up to you...



With over 90 min of content to discover, Eleven Eleven is a groundbreaking entertainment experience that places you in the center of the story.



Follow six main characters as they count down the final 11 minutes and 11 seconds before all life is extinguished on the island planet of Kairos Linea. Their only guarantee for survival is a transport ship that will launch just before the clock hits zero, taking whoever can get aboard to safety on a floating ark in the sky.



Their stories unfold simultaneously, and using your HTC Vive or Oculus Touch controllers you manipulate navigate through time and space as their narratives play out in real-time.



You can follow all the action in three unique ways:



- Story Mode allows you to attach to a main character and then takes you on a guided journey through their narrative for a lean-back experience

- Explore Mode lets you detach from the characters and free-roam the environment to find new perspectives, search for Easter eggs, and discover more clues and details about the story and world

- Goddess Mode lets you dynamically shrink the entire map so you can watch all the action play out in miniature like a living diorama and trek through the world at an unprecedented scale



Use these tools to watch all the stories from different perspectives and unlock the grand finale and learn the fates of all the interconnected characters in Eleven Eleven.

summary.핵심플레이: HTC Vive 또는 Oculus Touch 컨트롤러로 시공간을 조작하며 여섯 명의 주요 인물이 실시간으로 전개하는 이야기를 관찰한다. 여러 관점에서 각 인물의 서사를 지켜보며 최종 결말을 해금한다.
summary.특징: 소행성 Kairos Linea에서 생명이 소멸하기 전 11분 11초의 카운트다운을 배경으로 인물들의 이야기가 동시에 진행된다. 인물에 붙어 따라가는 Story Mode, 환경을 자유롭게 탐색하는 Explore Mode, 맵을 축소해 디오라마처럼 전체를 조망하는 Goddess Mode의 세 가지 관람 방식을 제공하며 90분 이상의 콘텐츠를 담고 있다.

name: Unending War: Grand-Strategy Chess
input:
Why are chess battles being fought? And what happens when two pawns clash? These are the questions that ‘Unending War’ answers.

In a fantasy setting; seven gods battle to conquer a vast and brutal world. Taking control of one of these, you must battle your way across a strategic map, securing resources, conquering locations, and building fortresses and supply depots.

Each province taken requires a chess battle, but as you’ve never played before. Supply lines determine the size of your army so that battles can be vastly uneven. More dramatic still: each time pieces collide on the board, the defending god can intercede with an arbitration, causing an rpg style battle to ensue. In these battles strategic resources can be used to devastating effect, and with enough mana, iron, and worship, a pawn might even turn back a queen!

FEATURES:

A new, three-tier strategy game with chess at its core, a strategic world-map above, and individual battles below.
The Strategic Map

- Over 650 provinces to conquer, each upgradeable with a variety of buildings..

- 7 gods and a mixture of other enemies and AIs to battle.

- A mixture of terrains that encourage (but not force) realistic empire sprawl patterns.

- Different visuals depending on which god owns a province.

- Skirmish battles to lower the supply, defence, or difficulty of a province, based on thousands of mid-game, high-level chess games.

- Magic that can change the strategic layout of the map by raising mountains, burning forests, and more.

The Chess Game

- - Difficulty levels that can be scaled to match the player, meaning that you are never overwhelmed.

- A vast range of difficulty levels from complete beginner to GM.

- Standard Chess, Chess 960, and uneven chess games are all offered through the strategy map.

- Each chess board tile is a unique location, offering different bonuses that can be useful during arbitrated battles.

- A selection of overlays which show the map as a more standard chess board.

The Arbitrated Battles

- A simple, yet effective, RPG style battle system.

- Each different chess piece has its own health, bonuses, and cost to arbitrate.

- Health does not recover after battles allowing several smaller pieces to coordinate to take down a larger one.

- Strategic resources can turn the tide of battles with spells, insights, and constructions.

- Not every chess encounter can be arbitrated, resources gained from the strategy map need to be conserved for critical encounters.

summary.핵심플레이: 7명의 신 중 하나를 조종해 전략 지도에서 자원을 확보하고 지역을 정복하며 요새와 보급소를 건설한다. 각 지역을 차지하려면 체스 대국을 벌이며, 보급선에 따라 양측 병력 규모가 달라진다.
summary.특징: 판타지 세계관에서 전략 지도, 체스 대국, 개별 전투의 3단계 구조로 진행되며, 650개 이상의 지역과 다양한 지형, 건물 업그레이드가 있다. 말이 충돌할 때 방어하는 신이 개입하면 각 기물의 체력과 자원을 활용하는 RPG식 전투가 벌어지고, 표준 체스·체스 960·불균형 대국과 초보부터 그랜드마스터까지의 난이도를 지원한다.

name: Mesorift Survival
input:
— Mesorift Survival —

Mesorift Survival offers a classic survival experience with an exciting mix of PvP and PvE – set in a dangerous, tropical world.

Explore a vast open-world map made up of three islands – one large main island and two smaller ones. You'll encounter dense jungle vegetation, abandoned bunker facilities, and old radio towers.

Mesorift Survival is launching in Early Access (version 0.0.1).

This first public build lays the foundation—content, balance, and performance will expand with frequent updates. Your feedback directly shapes development.

Features:

-
Classic Survival Start
You begin your journey on the beach – with nothing. Gather wood, stone, and other materials to craft your first tools like an axe and pickaxe.

name: King of my Castle VR
input:

A horde of armed enemy storms your city, you are the last rampart to protect it!

Arm your bow and defend your city!

name: The Bunny Graveyard II
input:
The Bunny Graveyard II is a one of a kind action-packed horror adventure where you must survive, investigate and play fun minigames. Featuring charming pixelated graphics inspired by the GBA and the NDS era and a wacky cast of characters.

STORY

Awakened by a mysterious white glove, Skye the Bunny embarks on a dangerous journey to find her missing brother, Claudio, and uncover the mystery behind the sudden disappearances haunting Carrot Town!

As dark secrets surface, and new fears unlock, Skye must find the courage to face the horrors ahead. Can she handle the truth and push forward? It's time to find out!

FEATURES

PLAY as Skye the Bunny, she can run, use her flashlight, crawl through hidden passages, and jump on platforms. Make sure to not get her scared, or she might lose her calm.

EXPLORE the haunted streets of Carrot Town, full of enemies and foes that will chase you down the road.

INVESTIGATE mysterious locations around the town, filled with secrets and puzzles waiting to be solved. With the help of your new "Handy" friend, you can point-and-click to inspect important objects.

-
Action-packed and creepy animated CUTSCENES!

-
Piece together the CLUES and learn about new mysteries.

-
Collect FIGURINES of all your favorite characters!

-
Earn Bun-Bun coins by completing ACHIEVEMENTS!

summary.핵심플레이: 토끼 Skye를 조작해 달리기, 손전등 사용, 좁은 통로 기어가기, 점프로 이동하며 생존하고, 마을을 탐험하면서 적을 피하고 미니게임을 플레이한다. 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로 사물을 조사하고 퍼즐과 단서를 풀어 미스터리를 파헤친다.
summary.특징: GBA·NDS 시대에서 영감을 받은 픽셀 그래픽과 애니메이션 컷신을 사용한다. 사라진 남동생과 Carrot Town의 실종 사건을 조사하는 이야기가 진행되며, Skye가 겁을 먹으면 평정을 잃는 요소가 있다. 캐릭터 피규어 수집과 도전 과제로 Bun-Bun 코인을 얻는 시스템이 포함된다.

name: NASCAR Arcade Rush
input:
The NASCAR Beasts are Unleashed!



The thrill of NASCAR meets the rush of arcade racing in a new game that puts you in the driver’s seat of a completely new NASCAR experience with re-imagined, iconic racetracks in unmatched high-speed, wheel-to-wheel action!



Key Game Features:

- Real-World NASCAR locations completely re-imagined with twists, jumps, nitro-boosts and high-speed fun! Experience Talladega Superspeedway, Daytona International Speedway, Darlington Raceway, Martinsville Speedway, Homestead-Miami Speedway, and more in a whole new, fun and dynamic way!



- HUGE Selection of Horsepower! Choose among a full array of vehicle models spanning 75 years of stock car racing from the 50’s to today!



- 1000’s of customization combinations ranging from paint schemes and new rims to spoilers, visual effects, and more! Plus driver suit designs, colors, and helmets!



- Robust Single Player Modes: Career NASCAR Cup Series, Quick Race, and Time Attack modes.



- Thrilling head-to-head local multiplayer plus 12 player online multiplayer fun.

summary.핵심플레이: 재구성된 실제 NASCAR 트랙에서 스톡카를 조종해 니트로 부스트와 점프 등을 활용하며 고속 경주를 펼친다. 커리어, 퀵 레이스, 타임 어택 모드로 진행한다.
summary.특징: Talladega, Daytona, Darlington 등 실제 NASCAR 서킷을 점프와 부스트 요소로 변형해 재현했으며, 1950년대부터 현재까지 75년간의 차량 모델과 도색·림·스포일러·드라이버 슈트 등 다양한 커스터마이징을 제공한다. 로컬 대전과 최대 12인 온라인 멀티플레이를 지원한다.

name: Idle Casino Empire
input: Buy real estate to expand your casino, invest in assets that attract customers and generate revenue, buy upgrades, unlock achievements, new assets and new features along the way. Where does it all end?

summary.핵심플레이: 부동산을 구매해 카지노를 확장하고, 고객을 끌어들여 수익을 창출하는 자산에 투자하며 업그레이드를 구매한다.
summary.특징: 진행하면서 업적을 달성하고 새로운 자산과 기능을 해금하는 방식으로 카지노 규모를 키워간다.

name: Source Code
input:
[Source Code]

[Source Code] is an ultra-realistic shooting and strategic construction game meticulously crafted by the top-tier game development team, Blitzball. It seamlessly blends the intense combat experience of Call of Duty with the tactical depth of Counter-Strike 2. In this game, you will step into a lifelike battlefield meticulously sculpted by cutting-edge graphics rendering technology and physics engines, experiencing unparalleled immersion in combat and creation.

Ultra-Realistic Battlefield, Ultimate Visual Feast

The game adopts the most advanced graphics technology, presenting stunning visual effects. From the neon nightscape of bustling cities to the scorching sun of desolate deserts, every scene is meticulously designed to ensure you can feel the swaying of every leaf and the flying of every grain of sand. The realistic lighting effects and intricate environmental details make you feel like you are in a real battlefield.

Portal System, Infinite Tactical Possibilities

A significant innovation in [Source Code] is its unique portal system. Players can quickly deploy portals on the battlefield for instantaneous transfer, whether for a rapid raid into enemy territory or an emergency evacuation from dangerous areas. The flexible use of portals will revolutionize traditional combat strategies, making every move you make full of uncertainty.

Build Fortifications, Strategic Defense and Counterattack

Beyond intense shooting battles, the game also incorporates rich construction elements. Players can utilize available resources to rapidly build fortifications, shelters, and other defensive facilities on the battlefield, constructing their own combat strongholds. Whether it's a sturdy bunker or a complex labyrinthine defensive structure, they can provide robust support for your combat. While defending, you can also use the fortifications as a starting point for counterattacks, planning thrilling counter-offensive battles.

AK Series Firearms, Glorious Tradition

AK series firearms are renowned for their durability and precision. In [Source Code], players can freely choose and combine various AK series firearms, ranging from rifles to machine guns, each with its unique performance and purpose. Whether for close-range rapid shooting or long-range precise strikes, AK series firearms can meet your combat needs. Besides AK series firearms, the game also offers a wide variety of other modern weapons and equipment, from advanced tactical skills to various grenades and explosives. Players can freely mix and match based on their preferences and combat requirements. Diverse weapon and equipment combinations not only personalize your combat style but also maximize tactical effectiveness in battle.

Team Collaboration, Shared Glory

[Source Code] supports multiplayer online and LAN gameplay, allowing you to team up with friends to face powerful enemies together. In a team, you need to closely cooperate with teammates, formulate tactics, utilize portal and fortification systems, and jointly resist enemy attacks to secure victory in combat. Every successful collaboration will deepen the rapport and friendship among you.

Global Online Competition, Pushing Limits

The game features a global online competition system where you can compete against players from around the world. In tense and exciting matches, showcase your tactical wisdom and shooting skills, climbing to the pinnacle of honor. Every victory will add brilliance to your legendary journey.

High-Difficulty Intelligent AI, Infinite Challenges

The game introduces a high-difficulty intelligent AI system. These AI enemies will make real-time judgments and reactions based on player behavior. They will use terrain for cover, flexibly choose shooting positions, and even cooperate with companions to charge, maximizing the threat to players' survival. The inclusion of high-difficulty intelligent AI makes every battle full of unknowns and challenges, requiring players to remain vigilant at all times and use tactics and wisdom to respond to various situations.

New and Complete Zombie DLC, Pushing Survival Limits

The game specially introduces a Zombie DLC, taking players into a world of even greater horror and despair. In post-war North America and Europe, a massive viral infection has led to a zombie infestation. Players need to survive in this dangerous environment, facing not only the threat of zombies but also competing with other players for limited resources. The Zombie Infinite DLC not only adds more challenges and fun to the game but also lets players experience the struggle between survival and death in tense and exciting battles.

Unreal Engine 5, Cinematic Graphics

[Source Code] utilizes Unreal Engine 5 for rendering, bringing players an unprecedented visual experience. Every scene and detail in the game has been meticulously designed and optimized, achieving realistic, cinematic effects. Whether it's a battlefield filled with gunfire and smoke, ruined urban ruins, or high-tech weapons and equipment, they are all rendered lifelike, as if you are in a real modern battlefield. The extreme rendering capabilities of Unreal Engine 5 allow players to not only feel the shock of gunfire but also enjoy a cinematic visual feast during combat.

Join [Source Code], Embark on Your Legendary Journey

As an ultra-realistic game combining shooting, team tactics, and construction, [Source Code] not only brings you an extreme visual feast and combat experience but also lets you feel the collision of strategy and wisdom in every game. We invite you to join this global combat feast, exploring the unknown, pushing limits, and jointly writing your legendary chapter with us! Join [Source Code] now and start your adventure!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 총기로 전투를 벌이며, 포탈을 배치해 이동하고 자원을 모아 방어 시설과 요새를 건설해 방어와 반격을 수행한다. 팀을 구성해 협력 전투를 하거나 온라인 대전에 참여한다.
summary.특징: 포탈을 이용한 순간 이동 시스템과 요새 건설 요소를 결합했으며, AK 계열을 비롯한 다양한 현대 무기를 조합할 수 있다. Unreal Engine 5로 렌더링되고 지형을 활용하는 AI가 등장하며, 좀비 생존을 다루는 별도 DLC를 제공한다.

name: Crystal Ortha
input:
Today too, in the town tavern the crystal appraisers devote themselves to their business, in search of a far-off legend. Set off on a journey, with four allies who have the future on their shoulders, to find the legendary crystal mother lode!



Enjoy solving puzzles in dungeons, and strike up conversations with the people around the world. Battles with bosses feature conversations, which might even give you some hints about tactics! Fill the skill slots with the skills you like to be prepared for strategic turn-based battles.

Find the ores to craft weapons and search around pots and objects to get items for your adventure.



Watch over the fate of the crystal seekers until the end of their journey!

summary.핵심플레이: 네 명의 동료와 함께 던전을 탐험하며 퍼즐을 풀고, 스킬 슬롯에 원하는 스킬을 배치해 턴제 전투를 진행한다. 광석을 찾아 무기를 제작하고 항아리나 오브젝트를 조사해 아이템을 얻는다.
summary.특징: 전설의 크리스탈 광맥을 찾는 감정사들의 여정을 다루며, 세계 각지 인물들과 대화할 수 있다. 보스전에 대화 요소가 포함되어 전술 힌트를 얻을 수 있다.

name: Hemomancer
input:
Musically charged story about reclaiming identity.

Explore surreal world and choose to dominate, befriend or understand its inhabitants, including yourself. Or just do your own thing, i'm not going to force your hand.

Features:

-
Musical elements - The world has a rhythm to it and music and beats are ever-present. Understand and utilize the soundtrack to your advantage - compose your own actions and attacks like a song, understand the world by becoming one with the music.

-
Roguelite elements - Gather resources and uncover ways to grow stronger permanently between the runs. Experiment by mixing and matching different sets of weapons, clothes, tools and abilities that will help you progress.

-
RPG elements - Your choices puts you on a path that affects both the gameplay and narrative. Make new friends or foes as you explore more lands that will help you learn things about the world and yourself.

-
Visual novel elements - interact with environment and engage in both short interactions and long spanning discussions to affect your gameplay and uncover what's really at stake.

-
Hand drawn pixel graphics - Handcrafted visual style that blends together and blurs the line between hand drawn and pixel art.

-
It's personal and fully indie - Art, music, writing, programming and all that jazz by me, unknown small creator working by themselves.

Thank you for reading all of that stuff!
Make sure to wishlist and spread the word to people if it's interesting, confusing or both.

summary.핵심플레이: 초현실적 세계를 탐험하며 주민들과 지배·우호·이해 중 방식을 선택해 상호작용하고, 리듬과 음악에 맞춰 행동과 공격을 구성한다. 실행(런) 사이에 자원을 모아 무기, 의복, 도구, 능력을 조합하며 영구적으로 성장한다.
summary.특징: 음악이 세계의 리듬으로 상존하며 사운드트랙을 이해하고 활용하는 요소가 중심이 된다. 선택이 게임플레이와 서사에 영향을 주며, 손으로 그린 픽셀 그래픽 스타일을 사용하고 한 명의 제작자가 아트·음악·글·프로그래밍을 모두 담당한 개인 제작 게임이다.

name: Blacksmith War
input:
About
There was a war between the east and the west, and as a blacksmith, you provided various weapons to the soldiers on the front line. From the initial dagger and short sword, to the sophisticated two-handed sword. For the sake of the warriors, please work hard to build the best weapons.

First, you'll craft some base weapons for your warriors to enhance their survivability. Second, sell these weapons to warriors for money, and invest money in research and development to obtain advanced medicinal weapons. Then, develop more powerful weapons for the warriors. You can decide the next step of research and development by observing the warriors' battles, if the warriors die on the battlefield, the recruits may only have money to buy the most basic weapons, you need to balance the profits and the warrior's combat effectiveness, the more powerful the warrior, the richer, the more opportunities for you.

Feature

The difficulty of the game increases dramatically as the levels increase, making it ideal for those who are more than willing to challenge themselves.

summary.핵심플레이: 대장장이가 되어 단검, 단검, 양손검 등 무기를 제작하고 전사에게 판매한다. 판매 수익을 연구 개발에 투자해 더 강력한 무기를 개발하며, 이익과 전사의 전투력 사이의 균형을 맞춘다.
summary.특징: 동서 전쟁을 배경으로, 전장에서 전사들의 전투를 관찰해 다음 연구 개발 방향을 결정한다. 전사가 강해질수록 더 많은 자금과 기회가 생기며, 레벨이 오를수록 난이도가 크게 상승한다.

name: Starchaser: Priestess of the Night Sky
input:
Tonight is the Rite of Starchasing, a ceremony handed down in the village. Kineto was chosen as the priestess by pure coincidence. She is dressed in the priestess's clothing, and at the end of the ceremony, she recites the names of the stars. That was supposed to be all she needed to do. When she looked up, though, her groggy eyes saw a pitch black sky. The stars she was supposed to be naming were nowhere in sight.

"...Where am I? Are these...giant dice?"

Kineto came back to her senses and found herself in the middle of a giant labyrinth.
Welcome to Starchaser

Priestess of the Night Sky is a 3D action game with gravity in every direction, where you have to jump, leap, shoot, and dodge traps littered about the maze. A wall might be your floor a moment later in this "Omnidirectional Gravity Space."

There is no concept of up or down in Starchaser: Priestess of the Nightsky. If you get close to a Gravity Floor , you can stand on any surface, and seemingly impossible routes become traversable if you switch the direction of gravity.

In The Starchasing Priestess, you will come up against enemies that block your way, such as the labyrinth's residents and lords, but the concept of using gravity to your advantage is even more important.

Take a good look at your surroundings. The path will reveal itself to you--all you must do is think.

summary.핵심플레이: 미로를 탐험하며 점프하고 도약하며, 총을 쏘고 곳곳에 설치된 함정을 피한다. 중력의 방향을 바꿔 벽이나 천장을 바닥 삼아 이동하며 길을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 모든 방향으로 중력이 작용하는 전방위 중력 공간을 배경으로 하며, 위아래 개념이 없어 중력 방향을 전환해 통과 불가능해 보이는 경로를 이동할 수 있다. 별 이름을 부르는 의식 중 거대한 미로에 갇힌 무녀 Kineto의 이야기를 따라간다.

name: Retro Wing Prime
input:
Description
Retro Wing Prime is a minimal, polished, retro-inspired, one button arcade game. Easy to learn and hard to master, it's a classic concept with modern gameplay elements and a unique control scheme. Unlock 5 unique ships and many helpful power-ups as you try for a high score!
Gameplay

- Your ship is constantly moving and circling around a point. By clicking your mouse or pressing the space bar, you reverse direction. By alternating directions, you can fly around the screen and shoot asteroids and enemies to increase your score, earn gems, and acquire power-ups.

- When you acquire enough gems, you'll unlock the 'store' which let's you choose from a randomly selected batch of power-ups that will increase the power and ability of your ship.

- As time goes on, asteroids and enemies spawn more frequently, and become more difficult.

- Survive, shoot enemies and asteroids to get points that go towards unlocking new power-ups and ships.

Features

- 5 unique playable ships

- 12 exciting power-ups

- 6 different weapons

- One-button controls

summary.핵심플레이: 기준점을 중심으로 계속 회전하며 이동하는 우주선을 마우스 클릭이나 스페이스바로 방향을 반전시켜 조종하고, 소행성과 적을 격추해 점수와 보석을 얻는다. 보석을 모으면 상점에서 파워업을 선택해 우주선을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 단일 버튼 조작 방식과 방향 전환 기반의 이동을 사용하며, 시간이 지날수록 소행성과 적의 등장 빈도와 난이도가 증가한다. 5종의 우주선, 12종의 파워업, 6종의 무기가 포함된다.

name: ♡beAt! -After the Summer-
input:
About the game

This is a visual novel about identity crisis, farewell of friendship and growing up. Which uses Live2D software instead of traditional character graphics. The story is based on the prequel "♡beAt!" but you don't have to play the prequel to enjoy this game.

Stories

In the center of Tokyo’s metropolitan area.

There’s a small talent agency named Yotsuba Productions (428 Prod. for short); where many aspiring idols strive to become the real deal.

Since the debut of their idol group “♡beAt (Heartbeat)”, the agency’s popularity has skyrocketed. However—due to a “certain” incident that occurred, it was decided to disband ♡beAt prematurely.

Now... As summer closes, along with each member going on their own path.

The story of ♡beAt, and it's end can be told.

Introduction

・Whole script over 5000 lines with the stories

・Original full-color CG artwork

・One-on-one communication mode with the idols

・Original UI design

...and more!

Key Features

- Designed using Live2D software.

- Story takes place across 4 chapters, each one corresponding to a member of ♡beAt from their perspective.

- Uncover secret scenarios depending on your choices, and meeting “certain” conditions throughout the chapters.

Note (Attention)

While the story is relatively for all ages and can be enjoyed as such. There are some scenes that may disturb or cause anxiety for younger audiences, or those who are easily disturbed.

In addition, though the story is partially based of real events. It's solely a work of fiction that doesn’t represent any: individual, group or agency. Thus, it should be treated as such with that context in mind.

Characters:

Core Hato (Stage name)/ Koa Aida (Real name)

The star attraction and leader of ♡beAt (Heartbeat), Core Haato, 16 with vibrancy and a cheerful disposition. She takes pride in being the leader, however hides her identity as an idol in order to live a normal life as, Koa Aida. But, after the "incident" occurred; she decides to openly embrace being an idol and live as, Core Hato.

Haru Samidare

Formerly debuted as an idol in the early days of ♡beAt (Heartbeat). Haru Samidare, now 21, manages the group and serves as a direct mentor to Koa. Although, being very stern and diligent, she's only seen as unpopular by fans. So, in her downtime, she works secretly as a shrine maiden.

Suzu Maikaze

The youngest and the "Sleeping Beauty" of ♡beAt (Heartbeat), Suzu Maikaze, 14 but claims to be 140 years old. She always seems sleepy; yawning while in the mist of conversations. But despite that; she's a breathtaking singer that surpasses Koa (vocally). However, since the "incident" occured, she's been targeted by a stalker.

Yuuka Kasasagi

Arriving from Saga prefecture, Yuuka Kasasagi debuts as the latest member of ♡beAt. While, having trouble standing out and feeling like the "Cinderella" of the group. The fans and her growing popularity tell a different story, as she's considered to be rivaled with Koa. But, with gossip like that spreading around, a lot of angry stans have arised.

Saku Mochidzuki

A childhood friend of Koa, Saku Mochizuki is the only one who knows Core Hato's true identity (aside from the group). To ensure that it doesn't leak; she decides to join ♡beAt as an assistance for Core Hato.

summary.핵심플레이: 아이돌 그룹 ♡beAt를 중심으로 전개되는 스토리를 읽어 나가며, 선택지에 따라 분기와 숨겨진 시나리오를 해금한다. 아이돌 캐릭터와의 1대1 커뮤니케이션 모드도 포함한다.
summary.특징: 전통적 캐릭터 그래픽 대신 Live2D를 사용하며, 그룹 해체를 둘러싼 이야기를 각 멤버 시점의 4개 챕터로 나눠 그린다. 정체성, 우정과의 이별, 성장을 다루는 5000줄 이상의 스크립트와 오리지널 CG를 담고 있다.

name: Pizza Bandit
input: Pizza Bandit is what happens when a third-person shooter crashes headfirst into a cooking show — bullets, bounties, and burnt crusts flying everywhere. In this mission-based, 4-player co-op adventure, you play as an ex-mercenary chasing an oddly specific dream: opening the galaxy’s greatest pizza joint.

summary.핵심플레이: 미션 기반으로 전투를 벌이며 총격전을 치르고, 피자를 만드는 요리 활동을 병행한다. 최대 4인 협동 플레이를 지원한다.
summary.특징: 은퇴한 용병이 은하계 최고의 피자 가게를 여는 것을 목표로 삼는 설정으로, 3인칭 슈팅과 요리 요소를 결합했다.

name: Wren's Resurgence
input:
Wren’s Resurgence is a 2D action platformer where Wren must fight her way through the Yokai-infested lands in order to rescue her sister Swan. With the evil force’s tyrannical grasp on the island, it’s up to Wren to brandish her katana and bring peace back to the land.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Wren이 되어 카타나로 요괴들을 상대하며 지역을 돌파해 나간다. 플랫폼을 이동하고 적을 처치하며 여동생 Swan을 구출하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 요괴가 창궐한 섬을 배경으로 하며, 악한 세력의 지배를 물리치고 평화를 되찾는 내용을 다룬다.

name: Swap Fire
input: Swap Fire was originally a Nintendo Wii U Exclusive. With the closure of the Wii U eShop, we've decided to preserve Swap Fire via Steam. We are especially excited about Steam Remote Play Together, which allows Swap Fire's local multiplayer experience to go online for the first time. Please check out our video tutorial for Steam Remote Play Together and be sure to share it with your friends. They don't need a copy of the game to play with you!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어들이 함께 즐기는 로컬 멀티플레이어 방식의 슈팅 플레이를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 원래 Nintendo Wii U 전용으로 출시되었던 게임을 Steam으로 이식했으며, Steam Remote Play Together를 통해 로컬 멀티플레이를 온라인으로 즐길 수 있고 친구는 게임을 구매하지 않아도 함께 플레이할 수 있다.

name: Full Spectrum Gradient
input:
An Arcade Puzzler with a twist. Instead of matching falling tokens of the same color, clear tokens by matching them up into a complete rainbow line.

STAGES MODE

Play through stages on a map and defeat alien creatures by making rainbow lines. Can you save the world?

ENDLESS MODE

See how long you can last and go for a new high score. Unlock additional endless modes by beating bosses in stages mode.

VERSUS MODE

Two player versus with one keyboard or two controllers. Who can last the longest? Make rainbow lines to trigger attacks on the opponent and speed up their token fall speed.

summary.핵심플레이: 떨어지는 토큰을 같은 색으로 맞추는 대신, 여러 색을 완전한 무지개 선으로 이어 맞춰 토큰을 없앤다.
summary.특징: 맵을 따라 스테이지를 진행하며 무지개 선으로 외계 생물을 처치하는 스테이지 모드, 최고 점수를 겨루는 엔들리스 모드, 무지개 선으로 상대를 공격하고 토큰 낙하 속도를 높이는 2인 대전 모드를 제공한다.

name: Awakening: The Dreamless Castle
input:
After Awakening in a mysterious castle it's up to you to collect clues and valuable items needed to solve perplexing puzzles and escape! Listen to your fairy friend as she guides you towards the exit. Play fun minigames and solve clever locks to make it to the next room in the castle. Use your Hidden Object skills to search for the next hint and discover a young Princess' destiny in Awakening: The Dreamless Castle.



- Gorgeous graphics

- Escape the castle!



This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

summary.장르: 어드벤처, 캐주얼, 히든 오브젝트 퍼즐 어드벤처
summary.핵심플레이: 장면 속에 숨겨진 사물을 찾고 단서와 아이템을 모아 퍼즐과 잠금장치를 풀며 성의 방을 하나씩 통과해 탈출한다. 중간중간 미니게임을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 신비한 성에서 깨어난 주인공이 요정의 안내를 받아 진행하는 스토리 기반 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로, 젊은 공주의 운명을 다룬다.

name: Sky Dreamer
input:
Discover Sky Dreamer – Your Gateway to Peak Productivity and Engaging Gamification!

Immerse yourself in a world of floating cities and cosmic vistas while leveraging the proven Pomodoro Technique to stay laser-focused. Sky Dreamer fuses productivity with play, reflecting your progress in a stunning sci-fi setting and rewarding every milestone. It’s the perfect choice for anyone determined to tackle tasks efficiently, all while having a blast!

Keep Sky Dreamer subtly visible at the bottom of your screen as you work or browse, so you can track your progress and stay motivated without missing a beat.

Key Features

-
Focus Sessions that Fuel City Expansion
Transform your work time into tangible progress as your futuristic floating cities grow with each focus session. Customize your city’s look and feel to match your personal goals and style.

-
Built-In Pomodoro Timer
Take advantage of pre-set work and break cycles, or tailor them to your own schedule. Stay efficient and avoid burnout with time-tested workflow methods.

-
Personalization & Progress
Earn points to unlock new buildings, sky colors, and futuristic elements like spaceships. Make your city uniquely yours while celebrating each achievement.

-
Customizable To-Do Lists
Organize and prioritize tasks right within the app. Watch your city thrive as each completed task propels it to new heights.

-
Relaxing Sci-Fi Atmosphere
Enjoy dynamic day/night cycles, see cities expand, and spot flying spacecraft in an ambiance designed to keep you calm yet inspired.

Why Choose Sky Dreamer?

-
One-of-a-Kind Sci-Fi Design
Turn your workspace into a futuristic haven that sparks creativity and enhances focus.

-
Gamification Meets Efficiency
Boost your productivity with visual rewards that showcase your progress, turning every goal you meet into an exciting step forward.

-
All-in-One App
Timer, to-do lists, visual progress, and engaging challenges—plus a sleek strip at the bottom of your screen to keep you motivated, all in one easy-to-use package.

Turn every minute of your day into an adventure! Sky Dreamer is tailor-made for go-getters who aim to stay productive while enjoying an immersive, playful world. Watch your floating cities soar higher as you crush each goal, all while keeping a constant eye on your achievements—even when you’re busy in other applications.

Elevate your routine and conquer your to-do list in true sci-fi style with Sky Dreamer!

summary.핵심플레이: 뽀모도로 타이머로 집중 세션과 휴식을 반복하고, 할 일 목록을 관리하며 작업을 완료하면 부유 도시가 성장한다. 획득한 포인트로 건물, 하늘 색, 우주선 등의 요소를 잠금 해제해 도시를 꾸민다.
summary.특징: 공중 도시와 우주 배경의 SF 세계관에서 진행 상황이 시각적으로 반영되며, 낮과 밤 순환과 비행하는 우주선 연출을 제공한다. 다른 앱을 사용하는 동안에도 화면 하단에 진행 상황을 표시할 수 있다.

name: Arcade Manager
input:
Build Animated Fun Arcade games for your customers
Crane Games, Coin Pushers, Bowling, Air Hockey, Dance Games, Hit Target Throwing Games, Pinball, Motorcycle Racing Game, Unlock the lock game, Lightgun game, Arcade Cabinet, Japanese styled arcade cabinet, Ball Drop Arcade Game, Coin Pusher, Ring Toss, Pong Game, Vortex Game, Bowling Game, Big Wheel Spin, Ticket Checker, Lots of furniture object...and more on release!

Manage and modify games
Increase profits and keep customers happy by modifying jackpots, how often jackpots happen, the quality of prizes, credit cost and more!
Goal Rewards
Progress through new goals every run to unlock machines, money and talents.
Replayability
Unlock legend mods, that change the rules of the game completely. Offering new ways to win and new strategies.

Create advertisements
Drive in more customers with randomly generate advertisement campaigns, use your smarts to determine which ones will bring in the most profit.

Events
Create events in your arcade light high score challenges, speed running, dance tournaments and more!

StaffHire and manager staff to help customers, repair machines, upgrade machines and clean up the arcade!
Economy / Management
Manage your finances in Arcade Manager by adjusting the costs per credits when guests enter the arcade. Set different credit costs per machine, adjust jackpot settings like the odds

Arcade Manager
Build and manage the arcade of your dreams in Arcade Manager! Start with a few machines, funky carpet, and sticky floors, then grow your business into a bustling entertainment hub, become a tycoon. of hitting a jackpot and the payout of the jackpot. Hire Staff each with different stats, like how fast they will repair/clean and how expensive they are. Events cost money and can be adjusted how big the event prize is.

summary.핵심플레이: 크레인 게임, 코인 푸셔, 볼링, 에어하키, 핀볼 등 다양한 아케이드 기계를 배치해 오락실을 운영하고, 잭팟 확률과 크레딧 비용, 상품 품질 등을 조정하며 수익을 관리한다. 직원을 고용해 기계 수리·업그레이드·청소와 고객 응대를 맡긴다.
summary.특징: 매 플레이마다 새로운 목표를 달성해 기계·자금·특성을 해금하며, 게임 규칙을 바꾸는 레전드 모드로 다른 전략을 시도할 수 있다. 광고 캠페인으로 손님을 유치하고 하이스코어 챌린지, 스피드런, 댄스 토너먼트 같은 이벤트를 개최할 수 있다.

name: Quantum Suicide
input:
Quantum Suicide is a game of betrayal, deception and romance in the cold depths of space.

This science fiction thriller visual novel tells the tale of an intergenerational mission and its diverse crew, fighting against a deadly AI (and each other) for the chance to survive. Strategy, love interests and quantum mechanics await you. Your choices change the fate of everyone in Quantum Suicide.

You play as a researcher aboard a spaceship on an epic mission to find humanity a new home. The mission is jeopardized by a corrupted A.I system that forces you to play "The Deletion Game", a weekly game where you must battle your crew mates for survival. Prepare to make both friends and enemies of your crew members as you play through rounds of "The Deletion Game". Can you see the Everett's mission through to the end...alive?

Quantum Suicide features:

- Over 30 different endings

- The choice to play as a boy or a girl

- 7 romance endings (Including 3 Male, 3 Female and the A.I. system)

- The romance options have their own sexual preferences - (romance and friend zone endings depending on your choices)

- Original Soundtrack

- Available in English and Japanese, with full voice acting

- Death around every corner

Can you see the Everett's mission through to the end...alive?

*Please Note: Quantum Suicide does not follow traditional dating simulator/game structure of a point or flag system - narrative branches are based on character deaths. It is also a requirement to play as both the male and female protagonist in order to achieve the true ending.

Questionable design choices, I know, but whats done is done and you have been warned :)*

Current Build Version: 29.10.211.

To ensure your game is up to date, please select Extras from the Main Menu > Credits > The version is listed in the bottom left hand corner :)

summary.핵심플레이: 우주선 연구원으로서 이야기를 읽어나가며 선택을 하고, 매주 진행되는 'The Deletion Game'에서 승무원들과 생존을 두고 대결한다. 선택에 따라 승무원들과의 관계와 결말이 달라진다.
summary.특징: 세대 간 이주 임무를 배경으로 한 SF 스릴러로, 30개 이상의 엔딩과 남녀 주인공 선택, 7가지 로맨스 엔딩(AI 포함)을 제공한다. 서사 분기가 캐릭터의 죽음을 기반으로 하며 진 엔딩을 위해서는 남녀 주인공을 모두 플레이해야 한다. 영어·일본어 지원과 풀 보이스 연기, 오리지널 사운드트랙을 포함한다.

name: Wild Warfare
input:
Survival of the fittest: now with guns.

Wild Warfare is a free-to-play, class and vehicle-based FPS, starring a colourful cast of critter mercs. Inspired by old school shooters, it seeks to capture the fun and fur-ious action of classic era multiplayer games. There ain't no regenerating health here.

Wild Warfare is currently in Alpha. If you enjoy classic arcade action with well balanced gameplay, crazy characters, and bears with mini-guns, this is exactly that game.

Wild Warfare features:

- Class-based combat - nimble rabbits with bludgeoning weapons, raccoons with assault rifles, and more on the way!

- Vehicle combat - Armoured Walkers transform the battlefield instantly with missiles!

- Customizable characters - deck out your animal with warpaint, hats, and backpacks!

- A bunch of game modes (Capture the Flag, Team Death Match, and Death Match)!

- Ranking and levelling up - earn your infamy!

- More of everything! This Alpha only scratches the surface of what's in store!

No animals were harmed in the making of this game. But we encourage you to pick up the slack.

summary.핵심플레이: 클래스와 차량을 활용해 팀 또는 개인 단위로 총격전을 벌인다. 캡처 더 플래그, 팀 데스매치, 데스매치 등의 모드에서 대전한다.
