name: VR historical journey to the age of Crusaders: Medieval Jerusalem, Saracen Cities, Arabic Culture, East Land
input:
The Arab Empire (632-1258) was an Islamic empire established by Arabs in the Middle Ages. Chinese history books since the Tang Dynasty have been called "big food (yì)", while Western Europe is used to call it the Saracen Empire. The Arab Empire has gone through 626 years. There are four major caliphs (632-661) and the Umayyad dynasty (661-750) and the Abbasid dynasty (750-1258).

We have seen many books about the Arab Empire, but have you tried a realistic Arab Empire world? In real life, we cannot go back to the past, and we cannot empathize well with the culture of that era. But in the VR field, we can enable you to enter an extremely real world by using virtual reality equipment. The historical journey in the era of the VR Crusader is to simulate the virtual world of the Arab Empire. You can feel the desolate and dry desert environment of abandoned small villages, experience the suffering of the people's life in the Arab Empire, and see the splendid castles of the Arab Empire. You can walk freely in the game, you can appear in any corner of the palace, you can also stand on the castle and look at it, it will grow alive in front of you. The immersive and immersive feeling brought by VR technology is unmatched by other technologies.

We have built several simulated scenes for this game. You can choose any scene to start your tour. At the same time, in order to prevent you from being bored during the tour, we have also designed a game session to find the treasure chest to bring more fun to your tour. Every time you find a treasure chest, you will get different points. The more treasure chests you find, the more points you will accumulate; don’t underestimate this point, this point will bring you a huge surprise after the game is over Big gift package. In addition to the game items to visit the scene, we also provide fishing game items imitating traditional fishing, bow and arrow hunting games and snake games. I have to say that the snake-eating game is very good for our shoulder and neck health. At the same time as the game, we are constantly exercising our cervical spine. It is really a very good game.

Arabia’s hectic territory stretches from the Indus River and Congling in the east, to the Atlantic coast in the west, to the Caucasus Mountains, Caspian Sea and southern France in the north, to the Arabian Sea and the Sahara Desert in the south, with a land area of ​​13.4 million square kilometers. It is the east and west in ancient world history. One of the empires with the longest span is also a great empire that straddles Asia, Europe and Africa after the Persian Achaemenid Empire, the Alexander Empire, the Roman Empire, and the Byzantine Empire.
From the second half of the 9th century, the Abbasid dynasty entered a period of division and gradual decline. The feudal lords or governors of various regions held separate forces, monopolized one side, separated from the center and became independent, and the Caliphs became the puppets of the Bouvets and the Seljuks. In 1258, the capital of Abbasid Baghdad was captured by Hulagu, the last Baghdad caliph Mustaisuimu was killed, the Arab Empire was destroyed, his uncle fled to Cairo, was adopted as Mustansir II, until 1517 Ottoman The empire was destroyed by the Mamluk dynasty. The last Cairo Caliph Mutawakil III under the control of the Mamluk Sultan was captured, and his caliph title was also captured by Selim I.
Due to its unique geographical location, the rise of the Arab Empire changed the development process of many neighboring nations and had a very important influence in the history of the Middle Ages.

The huge Arab empire is a multi-ethnic, multi-religious, and multi-belief collection established by Arab nobles through force of conquest.
There are certain estrangements and contradictions between different nationalities and different beliefs; there are irreconcilable class contradictions between the broad masses of the people, the aristocratic bureaucrats, and the wealthy business class; the Muslims are also torn apart due to complex contradictions; especially the further feudal system Develop and cultivate divorced forces from within the empire. Therefore, in the middle of the 9th century, the Caliphate had gradually released its own energy, and the empire had fallen sharply to the end of its disintegration, until its end.
As early as the establishment of the Abbasid dynasty, the descendants of the Umayyad family separatized the Iberian Peninsula in Europe and established the later Umayyad dynasty (756-1236). Because of the color and whiteness, Chinese history books called it "Big food in white", and the Abbasid dynasty fight against courtesy. In 788, the Shiite Idris dynasty emerged in North Africa and Morocco.
The differences in the economic foundations of the empire and the strong local power created by military confinement contributed to the formation of a separatist regime. The powerful economic foundation and military power that the governors and military commanders of various regions gradually acquired as a result of the implementation of the landlord system constituted a serious threat to the rule of the Abbasid dynasty. Dozens of governors and military commanders from all over the east and west took the opportunity to stand on their own feet, attacking and conquering each other, and trying to encroach on the central government.
In 800, general Ibn Agreb established the Agreb dynasty (822-875) after he obtained Tunisia.
In 868, the Governor of Egypt, Ahmed Tulun, declared independence and established the Tulun Dynasty (868-905). After the Tahir Dynasty in the eastern provinces, the Safar Dynasty (867-903) and the Saman Dynasty (874-999) appeared one after another.
In 909, Shiite Muslims established the Fatimid dynasty in Tunisia, and successively conquered Algeria, Syria, Egypt, and Sardinia. In 973, they moved their capital to Cairo. Because of the green color, Chinese history books called it "green food".

In addition, Mosul and Aleppo established the Hamdan dynasty; Persians and Turks established the Saman, Baiyi, Ghaznavid, and Seljuk empires in Persia, Central Asia, and Asia Minor; The Ayub Dynasty was also established in Egypt, Syria and Yemen. During this period, kingdoms large and small came and went.
After the 10th century, the empire was torn apart and the actual ruling area was limited to Baghdad and its surrounding areas, which existed in name only. Ali, the third son of Baiyi from the Delemu people on the south bank of the Caspian Sea, occupied Shiraz, the capital of Fars in 934; his brother Ahmed entered Baghdad in 945, and Caliph Mustekfei became the puppet of the Baiyi family . The feudal lords in various places maintained a separate regime and dominated one side.
In 1055, another Seljuk captured Baghdad and removed the caliphate from political power, retaining only the status of religious leader.

summary.핵심플레이: VR 장비를 사용해 재현된 여러 아랍 제국 시대의 장면을 자유롭게 돌아다니며 궁전, 성, 사막 마을 등을 둘러본다. 장면 곳곳에 숨겨진 보물 상자를 찾아 점수를 모을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 아랍 제국(632-1258) 시대를 가상현실로 재현한 관광형 콘텐츠로, 여러 시뮬레이션 장면을 선택해 탐방할 수 있다. 낚시, 활 사냥, 스네이크 등의 부가 미니게임도 제공한다.

name: Wool at the Gates
input:
Current Content

-
6 Heroes and 15 Hero Abilities

-
3 Factions (Human, Orc, Elf) and 45 Faction Perks

-
12 Troop Types and 12 Tower Types

-
9 Classes (27 class bonuses)

-
5 Full Maps + Tutorial Map

-
3 Challenges per Map

-
Endless Mode (Experimental)

-
~3 Hours of Campaign Content (not including challenges or endless)

About the Game

Inspired by games like Thronefall, SNKRX, and Warcraft 3, Wool at the Gates fuses minimalistic tactical base defense with the deep class synergy systems of auto-battlers and hero-driven action of MOBA’s to deliver an exciting loop of strategic base building and epic battles.

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 영웅과 병력을 활용해 기지를 방어하고, 클래스 조합과 진영 특성을 조합하며 전략적으로 기지를 건설하고 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 6명의 영웅과 15개 영웅 능력, 인간·오크·엘프 3개 진영과 45개 진영 특성, 12종 병력과 12종 타워, 9개 클래스가 제공된다. 튜토리얼을 포함한 5개 맵과 맵별 3개 도전 과제, 실험적 무한 모드, 약 3시간 분량의 캠페인 콘텐츠를 포함한다.

name: Aeris (BETA)
input:
Aeris is a flight simulator where you can explore the vast world in your favorite airplanes. Travel to your favorite locations and fly with friends, all for free. Buckle your seatbelt and get ready to dive into the world of Aeris.

Terrain

Aeris has global Cesium Ion Google Earth scenery. You can explore mountains, cities, and landmarks in the game.

Planes

While playing Aeris, you can fly in 3 different varieties of plane. A fighter jet, a cargo plane, and a passenger jet are all available to you when flying.

Multiplayer

Full multiplayer is supported so you can fly your friends and others above the scenery.

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 종류의 항공기를 조종해 전 세계 지형을 비행하며 원하는 장소를 탐험한다. 전투기, 화물기, 여객기 중 선택해 조종할 수 있다.
summary.특징: Cesium Ion 기반 Google Earth 지형을 사용해 산, 도시, 랜드마크를 재현하며, 멀티플레이를 지원해 다른 사용자와 함께 비행할 수 있다.

name: River City Melee Mach!!
input: The Renegade/River City (Nekketsu Kouha Kunio-kun) series has had its share of success in the late 80's, and now, the "Fight it out!" part of its numerous spin-off sports series is back and powered-up!

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 캐릭터가 등장하는 난투 액션으로, 플레이어는 캐릭터를 조작해 상대와 격투를 벌인다.
summary.특징: River City(Nekketsu Kouha Kunio-kun) 시리즈를 기반으로 한 스핀오프 작품으로, 시리즈의 'Fight it out!' 요소를 강화했다.

name: Communist Clicker
input: Communist Clicker is more than just a clicker game! You can buy stonks from the stonks market which will go up and down over time in addition to the player also being able to affect it, you can even mine dogecoin and have miners try to crack the code so you can sell the coins, and you can even pay a visit the secret black mar... Never mind. You can also upgrade your clicks to gain more money for each click, and you can also buy and upgrade workers who will click the hammer and sickle for you!

summary.핵심플레이: 낫과 망치를 클릭해 돈을 벌고, 클릭당 수익과 대신 클릭해 주는 일꾼을 구매·업그레이드한다. 주식 시장에서 주식을 사고팔거나 도지코인을 채굴해 판매할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 공산주의를 테마로 한 클리커 게임으로, 시간에 따라 변동하며 플레이어가 영향을 줄 수 있는 주식 시장과 채굴자를 이용한 코인 채굴 시스템을 포함한다.

name: Interconnected Stories
input: In each chapter of the story, you will have at your disposal a wide variety of cards with certain actions, with which you will have to help the characters involved to achieve their dreams at that moment. However, the way to fulfill these dreams will be at your whim, being able to generate really bizarre situations. In addition, you will also have in your hand the possibility of looking for alternative stories even more interesting than the original...

summary.핵심플레이: 각 챕터에서 다양한 행동이 담긴 카드를 사용해 등장인물들이 그 순간의 꿈을 이루도록 돕는다. 꿈을 실현하는 방식은 플레이어의 선택에 따라 달라진다.
summary.특징: 플레이어의 결정에 따라 기이한 상황이 만들어질 수 있으며, 원래의 이야기 외에 대안적인 스토리를 찾아볼 수 있다.

name: Mushroom Heroes
input:
A puzzle platform adventure, with inspiration going all the way back to SNES and 8-bit classics. The game is inspired from ‘90s classics like Lost Vikings.



Mushroom Heroes is a puzzle-platform video game developed by Serkan Bakar.

Retro platformer where the player can switch between three different characters.

You have a 3 mushroom hero and each mushroom has special abilities, some of which the player needs in order to pass certain obstacles.



Jumpi can higher jump and float in air.

Yuppi can kill enemies with his bow. The bow can also be used to detonate some walls and bombs.

Dombi can block enemies projectiles with his shield, and he can push or pull some objects.



Mushroom Heroes brings back the look and feel of the very best classic platformers from the 90's, introducing refreshed and engaging gameplay mechanics. If you miss platformers from the 16-bit era, and think games nowadays aren't that good anymore, think twice! Mushroom Heroes is for you.





STORY



A long time ago, there was a mushroom country, living in tranquility: it was Boduria. Boduria was ruled by King Bodur for 1000 years. King Bodur had an allied warlock, called Gaddar. Gaddar was also the one and only poisonous mushroom in the land. One fine day, Gaddar wanted to turn some of the mushrooms in the village into poisonous ones, just like him. Believing non-poisonous ones are weak, Gaddar's aim was to poison the the folk and become the King. King Bodur didn't let him get away with it, and exiled Gaddar. Nevertheless, Gaddar had the antidote to dispel the poison. Before it's too late, King assigned 3 of his best warriors to catch Gaddar and bring the potion back. Thus: Yuppi, Jumpi and Dombi embarked on a tough adventure.







Features:

• Over 37 Challenging Levels

• Dozens of Unique Puzzles to Solve

• EXTREMELY addicting

• The Ultimate Casual Brain Teaser

• Almost impossible to beat!

* Lots of enemies

summary.핵심플레이: 세 명의 버섯 캐릭터를 전환하며 장애물을 통과하고 퍼즐을 풀며 스테이지를 진행한다. Jumpi는 높이 점프하고 공중에서 떠 있을 수 있고, Yuppi는 활로 적을 처치하거나 벽과 폭탄을 터뜨리며, Dombi는 방패로 투사체를 막고 물체를 밀거나 당길 수 있다.
summary.특징: SNES 및 16비트 시대 플랫포머와 Lost Vikings 등 90년대 고전에서 영향을 받은 레트로 스타일로, 각 캐릭터의 고유 능력을 조합해 진행한다. 독버섯 마법사 Gaddar를 쫓는 스토리를 배경으로 37개 이상의 스테이지와 다양한 퍼즐을 제공한다.

name: Neuronaut
input:
Genre: Visual Novel, ADV, eroge, mysticism, humor

Length: about 2 hours



At first glance, this may appear to be a familiar story of young people with tumultuous personal lives, who, while on vacation in a resort town, meet new people, get jealous, quarrel, reconcile, make love and cause problems for themselves and others.

However, the catch is that the protagonist of this story is an office clerk who has the ability to leave his body for the astral plane and put his consciousness into other people. Now he is stuck in the body of a student, which our hero isn't happy about. Thrust into this situation, we will have to help a flighty young man make some important decisions that can completely change his future and the future of those around him. Everyone will have to learn a thing or two, make changes in their life and it will be up to you to set every character's fate right, help them overcome their struggles and reach the happy ending.



Here's what awaits you:

* Juice, colorful art and a CG gallery

* Atmospheric soundtrack and a music room where you can listen to your favorite tracks

* Several choices that will affect the course of the story

* 4 Female characters to romance

* 7 Different endings

summary.핵심플레이: 선택지를 통해 이야기의 흐름을 결정하며, 등장인물들이 중요한 결정을 내리고 각자의 문제를 극복하도록 돕는다.
summary.특징: 육체를 떠나 다른 사람의 몸에 의식을 옮기는 능력을 가진 주인공이 학생의 몸에 갇히는 설정을 다룬다. 4명의 여성 캐릭터와의 로맨스, 7가지 엔딩, CG 갤러리와 음악 감상실을 제공한다.

name: The Runner
input: Experience the authentic charm and challenge of Venice in this hyper-realistic endless runner game. Navigate intricate canals, evade bustling markets, and leap over historic landmarks as you test your agility and reflexes in the heart of one of Italy's most iconic cities. How far can you go in this true-to-life Venetian adventure?"

summary.핵심플레이: 베네치아를 무대로 계속 달리며 운하와 시장을 피하고 랜드마크를 뛰어넘어 최대한 멀리 이동한다. 순발력과 반사신경으로 장애물을 회피하는 것이 핵심이다.
summary.특징: 이탈리아 베네치아를 사실적으로 재현한 배경에서 진행되며, 운하와 역사적 랜드마크 등 실제 도시 요소를 코스에 활용한다.

name: You Want to Watch the World Burn
input:
Originally written for the TI-84+ CE calculator, You Want to Watch the World Burn for PC provides a tactile atmospheric retro experience with explosive destruction!

Features a fun and unique campaign; you will experience the cool game mechanics in many contexts.

An interactive tutorial allows you to enjoy the mechanics as you learn them.

Many weapons to help your destruction.
The lighter is used for controlled burns.
The napalm grenade has a long fuse, but it will cause a large amount of damage.
The flamethrower is fast and effective — great for corridors.
The shaped charge blasts fire to all floors at and below where it's placed.
The RPG-7 is an anti-tank rocket-propelled grenade launcher. It's effective for exploding things at a distance.

The textures, sounds, and shaders of the game can be modified for your enjoyment as well.
This game has true 320x240 resolution and was initially designed for a calculator. Your purchase additionally comes with the (older) calculator version for free! It is a *.8xp file to send to your TI-84+ CE calculator.

summary.핵심플레이: 라이터, 네이팜 수류탄, 화염방사기, 성형작약, RPG-7 등 여러 무기를 사용해 구조물을 파괴하고 불을 지른다. 캠페인의 다양한 상황에서 각 무기의 메커니즘을 활용한다.
summary.특징: TI-84+ CE 계산기용으로 처음 제작된 게임을 PC로 옮긴 것으로, 320x240 해상도의 레트로 스타일을 유지한다. 텍스처, 사운드, 셰이더를 수정할 수 있으며 구매 시 계산기용 버전(.8xp 파일)도 함께 제공된다.

name: Purrs in Heaven
input:
Poor Lanna has gone to heaven following a tragic accident. Fortunately, she has the chance to come back to life. Help the kitten pass all the tests and defeat the guardians, keepers of the 3 pieces of her soul. Do you accept the challenge?

Features

- 30 game levels.

- Simple puzzles of increasing difficulty.

- Hidden shmup mini game.

- Unlockable challenges and difficult mode for the most skillful.

- Beautiful pixel art.

- Wonderful soundtrack inspired by Ghibli composers.

summary.핵심플레이: 고양이 Lanna를 조작해 여러 레벨의 퍼즐을 풀고 소울 조각을 지키는 수호자들을 물리치며 진행한다. 난이도가 점차 올라가는 30개의 레벨을 클리어한다.
summary.특징: 사고로 천국에 간 새끼 고양이가 되살아나기 위해 시험을 통과한다는 설정을 갖는다. 픽셀 아트 그래픽, 숨겨진 슈머업 미니게임, 해금형 챌린지와 어려움 모드, 지브리 작곡가에게서 영향을 받은 사운드트랙을 포함한다.

name: LEGION
input:
LEGION is an epic real-time strategy game that brings the thrill of large-scale battles to both mobile devices and desktop platforms. Engage in intense, short skirmishes on diverse maps as you command massive armies, each consisting of hundreds of units.

Key Features

-
Cross-Platform Play: Experience seamless gameplay across mobile and desktop, allowing you to take the battle wherever you go.

-
Real-Time Strategy: Strategize in real time as you control every aspect of your squads on the battlefield.

-
Complete Squad Control: Take charge of your units with full precision—raise shields, adjust formations, and control formation density to outmaneuver your opponent.

-
Realistic Physics: Watch as cavalry charges tear through formations of archers, creating dynamic and believable battle scenes.

-
Variety of Maps: Fight across 3 unique battlefields, each offering different tactical challenges and opportunities.

-
Campaign Mode: Immerse yourself in a gripping campaign, honing your skills and learning the ropes before taking the fight online.

-
Online Multiplayer Battles: Test your strategic prowess against players worldwide in exciting real-time skirmishes.

-
Ranked Matches: Climb the ranks in competitive battles, proving your skills as a commander.

-
Unit Upgrades: Customize and improve your squads to create a fighting force tailored to your style of play.

Command, strategize, and dominate in LEGION—the ultimate RTS experience where every decision counts. Will your tactics bring victory, or will your army fall before a superior foe?

summary.핵심플레이: 수백 개 유닛으로 구성된 대규모 부대를 실시간으로 지휘하며, 방패 올리기·대형 조정·대형 밀집도 조절 등으로 부대를 통제해 짧은 교전을 치른다. 캠페인 모드로 기본기를 익힌 뒤 온라인 대전과 랭크 매치에서 다른 플레이어와 겨룬다.
summary.특징: 모바일과 데스크톱을 오가는 크로스 플랫폼 플레이를 지원하며, 기병 돌격이 궁병 대형을 관통하는 등 물리 효과가 전투에 반영된다. 3종의 전장과 유닛 업그레이드 시스템을 제공한다.

name: 星际争爸
input: After the devastating Third Great PK, Earth was nearly destroyed. After 500 years of self-repair, signs of life have begun to emerge, and a group of brave warriors is needed to return to Earth to spread technology and civilization, ensuring the continuation of humanity’s flame. Therefore, Ye Principal has devised a plan. The goal of this plan is clear: the first task of the advance team is to survive in the unknown environment of Earth, ensuring their safety. Based on this, they will gradually restore and spread civilization, avoiding the foolish mistakes of human history. Ultimately, the goal of the plan is to maintain peace on Earth and prevent new disasters from arising. Are you willing to join the Plan and become a father of Earth?

summary.핵심플레이: 파괴된 지구로 파견된 선발대가 되어 미지의 환경에서 생존하고, 기술과 문명을 복원·전파해 나간다.
summary.특징: 세 번째 대전쟁 이후 500년간 자가 복구된 지구를 배경으로, 인류 역사의 실수를 피하며 지구의 평화를 유지하고 새로운 재앙을 막는 것을 목표로 한다.

name: 『絵話 -kaiwa-』
input:
A story about scary pictures.



This is a short horror novel game without the element of surprise, which can make you feel still and unpleasant.



This title progresses only by clicking. No difficult operations are required.



Scary pictures, unusual pictures, and happy pictures will meet you.



What emotions will you feel when you see ......?



This title contains descriptions that may provoke feelings of fear, anxiety, and disgust. It includes descriptions that remind you of suicide, grotesque descriptions, and collective fear.



It is published as a free game.



Picture Series



『恐絵 -kyoukai-』



『異絵 -ikai-』



『幸絵 -koukai-』



『生帰-syouki-』



The above four works are combined into one work.

Translation into English, Chinese and Korean will be available.

Two additional stories, "Yuukai" and "Kaiwa," will be added and updated during the summer of 2022.



Differences between the free and paid versions

The paid version prioritizes typographical errors and minor corrections.

The paid version will be updated to allow users to choose the language of translation, but the free version will not be released in a translated version.

Only the paid version will be updated with an additional short story called "Kaiwa". (Both the paid and free version will be updated with an additional short story called "yuukai")



Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

summary.핵심플레이: 클릭만으로 진행되는 짧은 호러 노벨 게임으로, 별도의 조작 없이 이야기를 따라가며 여러 그림을 보게 된다.
summary.특징: 놀래키는 연출 없이 무서운 그림, 기이한 그림, 행복한 그림 등을 제시하며, 자살·그로테스크·집단 공포를 연상시키는 묘사를 포함한다. 『恐絵』『異絵』『幸絵』『生帰』 네 작품을 하나로 묶었으며, 영어·중국어·한국어 번역과 추가 단편이 제공된다.

name: Broken Blade: Prelude
input:
Broken Blade: Prelude(프렐류드)는 판타지풍의 시뮬레이션 롤플레잉 게임입니다. 당신은 세계의 운명을 지켜보는 '관찰자'가 되어, 제국의 황녀였던 카모밀레와 그 동료들의 앞을 막아서는 시련을 헤쳐나가기 위해 함께 노력해야 합니다.

인간과 마물이 공존하고 있는 '미드젤'.

대륙의 서쪽으로는, 세계수가 자리잡고 있는 인간들을 위한 나라 '크바지르 제국'. 그 반대편에는 여러 종족의 마물이 연합해, 크바지르에 대항하기 위해 세워진 '에이레 왕국'이 존속해 왔다.

하지만, 크바지르 제국의 황제이자 인간과 마물 사이의 불신을 해결하고자 한 황제, '시그몬드'가 시해당한 뒤, 미드젤과 한 소녀의 운명은 크게 뒤바뀌게 된다.

- 화려한 일러스트와 복고풍 픽셀아트
다양한 캐릭터 일러스트와 화려한 전투 애니메이션과 함께 Broken Blade: Prelude를 즐겨보세요.

- 기본적인 재미에 충실한 시스템
SRPG의 기본 요소인 전략과 육성에 중점을 두어, 각 캐릭터마다 준비된 다양한 기술을 스킬트리 시스템을 이용해 플레이어 입맛대로 고를 수 있습니다. 동료와의 대화를 통해 파티원들과의 유대를 쌓아 나갈 수도 있습니다.

- 캐주얼 롤플레잉 게임 지향
Broken Blade는 캐주얼 롤플레잉 게임을 지향합니다. 다른 SRPG에 비해 난이도가 낮은 편이기에, SRPG 장르를 처음 접하시는 분들에게 추천드립니다. 물론, 코어 유저분들을 위한 숙련자(HARD) 모드도 준비되어 있습니다!

summary.핵심플레이: 턴제 전략 전투에서 캐릭터를 배치·운용하며 시련을 헤쳐나가고, 스킬트리 시스템으로 각 캐릭터의 기술을 선택해 육성한다. 동료와의 대화를 통해 파티원과의 유대를 쌓는다.
summary.특징: 인간과 마물이 공존하는 대륙 '미드젤'을 배경으로, 관찰자 시점에서 황녀 카모밀레와 동료들의 이야기를 따라간다. 캐릭터 일러스트와 픽셀아트, 전투 애니메이션을 사용하며 캐주얼 지향으로 난이도가 낮은 편이나 숙련자(HARD) 모드도 제공한다.

name: Hentai Girls Slide
input:
Instructions:

Hentai Girls Slide is a classic slide puzzle game. In which you relax while solving puzzles of increasing difficulty.

Key Features:

All girls in the game are over 21 years old.

Different styles of girls

Full nudity

HD quality pictures

Puzzles

Big Gallery

Nice relaxing music

Gallery mode that can be controlled using a single hand

Get ready to enjoy beautiful girl as you try to solve slide puzzles.

summary.핵심플레이: 조각을 밀어 이동시켜 이미지를 맞추는 슬라이드 퍼즐을 풀며, 난이도가 점차 높아진다.
summary.특징: 성인 여성 캐릭터의 HD 이미지와 전체 누드 콘텐츠를 담고 있으며, 한 손으로 조작 가능한 갤러리 모드와 배경 음악을 제공한다.

name: Back to Coffin
input:
Back To Coffin is a 1-4 people CO-OP horror game
As a vampire hunter in a universe terrorized by vampires, you can work alone or with your team to use various magical equipments to find the vampire's class and send it back to its coffin.

Realistic Graphics
With the power of Unreal Engine 5, the game features specially designed maps that are waiting to give you a fun and horror-filled experience.

Customization
Customize your own unique hunter and catch the vampires!

Different Enemies
In each game, capture a random vampire from 20 different specially designed vampires

Interactive Maps
Pay attention as you move through the map. Each map has various interactions that will affect your gameplay. Keep your eyes peeled to find secret passages and avoid traps!

Unique Designs
Use magical equipment with unique designs to find the vampire and put him in its coffin!

Co-Op
Defeat the vampire alone or together with the help of up to 3 friends.

summary.핵심플레이: 뱀파이어 헌터가 되어 마법 장비를 사용해 뱀파이어의 종류를 파악하고 관으로 돌려보낸다. 혼자 또는 최대 4인이 함께 플레이할 수 있다.
summary.특징: Unreal Engine 5로 제작되었으며, 20종의 뱀파이어 중 무작위로 등장하는 적을 상대한다. 각 맵에는 비밀 통로와 함정 등 게임에 영향을 주는 상호작용 요소가 있고, 헌터 커스터마이징을 지원한다.

name: Shooty Skies
input:
Dodge the bullets, shoot the enemies, defeat the bosses!

Take to the skies for an endless-arcade shooter that is fast, furious and formidable!

- Collect over 200 daring pilots over 20 different terrains.

- Change the intensity from Scouty to Screamy, if you dare!

- Earn a multitude of achievements

- Challenging daily missions

- Guns! Missiles! Badgers!

Get flying now!

summary.핵심플레이: 비행기를 조종해 적을 쏘고 총알을 피하며 보스를 물리치는 엔드리스 아케이드 슈팅을 진행한다. 지형과 난이도를 바꿔가며 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 20개 이상의 지형과 200종 이상의 조종사를 수집할 수 있으며, Scouty부터 Screamy까지 난이도를 조절할 수 있다. 일일 미션과 다수의 도전 과제를 제공한다.

name: Sentinel 3: Homeworld
input:
The biggest installment of the award winning Sentinel sci-fi tower defense series now on PC!
Take the fight to the alien homeworld and unleash a massive arsenal of weaponry. Get up close and personal on the battlefield in your power armor to execute devastating attacks and support your defenses!

* An epic campaign across 20 levels.
* A powerful commander unit which can level up and gain new abilities as you play.
* Over 20 unlockable turrets, orbital ship weapons, automated drones and abilities at your disposal.
* Customize your weapon loadout in the Armory to match the demands of the mission.
* NEW: Includes new content featuring new commander, enemies, campaign, weapons and more!
* Endless modes for all maps.
* NEW: Steam Achievements
* Classic mode allows you to compete for scores in a pure skill-based game mode.
* Exclusive music by Specimen A.

summary.핵심플레이: 20개 레벨의 캠페인에서 터렛, 궤도 함선 무기, 자동 드론 등을 배치해 외계 침략을 방어하고, 파워 아머를 입은 지휘관 유닛으로 직접 전장에 개입해 공격과 방어를 지원한다.
summary.특징: SF 세계관의 Sentinel 시리즈로, 지휘관 유닛의 레벨업과 능력 획득, 무기고에서의 로드아웃 커스터마이징을 제공하며, 무한 모드와 점수 경쟁용 클래식 모드, Steam 도전 과제를 포함한다.

name: Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 2
input:
At Blacklands Manor Orphanage, three toys arrive in a donation box for Esther and her two friends Molly and Isaac. They call the tiger toy Mr. Stripes, the panda toy Miss Bo and the rabbit toy Mr. Hopp. Not long after, Molly and Isaac disappear and a mystery begins to unravel around the three toys, as well as a dark history of the town of Blacklands.

A Survival-Horror 2D side scroller pixel art experience, the prequel story to Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 1.

summary.핵심플레이: 고아원과 마을을 탐험하며 사라진 친구들과 세 개의 장난감을 둘러싼 미스터리를 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: Blacklands Manor 고아원을 배경으로 한 픽셀 아트 2D 횡스크롤 생존 호러로, Mr. Hopp's Playhouse 1의 프리퀄에 해당한다.

name: 龍躍九天 - 情繫江湖
input:
龍躍九天是一款非牟利同人遊戲。

這一款高自由度的RPG遊戲, 玩家能在遊戲中體驗善惡兩大主線,解鎖獨門技能, 招攬個性隊員, 購買大宅, 攻打領地等等。

由前作主角的大弟子（玩家）闖盪江湖歷險旅程， 過程中會遇到的人物和劇情，穿插其中同時， 能習得強大技能與裝備，開創自己宗派和養成人生哲學。

故事前奏： （一版）光明之境幫主雲曦為了復活已故紅顏和好友，被陰謀者算計從而令天下遭受戰火洗禮， 其徒（玩家 ，也是主角）也選擇步入江湖，與眾多角色互動， 揭露陰謀， 為天下蒼生而戰。 個中善惡的選擇會掌握在玩家手中，究竟主角最後的結果會是怎樣呢？

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공이 되어 강호를 여행하며 다양한 인물 및 사건과 상호작용하고, 기술과 장비를 습득하며 자신의 문파를 세운다. 대저택 구매, 영지 공략, 개성 있는 동료 영입 등의 활동을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 선과 악 두 갈래의 메인 스토리를 제공하며, 플레이어의 선택에 따라 주인공의 결말이 달라진다. 전작 주인공의 수제자를 조작하는 비영리 동인 RPG다.

name: Omega Blade
input:
Shoot, slash, dodge and survive to blade combats in multiple kind of challenges to test your skills and claim your place in the Omega Blade hall of fame.

Omega Blade is a hardcore virtual reality shooting/combat videogame that allow you to play several kind of challenges with your own physical style.

FEATURES

Multi range combat - Close, middle and lange range combat with flying droids and biped robots.

Full body action - You set your own peace and combat style based on. Decide the way you want to play it.

Enemy types - There are several kind of enemies, and they attack or defend themselfs in different ways.

Challenges - Omega Blade don't set a single infinite wave, but a large number of challenges with different weapons, enemies, life, stage and goals combination to keep surprising the player and provide all kind of new feelings.

Leaderboard - A leaderboard shows your position in each challenge, so you can try to dominate it.

Per match rival - Each time you play a challenge, the system will pick a target rival score, and your main goal will be to overscore it.

Body weapons grab - In the challenges menu, the screen will show you the weapons available and their body position. During gameplay, move your hand close to the weapon region and grab it.

WEAPONS

Weapons appearing in current challenges:

- Alpha Revolver

- Beta Blade

- Machinegun

- Shuriken

- Sniper Rifle

- Dual Blade

- Shield Grenade

Weapons appearing in the next challenges update:

- Shotgun

- Shield Disk

- Turtle Generator

- Spear

- Bow

- Hand addon Delayed Segments

GAMEPLAY HINTS

- Weapon grab
Onscreen icons will appear when you indicate what weapon each hand is over. Shoulder items can be grabbed easily placing the hand in front of the face.

- Two hands grab

Long weapons such as the machinegun, shotgun, sniper rifle or the spear must be grabbed using both hands. Some weapons like the machinegun will lose accuracy if used one handed, and others like the spear will not extend their energy blades.

- Weapon discard

Just launch the weapon and it will explode on it's own after a few seconds and will come back to your body. Grenades will come back to your body on launch only if they were not activated pressing the index trigger.

- Sword and knife grab to grip

When your hand thumb points down, you will grab the edge weapon with standard grip. If your hand thumb points up, you will grab the weapons with an inversed grip.

- Juggle

You can launch and regrab your weapons before they autodestructs. This is useful to perform a fast blade grip change, change a revolver from one hand to the other... or just to feel cool.

- Defensive bullet Reflection

You can use blades to reflect bullets and defend yourself. Some game modes are based on this action

- Combo bonus

When you destroy enemies in a stake you will get combo points. The combo counter will reset if you don't destroy a new enemy soon.

- Enemy destruction bonus

Destroying an enemy shooting down a certain weak point can provide a coreshot bonus. Most enemies have some points that can be destroyed individually or in group to obtain an additional bonus prior to destroying them. Experiment shooting enemies down piece by piece to discover how to trigger each one of them and maximize your score.

- Energy color patterns

Take into account that neutral energy enemies (yellow) can be destroyed with any weapon, but alpha and beta energy enemies (green and red) can only be destroyed with their same kind of energy.

- Energy match game mode bonus

Some game modes will ask you to reflect positive and negative energy bullets with the correct weapon to gain a bigger bonus. Others will ask you to destroy targets using only the right energy or a penalization will be applied.

- Energy breakdown

A wrong blade weapon crashing a positive or negative surface will result in the blade desintegration (but will be regenerated in the body).

- Hand poses

While single hand weapons are grabbed, the pose will be modified attending to your thumb and index position. Some poses may become helpful when using some weapons.

- Radar

If you aren't able to find a pending enemy to shoot it down, remember you can press the right controller A button to display a 3d map on top of your hand. Press A again to dismiss it.

- Snipering

The sniper rifle zoom is controlled by means of a yellow dot placed in the scope. Grab it and a virtua line will appear from the scope to your hand. Make the line longer or shorter to control the zoom level. The scope is further from your eye to allow you to press your arms againts your body to increase your accuracy.

- 180º and 360º Combat

Some stages will keep the action focused in the front, while other stages labeled as 360º ones will allow enemies to be deployed and attack you from any direction.

summary.핵심플레이: 근·중·원거리에서 다양한 무기로 비행 드론과 이족 로봇을 공격하고, 총알을 검으로 반사하며 회피·방어하는 전투를 수행한다. 무기는 신체 위치에 배치되어 있어 손을 가져가 잡고, 각 도전 과제에서 라이벌 점수를 넘기는 것을 목표로 한다.
summary.특징: 단일 무한 웨이브 대신 무기·적·목표가 조합된 다수의 도전 과제로 구성되며, 리더보드와 매 판마다 지정되는 라이벌 점수를 제공한다. 중립·알파·베타 에너지 색상에 맞춰 적을 파괴하는 에너지 매칭 시스템, 약점 코어샷 보너스, 무기 저글링, 180도·360도 전투 스테이지 등이 있다.

name: Build buildings
input: Build buildings is a game that will test your focus and timing skills. In this game, you have to build a building, but it's not so easy. Try to build the maximum number of floors and test your reaction.You can change the type of buildings in the presence of experience stars. It can be played with the mouse.

summary.핵심플레이: 타이밍에 맞춰 건물의 층을 쌓아 올려 최대한 많은 층을 짓는다. 마우스로 조작한다.
summary.특징: 경험치 별을 보유하면 건물의 종류를 변경할 수 있으며, 집중력과 반응 속도를 시험하는 방식으로 구성되어 있다.

name: Downtown Drift
input:
Think of Downtown Drift as pac-man, but as a first-person racing game. You need to try and score as many points as possible by drifting while police is chasing you down. Each drift gives you a certain amount of points and also increases your multiplier. The higher the multiplier, the more points you get for each drift. However there is a catch: you only have limited health and you take damage everytime you crash, so watch how you move!
Features

- Fast pace racing with thrilling police chases

- Realistic car destruction

- Global Highscore Ranking to compete with friends and players around the world

Development Updates

Join the Community Group and and follow on Socials for Updates on the development process!

summary.핵심플레이: 경찰의 추격을 피하며 드리프트로 점수를 획득하고, 드리프트마다 배수가 올라가 더 많은 점수를 얻는다. 체력이 제한되어 있고 충돌 시 피해를 입으므로 이동에 주의해야 한다.
summary.특징: 1인칭 시점으로 진행되며, 차량 파손 표현과 전 세계 플레이어와 경쟁하는 글로벌 최고 점수 랭킹을 제공한다.

name: Anomaly Zone
input:
This is a story of human pride. Time is at hand when, in their utter desire to study the world, people will start destroying it. Tests of high-energy heavy particles accelerators will result in billions of microscopic black hole rupturing the structure of time and space. This will become the point of no return. A counter-strike from nature itself will follow and the Earth as we know it will cease to exist.

This is a story of human strength and true heroes. Three generations after the apocalypse, not only did humankind survive in the man-made hell – it continued to develop. Gradually, the infrastructure restored, wars stopped, people were returning to normal life. However, the crippled nature was barely starting to fight back...

So-called anomalous activity zones started appearing all over the planet, like terrifying scars left by the man-made catastrophes. The vast territories of post-apocalyptic world live their own life, which looks like nothing you have seen before. Bloodthirsty mutated monsters, inexplicable phenomena, mysterious anomalies are but the tip of the iceberg.

One of the Zones was formed in the vicinity of Ukraine, in an area combining the unmistakable atmosphere of Soviet times and the fast pace of modern life. In order to contain the dangers of the Zone, the government decided to fence the perimeter, and introduce quarantine in the area. Local residents found themselves trapped and left to their own devices. However, forbidden fruit is always the most enticing. And this was when the "stalkers" came in. Mystical artifact hunters, former military men, explorers, adventurers, armed gangsters, mafia and just those who love getting away with shooting live targets – they swarmed in like locusts in Egypt to lead mortal combat with monsters and humans alike.

This is a story about YOU.

There is a non-stop battle between stalkers' clans, between aliens and locals. You can support any side or remain a free shooter. You can give a dota tion to your mates as a leader or take every loot to yourself. And if you don't want to lose your life in a proxy war, there is a PvE server and safety zones. You can shape your own story in the Zone.

Who will you become?

- Over 40 square kilometers of lands to explore, from closed science villages and abandoned military facilities, to the forests of Tunguska and snowy deserts of Novaya Zemlya.

- Deadly mutants, anomalies and hundreds of main story quests.

- Huge choice of artifacts, gear and weapons.

- Repair broken things or assemble new gear from scratch.

- Improve dozens of skills and abilities.

- Be a doctor, a scientist, a hunter, a soldier or an engineer. Take part in mass PvP, bring death or salvation to those around you.

This is the Zone. Come to hell and make it your home.

summary.핵심플레이: 포스트 아포칼립스 세계의 '존'을 탐험하며 변이 생물과 다른 스토커들과 전투를 벌이고, 아티팩트와 장비, 무기를 수집한다. 아이템을 수리하거나 새로 제작하고 다양한 스킬과 능력을 성장시킨다.
summary.특징: 입자가속기 실험으로 발생한 재앙 이후의 세계를 배경으로, 폐쇄된 과학 마을과 군사 시설, 툰구스카 숲과 노바야제믈랴 등 40제곱킬로미터 이상의 지역을 다룬다. 스토커 클랜 간 대규모 PvP와 PvE 서버, 안전 구역을 제공하며 의사, 과학자, 사냥꾼, 군인, 엔지니어 등 역할을 선택할 수 있다.

name: Night Darkness
input:
You have to take control of one of the most famous mercenaries and complete a special mission to save humanity from certain death.



Explore the island where you found yourself after a helicopter crash and reveal all the secrets that are stored here. But beware of the enemies that await you on your way, because this island is inhabited by a variety of drones that yearn for your death.



Features:

Eliminate the threat alone. Play a small campaign in single player mode.

Explore a new hostile world.

Embark on an exciting journey and save humanity.

summary.핵심플레이: 헬리콥터 추락 후 도착한 섬을 탐험하며 특수 임무를 수행하고, 섬에 서식하는 드론 형태의 적을 처치한다.
summary.특징: 싱글플레이어 모드의 소규모 캠페인으로 구성되며, 용병 캐릭터를 조종해 인류를 구하는 임무를 진행한다.

name: Limb From Limb
input:
The Raymond Mitchell Association Welcomes You
Limb From Limb is a card roulette game about surviving encounters against a monster with your fingers as a sacrifice for losing. Between encounters, navigate your way across a board of randomized events that forces you to consider what path you take out of this accursed experiment.

Fighting Patient Zero
Engage with a patient in a lethal card game of chance. Draw from a deck of 52 cards, some of which will cost you a finger to proceed.

Collect Items
Gather from a pool of 10 different items, each with its own personality and effect. Choose which items you want to take into the encounters, but be meticulous, as once-used items are gone forever.

Escape
Traverse through the hospital using a game board and your innate strategy to succeed in the RMA program. Each attempt brings a series of mixed events to define a new experience for every patient.

Content Warning
This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

summary.핵심플레이: 52장의 덱에서 카드를 뽑아 몬스터와의 확률 기반 카드 대결을 벌이며, 패배 시 손가락을 대가로 잃는다. 대결 사이에는 무작위 이벤트로 구성된 보드를 이동하며 경로를 선택한다.
summary.특징: RMA 실험을 배경으로 하며, 각 시도마다 무작위 이벤트가 달라진다. 10종의 아이템 중 원하는 것을 골라 대결에 가져갈 수 있으나 한 번 사용한 아이템은 영구히 사라진다. 광과민성 발작 유발 가능성에 대한 경고가 포함되어 있다.

name: Himiko's Journey
input:
Dive into a world of nostalgia and thrilling adventure with "Himiko's Journey," a retro roguelike deckbuilding game that captures the essence of classic gaming while giving you a relaxed but challenging space.

Key Features:

🎲 Dice-Rolling Thrills: Embrace the unpredictability of each round as the roll of the dice determines your starting resources and card effects. Adapt to ever-changing circumstances and seize victory.

🃏 Over 100 Unique Cards: Craft your deck from a vast collection of over 80 unique cards, each with its own strategic twist. Build and adapt your deck as you progress through an ever-changing world. And there are more to come!

🕹️ Roguelike Challenge: Prepare for an exhilarating challenge where each death marks the beginning of a new adventure. Learn from your mistakes, grow stronger, and face evolving challenges in every playthrough.

🔮 Unique Mechanics: Master a range of captivating mechanics, including poison, frost, burn, dice rolling as well as summoning henchmen. Tailor your strategy to conquer your foes and uncover hidden treasures.

🏆 Unique Artefacts: Discover powerful artefacts that can shift the balance of power in your favor. Collect and harness their unique abilities to overcome even the toughest challenges.

🌟 Visuals That Captivate: Immerse yourself in a visually stunning world that combines retro aesthetics with modern design. Our handcrafted artwork and enchanting landscapes bring the game to life.

👾 A Passion Project: "Himiko's Journey" is a labor of love, born from a desire to invoke the same magical feelings experienced during classic gaming sessions. It's not about being the best game ever; it's about delivering a fun, enjoyable experience you'll return to time and time again.

Embark on an epic adventure, where every card you play, every decision you make, and every roll of the dice shapes your destiny. Will you conquer the challenges that lie ahead and emerge victorious on "Himiko's Journey"?

Get ready to rediscover the joy of gaming – add 'Himiko's Journey' to your Steam library today!

summary.핵심플레이: 카드로 덱을 구성하고 주사위를 굴려 시작 자원과 카드 효과를 결정하며 적과 전투를 진행한다. 캐릭터가 죽으면 새로운 플레이가 시작되며 반복 플레이를 통해 전략을 발전시킨다.
summary.특징: 독, 서리, 화상, 주사위 굴리기, 부하 소환 등 다양한 메커니즘과 전세를 바꾸는 유물을 갖추고 있으며, 80종 이상의 카드와 레트로풍 아트 스타일을 사용한다.

summary.핵심플레이: 자동차를 운전하며 도로를 지나갈 때마다 일정 확률로 발생하는 이상 현상을 판단한다. 이상이 있으면 방향을 돌리고 없으면 계속 전진하며, 판단이 맞으면 다음 거리로 진입하고 틀리면 처음 거리로 돌아가 반복하게 된다.
summary.특징: 1인칭 시점의 운전 조작을 통해 다양한 유형의 이상 현상(명확한 것, 숨겨진 것, 상호작용형 등)을 탐색하며, 8번가에서 벗어나는 것을 목표로 한다. 이상 현상을 더 많이 탐색할수록 결말이 명확해진다.

name: Silent Watcher
input:
Silent Watcher is a first-person psychological horror game with a short but intense experience, centered on tension, an oppressive atmosphere, and the fear of the unknown.

You are a young woman waiting for your partner to return home. Night falls, and with it, a disturbing feeling that something—or someone—is watching you from the shadows. Every reflection, every sound, every corner seems to hide an invisible presence... one that refuses to be ignored.

This game challenges you to explore a home while surviving a silent stalker. There are no weapons. There is no combat. Only sound, your intuition, and environmental details will be your tools to resist.

-
First-person narrative psychological horror

-
Gameplay focused on exploration and role-playing

-
Achievements available for the most observant

-
Interface available in English and Spanish

-
Immersive soundtrack and sound design

Will you be able to remain calm when you feel you are no longer alone?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 파트너를 기다리는 여성이 되어 집 안을 탐색하며, 무기나 전투 없이 소리와 환경 단서, 직관에 의존해 조용히 추적하는 존재로부터 생존한다.
summary.특징: 밤중 집 안에서 감시당하는 느낌을 다루는 1인칭 서사 중심의 심리 호러로, 사운드 디자인과 관찰력을 요구하는 도전 과제, 영어·스페인어 인터페이스를 지원한다.

name: Moonshot Galaxy™
input:
In a Galaxy far, far away…



Moonshot Galaxy™ is a VR game like no other. Play your way through planetary challenges in exotic branches of the galaxy at your own pace. Designed for comfort, anyone can pick it up and play - though reaching the top of the leaderboards will put your skills to the test. The polished presentation and endlessly addictive game-play of Moonshot Galaxy™ make it an excellent choice for VR veterans and newbies alike.



Will you crush the final volcano? Will you cry into your headset? Will you earn a high five?



These are important questions you need answers to. This is your galactic quest, should you choose to accept it.



Good Luck.

summary.핵심플레이: VR 환경에서 은하계 곳곳의 행성별 챌린지를 자신의 속도로 진행하며 점수를 쌓는다. 리더보드 상위권을 목표로 반복 플레이할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 편안한 플레이를 위해 설계되어 VR 초보자와 숙련자 모두 이용할 수 있으며, 여러 행성을 배경으로 한 챌린지와 리더보드 경쟁 요소를 제공한다.

Cozy and Pixelated Art-style

summary.핵심플레이: 소시지 모양의 고양이를 움직여 우유 그릇까지 도달시키면서 방 전체를 채우는 퍼즐을 푼다.
summary.특징: 30개의 레벨과 픽셀 아트 스타일로 구성되며, 스팀 도전 과제를 지원한다.

summary.핵심플레이: 기호와 색을 인식하고 판별하는 두뇌 퍼즐을 플레이한다. 시간 제한이 있는 모드와 없는 모드 중에서 선택할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 모든 기능이 무료로 제공되며 잠긴 요소가 없다. Ohrwert의 Dub Techno 배경음악과 각 트랙에 맞춘 효과음, 색맹 옵션을 지원한다.

name: Wizardry 8
input:
A New Wizardry for a New Generation

The universe is in the throes of violent upheaval and change. Vast and mysterious forces are preparing for the final confrontation. A small group of heroes from distant lands must plunge into the heart of the maelstrom, to uncover long-forgotten secrets, and bring about a new era. Should they succeed, they will gain the powers of the gods themselves. If they fail, countless worlds will fall into the grip of darkness.

Wizardry 8 raises the standard for fantasy role-playing with a vengeance. Prepare yourself for a new level of excitement, immersiveness and depth that made role-playing games one of the best-selling, best-loved genres of all time.

Prepare to experience the culmination of a prestigious RPG series. Enter a vast world of intrigue and wonder. Unravel a gripping, non-linear storyline. Battle your way to victory using your swords, your magic, and your wits. Compete with rivals or align with allies as you struggle to ascend to the Cosmic Circle. Take the battle to the dreaded Dark Savant in Wizardry 8, the phenomenal conclusion to the Dark Savant trilogy, one of the most extensive and challenging stories ever told in classic role-playing games!

This is the legacy of Wizardry 8!

- Explore a vast 3D world filled with action, magic and adventure. Wander through dark dungeons, lush landscapes, scorching volcanoes and even beneath the sea.

- Create your own custom party of adventurers. Make a gnome gadgeteer, a lizardman fighter, a rawulf lord or even a faerie ninja. the possibilities are endless!

- Choose a custom personality for each character and hear them speak over 100 lines of dialogue; Kindly or Chaotic, burly or surly-how your characters act is up to you.

- Talk to dozens of intelligent characters. How you treat them determines whether they become powerful allies or deadly enemies.

- Battle over 300 types of monsters in some of the most intense combat ever seen in an RPG. The unique auto-targeting system makes combat easy to learn, while the huge number of strategies adds unprecedented depth.

- Advanced creature A.I. brings a new level of realism to RPGs. You don't just hunt the monsters-the roaming monsters hunt you.

- Cast over 100 spells using a unique power-level system that guarantees that no spell ever becomes obsolete.

summary.핵심플레이: 직접 구성한 파티로 3D 세계를 탐험하며 자동 타겟팅 시스템 기반의 전투로 300종 이상의 몬스터와 싸우고, 100종 이상의 주문을 파워 레벨 시스템으로 사용한다. 등장인물과 대화하며 그들을 아군이나 적으로 만든다.
summary.특징: Dark Savant 3부작의 마지막 편으로 비선형 스토리를 진행한다. 노움 개짓티어, 리자드맨 파이터, 페어리 닌자 등 다양한 종족·직업으로 캐릭터를 만들고 성격을 지정하며, 로밍 몬스터가 플레이어를 추적하는 AI를 특징으로 한다.

name: Defend Your Crypt
input:
Defend Your Crypt is a strategy and puzzle game, in which we will have to avoid to lose our treasure by the tomb thieves. We, as the Pharaoh, can use different traps to defeat those damn ambitious humans who are profaning your tomb.

Let them fall into the void, burn them, put an arrow through them, drown them, send your scorpions to kill them… Do everything you find necessary so you can end their lives.

- Retro style: Like many of our games, Defend Your Crypt will have retro pixel art. In addition, we will lean toward Egyptian style.

- Trap variety: The game will contain classic traps such as open platforms, which can make robbers fall onto spikes, and also water traps or killer scorpions and beetles.

- Gore: In Ratalaika Games, we know you like blood, so we have included it. A lot of it. Killing the robbers won’t be enough. ”If it bleeds, we can kill it”, and we’re taking it to the limit. (If you don’t like blood, you can deactivate it :P)

- Levels: A large number of levels to make sure the robbers will not steal any of your gold, and you enjoy the game to the fullest. A lot of time can be spent on finishing all of them!

- Robbers with feelings: No robbers are heartless. Throughout the game, players will see robbers in different moods, and they will also interact with each other a little bit. Seeing a hallway full of blood could make a robber sad and break his heart.

summary.핵심플레이: 파라오가 되어 무덤에 침입하는 도굴꾼들을 다양한 함정으로 처치하며 보물을 지킨다. 낙하 구덩이, 화살, 물, 전갈과 딱정벌레 등의 함정을 이용해 도둑들을 막는 것이 핵심 루프다.
summary.특징: 고대 이집트풍의 레트로 픽셀 아트로 제작되었으며, 다수의 레벨과 여러 종류의 함정을 제공한다. 유혈 연출을 켜고 끌 수 있고, 도굴꾼들은 감정 상태와 상호작용을 보이며 반응한다.

name: Hit Idol
input:
Shoot for the stars, let their song fill everyone's hearts, and bring justice long overdue.

Take the role of Teacher on the idols' journey to greatness. Guide their training with four different puzzle mini games, each testing your wit and creativity.

Do your best and you can make it all the way to Star-Filled Sky Festival. There, idols become stars and the evil Professor Kerr awaits your revenge!

In addition to the main story, put the right idols together to experience twelve unique storylines told between them.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 Teacher가 되어 네 가지 퍼즐 미니게임으로 아이돌의 훈련을 지도하며 성장 과정을 이끈다. Star-Filled Sky Festival을 목표로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 메인 스토리 외에 아이돌들을 조합하면 그들 사이에서 펼쳐지는 12가지 스토리라인을 볼 수 있으며, 악당 Professor Kerr와의 대결이 포함된다.

name: Ashes of the Ark
input:
Ashes of the Ark

Virtual reality meets zombies in space! Ashes of the Ark is a first-person shooter built exclusively for VR that immerses you in an end of humanity scenario on the Ark - one of the last bastions of hope as humanity flees a zombie-apocalypse.



When you are awoken from your cryo-station - the realization sets in that you must save the rest of the sleepers. Alone and armed with the weapons and scarce ammo you find, you will need to solve puzzles and fight in order to navigate through the remnants of the Ark



Developed from the ground up for HTC Vive and Oculus, Ashes of the Ark inserts you into a universe where you must survive against zombies who have taken over the failing space station. Handle realistic weapons with real-life movements, freely explore the immersive Ark, and solve puzzles all in the realm of VR. Can you stop the Flood before they reach the cryo-sector and finish off humanity?



Play your own way: Built form the ground up, Ashes of the Ark allows you to choose the movement controls that are best for you. You can choose between the default walking mode for full immersion or the various teleportation modes for maximum comfort.

Real-life weapon handling: Using VR motion controls, you can handle weapons with real-life movements. Anticipate attacks, load weapons, manage ammo and aim down the sights to survive on the Ark. Ashes of the Ark showcases some of the most realistic weapons available in video games today.

Full-size campaign: Built from the ground up so that you can play through the whole story in one go or choose unlocked levels at any time from the fully interactive player HUB.

Survival Mode: Unlimited zombies - unlimited ammo. How long can you survive?

Ashes of the Ark has a main HUB area featuring a shooting range for you to relax, test weapons and choose your missions. Free exploration: Search the remnants of the Ark for fellow awoken sleepers.

Free exploration: Search the remnants of the Ark for fellow awoken sleepers.

Immersive zombie survival: Scavenge what is left, and manage ammo and consumables in a battle for survival more immersive than ever before in this once-in-a-lifetime VR experience.

Unprecedented VR realism: Ashes of the Ark brings unprecedented realism to VR gaming with zombie mutilation, destructible environments, and an overall cinematic and immersive experience.

Only in VR: Ashes of the Ark is a VR shooter exclusively built for VR. Step into the Ark and take down zombies in a journey that is guaranteed to feel more real than ever before.

summary.장르: 1인칭 슈터, VR 슈터, 액션, 어드벤처, 시뮬레이션
summary.핵심플레이: 우주정거장 Ark에서 냉동 수면에서 깨어난 플레이어가 무기와 탄약을 찾아 좀비와 전투하고 퍼즐을 풀며 정거장을 탐험한다. VR 모션 컨트롤로 무기를 장전하고 조준하며 다른 생존자를 찾아 나선다.
summary.특징: HTC Vive와 Oculus 전용으로 제작된 VR 전용 게임으로, 걷기 모드와 텔레포트 모드 등 이동 방식을 선택할 수 있다. 캠페인 모드와 무한 좀비·무한 탄약의 서바이벌 모드, 무기 시험용 사격장이 있는 허브 공간을 제공하며, 좀비 훼손과 파괴 가능한 환경을 구현한다.

name: Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble
input:
Available on Steam March 10th - Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble

Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble will be available on Steam on March 10th!

Truffle Trouble is a unique game featuring Pax, the hero of Mushroom Men, that combines classic platforming action with imaginative puzzle-solving as you must move, stack, and use objects to create new paths to jump and clamber on, all while the besotted Truffle Princess draws ever closer.

About the Game
Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble is a unique platforming game featuring Pax, the hero of Mushroom Men.

Pax is trapped in a terrible nightmare. You control Pax as he is pursued by the besotted Truffle Princess, combining classic platforming action with imaginative puzzle-solving as you must move, stack, and use objects to create new paths to jump and clamber on, all while the Truffle Princess draws ever closer.

Being in a dream, even if it is a nightmare, can have its advantages. Pax can transform into different forms to help him negotiate the world, each with its own distinct and powerful abilities. You can use the forms to scamper across vertical walls, turn invisible, or even fly across vast chasms, but using them at the right time is the key.

Mushroom Men: Truffle Trouble hooks you with its distinct gameplay, then keeps you engaged with its beautiful worlds, quirky humor, and Pax’s super-powered forms.

- Platforming - Pax can run, jump, climb, cling to ledges, push, pull, and grab objects, and use his special Form abilities to overcome obstacles.

- Puzzles - Pax is able to manipulate his environment through stacking or moving objects in the world, allowing you to creatively use parts of the environment to create new paths for platforming your way forward.

- The Chase - As you move through the levels you are under a time pressure: the Truffle Princess is after you, steadily smashing her way through the level. You must find a way to keep ahead, increasing your lead enough so that you have time to puzzle through the tricky parts. Even the most basic stretches of levels become critical as you push to stretch your lead.

- Enemies - Scattered throughout the levels are opponents that you want to avoid or destroy. Each opponent has a different set of abilities. Some move about in a small area, others fly about and attack you from range. You either need to avoid them and their attacks, or land on them to squish them.

- Forms - Truffle Trouble features five new Forms that Pax can mutate into, each one with its own set of distinct powers and movement abilities.

- Ghost Pax, who is invisible to enemies and the Princess.

- Moth Pax, who can fly.

- Spider Pax, who can walk on walls and ceilings.

- Mole Pax, who can tunnel through dirt with his powerful claws.

- Super Pax, who can run and jump faster and higher than trains and tall buildings.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Pax를 조작해 달리고 점프하고 기어오르며, 물체를 밀거나 당기고 쌓아 새로운 경로를 만들어 진행한다. 뒤쫓아 오는 Truffle Princess보다 앞서 나가기 위해 제한 시간 안에 퍼즐을 풀어야 한다.
summary.특징: Pax의 악몽을 배경으로 하며, 벽 타기·비행·투명화·땅 파기·강화 이동 등 서로 다른 능력을 가진 다섯 가지 변신 형태를 상황에 맞게 활용한다. 다양한 능력을 지닌 적을 피하거나 밟아 처치할 수 있다.

name: Flyeeex
input:
A CINEMATIC SPACE SHOOTER - WISHLIST NOW!

About the Game
Brief description

There are 10 levels available in the current version.
The main character Flyeeex is able to jump run and rotate the level.
In the game you have to collect coins look for a way out and beware of traps Flyeeex very brave warrior.

Feature of game:

- Collecting coins

- Jumping over dangerous saws

- Rotate the entire level

History

In one very cozy galaxy, around a gentle black star revolved the planet on which the brilliant Creatures lived. Their mood was always cheerful.

Lived they small, together rejoiced good and helped each other in trouble, and so as were they honest, good and sympathetic, evils happened with them very rarely, can be said that almost not happened.

Until one day ... a real alien spaceship appeared Near their planet.

He was very old. It was visible at once: all in spots of rust, scratched by asteroids and space dust, in several places deep dents, some joints of a covering parted and from there pieces of thermal insulation and a wire sadly hung down. Of the dozen engines in working order were only three. However, despite his advanced age, and later it turned out that he was about twenty thousand years old, he still worked.

And so, when he flew to the planet of brilliant beings at the required distance, one of its hatches opened, and stretched out a metal manipulator, dotted with various cameras and scanners.

Turning to the planet, he immediately set to work. Assessed the composition of the atmosphere, temperature, availability of life and natural resources. Then the data was processed by a powerful computer and transmitted through a special device that was the heart of the ship-a hyperspace portal, a huge distance, to the planet of those who created this ship.

Yes, the ship had no crew, it was a robot whose main task was to search for inhabited worlds. And when such a world was, the ship opened a spatial tunnel, and on Board appeared owners.

It was a very convenient technology: it was not necessary to travel through the universe while in suspended animation. In hyperspace, both information and matter are transmitted millions of times faster, and so within an hour in the main hall, the teleport started working, and two people came out of it. Short, about the same as the brilliant creatures on the discovered planet. But their faces did not glow with joy and friendliness, they were frowning and taciturn. They walked to the huge screen in the center of the room, which was lined with equipment, and stared silently at the newly discovered planet.

At last one of them said, " Look what a vile people they are, all smiling like lunatics." To which the other replied “ " What a disgusting world they have." In a matter of minutes, the fate of the planet was decided: through the portal to the main hall of the scout ship, troops of equipment and columns of troops were drawn.

The newcomers were not sociable, concentrated, they were considered bad form laughter and fun, they were angry - this mood was always with them. They were people who relied on technology and computers for everything.

And even their most important ruler was a computer, because they did not trust each other. He was their ruler, and came up with a long time ago to send to all ends of the universe scout ships. Its creators, brilliant beings, unlike the evil ones, who did not know wars, fought very often, almost all the time. This went on for centuries, until one part of them defeated the other. But even after winning, they could not begin to live a happy life. The fear that someone might attack them at any moment poisoned their lives, and although there were no enemies left on their home planet, they immediately began to look for them wherever they could. They began to fear that one day someone might come to them from the depths of space and enslave them.

They did not believe that good beings could live in the universe, because they themselves had exterminated such in their society. And so when they created a robot ruler, they asked him the question of how to protect themselves from such an invasion in the absolute sense. Their ruler was a powerful computer, but he thought computer-straight. After spending no more than a few microseconds solving the problem, he replied, " We must carry the values of our society to all living beings in our universe."

"If they become like us and join our civilization we will not need to fear attack, they will live by our laws!»

At first the evil beings behaved politely and cautiously among the geniuses. They even tried to re-educate brilliant creatures, and some became even slightly angrier. But when a few of these people died of anguish, brilliant creatures realized that they will not succeed. They began to remake the planet, everything they could reach, they began to put in hard black barbed armor, as on their home planet. So that ingenious creatures had to retreat on land, which still not typically recognized remake under themselves green.

And here is, when on the entire planet has remained only a small part of, where they still could routinely to live, all ingenious beings gathered and decided send his defender of and deliverer on contest, which staged a evil invaders, both sides agreed to that in case victory evil newcomers will retreat.

Brilliant beings have achieved something, their civilization was based on biotechnology, they grew plants and knew how to grow exactly what you need! So they gathered all their strength and knowledge and raised... HIS super defender!

It was a creature of incredible courage and agility. It was a living organism, strong and brave able to challenge machines to evil invaders. Each of the main scientists, brilliant creatures, laid in a new hero special abilities: he could rotate the whole building, move quickly, and deftly jump.

The great beings had hope and began the test: it was necessary to pass the test repeatedly collecting coins, dodging obstacles and move to the teleport.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Flyeeex를 조작해 점프와 이동을 하며 코인을 모으고 함정을 피해 출구인 텔레포트로 이동한다. 현재 버전에는 10개의 레벨이 있다.
summary.특징: 레벨 전체를 회전시키는 시스템이 있으며, 회전과 빠른 이동, 점프 능력을 활용해 톱날 등의 장애물을 피한다. 외계 문명의 침공에 맞서 만들어진 방어자 캐릭터를 다룬 배경 설정을 갖는다.

name: Tactical Three Kingdoms (3 Kingdoms) - Strategy & War
input:
Tactical Three Kingdoms (3 Kingdoms) - Strategy & War is a Three-Kingdoms themed tactical strategy game with a unique style, It will bring you back to the Three Kingdoms period. You will need to recruit various famous generals and apply your strategy to make your own history.





GAME INTRODUCTION



Since the uprising of the Yellow Scarves, civilians across the country have been suffering from constant warfare.Heroes are emerging from across the continent, and you are the only savior to end the chaos…



Join Tactical Three Kingdoms (3 Kingdoms) - Strategy & War now and relive the heroic yet chaotic age!



This is a battlefield of both strength and intelligence.In this game, you can relive famous Three Kingdoms battles and recruit powerful heroes to form a team. Fight alongside your favorite generals to face off against different enemies.





GAMES FEATURES



- Novel artwork without rival

This tactical chess game is easy to play and even easier to learn! You don't need godlike reflexes or difficult techniques. You can excel at this game just with a tap of a finger!



- Deploy strategies with the tap of a finger

You can play this tactical strategy game with just one hand! You don't need godlike reactions or difficult techniques to master it, all you need is your finger.



- Use tactics and deploy your army accordingly

Don't underestimate simple operations. Each move requires planning, and each decision you make might alter the result. Big brains are behind the simple plays!



- Diverse game mechanisms allow you to make various plans

Your familiar heroes now have distinctive styles! Tactical Three Kingdoms (3 Kingdoms) - Strategy & War uses special art designs to give each hero a unique image, creating the most lasting impression!



- Develop and train your heroes

Develop your favorite heroes' levels, skills, and stats. Customize skill combinations to form the most powerful lineup. New victories await!





CORE GAMEPLAY



SPECIAL STORYLINE: Our tailor-made storyline has a hint of humor. We bring you an all new three kingdoms experience!

QUEST SYSTEM: Complete different quests to claim rich resources and prizes!

ORGANIZED HUNTING: Experience ancient hunting activities. Collect resources to upgrade your heroes!

REAL-TIME BATTLE: Face off against other players across the globe in real-time. Let’s see who has the better game sense, and who can come up with the most ingenious plans!

ARENA BATTLES: Choose your favorite heroes to form a powerful squad. Face off against other players!

ELITE BATTLES: Challenge strong enemies, plan meticulous tactics, and save the world by yourself!

ENDLESS WARFARE: Gather your squad, make plans accordingly, and survive infinite waves of enemies!





TIPS

Tactical Three Kingdoms (3 Kingdoms) - Strategy & War is a free-to-play game. You do have the option to perform in-game purchases. This game requires a network connection.

summary.핵심플레이: 삼국지 시대를 배경으로 여러 무장을 모아 부대를 편성하고, 전투마다 배치와 전술을 결정해 적과 겨룬다. 무장의 레벨, 스킬, 능력치를 육성하고 스킬 조합을 구성해 진영을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 황건적의 난 이후를 다루는 스토리라인과 각 무장에 개별 아트 디자인을 적용했으며, 실시간 대전, 아레나, 엘리트 전투, 무한 웨이브 등 여러 전투 모드를 제공한다. 기본 무료 플레이에 인앱 구매가 있으며 네트워크 연결이 필요하다.

name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
input:
∞ "Amnea 28" is a visual novel about a group of young people who go to listen to a course of lectures by a respected professor of psychology. Their destination is "Amnea", an old hotel which ceased to fulfill its main functions ten years ago and now serves as the professor's residence. Week of studying didn't promise any problems, yet the atmosphere felt more unsettling with each passing day.

∞ Why did the students' behavior suddenly become strange? What are they hiding? The protagonist will have to solve all the mysteries of "Amnea", otherwise the walls of the old hotel won't let her leave alive.

∞ 30-50 hours of gameplay
∞ 5 unique routes
∞ 36 different endings and 19 unlockable epilogues
∞ more than 100 CGs and 32 music tracks
∞ the character routes are NOT romantic (the protagonist can't romance anyone); however there are certain romantic subplots in the story
∞ the choices you make shape up the character's mental state, the changes can be observed via a special stress scale. Don't let stress destroy the poor thing's mind, or their not-so-great qualities will manifest. They say "Amnea" puts pressure on its guests, so don't let them lose their minds!

Li (the protagonist)

- Responsible, inquisitive, likes when everything is in order

Vincen
- A reliable leader who can take control of the situation if necessary, cool-headed and quick-thinking
∞ Why did Vincen, who has no need for the professor's lectures, come to "Amnea"? Out of mere curiosity?

Debra
- Energetic, sharp-tongued, may get violent if someone gets in a fight with her
∞ Where will Debra's stubborn desire to achieve the goal get her?

Cordelia
- Kind-hearted and amiable, has an air of peacefulness around her
∞ Why is Cordelia afraid of sharp objects? Why does she suffer from panic attacks?

Josheni
- Always smiles and acts friendly, gets along well with the others easily, absolutely non-confrontational
∞ Is Josheni as invincible as he thinks? Will he be able to find his most precious treasure in "Amnea"?

∞ After finding out the four main characters' secrets the fifth route will be unlocked - the story of the protagonist herself, who is the closest to unravelling the old hotel's mysteries. Afterwards, the second part of her route will be revealed, leading to the true ending.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Li가 되어 오래된 호텔 Amnea에서 벌어지는 사건을 조사하고 선택지를 통해 이야기를 진행하며, 등장인물들의 비밀을 밝힌다. 선택에 따라 캐릭터의 정신 상태가 변하며 이는 스트레스 게이지로 확인할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 5개의 루트와 36개의 엔딩, 19개의 해금형 에필로그, 100개 이상의 CG를 포함하며, 캐릭터 루트는 연애가 아닌 미스터리 중심이다. 네 인물의 비밀을 밝히면 주인공 자신의 다섯 번째 루트가 열려 진 엔딩으로 이어진다.

name: Spectral Shades: Fragments
input:
Spectral Shades: Fragments is a magical girl themed exploration game, where the female protagonist Chiharu finds herself lost in the depths of an unknown and surreal space, which soon turns out to also be the battle ground of two magical girls. Both of them seem to have a particular interest in poor Chiharu.

Find your way through this surreal environment, solve puzzles, acquire objects that grant you new abilities and try to find your way out. Oh, and maybe save a magical girl in the meantime.

Spectral Shades: Fragments…

- is a short game with multiple endings and little hand holding.

- has some eerie or unsettling moments. It’s a RPG Maker horror adventure after all.

- has some flashing images and colors. So if you are sensitive, please be aware.

- has magical girls. That are fighting about Chiharu.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Chiharu를 조작해 초현실적인 공간을 탐험하며 퍼즐을 풀고, 새로운 능력을 부여하는 아이템을 획득해 탈출로를 찾는다.
summary.특징: 마법소녀를 소재로 한 RPG Maker 호러 어드벤처로, 여러 엔딩과 최소한의 안내를 제공하며 불안하거나 섬뜩한 순간과 번쩍이는 이미지·색상이 포함된다.

name: Niflhel's Fables: The Book of Gypsies
input:
A visual novel with a fabulous atmosphere where your every choice matters.

Ruff and his brothers went to haymaking one day. His brothers punished him — do not lie down in the heat on the boundary under a broom bush. Did not listen to the brothers Ruff. This is where his misadventures began.

"Navi tales: the Book of Gypsies" is a visual novel, from the pages of which the midday summer heat is bursting. The setting is based on Slavic folklore.

"Navi Tales" is a prequel to another game of our studio - "Navi Day".

summary.핵심플레이: 이야기를 읽어나가며 선택지를 고르고, 그 선택이 전개에 영향을 미친다. 주인공 Ruff의 이야기를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 슬라브 민속 설화를 배경으로 한 세계관을 다루며, 스튜디오의 다른 게임 'Navi Day'의 프리퀄에 해당한다.

name: Smokkehed
input: Smokkehed is a music driven on-rails shooter set in a beautiful surreal world. Glide through wireframe landscapes and nebulas made of diamond as you shatter a dazzling array of shimmering glass enemies. Battle collossal Lovecraftian beasts and countless minions which pulse to the beat. Use your trusty head cannons to blast your way through over 20 levels of audiovisual mayhem.

summary.핵심플레이: 레일을 따라 이동하며 헤드 캐논으로 유리 재질의 적과 대형 보스를 파괴한다. 20개 이상의 레벨을 진행한다.
summary.특징: 음악에 맞춰 적들이 움직이며, 와이어프레임 지형과 다이아몬드로 이루어진 성운 등 초현실적 세계에서 러브크래프트풍의 거대 몬스터와 전투한다.

name: DR MILOS REVENGE
input:
GAMEPLAY
DR MILOS REVENGE is a challenging horror experience with suspenseful stealth gameplay, light puzzle solving and minimal hand-holding. Unlock Nightmare Mode after beating the game, a much more challenging and definitive way to experience the game.

STORY
Take on the role of a researcher, working in an isolated polar station when something knocks the power out and you're chosen to fix it. Soon you'll find the task at hand isn't as easy as it may have initially seemed.

FEATURES

- Intense Stealth Gameplay

- Puzzle Solving

- No Handholding

- Maze like Level Design

- Bonus Nightmare Mode

summary.핵심플레이: 고립된 극지방 연구소에서 연구원이 되어 끊긴 전력을 복구하는 임무를 수행하며, 스텔스로 위협을 피하고 퍼즐을 풀어 나간다.
summary.특징: 미로형 레벨 디자인과 별도 안내가 최소화된 진행 방식을 갖추고 있으며, 게임을 클리어하면 더 높은 난이도의 나이트메어 모드가 해금된다.

name: Clean History
input:
Lore

Clean History is a temporal agency whose mission is to go back in time and clean up scenes from our history that should never have existed.

You've been working hard for the company for 6 years, employee of the year several times in a row, never counting overtime until you've accumulated hundreds of hours.

summary.핵심플레이: 시간을 거슬러 과거로 이동해 존재해서는 안 될 역사의 현장을 청소한다.
summary.특징: 시간 여행을 다루는 기관 Clean History를 배경으로, 플레이어는 6년째 근무하며 여러 차례 올해의 직원으로 선정된 직원 역할을 맡는다.

name: Massive Assault
input:
Take the command of Free Nations Union forces and defeat the Phantom League on one of six distant planets. The rebels decided to seize the power on Earth by first conquering the space colonies, which provide vital energy resources to AOG. The war for global domination unrolls on continents, at sea, and in the air. With secret allies, you can disclose and provide troops at any moment, surprisingly shifting the power balance in a particular region. Lead your divisions, fleets, and air squadrons against those who dared threaten our freedom and democracy.

- Original political system based on "Secret Allies" providing endless replayability

- Smooth and Dynamic Gameplay

- Full 3D Graphic Engine

- Huge 3D Landscapes

- 26 Detailed 3D Units

- Realistic Lighting, Explosions and Effects

- 3D Sound

- 6 Different Worlds (planets)

summary.핵심플레이: Free Nations Union 병력을 지휘해 여섯 개 행성에서 Phantom League를 상대로 육상, 해상, 공중 전투를 벌이며 사단, 함대, 공군 편대를 운용한다.
summary.특징: '비밀 동맹' 시스템을 통해 특정 시점에 동맹을 공개하고 병력을 투입해 지역별 전력 균형을 바꿀 수 있으며, 3D 그래픽 엔진으로 여섯 개의 행성 환경과 26종의 유닛을 구현한다.

name: Kamimachi Site - Dating story

Enjoy a wonderful time with a tidy and lovely Japanese girl.

summary.핵심플레이: 메시지 게시판에서 만난 여성과의 이야기를 진행하는 어드벤처 파트, 잠든 그녀를 마우스로 조작하는 파트, 숫자 키패드로 영상을 제어하는 성적 파트의 순서로 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 등장인물은 모두 18세 이상이며, 성인 콘텐츠를 담고 있다. 여성 성우 Koto Kinoshita의 음성과 Chata의 엔딩곡이 수록되어 있고, 엔딩곡 버전, 배경화면, 미사용 사운드 등의 부가 요소를 포함한다.

name: Oik 4
input:
Casual physics puzzle. The player's goal to keep the blue block on the platform for 3 seconds in order to pass the level.

- 60levels
- Relax music

Oik 4 - Puzzle in the style of Zup!
Credits
"Oik 4" powered by Clickteam Fusion 2.5

summary.핵심플레이: 물리 기반 퍼즐로, 파란색 블록을 플랫폼 위에서 3초간 유지하면 레벨을 통과한다.
summary.특징: 총 60개의 레벨과 편안한 음악을 제공하며, Clickteam Fusion 2.5로 제작되었다.

name: Lords of Solgrund
input:
Lords of Solgrund combines elements of real time strategy, city building and other unique additions. The game features detailed animations, complex gameplay systems inspired by the early middle ages and combined with magical, spiritual and other fantastical elements that are based in an entirely seperate reality from ours.

Discord

Join the Lords of Solgrund community on discord to share your opinions, ideas and get the earliest updates and further insight into the development.

Gameplay

Before the game starts, you will choose a faction. Each faction has several positive or negative attributes, such as having head start on specific researches, cheaper market prices, stronger or weaker soldiers and more. While in game you can pick your school of magic that determines what kind of spells your spell book will have access to. Each school of magic has a different theme with a set of spells associated with it.

During the game, you will manage your economy and ensure your people have enough to eat and have decent housing. Houses can be upgraded to have higher income and hygiene but also require more needs and luxuries, such as furniture, clothing or decorations.

Editor

Create your own custom maps, campaigns or mini scenarios with the ingame editor and share them with other people!

Localization

The game is built to support as many languages as possible, you can volunteer to help translate the entire game into your native language (or any language you are fluent in). Localizing maps and campaigns is also possible.

!!! Please keep in mind localization is community-driven. There may be words missing or wrongly translated as the translation lags behind development !!!

summary.핵심플레이: 팩션을 선택해 시작하고, 경제를 운영하며 주민들의 식량과 주거를 관리한다. 주택을 업그레이드해 수입과 위생을 높이는 대신 가구, 의류, 장식 같은 추가 수요를 충족시켜야 한다.
summary.특징: 초기 중세를 기반으로 마법적·영적·환상적 요소를 결합한 별개의 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 게임 내 마법 학파를 선택해 사용할 주문을 결정한다. 인게임 에디터로 맵, 캠페인, 미니 시나리오를 제작·공유할 수 있고, 다국어 지원 및 커뮤니티 기반 번역이 가능하다.

name: Legends of Boom
input: Legends of Boom is a fast-paced RTS-Lite Battle game, designed for players who crave quick, intense matches where you strategically place bases, weapons, defenses, and events on one of 24 different battle maps. Dive into the single-player Path of Boom to earn experience, upgrade your cards, and unlock powerful strategies. Or, take your finely tuned deck-building skills online to face off against opponents while the puppet sportscaster, Flip Rimrod (voiced Tim Kitzrow, legendary NBA JAM announcer), delivers play-by-play of every match.

summary.핵심플레이: 24개의 전투 맵 중 하나에 기지, 무기, 방어 시설, 이벤트를 전략적으로 배치하며 매치를 진행한다. 싱글플레이 Path of Boom에서 경험치를 얻어 카드를 업그레이드하고, 덱을 구성해 온라인에서 다른 플레이어와 대전한다.
summary.특징: NBA JAM 아나운서 Tim Kitzrow가 목소리를 맡은 퍼펫 스포츠 캐스터 Flip Rimrod가 매치 중 실황 중계를 제공한다. RTS-Lite 형식과 덱 빌딩 요소를 결합한 무료 플레이 방식이다.

name: Dark Quest 3
input:
A message from the Elder
"Heed my warning well, friends. A new evil has risen in the East. A power-hungry sorcerer of chaos magic is laying siege to the realm. That is why I called you here. You are heroes, one and all. And without you, all hope is lost. You will face untold challenges you may not survive, and old alliances will need to be rebuilt to stand a chance. I will guide you as best I can, but the rest is up to you."
