summary.핵심플레이: 영웅들을 이끌고 혼돈 마법을 쓰는 마법사에 맞서 여러 도전을 헤쳐 나간다.
summary.특징: 동쪽에서 새로운 악이 부상해 왕국을 공격하는 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 옛 동맹을 재건해 위협에 대응한다.

name: The Realm
input:
Story

The player lost in a Labyrinthine village in another world is looking for a way out alone.

You explore the village from a first-person perspective and find the exit.

There are many creatures lurking in the village. All of them are terrifying creatures you've never seen before.

Will you be able to leave the village safely?



System

This game is a walking simulation game, and all you have to do is walk in the dark village.

The controls for this game are easy, just grab your flashlight and keep walking and look for exit.

You can have an experience like you're actually in a village of horror.

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점으로 어두운 미로 같은 마을을 탐험하며 출구를 찾는다. 손전등을 들고 걸어다니며 마을 곳곳을 살펴본다.
summary.특징: 다른 세계의 마을에 홀로 남겨진 플레이어가 탈출로를 찾는 설정으로, 마을 곳곳에 처음 보는 생명체들이 숨어 있다. 조작이 단순한 워킹 시뮬레이션 방식이다.

name: Target Dragon 2: Maze Runner
input:
Target Dragon 2: Maze Runner is a single-player fantasy RPG adventure where you battle dragons invading your village. As you progress through six different maps navigating through Dragon’s labyrinths to reach LORD DRAGON, you complete various quests to upgrade your character. During battles with fantastical creatures, you can bring along a loyal pet dog; its automatic attack system lends you extra support by taking care of enemies on your behalf. Additionally, you have the option to nurture a fairy that grants you unique skills, helping to speed up your progress.

While gathering materials by engaging in activities such as mining, woodcutting, flower picking, and fishing, you can utilize the crafting system to refine your resources—further boosted by hiring workers when needed. With the freedom to choose between male and female characters and play as a warrior, archer, or mage, this offline adventure features over 100 mazes, 1000 puzzles, and countless quests waiting for you.

As you embark on your adventure, you must choose one of the warrior, archer, or mage characters and select the difficulty level you desire from easy, normal, or hard. You can continue the game across 25 different save.

summary.핵심플레이: 마을을 침략한 드래곤과 전투하며 여섯 개의 맵과 미로를 탐험해 LORD DRAGON에 도달하고, 퀘스트를 완료해 캐릭터를 성장시킨다. 채굴, 벌목, 꽃 채집, 낚시로 재료를 모아 제작 시스템으로 자원을 가공한다.
summary.특징: 전투를 돕는 반려견과 고유 스킬을 주는 요정을 육성할 수 있으며, 전사·궁수·마법사 중 하나와 남녀 캐릭터를 선택한다. 100개 이상의 미로와 1000개의 퍼즐, 세 가지 난이도, 25개의 저장 슬롯을 제공하는 오프라인 싱글플레이 게임이다.

name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2
input:
Anomalous Coffee Machine 2 is a strange interactive visual novel and fictional simulation where you stand across from a mysterious girl and an unassuming coffee vending machine capable of producing anything you type, no matter how impossible it seems. She doesn’t tell you who she is, why she's there, or what's the deal with the coffee machine. All she asks is that you type a word—any word—and press the button. The machine will respond. It always does.

Type in "coffee", and you’ll receive exactly that.
Type "blood"—yeah, sure.
Type "saliva"—You probably shouldn’t, but it can do that too.
Type "death"? You can try.

HOW TO PLAY

Gameplay is simple:

-
Type a word.

-
A cup appears.

-
Choose who drinks: the girl, or you.

-
Something happens. Or doesn’t. Or waits.

She reacts differently depending on what you give her. Sometimes she smiles. Sometimes she winces. Sometimes she vanishes, only to return changed. Sometimes she doesn’t come back at all. And if you choose to drink, the machine reacts to you instead. Don’t expect a fair trade.

There are no instructions. No quests. No markers to follow. You’re not told what the machine is or what it wants. You’re left to experiment. Test words. Try feelings. Push the machine. Break it. Or let it break you.

summary.핵심플레이: 단어를 입력하면 자판기가 해당 단어에 대응하는 음료 한 잔을 내놓으며, 그것을 소녀에게 줄지 자신이 마실지 선택한다. 선택에 따라 소녀 또는 플레이어에게 다른 반응과 결과가 나타난다.
summary.특징: 정체를 알 수 없는 소녀와 무엇이든 입력한 대로 만들어내는 커피 자판기를 다루며, 별도의 안내나 퀘스트·목표 표시 없이 다양한 단어와 감정을 실험하는 방식으로 진행된다.

name: Relaxing Simulator
input:
Welcome to our Relaxing Simulator, a unique experience designed to calm the senses, relax the mind, and nurture the soul. In a hectic world where stress and hustle are omnipresent, our game offers an oasis of serenity and tranquility.

Immerse yourself in an immersive environment filled with natural beauty. Each location has been carefully crafted to create an atmosphere of relaxation and peace. Listen to the soothing sounds and enjoy the surroundings. Interact with objects as needed to view, turn on, or open them.

Our game offers relaxing activities aimed at calming the mind and relaxing the body. Explore locations in the virtual world to establish a deeper connection with yourself.

Our aim is to create a digital sanctuary where players can take a break from the stresses of everyday life. With a harmonious combination of visual aesthetics, relaxing music, and soothing activities, we invite players to leave the hustle and bustle of life behind and immerse themselves in the world of inner peace. Welcome to our Relaxing Simulator - a place where relaxation and rejuvenation take center stage.

Features:
- Experience complete freedom in first-person perspective to move around freely.
- Enjoy the surroundings with music or ambient sounds.
- There are 8 different environments available.
- Interact with objects, furniture, and doors to actively explore the world.
- Set the time of day to create the desired atmosphere in your surroundings. You can also watch the sunrise and sunset.

Highlights:
- Earn numerous achievements through diverse challenges.
- A global leaderboard to showcase how long you've enjoyed your tranquility.

More:
- You love this game and want additional environments to relax in. Share your ideas in the CommunityHUB and let's talk about them together.

Note:
This experimental project offers you a digital sanctuary. The game has no story, no characters, no running or jumping or anything like that. You move forward standing and running and are located on mini-maps.

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점으로 환경을 자유롭게 이동하며 오브젝트, 가구, 문 등을 조작하고 주변을 둘러본다. 뛰거나 점프하는 동작 없이 걸으며 미니맵 형태의 공간을 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 자연을 소재로 한 8개의 서로 다른 환경을 제공하며, 시간대를 설정해 일출·일몰 등 분위기를 바꿀 수 있다. 음악과 환경음, 도전 과제, 글로벌 리더보드가 포함되며 스토리나 캐릭터는 없다.

name: Third Eye
input:
Third Eye is a hack 'n' slash adventure game with its roots set in Indian culture. A game that is made by a group of 8 people putting in all their efforts to bring you the experience of a hack and slash adventure game made in India.
Story:

Time is endless in the endless wheel of life and death, beginnings and ends, and birth and rebirth. As that wheel moves, ages come and go and are forgotten to time, becoming nothing but dust in the wind. In one such spoke of the wheel, we come to the story of Prithvilok, a realm ruled by beings of energy that seem to be nothing but myths to us mortals. In this beautiful and mythical land, the never-ending battle between Good and Evil is at its penultimate chapter.

Raakh (Our hero), a dutiful son, is put into the hardest trial of his life when his father gives him the responsibility to be the guardian of the sacred trident. Meanwhile, as a hero rises, so must a villain!

Shukracharya, the most intelligent of the Seven Sages, has his own beliefs of the concept of good and evil.

Both of their paths collide as they both think that the actions that they are taking is in the best interest of mankind.
Features:

- Hack and slash your way to power with tight action gameplay

- Experience an immersive story with a rich cultural backdrop

- Defend yourself and your world from Shukracharya's demonic armies

- Take on challenging boss fights and slay hordes of enemies

- Save Prithvilok from the forces of darkness and fulfill your destiny as the Chosen One

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공 Raakh를 조작해 근접 전투로 적 무리를 처치하고, 보스전을 진행하며 이야기를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 인도 문화와 신화를 배경으로 한 세계 Prithvilok를 무대로, 신성한 삼지창의 수호자가 된 주인공과 현자 Shukracharya의 대립을 다룬다.

name: Luck Auto Chess
input:
The Great Demon King wants to conquer this beautiful land. Warriors, assemble your team and repel it!

You can choose the Imperial warriors who can evolve up to 5 times!

You can also choose the wolf pack! By raising werewolves, you can have more and more wolves in your chess pool. Then, by utilizing the synergy effects of the wolf race, you can achieve astonishing combat power to crush your enemies!

There are also mages here who cast magic missiles like crazy! Are you ready to welcome the feast of magic missiles flying in the sky?

Game Features:

-
350+ unique and distinctive chess pieces

-
130+ various treasures

-
30+ items that can be used on chess pieces

-
5 heroes with different styles

-
18 maps

summary.핵심플레이: 기물을 모아 팀을 구성하고 배치해 마왕의 군대를 막아내는 오토체스 형태로 전투를 진행한다. 제국 전사, 늑대 무리, 마법사 등 종족과 시너지를 조합해 전력을 강화한다.
summary.특징: 최대 5회까지 진화하는 제국 전사, 늑대를 키워 체스풀 내 늑대를 늘리는 늑대 종족 시너지 등 다양한 조합 요소를 제공한다. 350종 이상의 기물, 130종 이상의 보물, 30종 이상의 아이템, 서로 다른 스타일의 영웅 5명, 18개의 맵을 포함한다.

name: Waiting For The Raven
input:
Become Master of Spies, plant your connections, associates and agents in the underworld and slowly take control over the city.

Dispose of your opponents in many clever ways.

Bathe in treachery, choose who to join and who to betray.

Negotiate and manipulate different characters through fully voiced letters.

Immerse yourself in a unique and chilling atmosphere of mystery.

Decrypt & Decipher Secret Letters.

Solve Puzzles.

Uncover Mysteries.

Survive, by keeping your enemies at bay, the constabulary confused and your own lackeys on a short leash.

Choose your very own path in this hybrid of first-person and top-down experience.

The many tools in your disposal include treachery, espionage, abduction, influence, murder, schemes, plots, bribes, seduction, even the law. Use and abuse them in any way you fancy.

Are you a cruel boss of the underworld? Leader of a cult? Greedy and witty businessman? Maybe a secretive spymaster which exists only in rumours of myth? The approach you take may dictate eventually how everyone sees you in this cold-hearted world of espionage and treachery.

summary.핵심플레이: 스파이 조직의 수장이 되어 뒷골목에 연줄과 요원을 심고 도시에 대한 통제권을 서서히 확대한다. 협상과 조종, 배신, 첩보, 납치, 매수 등 다양한 수단으로 상대를 제거하고, 암호 편지를 해독하며 퍼즐을 풀고 미스터리를 파헤친다.
summary.특징: 1인칭과 탑다운 시점을 결합한 방식으로 진행되며, 음성이 입혀진 편지를 통해 인물들과 교섭한다. 첩보와 배신을 다루는 미스터리 분위기 속에서 플레이어의 선택에 따라 진행 경로와 세계 속 평판이 달라진다.

name: Twizzle Puzzle: Predators
input:
Twizzle Puzzle: Predators - is the perfect puzzle game for a fun and rewarding pastime.
Your goal is to assemble a picture of cute predators that has been cut into an equal number of pieces.
Rotate the pieces to create the full picture, but think logically about the connections and solve the puzzle.
There are 50 levels to complete, and the challenge becomes increasingly difficult as you progress.
Enjoy a relaxing time connecting the pieces to create a beautiful picture of predators

In Twizzle Puzzle: Predators:

•50 levels
•Beautiful art
•Simple controls (mouse)
•Achievements
•Relaxing music

summary.핵심플레이: 조각으로 나뉜 포식 동물 그림을 회전시켜 올바른 방향으로 맞춰 하나의 그림을 완성한다. 조각들의 연결을 논리적으로 판단하며 퍼즐을 푼다.
summary.특징: 포식 동물을 소재로 한 50개의 레벨로 구성되며, 진행할수록 난이도가 올라간다. 마우스만으로 조작하며 도전 과제와 배경 음악을 포함한다.

name: Cancer Crusher USA
input:
Cancer Crusher USA puts you behind the wheels of the CANCER CRUSHER on a high-stakes mission across the country. Take control of Pete, a dedicated worker for California Cancer Crusher, who refuses to sit back as cancerous tumors spread across America’s roads and countryside. When Pete sees the crisis unfolding, he can’t stay home - he has to do something, even if it means breaking the rules.

Armed with his one-of-a-kind Cancer Crusher truck, Pete sets off from California on a cross-country journey to wipe out tumors and uncover the mystery behind the nationwide outbreak. Smash through cancerous growths to earn magic points, and rack up combo bonuses by drifting through chains of tumors without missing a beat. The more cancer you crush, the more powerful your abilities become!

Strategically use your magic points to gain the upper hand:

-
Hold left trigger for a powerful speed boost to outrun patrols and clear obstacles.

-
Activate rotating defense shields with the left shoulder button to destroy enemy drones and trucks on contact.

-
Jump with the right shoulder button to leap over hazards and blockades.

Every move counts—each ability drains your magic, so plan your combos for maximum impact.

Along your route, you’ll meet a colorful cast of characters who reveal clues, explain the spreading phenomenon, and help you piece together the path to a cure. Dodge enemy patrols, slip past drone checkpoints, and race toward iconic landmarks across the United States as you unravel the story.

Will you discover the truth and finally crush cancer, once and for all? Strap in, rev up, and join the fight!

summary.핵심플레이: 트럭 Cancer Crusher를 운전하는 Pete를 조작해 도로 위의 종양을 부수며 캘리포니아에서 미국 전역을 횡단한다. 종양을 연속으로 드리프트하며 파괴해 콤보 보너스와 매직 포인트를 쌓고, 이를 소모해 능력을 사용한다.
summary.특징: 매직 포인트로 속도 부스트, 회전 방어 실드, 점프 등의 능력을 발동해 적 순찰대와 드론 검문소를 피한다. 이동 중 만나는 여러 캐릭터들이 종양 확산 현상에 대한 단서를 제공하며 치료법을 찾는 이야기가 전개된다.

name: Neospace: Prologue
input:
You are on the Steam page of the prologue. Wishlist the full version here:

You wake up in a spaceship, you realize that strange things are going on there, you try to get back to civilization. However, this is harder than you think, the encounters will drive you crazy and you will doubt yourself.

- Continuous storyline

Discover the truth about yourself, especially why you play such a big role in the universe

- hub world
Not only serves to get to the next chapter, but also to play cool mini games, can you become the best?

- Hard Puzzles
The path isn't always easy Collect items and solve puzzles to advance

- help system

If you get stuck, you can activate the help system! If activated, important story components are highlighted in neon blue. But be careful, this function is only available on the "Easy" and "Normal" difficulty levels.

summary.핵심플레이: 우주선에서 깨어난 주인공이 되어 아이템을 모으고 퍼즐을 풀며 문명으로 돌아가는 길을 찾아 이야기를 진행한다. 허브 월드에서 다음 챕터로 이동하거나 미니게임을 즐길 수 있다.
summary.특징: 연속적인 스토리라인을 통해 주인공의 정체와 우주에서의 역할에 관한 내용을 다룬다. 막힐 경우 중요한 스토리 요소를 네온 블루로 강조해 주는 도움 시스템이 있으나 이는 Easy와 Normal 난이도에서만 사용 가능하다.

name: Galaxy Control: 3D Strategy
input:
Steam FAQ

QUESTION: Free-to-Play game? Another one?!
ANSWER: Yes, this is a F2P game. We’re honest about it. There is no paywall, no artificial barriers. Everyone is in same conditions if they pay or not. If you like to support developers and grow faster (but not bigger!) in the process — you can donate. But this is completely voluntary!
Q: WTF? Timers?!
A: Yes, many things in our game are time dependent. This is a way to balance a massive multiplayer game and to make players return to game regularly. This may be a bit strange for desktop game, but mobile games been using it for years.
Q: Can I play on mobile?
A: Galaxy Control is already available on all mobile platforms:
- iOS:
- Android:
- Amazon:
- Windows Phone:
Q: Why do we need a Steam version?
A: We have a lot of fans who prefer playing (or continue playing) on PC and Mac in Facebook version, meanwhile many browsers limiting support of 3D games recently. So we do this for their convenience first of all. We're determined to develop Steam version and hope that many new players will join the game!
Q: Will I be able to play on the same account from Steam and from mobile?
A: Absolutely! We support connecting Steam accounts to mobile (and vice-versa) through Facebook.
Q: Are Steam players playing on the same server as mobile users?
A: Everyone is playing on the same server. There are already hundreds of thousands of players in Galaxy Control!

About the Game
Galaxy Control is an ultimate space combat strategy game with fast-paced combats!

Build your base and battle with other players to control the galaxy! Galaxy Control is an ultimate space combat strategy game with next generation 3d graphics and fast-paced combats!

Gather minerals and extract uranium, defend your base with laser towers, missile turrets, cannons, walls and mines, create the ultimate army with unique ground and air units! Battle with millions of players and take their Fame point and resources! Became the TOP 1 in the galaxy!

NOTE! Galaxy Control requires internet connection.

FEATURES:

- 100% FREE TO PLAY ultimate space strategy
- Battle with players from all over the world and take their Fame Points and resources
- Gather minerals and extract uranium to build and upgrade your base
- Defend your base with laser towers, missile turrets, cannons, walls and mines
- Create the ultimate army with more than 11 unique ground and air units
- Campaign Mode with more than 100 unique missions

STAY IN TOUCH WITH DEV AND OTHER PLAYERS ON DISCORD-

summary.핵심플레이: 광물과 우라늄을 채집해 기지를 건설·업그레이드하고, 레이저 타워·미사일 포탑·대포·벽·지뢰 등으로 방어 시설을 구축한다. 지상·공중 유닛으로 군대를 편성해 다른 플레이어를 공격하고 명성 포인트와 자원을 빼앗는다.
summary.특징: 우주를 배경으로 한 기지 건설형 전략 게임으로, 시간 기반 시스템과 상시 인터넷 연결이 필요하다. Steam, 모바일, Facebook 버전이 동일 서버를 공유하며 계정 연동이 가능하고, 100개 이상의 미션으로 구성된 캠페인 모드와 11종 이상의 유닛을 제공한다.

name: Population Goals!
input:
In the distant future, the last living humans in the universe have sent back a cyborg to Old Earth. Your job is to clone and portal back humans birthed from long ago buried cloning machines. It will be up to you to find these buried machines and lead these newly cloned "citizens" safely back to the portal to New Earth. You will need to mine into Old Earth and create hazard free tunnels to help New Earth meet it's Population Goals!

FEATURES

-
Mine into many different biomes to find 100's of unique artifacts.

-
Use different materials to build safe tunnels and lighting to assist citizens back to the portal ship.

-
Use artifacts to craft helpful tools and drones, each with their own abilities.

-
Discover the truth behind New Earth and the demise of Old Earth.

-
Help citizens avoid biome specific destructive creatures and traps.

-
Bring the Oasis back to life and help these new citizens thrive.

-
Earn Steam Achievements as you play.

summary.핵심플레이: 사이보그가 되어 지하 클로닝 기계를 찾고, 땅을 파서 위험 요소가 없는 안전한 터널과 조명을 만들어 복제된 시민들을 New Earth로 향하는 포탈로 안전하게 인도한다. 여러 바이오홈을 채굴해 유물을 모으고 이를 활용해 도구와 드론을 제작한다.
summary.특징: 먼 미래 우주의 마지막 인류가 옛 지구로 사이보그를 보내 인류를 복제·이송한다는 설정을 배경으로 한다. 바이오홈별로 존재하는 파괴적 생물과 함정을 피하며 시민을 보호하고, New Earth의 진실과 옛 지구의 멸망을 밝혀 나가며 오아시스를 되살린다.

name: Crossroad Mysteries: The Broken Deal
input:
Desperate to find a way to medically remedy the horrendous stigmata and nightmares, Anna begins to look for the reason for her childhood suffering, which she knows nothing about. Her way lies through a small town from where she got to the asylum. Up to this moment all her memories were as though wrapped in a white shroud. What happened to Anna in her early childhood? How will she cope with what she releases from the chambers of her past?

Features:

- Stunning graphics

- Exciting story

- Fully interactive environment

- A variety of mini-games

- 23 quest screen

- 20 mini-games

- 9 Hidden Object Scenes

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Anna가 되어 어린 시절의 고통과 악몽의 원인을 찾아가며, 상호작용 가능한 환경을 탐색하고 미니게임과 숨은 물건 찾기 장면을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 기억을 잃은 여성이 어린 시절의 과거를 추적하는 스토리를 따라가며, 23개의 퀘스트 화면, 20개의 미니게임, 9개의 히든 오브젝트 장면으로 구성되어 있다.

name: MDNE
input:
MDNE - My Dream Never End!

You find yourself in your nightmare once again, but this time you will discover once and for all what causes it.

In this nightmare, all your frightening dreams, childhood memories, fears, ancient Greek mythology, and your own unique and strongest fear are intertwined.
To help make sense of it all, your inner voice will guide you, vividly remembering all your past nightmares.
And at the end of the game, a final battle awaits you.

This is a first-person mystical horror novel with standard controls: keyboard and mouse.

You will plunge into a dream world in which you need to solve puzzles, run away from monsters and discover the history of your nightmares.
Warning: some strong language.
Game Features:

- Simple and pleasant controls.

- The atmosphere of mystical dream.

- Good optimization.

- Interesting novel storyline.

- Hand-drawn graphics.

- There are achievements and cloud saving.

- Three endings.

summary.핵심플레이: 꿈 속 세계를 탐험하며 퍼즐을 풀고 몬스터를 피해 도망치면서 악몽의 원인과 이야기를 밝혀낸다. 게임 후반에는 최종 전투가 진행된다.
summary.특징: 악몽, 어린 시절의 기억, 공포, 그리스 신화가 얽힌 세계관에서 내면의 목소리가 안내자 역할을 하며, 손으로 그린 그래픽과 세 가지 엔딩, 도전 과제 및 클라우드 저장을 지원한다.

name: Workshop Simulator VR
input:
Workshop Simulator VR is a simulation game where you take on the role of a workshop owner, equipped with a range of specialized tools. Become a master of restoring various items, take on increasingly complex tasks, earn money, build your reputation, buy new tools, replenish resources, and expand your workshop.

🔧 Disassemble & Assemble:

Use a special arm, manual, and mechanical tools to unscrew and screw bolts, remove and hammer nails, and take apart the most intricate structures. Reassemble items to restore them to their original glory.

🧼 Cleaning:

Carefully wash all surfaces with a special cleaning solution, sponge, or pressure washer. Then, clean and polish every crevice of each item with a wire brush, grinder, or sandblaster. Your earnings and reputation depend entirely on the quality of your work.

🎨 Make it beautiful:

Use brushes, colorful sprays, or an airbrush. Unleash your creativity by choosing colors and techniques to breathe new life into every item, transforming it into a unique piece of art.

Key features:

-
Play as the owner of the Workshop

-
Variety of tools and workshop techniques

-
Diverse tasks to complete

-
Interactive, physics-based objects

-
Expand and develop your workshop

summary.핵심플레이: 작업장 주인이 되어 다양한 도구로 물건을 분해·조립하고, 세척과 연마로 표면을 정리한 뒤 페인트와 스프레이로 도색해 물건을 복원한다. 작업을 완료해 돈을 벌고 평판을 쌓으며 새 도구와 자원을 구매해 작업장을 확장한다.
summary.특징: VR 환경에서 나사 풀기, 못 박기, 세척, 연마, 도색 등 물리 기반 상호작용으로 작업을 수행하며, 작업 품질에 따라 수입과 평판이 결정되고 점점 복잡한 작업이 주어진다.

name: Infinite Game Works Episode 1
input:
Update Notes

Ver 0.5 Update Notes:

- Add tooltips to Lunch screen

- Add character status to "Game Developing" screen

- Add "No Ads Ordered" indicator to development screen

About the Game

The second game about making games!
Experience the life of a high school indie game developer. Care for and build relationships with your teammates!

Yuta is following in the footsteps of Justin (from the first game) and wants to become an indie game developer. With his teammates, will he be able to fulfill his dream or will the drama overcome him?

- In-depth Indie Game Development Simulation

- Manage funding, game ideas and your team

- More story (just like you asked for)

- Buff System

- More characters

- Multiple endings

- Eat snacks in-game (for better or worse)

summary.핵심플레이: 고등학생 인디 게임 개발자가 되어 자금과 게임 아이디어, 팀을 관리하며 게임을 개발한다. 팀원들을 돌보고 관계를 쌓아간다.
summary.특징: 주인공 Yuta의 인디 게임 개발 도전을 다룬 스토리 기반 시뮬레이션으로, 버프 시스템, 여러 캐릭터, 복수의 엔딩, 게임 내 간식 섭취 요소를 포함한다.

name: Critter'n Roll: A Twitch Chat Experience
input:
Critter'N Roll is a cute animal Twitch chat game where viewers compete as adorable rolling critters! Roll through diverse levels and environments while enjoying peaceful, charming atmospheres. Level up your animal, unlock customizations, and roll your way to victory alongside up to 20 other players!

Simply type "!join" in chat to enter the game as your chosen critter. Roll, bounce, and tumble through 7x7 grid levels filled with obstacles, paths, and surprises. Each level presents a unique challenge - find the exit, collect items, or survive environmental hazards while competing alongside fellow viewers.

-
Real-time Chat Integration - Commands are instant and easy to learn

-
Diverse Environments - From peaceful meadows to tricky maze levels

-
Animal Customization - Unlock new critters and personalize your rolling friend

-
Streamer Interaction - Broadcasters can influence gameplay and create memorable moments

-
Relaxing Atmosphere - Enjoy soothing visuals and sounds while you compete

-
Community Fun - Perfect for building viewer engagement and friendly competition

Perfect for streamers looking to boost chat engagement and create inclusive, entertaining content for audiences of all ages.

summary.핵심플레이: 시청자가 채팅에 '!join'을 입력해 굴러다니는 동물 캐릭터로 참여하며, 7x7 격자 레벨에서 장애물과 경로를 지나 출구를 찾거나 아이템을 모으고 환경 위험을 피하며 최대 20명이 함께 경쟁한다. 캐릭터를 레벨업하고 커스터마이징을 해제할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 트위치 채팅과 실시간으로 연동되어 명령어로 조작하며, 초원부터 미로형 레벨까지 다양한 환경을 제공한다. 방송자가 게임 플레이에 영향을 줄 수 있고, 여러 동물 캐릭터를 해제해 개성을 부여할 수 있다.

name: Echoes of the Forgotten
input:
Recognized for his unparalleled skills in investigating the paranormal, Alex answered Karlheinz Asylum's distress call, sensing it would be a challenging case. The lone path out was imprisoned beneath the terrifying depths of the darkness, buried there. Alex searched the deserted tunnels for all keys to escape. The urge to unravel the asylum's mysteries grew with each step deeper into its enigmatic shadows. The detective followed his gut and moved through physical tension to reveal the secrets that lay beneath.

With the startling realization that the only way to find the elusive keys to liberty was to delve deeper into the darkness, Alex's struggle to escape the asylum's control became more and more passionate as the dreadful reality set in.

- Explore the haunting corridors and derelict chambers of the forsaken asylum, each room holding secrets and horrors that will send shivers down your spine.

- Beware of the otherworldly entities that lurk in the shadows, ready to plunge you into madness. Can you outwit and evade these malevolent forces?

- Dive into a visually stunning environment, heightened by a bone-chilling soundtrack that intensifies the sense of dread and suspense with every step.

- Your sanity is your lifeline. As you search for the keys to escape, remember that the darkness can consume you, leading to a grisly demise.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Alex가 되어 정신병원의 복도와 방을 탐색하고, 탈출에 필요한 열쇠들을 찾아 이동한다. 어둠 속에 도사린 존재들을 피하고 따돌리며 진실을 파헤친다.
summary.특징: 버려진 Karlheinz 정신병원을 배경으로 하며, 플레이어의 정신력이 생존 자원으로 작용해 어둠에 잠식되면 사망에 이른다. 어두운 환경과 사운드트랙으로 긴장감을 연출한다.

name: Dungeon Reels Tactics
input:
Dungeon Reels Tactics is a party-based, roguelike, with slot machines and puppet shows! Collect new party members with their own pre-built slot machine reels and embark on an adventure to ATTEMPT to defeat The "Great Evil".... Traverse a map filled with enemy encounters, fate cards to resolve, treacherous bosses, and more!
Recruit new party members by collecting recruit tickets throughout your adventure
Each run of Dungeon Reels Tactics will include a pool of 12 different characters you can recruit throughout the adventure. To gain new recruits you will need to collect soul shards from fallen foes, resolve fate cards, or purchase recruit tickets in the shop. If a party member falls in battle they will die and you will need to recruit a party member for the adventure.

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 각자 고유한 슬롯머신 릴을 가진 파티원을 모아 적 조우, 운명 카드, 보스가 배치된 맵을 탐험하며 전투를 진행한다. 쓰러진 적의 소울 샤드나 운명 카드, 상점의 영입 티켓으로 새 파티원을 모집한다.
summary.특징: 슬롯머신과 인형극 연출을 결합한 파티 기반 로그라이크로, 한 회차마다 12명의 캐릭터 풀에서 영입이 이루어지며 전투에서 쓰러진 파티원은 사망해 새로 영입해야 한다.

name: Futa Tales
input:
These ladies are packing HEAT!

Futa City is a futa-filled anthology series featuring 5 unique standalone stories, each with their own taste of the taboo. Every story is depicted as a dynamic visual novel, right up until the clothes start flying off. Then we get a whole lot more immersive.

Would you like to know more?

Genre-bender

From superheroes to reality-tv housewives, our futas are coming from all walks of the wild life. Prepare to wear many hats, and then take them off!

Fun Lovin'

A little known fact is that futas find humor in the little things. And so do we! Which is why we’ve written each story to leave you with a laugh.

Fully Voice Acted Action

We let our VAs know what they were getting into ahead of time so thankfully nobody passed out when they received their scripts. The result of their hard work should get you even harder!

Gameplay features:

-
Engage in full lustful intercourse with either one or two partners.

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 동적 비주얼 노벨 형식으로 진행되는 다섯 편의 독립된 이야기를 감상하고, 성적 장면에서 한 명 또는 두 명의 파트너와 상호작용한다.
summary.특징: 슈퍼히어로부터 리얼리티 TV 주부까지 다양한 futa 캐릭터가 등장하는 옴니버스 구성이며, 전편 음성 연기가 적용되어 있고 유머 요소를 담은 스토리로 구성되어 있다.

name: Lost in Spice
input:
Lost in Spice is a cooking game for Oculus Rift in which you play as an abducted human forced to cook Earth food for aliens at the Intergalactic House of Planets. Now you have to dice up weird ingredients, cook them, and submit them in the time limit to get a good score. And if you don't, you'll be vaporized!



The game includes a tutorial to teach new players, and a timed high-score mode. There are 4 different soups to make: Tomato, carrot, chicken noodle, and french onion.

summary.핵심플레이: 제한 시간 안에 재료를 손질하고 조리해 요리를 제출하며 점수를 얻는다. 시간 내에 완료하지 못하면 실패한다.
summary.특징: Oculus Rift용 VR 게임으로, 외계인에게 지구 음식을 요리하도록 강요받은 인간을 연기한다. 튜토리얼과 타임 기반 하이스코어 모드가 있으며 토마토, 당근, 치킨 누들, 프렌치 어니언 등 4종의 수프를 만들 수 있다.

name: 仿品一號 | Imitation: No.1
input:
-
A mysterious organization yearns for world-controlling power—be it wealth, authority, or influence.
But in a world ruled by alchemy, this is no easy feat.
As long as they fail to grasp the essence of alchemy, the quality and quantity of gold they produce is incomparable to others. Their social status and connections are equally hindered.

At this time, the organization’s attention shifts to a particular alchemist.
Despite being of noble birth, his reputation is surprisingly modest.
At first, he seemed like a mediocre follower of alchemical trends—until rumors surfaced of his residence being filled with luxurious gold-crafted furniture and tools.
These contradictions stirred the organization’s curiosity.

They began to suspect that what this alchemist sought might be something that transcends gold itself.
If that hypothesis proves true, then whatever he is pursuing could surpass gold in influence and value.
Thus, the player is secretly assigned a mission: to infiltrate the alchemist’s memories and uncover the true nature of what he sought...

-
17:00 Workshop

is a team of three passionate and challenge-driven creators, dedicated to crafting deeply immersive game experiences.

Founded in January 2023, the team swiftly began conceptualizing the framework and core mechanics of Imitation: No.1.

Development has been carried out during after-school and after-work hours, driven by a shared vision to create a uniquely styled mechanical puzzle game using Unreal Engine.

summary.핵심플레이: 연금술사의 기억 속으로 잠입해 그가 추구하던 것의 실체를 밝히는 임무를 수행한다. 기계적 퍼즐을 풀며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 연금술이 지배하는 세계를 배경으로, 한 조직이 금을 넘어서는 무언가를 좇는 연금술사의 기억을 파헤친다는 설정을 다룬다. Unreal Engine으로 제작된 기계식 퍼즐 게임이다.

name: MineGeon: Renegades
input:
MineGeon: Renegades is an action roguelite focused on resource gathering, set on the mysterious planet PAIMO. As part of a group of cosmic renegades, your mission is to explore dangerous, deep dungeons—either solo or with friends—to extract valuable minerals while facing hordes of enemies and uncovering hidden secrets. Each run offers a unique experience with diferent dungeons and ever-changing challenges. Upgrade your skills, discover legendary weapons, and face formidable bosses alongside your companions.

DESCEND WITH FRIENDS

summary.핵심플레이: 행성 PAIMO의 던전을 솔로 또는 협동으로 탐험하며 광물을 채취하고, 적들과 싸우면서 스킬을 강화하고 무기를 획득한다.
summary.특징: 매 플레이마다 던전과 도전이 달라지며, 자원 채집에 초점을 둔다. 최대 여러 명의 협동 플레이와 보스전을 지원한다.

name: ModBots
input:
In the far future, humanity has been victorious in the great war against machines. Now keeping the remaining robots in storage, some have figured that the coming destruction of them may as well be entertaining to the masses. In underground fighting arenas, players play as these robots, fighting against smaller robots and advanced gladiators to the enjoyment of the onlookers.
Battle!
Fight through hoards of enemy gladiator bots in the arena either solo or with friends!
Upgrade!
After each round, you will have the opportunity to collect loot to upgrade your bot for the next round to come.
Survive!
Survive wave after wave collecting new weapons and upgrading your bot’s abilities to vie for supremacy in the arena!

summary.핵심플레이: 경기장에서 적 로봇과 검투사 봇을 상대로 전투하며, 각 라운드가 끝나면 전리품을 모아 봇을 업그레이드한다. 새로운 무기를 수집하고 능력을 강화하며 밀려오는 웨이브를 버틴다.
summary.특징: 기계와의 전쟁에서 승리한 먼 미래를 배경으로, 남은 로봇들이 지하 투기장에서 싸우는 설정이다. 솔로 또는 친구와 함께 플레이할 수 있다.

name: GEORGIE-YOLKIE™ Enhanced
input:
Just Updated

Specially enhanced edition with 4K graphics support, raycasting, quality of life features and bundled with Georgie-Yolkie 64!

About the Game

One kitten. One bird. Zero clue what they’re doing.

Join Georgie, a fluffball with more enthusiasm than sense, and Yolkie, a chirpy sidekick who thinks she’s the brains of the operation (she’s not), as they stumble, flap, and paw their way through a kingdom overrun by Rattie's minions with delusions of grandeur.

It’s a puzzle-platforming adventure full of questionable decisions, dramatic meows, and the kind of teamwork that makes you wonder how these two haven’t been beaten yet.

GEORGIE-YOLKIE — because saving the world is better with feathers and fur.

With a giant open world and no less than ten other worlds full of bright colorful and weird characters, jump, swim, bounce and defy gravity as the worlds of Felina unravel around you, with a fun musical score and excellent replay value.

-
Jump, run, spin, go upside down, glide, swim and more as you progress through the massive and detailed worlds and combat challenging quirky bosses and meet with silly characters in a humorous story, a love letter to classic platformers of the ninetees!

-
Ten worlds with different challenges and collect those shiny objects to progress through the worlds of Felina.

-
A purrfect catchy soundtrack and natural effects that bring the game to life and make it an unforgettable adventure

-
And a load more- play challenging mini-games and mix-it-up after beating the game!

-
Now enhanced with raycasting, HD Textures, special effects and quality of life improvements!

-
Includes Georgie-Yolkie 64 - The Furry Tale!

summary.핵심플레이: 점프, 달리기, 회전, 활공, 수영 등의 이동 동작으로 여러 월드를 진행하며, 빛나는 수집품을 모아 다음 월드로 나아가고 보스와 전투한다. 게임 클리어 후에는 미니게임을 즐길 수 있다.
summary.특징: 고양이 Georgie와 새 Yolkie가 Rattie의 부하들에게 점령당한 왕국을 헤쳐나가는 유머러스한 스토리로, Felina 세계를 배경으로 열 개의 월드와 다양한 캐릭터가 등장한다. Enhanced 에디션은 4K 그래픽, 레이캐스팅, HD 텍스처를 지원하며 Georgie-Yolkie 64가 함께 포함된다.

name: Ainmora: The Impending Disaster
input:
"Pay attention: in the beauty of triviality, life's treasures are hidden. Wise is the one who sees it without difficulty. Follow my story and confirm this truth."

Ainmora: The Impending Disaster is no longer your average RPG. It carries a profound message that attentive eyes won't miss anyway.

Aziron is an ordinary lumberjack, living an ordinary life just like you and me, until the day he receives a letter. Within everyday life, something capable of transforming everything can arise - without prior notice. A letter started Aziron's new life. This game can start something in your life today.

Ainmora is a world of a parallel dimension where humanity has divided into 5 large districts and several small villages. Each district has a culture and system of government. Despite the rich historical context, the focus of this story is to solve Kiarah's biggest obstacle that, not coincidentally, appears precisely in Aziron's trivial routine.

A letter, a prophet, a prediction, an illness, a political betrayal, an ambition. All points harmonize in the story of Ainmora: The Coming Disaster. It will be up to each player to feed the course of this simple adventure.

In Ainmora: The Impending Disaster you will find:

• 21 playable characters: interact, do business, gather people or use any other strategy to get new team members. Each character has a unique ability that can be used strategically on the battlefield.

• Strategic battles: the player will need to analyze the elements of each character and enemy in addition to the specific skills of each hero to find the best way to overcome the enemies that come along the way.

• Skill tree: access the Central dos Caminhos to improve your warriors according to the strategic line you want to follow (attack, defense, strength or life).

• Smart Enemies: Enemies in Ainmora are a bit unusual. They can also use items and abilities like the playable characters. It is valid to say that not all enemy actions will be brilliant... but who is infallible, right?

• Shops and clerks: some people love games with shops. In Ainmora, you'll be able to buy weapons, armor, and obligatory items to defeat certain enemies.

• Respect system: through interactions with the inhabitants of Ainmora, you can earn respect. Useful advantages will be released as your respect grows among the people.

• Game Modes: Want to play in easy, normal or impossible mode? It will say a lot about you. Choose your difficulty carefully, as the consequences can be too heavy.

• Optional quests: in addition to the main storyline, you can complete side quests during the game that, if completed, will add strength to the team during the adventure.

• Rental System: In this RPG, you can be a real master of the real estate market. In addition to wielding weapons well, you will need to be a good manager and financial investor.

• Many hidden areas: you are not required to explore Ainmora fully, but more experienced players will find it necessary to return to old places already visited to find new passages that will become available after learning of new bodily abilities such as: digging, swimming, far jumping, climbing and mental shielding.

• 5 possible endings: the ending of your journey in Ainmora will depend on your personality and your opinions. There are political and social problems in Ainmora that cannot be ignored. Your interactions and your dedication will enact the future of Ainmora.

Live this fun and passionate experience while absorbing the profound teachings that this game can promote in your life.

summary.핵심플레이: 평범한 나무꾼 Aziron이 편지를 받으며 시작되는 이야기를 따라가며, 캐릭터와 적의 속성 및 스킬을 분석해 전략적 전투를 진행한다. 21명의 플레이 가능한 캐릭터를 모으고, 스킬 트리로 성장시키며 상점 이용, 사이드 퀘스트 수행, 숨겨진 지역 탐색을 반복한다.
summary.특징: 인류가 5개 지구와 여러 마을로 나뉜 평행 세계 Ainmora를 배경으로 하며, 주민과의 상호작용으로 얻는 평판 시스템과 부동산 임대 관리 시스템, 아이템과 능력을 사용하는 적, 파고들기·수영·등반 등 능력 습득에 따른 재탐색 요소를 포함한다. 난이도 3종과 플레이어의 선택에 따라 갈리는 5가지 엔딩을 제공한다.

name: Tattered Sails
input:
The Golden Age of Piracy, a time when legends are made or torn down. No trip over the seas is safe and every voyage could be your last. Or... You could find riches, power, and become legend!

Welcome to the dangerous waters of Tattered Sails, an open world piracy survival MMO set during the early 18th century. Here you have a choice; will your story see you rise as a hero of the guard or a dread captain of ruthless pirates?

Explore a world full of resources, sailing from one island to the next, gathering all that you need to build your own haven. Whether a simple home or an outpost, you can let creativity lead you.

Weigh anchor, loose the sails, and set out from your berth with a cargo hold full of goods you've crafted to make your fortune or... Load your ship with cannonballs and gunpowder, ready to hoist the colors and take down those merchant ships! The choices you make and the transactions you conduct matter with an economy that is driven entirely by player actions. Will the world see glorious riches or will it all crumble only to become a ghost story?

Join your friends, create a pirate crew or a company of guards, and let history remember you all as legends. Leave nothing but the Tattered Sails of enemies in your wake!
Features

Crafting: Tattered Sails allows players to achieve prominence not through combat, but by mastering crafting, enabling them to ascend to the top by creating essential and valuable items.

Open-World Exploration: Travel from island to island scavenging for the right materials or trading with the locals to secure the resources you need.

Reputation: Your choices affect how the surroundings in the world perceives you. If you are a ruthless murderer you won’t be allowed into certain towns. If you are a protector of the people, you will be rewarded with access to certain goods.

Sailing: Sailing is the main mode of transportation. You’ll be able to sail a ship on your own but later down the road, you’ll need more than just yourself unless you are a skilled sailor.

Conquest: Capture islands for certain buffs for you and your crew. Will expand further on a later road map post.

Become a legend: Leave your mark on the world by being either a ruthless pirate or a guard.

Regular Updates: Continuous updates to further add more content based on player feedback while also fixing bugs.

I am a solo developer and I do hire out with a small budget to help with elements of the game. My main focus is hiring for coding and some UI elements.

summary.핵심플레이: 18세기 초를 배경으로 섬을 오가며 자원을 수집하고 제작하며 항해하고, 상품을 거래하거나 다른 선박을 공격해 부를 쌓는다. 혼자 배를 몰거나 선원·경비대를 꾸려 협력할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 플레이어의 행동으로 굴러가는 경제 시스템과 평판 시스템이 있어 해적이나 경비대로서의 선택이 진입 가능한 마을과 얻을 수 있는 물품에 영향을 준다. 섬 점령으로 버프를 얻는 정복 요소가 있으며 1인 개발자가 지속적으로 업데이트한다.

name: GuiGui
input:
■ About the Game

GuiGui is a clicker game where you click on a cute character named GuiGui!
Get a random character item from the GuiGui universe every 3 hours and grow your collection, featuring exclusive art pieces by GuiGui himself!

■ Features:
- GuiGui, of course
- Items to grow your collection
- Achievements
- A community that's as cute as GuiGui
- Exclusive designs by GuiGui: All items received every 3 hours are original creations by the artist GuiGui

■ About the artist GuiGui (귀귀)

GuiGui(귀귀) is a celebrated Korean webtoon artist and oil painter, known for his unique artistic style and engaging storytelling. Fans who recognize his talent often describe GuiGui as either a genius or a madman. GuiGui gained popularity through major Korean webtoon platforms such as Naver Webtoon, where he serialized famous works like 'Passionate Man' and 'Hot-Blooded Elementary School.' His artistic endeavors have expanded to include canvas oil paintings.

Since his first exhibition in 2022, GuiGui has held several creative exhibitions combining webtoon elements with symbolic oil paintings. His oil paintings and illustrated prints are particularly known for being traded at high prices.

Through this game, we aim to introduce GuiGui's artistic world to a global audience, allowing players to enjoy and appreciate his original creations.

For more information about GuiGui, visit his Wikipedia page.

summary.핵심플레이: GuiGui라는 캐릭터를 클릭하고, 3시간마다 무작위 캐릭터 아이템을 받아 컬렉션을 늘린다.
summary.특징: 한국 웹툰 작가 귀귀(GuiGui)의 오리지널 아트가 아이템으로 등장하며, 도전 과제와 커뮤니티 요소를 포함한다.

name: Geneforge 5: Overthrow
input:
Geneforge 5: Overthrow is an Indie fantasy role-playing adventure, the final chapter of the epic Geneforge Saga. Return to the world of the Shapers one final time. Explore a vast, war-torn world, create and mold your own army of strange, powerful monsters, and choose a side to help lead to final victory.

Geneforge 5: Overthrow features nine character classes and an enormous world with over 80 areas to explore. Choose among five different factions, each with its own beliefs, cities, and quests. Help the rebels or fight them. Slay your enemies or use stealth and diplomacy to outwit them. Your choices will shape the world, and there are dozens of different endings. Choose for yourself how the saga will finally end.

summary.핵심플레이: 광활한 세계를 탐험하며 강력한 몬스터로 구성된 자신만의 군대를 창조하고 조종한다. 다섯 개의 파벌 중 하나를 선택해 전투, 은신, 외교 등의 방식으로 퀘스트를 진행한다.
summary.특징: Shaper 세계를 배경으로 한 Geneforge 사가의 마지막 편으로, 아홉 개의 캐릭터 클래스와 80개 이상의 지역을 갖춘 세계를 제공한다. 각기 다른 신념과 도시, 퀘스트를 가진 다섯 파벌과 플레이어의 선택에 따라 수십 가지 결말로 이어진다.

name: Miegakure
input:
Miegakure is a puzzle/adventure game, the first that lets you explore and interact with a 4D world. In this game, the fourth dimension is not time! It is an actual fourth dimension of space, that works just like the first three dimensions we are familiar with. If you count time, this game is 5D.

For a while games used to be 2D, taking place solely along two directions. For example, a game character could only move forwards and backwards, or jump up and down. Then came computers powerful enough to render 3D graphics, which allowed for full 3D movement: up / down, backwards / forwards and left / right. (Of course, the graphics we see, while they are computed in 3D, are displayed on a 2D screen. They are projected down from 3D to 2D, in a way that mimics how our eyes perceive the third dimension.)

But it doesn’t stop there. If in a 2D game every object’s position is represented in the computer using two numbers, and if in a 3D game every object’s position is represented using three numbers, what if each position was represented using four numbers? In other words, what if there was another direction you could move along in addition to the first three? Trying to answer this question is what that led us to develop this game.

As far as we know, our universe has exactly three spatial dimensions — so it’s difficult for us to picture what a four-dimensional world would look like. But a computer, on the other hand, does not care; it’s just working with numbers as usual (it’s just slightly more numbers in this case!). So we had to come up with a way to display this calculated 4D world so that our three-dimensional brains could comprehend it.

The way we chose is a method that has been popularized in the novella Flatland. This novella talks about a 2D square that can only see a 2D cross section of a 3D world. For the square, the third dimension is invisible and mysterious; the square has no concept of it because it is stuck seeing a 2D world. If a 3D object visits the 2D plane it appears to be deforming, in a way that looks like an M.R.I. scan (of a brain, for example). In an M.R.I. what we see while moving the slice through the object appears to be deforming, but we know that we are just taking a different cross-section of the same 3D object.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 시간이 아닌 실제 공간의 네 번째 차원을 가진 4D 세계를 탐험하고 상호작용하며 퍼즐을 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 각 오브젝트의 위치를 네 개의 숫자로 표현하는 4차원 공간을 구현했으며, 소설 Flatland에서 소개된 방식처럼 3차원 단면을 통해 4D 세계를 표시하여 3차원적 인지로 이해할 수 있게 한다.

name: BallBastic!
input:
Ballbastic! is a game created to scratch the itch of hardcore gamers with an interest in games that are easy to learn but difficult to master.

-
Test your rolling skills against 150 levels across Novice, Journeyman, Expert, and Marathon Mode.

-
See how fast you can beat a difficulty level when you select Play for Time!

-
See how far you can get on a single life in Survival Mode!

-
Shake up your experience with Randomizer Mode after beating every level once.

-
Learn how to utilize your environment with trampolines, rockets, teleporters, speeders, slowers, and more.

-
Travel through harder-to-reach warps to skip levels!

-
Six different worlds, all with their own theme, from the simple mountains to the mind-boggling dreamscape.

-
Instantaneous gameplay. No instant replays when you die or score calculations when you pass a level--just keep on going!

-
Featuring Brian Matt as the announcer; returning to form from narrating Super Monkey Ball games in the early 2000s.

-
Different types of cosmetic skins to unlock that prove what you are capable of doing!

-
Controller support!

summary.핵심플레이: 공을 굴려 150개의 레벨을 통과하며, 트램펄린·로켓·텔레포터·가속기·감속기 등 환경 요소를 활용해 목적지에 도달한다. Play for Time으로 클리어 시간을 겨루거나 Survival Mode에서 한 목숨으로 얼마나 진행하는지 도전할 수 있다.
summary.특징: Novice, Journeyman, Expert, Marathon 난이도와 모든 레벨을 한 번씩 깬 뒤 열리는 Randomizer Mode를 제공한다. 산악부터 드림스케이프까지 서로 다른 테마의 6개 월드로 구성되며, 잠금 해제형 코스메틱 스킨과 컨트롤러를 지원하고 Super Monkey Ball 시리즈를 맡았던 Brian Matt가 아나운서로 참여했다.

name: Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces
input:
You may also like

About the Game
Be a pioneer of aerial warfare in Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces. Fight above the battlefields of World War I and become the ultimate Sky Ace!
The game will take you into the times when aviation was in its dawning of existence – the first Wright brothers machines went into the sky just 11 years before the Great War! Engineers were quickly adapting this brand new invention into military purposes while creating fascinating and sometimes oddly looking planes.
In Warplanes: WW1 Sky Aces you take control of over 30 historical airplanes – including the Fokker Dr.I, famous for its pilot Manfred von Richthofen a.k.a. “Red Baron”. Others stemming from light fighters like the Airco DH.2 to an enormous 4-engine bomber like the Sikorsky Ilya Muromets – all planes can be customized and upgraded.
Choose between two modes suited for different playstyles and skillsets. In Pilot Mode you can simply focus on air combat, collecting and upgrading planes. Squadron Leader Mode adds an extra layer to the gameplay – apart from combat, you also need to manage resources, hire and train pilots and expand your base.
Two campaigns for Triple Entente and one for Central Powers will let you experience all major fronts of World War I – you’ll fly above most countries that participated in the conflict in various types of mission. Pilot fighters and bombers. Protect or destroy ground targets. Face mighty zeppelins and anti aircraft artillery to change the tides of war.

BECOME A SKY ACE

- Experience WWI aerial warfare with intuitive controls and user-friendly flight mechanics.

- Choose between fun-to-play Pilot Mode or a more advanced Squadron Leader Mode.

- Collect over 30 historical planes from World War I.

- 3 campaigns set in all parts of the world.

- Various types of missions and tasks.

summary.핵심플레이: 제1차 세계대전을 배경으로 전투기와 폭격기를 조종해 공중전을 벌이고 지상 목표를 보호하거나 파괴하는 임무를 수행한다. 기체를 수집하고 커스터마이즈 및 업그레이드할 수 있다.
summary.특징: Fokker Dr.I, Sikorsky Ilya Muromets 등 30종 이상의 실존 항공기를 다루며, 전투에 집중하는 Pilot Mode와 자원 관리·조종사 고용 및 훈련·기지 확장을 포함하는 Squadron Leader Mode를 제공한다. 삼국협상과 동맹국을 다루는 3개의 캠페인이 있다.

name: Stage of Light
input:
Stage of Light is a lighting sandbox where you can build stages with procedural modelling tools and control both lights and stage structures with integrated DMX controllers.
Every device in the game can be triggered with DMX signal.
You can program them from DMX controllers and create nice light shows.

Supports MIDI control. Anything from a simple MIDI keyboard to Launchpad grid controller and APC style controllers would work.
It has plenty of options to support any MIDI device. It supports both MIDI keys and gradual input sources like faders and knobs on a MIDI device.
Lights on your Launchpad or similar type of grid controllers can synchronized with playback information in DMX consoles in the game.

Realityocean Games

Builder features

- 19 lighting fixtures with different effects and capabilities.

- Fire machine with DMX control.

- 7-axis industrial robot with 3 different size(can be controlled with DMX too).

- Ability to build stage trusses with almost any shape or size.

- A special stage builder system that helps you to erect a stage with a few clicks,
if necessary resizes trusses when you move them around.

- Scaffolding truss builder system that allows you to the create scaffolding structures very easily.

- Video panel builder system which allows you to install huge video panels on scaffolding structures.

- Cube builder system to create stage floors or other interesting shapes.

- Position and Rotation snapping options for ease of use.

Lighting controllers

Dmx 960 Console
- Up to 40 fixtures
- 2 control wheels
- Effect Generator
- Chase Modulator

M5000 Dmx Console
- Controls virtually unlimited fixtures
- 3 touchscreens with scrolling capability
- 3 control wheels with integrated display
- Fixture groups
- Effect Generator
- Chase Modulator

All Dmx consoles can be controlled by clicking their buttons or moving faders & wheels.
Playbacks can be triggered by moving faders with mouse or key presses from your keyboard.

Visual Content
In the game there is a 2D graphics engine which generates visuals to display them on video panels. Mapping 2D visuals to video panels can be done with a few clicks.

In this sandbox you can record everything you have done in the game to a save file and load the save file later and continue playing.

summary.핵심플레이: 프로시저럴 모델링 도구로 무대 트러스, 비계, 비디오 패널, 큐브 구조물 등을 조립하고, DMX 콘솔로 조명 기구와 무대 장치를 프로그래밍해 라이트 쇼를 만든다. 작업 내용을 저장 파일로 기록하고 불러와 이어서 진행할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 게임 내 모든 장치가 DMX 신호로 제어되며, DMX 960·M5000 콘솔과 함께 MIDI 키보드, Launchpad, APC 계열 컨트롤러 등 외부 MIDI 기기를 지원한다. 19종 조명 기구, 화염 장치, 3가지 크기의 7축 산업용 로봇을 제공하며, 2D 그래픽 엔진으로 생성한 영상을 비디오 패널에 매핑할 수 있다.

name: Kotiro
input:
Kotiro is an adult game in the Souls-like genre.
Story

The earth has been obliterated by evil. To save the human race, a brave fighter has established a system to boost the power of humans through a power selection system.

Each boy born can take a chance to contribute his genetic heritage. To this end, he must defeat the Guardians stopping him on his way of reproduction. These girls are trained from a young age to become formidable opponents. They are in control of the territory assigned to them.

So, to be worthy of an offspring, you will have to defeat the Guardians. Don't be fooled by appearances; these girls won't hesitate to kill you if you don't prove yourself worthy of their power.

Be brave and glorious or be miserable and wiped out - it's up to you.
Features

- A Dark and Post-Apocalyptic Universe

- Progression through character improvement

- Simple gameplay

- Interesting Guardians

- A world with a lore to discover

- Thrilling boss fights

- Quests to guide you

- Intimate scenes with the Guardians

Informations

Kotiro is divided into several territories. Each territory is different, with specific monsters, different locations, a Guardian as well as quests and gameplay elements etc...

This version includes only one part to present the game with only one territory and one Guardian. The game is under development. The final release should take some time and will require a fee.

summary.핵심플레이: 각 구역을 지키는 가디언을 물리치며 진행하고, 캐릭터를 강화해 성장한다. 보스전과 퀘스트를 수행하며 지역을 공략한다.
summary.특징: 악에 의해 파괴된 포스트 아포칼립스 세계관을 배경으로 하며, 구역별로 다른 몬스터와 가디언, 로어가 존재한다. 가디언과의 성인용 장면이 포함되며, 현재 하나의 구역과 가디언만 제공되는 개발 중 버전이다.

name: Moonhaven
input:
Moonhaven combines farming, survival, tower defense, and role-playing genres.

You awake on the beach of a seemingly deserted and definitely haunted island. Hungry and alone, armed with only your wits, you set out to survive and build a life for yourself. Can you make it through the night and fend off the monsters bent on destroying what you worked hard to build? It will not be easy. The once vibrant, nearby town of Moonhaven lies in ruins and now is home only to monsters and the ghosts of the past! With some dedication, you may just be the one to vanquish the monsters and restore the island to its former glory!

Turn the wilderness on the island into a bustling farm! Grow crops, raise animals and craft new items! Build your dream farm anywhere you want in the island's wilderness.

Defend your farm! During full moons, fend off hordes of monsters bent on destroying what you worked so hard to build!

Survive the cold nights! Grow, gather, hunt and fish for the food you need to survive!

Up to 5 Players! Invite 1-4 players to join you on the island online! Players can work together to build their farms, share resources and rebuild the nearby town of Moonhaven!

Level up your skills! Everything you do gains you experience and levels. Each level you get a new skill point you can spend on unlocking new cooking and crafting recipes, and improving your farming, crafting, hunting, fishing and fighting abilities.

Explore a mysterious island! You'll encounter a variety of animals and monsters. Find powerful weapons, raw materials for crafting and mysteries to be uncovered.

Cook delicious foods and craft everything you need! Cook dozens of different recipes to help sustain you and provide you with beneficial effects. Craft tools, weapons, building materials and other useful items to help you build your farm and survive on the island!

Build your base! Build your own farm house, barn and more! Build fences and traps to keep out predators during the night and protect your crops.

summary.장르: 농사 시뮬레이션, 서바이벌, 타워 디펜스, RPG
summary.핵심플레이: 무인도에서 작물 재배, 동물 사육, 채집, 사냥, 낚시로 생존하며 농장과 기지를 건설한다. 보름달이 뜨는 밤에는 밀려오는 몬스터로부터 농장을 방어한다.
summary.특징: 버려진 유령 섬과 폐허가 된 마을 Moonhaven을 배경으로 하며, 최대 5인 온라인 협동으로 농장을 짓고 자원을 공유하며 마을을 재건할 수 있다. 활동을 통해 경험치를 얻어 레벨업하고 스킬 포인트로 요리·제작 레시피와 능력을 강화한다.

name: Dodge Diego
input:
Dodge Diego is a side-scrolling adventure jump and run where you play Diego, a young man on a mission. You will follow Diego on his journey through a jungle full of enemies and other dangers. Skeletons and scary monsters will try to stop you, but you will prove that you truly are the toughest of the jungle, or will you?

The soundtrack composed by Eric Skiff will motivate you to improve your highscore over and over again.

How far can you go?

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Diego를 조작해 정글을 옆으로 이동하며 해골과 몬스터 등 적과 위험을 피하고 최고 점수를 갱신한다.
summary.특징: 적과 위험이 가득한 정글을 배경으로 하며, Eric Skiff가 작곡한 사운드트랙이 포함되어 있다.

name: Honey Trap Amnesia
input:
In this game, you play as the protagonist and make your way through the story in visual novel format. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the adventure!

You have a girlfriend.

She's polished, caring, kind, and gets good grades.

You're just enjoying your life with her when one day, you get into an accident.

When you wake up in the hospital, you've forgotten all about your family, friends… and her.

You try to restore your memories, but other women approach you, taking advantage of your amnesia with half-truths.

Can you get your memories back and return to those blissful days with your girlfriend?

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공이 되어 비주얼 노벨 형식으로 이야기를 진행한다. 사고 후 기억을 잃은 주인공으로서 기억을 되찾으려 시도하며 스토리를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 주인공이 사고로 가족, 친구, 여자친구에 대한 기억을 잃은 뒤, 다른 여성들이 반쪽짜리 진실로 기억상실을 이용해 접근하는 상황을 다룬다. 기억을 회복해 여자친구와의 관계로 돌아갈 수 있는지가 이야기의 중심이다.

name: Escape Dream
input:
You need to go to work but you are stuck in a dream!?

No matter how much you get hurt or die, what if you are trapped in a endless dream and never wake up!?

Help the character in order to wake up!
Game Features

- It consists of 8 stages, and you should control the character to reach the destination.

- There are stages you need to clear with different difficulty.

- You will meet lot of traps and monsters.

- So you need to find some items to escape from them.

- If you explore the map, you will be able to discover many items.

- You will need to solve some quiz.

- So you need to think a lot.

- If you're stuck on a quiz, always take a good look at the map.

- There may be a skill that could help you with the quiz or the next stage.

- Or There may be a different way to go to the next stage..

- Some 'Save Point' will make you play easy.

- Acquire various skills to avoid obstacles.

-

summary.핵심플레이: 캐릭터를 조작해 각 스테이지의 목적지에 도달하며, 함정과 몬스터를 피하고 맵을 탐색해 필요한 아이템을 찾는다. 진행 중 퀴즈를 풀어야 한다.
summary.특징: 꿈에서 깨어나려는 캐릭터를 돕는 설정으로, 서로 다른 난이도의 8개 스테이지로 구성된다. 세이브 포인트가 있으며, 장애물 회피나 퀴즈 해결에 도움이 되는 스킬을 습득할 수 있다.

name: Barbarian Legend
input:
Barbarian Legend is a war strategy simulation game.



In the war strategy round, you need to manage the economy of your territory and develop your military strength.



In battle, you need to decide carefully when to send your troops out, otherwise you are likely to be attacked from behind and take advantage of the enemy.

You also need to time the use of your general's skills so that you can destroy the enemy quickly.



After capturing a local territory, you will not only gain more economic benefits, but you will also be able to capture enemy generals for your own use.

Of course, some of the most powerful generals will not be so easily loyal to you and you will need to torture their will in order to make them loyal to you.



Generals also need to be upgraded to become more powerful, and the game's adventure feature can help you do this, with every adventure choice being crucial.

Soldier levels are very important if you want to win against the weak, and the game's training function allows you to make your soldiers stronger than your opponent.



Don't think you'll win if you're bogged down, your enemies will keep attacking you and attacking is the best defence.



There are four ancient kingdoms waiting to be conquered! Come on Lords!

summary.핵심플레이: 전략 라운드에서 영지 경제를 관리하고 군사력을 키우며, 전투에서는 출병 시점과 장수 스킬 사용 타이밍을 판단해 적을 공격한다. 영지를 점령해 경제적 이득과 적 장수를 확보한다.
summary.특징: 점령한 적 장수를 아군으로 편입할 수 있으며, 강한 장수는 고문을 통해 충성시킨다. 모험 기능으로 장수를 성장시키고 훈련으로 병사 레벨을 올리며, 네 개의 고대 왕국을 정복하는 것을 목표로 한다.

name: Invasion Resistance 2
input:
In the year 2056, 21 years after the failed Zooxian invasion, the Zooxians came back with a stronger invasion force to conquer Earth. The Earth Protection Association was defeated. The sole survivor, Major Stevens, badly injured from his encounter with the Zooxians, contacts his old commanding officer, the Colonel, to take back the planet.



Invasion Resistance 2 is a PC first-person shooter game with 13 small linear maps to complete. The short single-player campaign is continuous with cut-scenes explaining the story as you play.



The sequel to Invasion Resistance is more action packed, has improved game-play and several maps.



There is a page clearly explaining the controls and there is the option to change game graphics qualities to match your computer's graphical capabilities.



Read the manual included on the Steam game page for game-play instructions.



Game Manual:



1- Install game from Steam.



2- Follow the instructions in the game to complete the game.



3- Shoot aliens using primary weapons and/or secondary weapon.



4- Switch between weapons using mouse scroll.



5- Green boxes are ammo crates. Go towards them to refill ammo.



6- The last level's ammo crate contains infinite ammo. Hint: Stay close to the ammo box.



Developer: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi

Graphics: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi

Cut-scenes: Ali Soltanian Fard Jahromi

summary.핵심플레이: 13개의 선형 맵을 진행하며 외계인을 주무기와 보조무기로 처치하고, 마우스 스크롤로 무기를 전환한다. 초록색 상자에 접근해 탄약을 보충한다.
summary.특징: 2056년 Zooxian 외계인의 재침공을 배경으로, 생존자 Stevens 소령이 지구 탈환에 나서는 짧은 싱글플레이 캠페인을 담고 있다. 컷신으로 스토리가 이어지며, 컴퓨터 성능에 맞춰 그래픽 품질을 조절할 수 있다.

name: Hide and Sheep
input:
Hide and Sheep is a 2-10 player online multiplayer social-deduction party game. Players need to blend in with the AI sheep, identify the other real players, and strike before they do!

Blending In with AI Sheep

Blend in by mimicking AI sheep—move, graze, look around, and act exactly like them.

summary.핵심플레이: 2~10명의 플레이어가 AI 양들 사이에 섞여 양처럼 이동하고 풀을 뜯으며 행동하고, 다른 실제 플레이어를 식별해 먼저 공격한다.
summary.특징: AI 양의 움직임과 행동을 모방해 위장하는 온라인 멀티플레이어 방식이며, 정체를 숨긴 채 상대 플레이어를 찾아내는 소셜 추리 요소를 갖췄다.

name: Demolition Master 3D
input:
Indulge in Explosions with Demolition Master 3D! With Demolition Master 3D you will fill like the real bomb expert capable of tackling even the most complicated tasks. Travel to various countries and continents, take part in ambitious construction projects and demolish, demolish, demolish!
Demolition Master 3D is a sequel of popular game Demolition Master that already has hundreds of thousands
fans worldwide.
Features:

- 110 game levels, 5 locations

- 4 types of explosives with different properties

- Realistic physics

- Excellent graphics and nice visual effects

summary.핵심플레이: 각 레벨에서 폭발물을 배치하고 폭파시켜 건축물을 철거하는 과제를 수행한다. 여러 국가와 대륙을 이동하며 다양한 철거 임무를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 110개의 레벨과 5개의 지역이 제공되며, 서로 다른 특성을 가진 4종류의 폭발물을 사용한다. 물리 시뮬레이션을 기반으로 폭발과 붕괴가 구현된다.

name: Lazy Galaxy: Rebel Story
input:
🔥JUST RELEASED🔥

About the Game
An old robot named H-34-RT wakes up in a derelict space station orbiting his home planet. His civilization was destroyed long ago by evil O'Xelg, but he has yet to figure that out. After an initial shock, he decides to follow his old defense routines: that means fighting the invaders, even if he is alone now.

Lazy Galaxy: Rebel Story is a challenging, squad-based shoot-em-up/bullet hell roguelite. Fly through tons of bullets, defeat various enemies and engage challenging bosses, all this to help a lonely robot complete his mission.

Features:

- Start out alone, but rescue allies as you progress

- Your allies do not level up by killing enemies. Rather they get stronger once they get to know you and each other better

- Change you fleet formation to avoid bullets and focus fire

- Use your ally special abilities to boost your firepower or heal yourself

- 2 Player Local Co-Op Support

- Fly through eight different levels, encountering various enemies and fighting your way to the O'Xelg communication base

Inspired by Steredenn and Jets'n'Guns Gold, the game tries to add its own distinguishable traits to the genre.

summary.핵심플레이: 함선을 조종해 다수의 탄막을 피하고 적과 보스를 물리치며 여덟 개의 레벨을 진행하고, 진행 중 아군을 구출해 함대를 구성한다. 함대 진형을 바꿔 탄막을 회피하거나 화력을 집중하고 아군의 특수 능력을 사용한다.
summary.특징: 오래된 로봇 H-34-RT가 파괴된 문명의 방어 임무를 이어간다는 설정이며, 아군은 적을 처치해 성장하는 대신 서로 친해질수록 강해진다. 2인 로컬 협동 플레이를 지원한다.

name: T1WRE3: NONAME
input:
Hi, I am NONAME! Can you solve my puzzle?

Lo, and behold! Welcome, brave adventurer, to the realm of PUZZLE GAME, a place where wit is your weapon, logic is your shield, and riddles are the trials thou must overcome!

About This Game

Hear this, seeker of wisdom: This is no ordinary game. It is a journey of the mind, a test of intellect, and a celebration of riddles! Prepare thyself to face challenges that will tease thy brain, confound thy senses, and reward thy perseverance. Thy quest is simple yet profound: uncover the six-digit keys hidden within each puzzle and unlock the door to the next mystery.

But beware! For the path is fraught with enigmas most cunning, and only the most steadfast shall reach the end. Shall thou be among them?

Key Features:

-
A Myriad of Riddles:

-
Venture through a collection of handcrafted puzzles, each designed to push thy logic and creativity to the limits.

-
Encounter a variety of challenge types, from deciphering cryptic codes to unraveling poetic clues.

-
Progression Through Discovery:

-
Each stage hides a unique six-digit key, a combination born from the solution to its riddle.

-
Enter the correct answer to advance, or linger in the labyrinth of thought until thy epiphany dawns.

-
A Guiding Light - Hints System:

-
Should the path grow dark and the puzzle seem insurmountable, thou mayest summon a hint to aid thy journey.

-
Fear not, for these hints are designed to nudge thee gently, preserving the joy of discovery!

-
An Immersive Experience:

-
Minimalist visuals and a hauntingly beautiful soundscape keep thee focused on the essence of the challenge: the puzzles.

-
Atmospheric design enhances the mood, drawing thee deeper into the enigma’s embrace.

-

-
Hidden Secrets Await:

-
For the most intrepid of minds, a secret reward lies hidden within the folds of this game. Solve all riddles, uncover every key, and claim the ultimate prize—a token of thy triumph!

-
Replayability for the Bold:

-
Return to puzzles thou hast conquered and challenge thyself anew.

-
Share thy discoveries with friends and compare thy journeys to see who stands tallest in the realm of riddles!

-
For All Who Seek the Truth:

-
This game is crafted for all, from the casual puzzler seeking a quick test of wits to the seasoned riddle-master ready for a gauntlet of challenges.

The Challenge Awaits:

Prepare thy mind, steady thy heart, and embark on this journey of intellect and discovery. Each riddle is a step closer to glory, and each solution brings thee nearer to uncovering the secrets that lie at the heart of the game.

Thy fate is thine to command—shalt thou solve them all and bask in the glow of victory?

NONAME awaits thee. Step forth, and let the game begin!

summary.핵심플레이: 각 스테이지에 숨겨진 수수께끼를 풀어 여섯 자리 숫자 키를 알아내고, 정답을 입력해 다음 단계의 문을 여는 방식으로 진행한다. 암호 해독과 시적 단서 풀이 등 다양한 유형의 문제를 해결한다.
summary.특징: 막힐 경우 사용할 수 있는 힌트 시스템과, 미니멀한 비주얼 및 분위기 위주의 사운드를 갖췄다. 모든 수수께끼를 풀면 얻는 숨겨진 보상과, 이미 푼 퍼즐을 다시 도전하는 리플레이 요소가 있다.

name: Blip (Open Alpha)
input:
Our goal with Blip is to build an Open-Source Roblox alternative.
It's primarily designed for mobile, but fully playable on Windows & macOS too! 😄

Blip is a platform where players and creators come together to build, play, and share unique gaming experiences. Whether you're battling friends, designing a custom avatar, or crafting your own game world, Blip offers endless creative freedom.

For Players:

-
Customize your avatar with unique outfits and accessories.

-
Explore a growing library of community-created games, from arcade puzzles to real-time multiplayer adventures.

-
Play with your friends and meet new ones!

For Creators:

-
Design 3D assets and avatar equipment

-
Build your own games with the embedded World Editor and Luau scripting

-
Share your creations with the community and earn virtual currency (with plans for real-world monetization in the future)

Join Now!

Blip is in its early stages, making now the perfect time to join as a pioneer! Shape the platform’s future, connect with a passionate community, and leave your mark as one of Blip’s first creators or players.

summary.장르: 액션, 어드벤처, 캐주얼, 시뮬레이션, 게임 제작 플랫폼
summary.핵심플레이: 아바타를 커스터마이징하고 커뮤니티가 제작한 다양한 게임을 탐색·플레이하며, 친구들과 함께 즐길 수 있다. 제작자는 내장된 월드 에디터와 Luau 스크립팅으로 3D 에셋과 게임을 만들고 커뮤니티에 공유한다.
summary.특징: 오픈소스 기반의 Roblox 대안을 지향하는 게임 제작·공유 플랫폼으로, 모바일 중심이면서 Windows와 macOS에서도 플레이할 수 있다. 창작물 공유로 가상 화폐를 획득할 수 있으며 향후 실제 수익화 도입을 계획하고 있다.

name: The Scientist Battles
input:
Science used to be your purpose, but now it is your prison.

Trapped in a distorted version of your lab, shaped by the quiet, unseen struggles of scientific research, you must find your way out. Battle with lab-inspired tools and science-themed companions in light 2D combat! As in science, the way forward isn’t always a choice.

-
A short narrative journey with an emotional, introspective tone

-
2D combat using lab equipment and science-inspired companions

-
Rooted in the lived experience of someone who's been through the ups and downs of research

Alright. Deep breaths. Let’s find the way out of here. I’ve got loads of experiments waiting for me back in the real world.

Researcher's log

I started this game while unemployed, after moving to a new country, and decided to finish it after settling into a new job in a lab. It’s inspired by the quieter, often unspoken stories behind scientific research. I hope the game resonates with you, even just a little bit, whether you're in the lab, playing for the story, or just finding your way forward.

- Shaun

summary.핵심플레이: 왜곡된 실험실을 배경으로 실험 기구를 활용한 무기와 과학을 테마로 한 동료와 함께 2D 전투를 벌이며 탈출구를 찾아 나간다.
summary.특징: 과학 연구의 잘 드러나지 않는 이면과 감정적·성찰적 정서를 담은 짧은 서사 중심 게임으로, 실제 연구 경험에서 영감을 받아 제작되었다.

name: CADE PRIME
input:
CADE PRIME is the DoD's most advanced android. Bad Dudes have placed him inside of the Mainframe. Can You help him solve challenging puzzles in order to escape ?



Featuring Puzzles, Parkour and Platforming Action.



Each Level gets more challenging.



Interact with the objects in each area to test Your logic skills.



*** Challenge ***



"Steamy Streamer" Challenge - Get ALL of the Archor Games products available on Steam and Stream ALL of them Beginning to End.

summary.핵심플레이: 메인프레임에 갇힌 안드로이드 CADE PRIME을 조작해 각 구역의 오브젝트와 상호작용하며 퍼즐을 풀고, 파쿠르와 플랫포밍으로 탈출을 시도한다.
summary.특징: 레벨이 진행될수록 난이도가 높아지며, 안드로이드가 메인프레임에 갇힌다는 설정과 로직 기반 퍼즐을 다룬다. Archor Games 제품 전체를 스트리밍하는 'Steamy Streamer' 챌린지가 포함되어 있다.

name: Porn Empire
input:
Porn Empire is an adult business management game with light RPG elements. Start as a small time porn producer and build your empire.

- Create your own character and choose to play as either a male or female protagonist!

- Level up and try to persuade increasingly prestigious models to join your team.

- Manage your porn studio. Starting with amateur shoots and advancing to automated multi-studio productions.

- Explore side ventures such as camshows, photo modeling, nightclubs, and more.

- Manage your models. Train, keep them happy, secure with contract.

- Oversee your company by hiring and managing staff, setting policies, establishing a network of websites, and striving to outperform your rivals.

- Build and upgrade you own mansion to reflect your success.

summary.핵심플레이: 소규모 성인물 제작자로 시작해 모델을 영입·훈련·관리하고 스튜디오 촬영을 진행하며 회사를 키운다. 레벨업을 통해 더 유명한 모델을 설득하고 자동화된 다중 스튜디오 제작으로 확장한다.
summary.특징: 남성 또는 여성 주인공을 선택해 캐릭터를 만들 수 있으며, 아마추어 촬영에서 시작해 캠쇼, 사진 모델링, 나이트클럽 등 부가 사업과 직원 고용, 정책 설정, 웹사이트 네트워크 구축, 저택 건설 및 업그레이드 등을 관리하는 성인 사업 경영을 다룬다.

name: GMU Blastmaster Battle
input:
GMU Blastmaster Battle by Studio 410 is a colorful reimagining of the classic Bomberman formula with a healthy dose of GMU spirit. Play as one of four GMU-themed characters and blast your way to victory using a multitude of powerups over three beautiful stages!

Here are some features to expect from Blastmaster Battle:

- Fight Your Friends: Up to four players can play via keyboard or controller in local PvP or virtually through a third party such as Parsec. Only XBOX or similar controllers are supported; button 1 is A, button 2 is B. Back is the Start button.

- Gamemodes: The major gameplay change that's being implemented in v1.1 is the addition of optional gamemodes. They can do many things, from changing small stuff like what drops when to big things like starting a match with no blocks or even changing bomb types every couple seconds! They can be disabled in settings for the classic Blastmaster experience.

- Tutorials: We've completely overhauled the tutorial screen, adding looping instructional videos introducing the bomb types, powerups, and general ways to play.

- Win Tracking: For everyone doing those sick all-night Blastmaster LAN parties, the game tracks who has won the most games with a nifty little crown floating above their character. Now you'll know exactly who to gang up on in the next match!

And more!

summary.핵심플레이: 네 명의 GMU 테마 캐릭터 중 하나를 조작해 폭탄을 설치하고 파워업을 활용하며 상대를 제거해 승리를 노린다. 세 개의 스테이지에서 진행되며 최대 4인이 로컬 PvP로 대전한다.
summary.특징: 클래식 봄버맨 방식을 기반으로 하며, 드롭 아이템이나 블록 배치, 폭탄 종류 변경 등을 조정하는 선택적 게임모드를 제공한다. 폭탄 종류·파워업을 설명하는 반복 재생 튜토리얼 영상과 최다 승리자에게 왕관을 표시하는 승리 추적 기능이 있다.

name: Prototype Blocks 2
input:
Prototype Blocks 2 - Continuation of the first part of the puzzle in which new difficulties and portals await you!



Use portals and blocks to solve exciting puzzles! You have to go all the way from start to finish, and whether you can do this is up to you.



Waiting for you:

- Many levels

- Physics

- Convenient management

- Portals

summary.핵심플레이: 포탈과 블록을 활용해 시작점에서 도착점까지 이동하며 퍼즐을 풉니다. 각 레벨을 클리어하는 것이 목표입니다.
summary.특징: 물리 시스템과 포탈 요소가 포함된 여러 레벨을 제공합니다. 전작에 이어 새로운 난이도와 포탈이 추가되었습니다.

name: Non-Euclidean Chess
input:
Take your chess game beyond the limits of a physical board! Non-Euclidean Chess is a chess engine which supports custom board types - many of which defy traditional movement rules, or even physical limitations.

Non-Euclidean Chess is also the only chess game where you can play with any number of players. Do you and 100 of your best friends want to play? We can't promise it will be quick, but you can do it!

Choose from the following gamemodes:

- N-Player Chess

- Hyperbolic (Poincare Disk) Chess

- Cubic Chess

- Toroidal Chess

- Battle Royale Chess

- Chesseract

- Growth Chess

summary.특징: 블랙홀로 인해 태양이 위협받는 상황에서 인류가 정착할 행성을 찾는다는 설정을 배경으로 하며, 무작위로 생성되는 항성계와 행성이 등장하고 영어·러시아어·우즈베크어 안내를 지원한다.

input:
Nurikabe is a minimalist logic puzzle from Japan. The goal is to determine which tiles are part of the white islands and which are part of the black sea. Unwind as you solve these challenging puzzles.

- Includes over 50,000 unique puzzles

- 5 levels of difficulty

name: 零号协议AgreementZero
input: This is a full 3D simulation development type game. The character played by the player enters a virtual world, but a fault occurs during the entry process, causing the player to lose some memory. The only thing to remember is that the task is to find and establish a close connection with an important girl here. In this process, gradually retrieve memories and use various means to achieve goals. Provide companionship, assistance, or services (massage, etc.) to girls in daily life to enhance their liking for you, break through layers of spiritual and physical barriers, and ultimately form a strong connection with the girl to complete the final task. Free map, you can enter any room to find girls to interact with. In the game, you can also edit and change the appearance of girls' clothing, and after unlocking the action, you can "recall" it at any time to view it.

summary.핵심플레이: 3D 가상 세계에서 캐릭터를 조작해 특정 여성 캐릭터를 찾고, 일상에서 동행·도움·마사지 등의 서비스를 제공해 호감도를 높이며 관계를 발전시킨다. 이 과정에서 잃어버린 기억을 점차 되찾아 최종 목표를 달성한다.
summary.특징: 자유롭게 맵을 이동해 원하는 방에 들어가 여성 캐릭터와 상호작용할 수 있고, 여성 캐릭터의 의상 외형을 편집·변경할 수 있으며, 해금한 행동을 언제든 다시 불러와 확인할 수 있다.

name: Hamstörm
input:
The mines of the great city of Hamsteria were peaceful and thriving, until the day the horrible rats of the Chedd’Ore clan attacked! Now, the valiant Hamstörm must go back to the city to warn the people about the arrival of these nasty rodents in their tunnels.



Travel through a fun and colourful puzzle game, in which you will help Hamstörm make his way inside the mine’s tunnels, now infested with terrible rats! Whether it’d be by destroying crystals, shattering the ground beneath their feet or by setting off traps, you’ll need every trick in the book to make it out in time!



This game was developed over 15 weeks by a group of 6 students from the University of Quebec at Chicoutimi as part of a bachelor's capstone project.

summary.핵심플레이: 광산 터널을 배경으로 크리스탈을 부수고, 바닥을 무너뜨리거나 함정을 작동시키며 퍼즐을 풀어 Hamstörm이 터널을 통과하도록 돕는다.
summary.특징: 쥐 클랜 Chedd'Ore의 습격을 받은 도시 Hamsteria를 배경으로 하며, 퀘벡 치쿠티미 대학교 학생 6명이 학사 졸업 프로젝트로 15주간 개발했다.
