name: Obgob
input:
Obgob is a auto battler roguelike, where you draft units, add items, and collect artifacts to create chaotic builds.

Break The Game!

Obgob is a auto chess roguelike focused on creating absurd builds that break the game. Artifacts can combo with units, items and other artifacts to create the ultimate units.

Game Components

-
Artifacts act as the team enhancers allowing the team to participate in a buff, you can get these at shops, elite battles, or beating a boss.

-
Items act as unit enhancers that make units stronger, especially if they scale off the items stats. These are available from chests, and shops.

-
Units are the team of creatures you use to fight for you. These units can star up if you collect three copies of their type, from 1 star, to 2 star, to 3 star.

Expected Features

-
40+ units

-
100+ artifacts

-
20+ items

-
Roguelike map system

-
Endless mode

-
Hardcore mode

summary.핵심플레이: 유닛을 뽑아 팀을 구성하고 아이템과 아티팩트를 수집해 빌드를 만들어 자동 전투를 진행한다. 같은 유닛 3개를 모으면 1성에서 3성까지 성급을 올릴 수 있다.
summary.특징: 아티팩트는 팀 전체를 강화하고 아이템은 개별 유닛을 강화하며, 이들을 유닛과 조합해 극단적인 빌드를 만드는 데 초점을 둔다. 40종 이상의 유닛, 100종 이상의 아티팩트, 로그라이크 맵 시스템, 엔드리스 모드와 하드코어 모드를 제공한다.

name: Luzhanqi
input:
Luzhanqi (also known as "Land Battle Chess") is a classic Chinese abstract-strategy game. It combines elements of hidden information, deception, as well as tactical maneuvering. Two players command an army whose ranks are hidden from their opponent. Both players must position their army strategically and use careful deduction to defeat their rival. And the overall goal? To capture the enemy's flag while protecting your own!

A Classic Game in a Digital Format

This digital adaptation allows you to experience Luzhanqi in a more accessible format. Regardless of whether or not you are a strategist, a board game enthusiast, or a newcomer who wants to learn, this version of Luzhanqi is a perfect introduction. Face off against a computer opponent with an adjustable difficulty level or against human players online. The game rules can be adjusted to your likings in each match.

Step into the Battlefield

Luzhanqi is a game of strategy and mind games, but it doesn't require fast reflexes. Rather, it requires careful planning, deception, and tactics. With clean pixel graphics, smooth gameplay, and a simple interface, this adaptation allows for the authentic Luzhanqi experience without the need for a referee.

The Rules in Summary

Each player commands an army of ranked soldiers, explosives, and a flag. All pieces are placed secretly on the board, and players take turns moving their pieces one step at a time, never revealing identities even in combat. Higher-ranked pieces defeat lower-ranked ones, but explosives can destroy any piece along with themselves. Set traps, scout the battlefield, and outthink your opponent to emerge victorious!

summary.핵심플레이: 두 플레이어가 계급이 숨겨진 말들을 비밀리에 배치한 뒤 한 칸씩 이동시키며, 추리와 전술로 상대의 깃발을 잡고 자신의 깃발을 지킨다. 높은 계급의 말이 낮은 말을 이기며, 폭발물은 상대 말과 자신을 함께 제거한다.
summary.특징: 중국의 추상 전략 보드게임 Luzhanqi를 디지털로 옮긴 작품으로, 조정 가능한 난이도의 컴퓨터 대전과 온라인 대인전을 지원하고 매 경기 규칙을 변경할 수 있다. 픽셀 그래픽과 간단한 인터페이스로 심판 없이 진행된다.

name: Unlimited World Book: Retro
input:
Unlimited World Book: Retro is a single-player story game. The story takes place on a cold and frosty planet called Astra I. The game offers 2 episodes but the story continues also in the Unlimited World 1.

This is the origin story of a character called Dr. Edward Retro who has a normal life in the 18th century until the Reaper came and destroyed his whole village! When he notice that he must go to the castle, the only safe place around but notice that the Reaper already got there and now our protagonist Retro has to escape from the Reaper but how will he do that? Thats your task!

For this game we have planned an entire series of games which all tell a unique story!

Here is a list of what we release next & might already released.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공 Dr. Edward Retro가 되어 스토리를 따라가며 마을과 성을 파괴한 Reaper로부터 탈출하는 방법을 찾아 진행한다.

name: Dark City: Vienna Collector's Edition
input:
4 Friends Games brings you the next exhilarating chapter in the Dark City series!

When a masked assailant wreaks havoc on a theater in Vienna, you rush to investigate. You quickly arrive to find that this is no ordinary criminal. A dangerous phantom has descended on the local opera house, promising swift justice for past wrongs! This theater is filled with history and secrets. With the lives of both patrons and performers at stake, time of is the essence! Do you have what it takes to uncover the deadly secrets surrounding the opera and unmask the malevolent entity before it’s too late? Find out in this riveting Hidden-Object Puzzle adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:

- Help find a mysterious muse in the bonus chapter!
- Search the rooms and streets of Vienna by replaying HOPs and mini-games!
- Tons of collectible letters and theatrical morphing objects to find!
- Enjoy exclusive wallpapers, screen savers, a bonus game, and more!
- Never get lost with the strategy guide!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.

summary.핵심플레이: 특정 장면에서 목록에 제시된 숨겨진 물건을 찾고, 미니게임과 퍼즐을 풀며 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: Dark City 시리즈의 한 편으로, 빈의 오페라 하우스에서 벌어진 사건을 조사하는 스토리를 다룬다. 컬렉터스 에디션에는 보너스 챕터, 수집용 편지와 변형 오브젝트, 배경화면, 보너스 게임, 공략 가이드 등이 포함된다.

name: Paddle Flap
input:
Welcome to Paddle Flap, a minimalist casual arcade game where you control a paddle at the bottom of the screen and flap it left or right to bounce falling balls. Use precise timing to control the direction of the balls and hit right targets, avoiding the spiky ones.

Along the way, collect power-ups and earn achievements as you unlock new ball graphics, backgrounds and color themes. Can you master the art of Paddle Flap and become a top scorer? Play now and find out!
Features:

- High speed ball action

- Simple but engaging gameplay

- Satisfying paddle interaction

- Power-ups

- Achievements

- Unlockable balls, backgrounds, color themes and music

Check out and wishlist our upcoming game, Mechanical Mayhem!

summary.핵심플레이: 화면 하단의 패들을 좌우로 움직여 떨어지는 공을 튕겨낸다. 타이밍을 맞춰 공의 방향을 조절하고 올바른 목표물을 맞히며 가시가 달린 공은 피한다.
summary.특징: 파워업을 수집하고 도전 과제를 달성하며, 공 그래픽·배경·색상 테마·음악을 해금할 수 있다.

name: Blockers - Advanced BreakOut
input:
An evolved block-breaking game controlled with a mouse.

Use technique and strategy to advance through three levels and over 100 stages.

Depending on the stage, the blocks will scroll and rotate dynamically, or stack in multiple layers, showing a variety of different movements.

When you destroy a certain number of blocks, four types of items will appear randomly.

Obtaining and using these items will give you an advantage as you progress through the stages.

summary.핵심플레이: 마우스로 조작하며 블록을 격파해 3개 레벨과 100개 이상의 스테이지를 진행한다. 일정 수의 블록을 파괴하면 랜덤으로 등장하는 네 종류의 아이템을 획득해 사용한다.
summary.특징: 스테이지에 따라 블록이 스크롤·회전하거나 여러 층으로 쌓이는 등 다양한 움직임을 보인다.

name: Digimon Story Cyber Sleuth: Complete Edition
input:

Get the full experience with the Complete Edition which includes both titles in one!



MYSTERIOUS EVENTS

VIVID & IMMERSIVE WORLDS

• Embark on a thrilling adventure where the line between the real and digital worlds is blurred.



ENDLESSLY ADDICTING

SOLID GAMEPLAY

name: Edge Run
input:
You have to go through an exciting journey in a world about which you know nothing. You have to show your dexterity skills to overcome physical obstacles, as well as the power of your mind to solve tricky puzzles. With each new stage, new opportunities will await you.
After all, each new stage will throw you new challenges that you must overcome in order to become the best. But who is the best? Why does the whole environment look like a computer simulation? Who came up with these tests, and most importantly, why? This is for you to find out. We wish you exciting adventures!
What is waiting for you?
Exciting puzzles will be waiting for you, which will become more and more difficult with each new level. In addition, we tried to integrate new mechanics or gameplay features into each new level. Well, the most important thing is that you will have to show unprecedented dexterity and reaction! Parkour is integrated into all levels. Its difficulty is non-linear and can vary from level to level or even within one small part. We also really hope for your attentiveness and curiosity, and we sincerely hope that you will be able to discover all the secrets of this world!

summary.핵심플레이: 물리적 장애물을 파쿠르로 통과하고 퍼즐을 풀며 각 스테이지를 진행한다. 레벨이 올라갈수록 난이도가 높아지고 새로운 메커니즘이 추가된다.
summary.특징: 컴퓨터 시뮬레이션처럼 보이는 세계를 배경으로, 파쿠르가 모든 레벨에 통합되어 있으며 난이도는 비선형적으로 변한다. 숨겨진 요소를 탐색하는 요소가 포함된다.

Other features
The game supports up to 32 Bots , automatically assign teams, player could command Bot.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 캐릭터를 선택해 매치에 참가하고, 협력하여 거점을 점령한다. 다양한 무기와 지원 아이템을 사용해 전투를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 돌격, 의무병, 지원 등의 직업 캐릭터가 있으며 권총과 7종의 소총, 수류탄, 4종의 조준경 등을 제공한다. 최대 32개의 봇을 지원하고 팀을 자동 배정하며, 플레이어가 봇에게 명령을 내릴 수 있다.

name: Kairobotica
input:
Next Kairogames

Coming soon

About the Game
Vanquish villains and lead the Kairobot Corps to glory in this spacefaring saga!

In a galaxy not so far away, miscreants and monsters are wreaking havoc, and it's up to everyone's favorite mechanical mascot to dole out a heaping helping of bot-kicking justice! And he's bringing an army of his Kairobotic brethren to do it.

In this new spacefaring sim, you command the Kairobot Corps, a state-of-the-art brigade of mass-produced guardians of galactic peace. Heed calls for help to patrol planets and vanquish villains to build your reputation as the most elite interstellar security force this side of the Andromeda!

Between missions, upgrade your mobile colony from shields to shops and you may attract inquisitive spacetrotters from unexplored planets. You can even exhibit animals captured on patrol. Can you catch them all?

Join Kairobot's campaign for cosmic fame in this stirring saga of the stars!

▼Kairobotica
In this space colony simulation, you produce robots called Kairobots to maintain interplanetary peace. Accomplish as much as you can in 15 years of game time.

▼Game Flow
Patrol planets to keep the peace while continually improving the Kairobots' housing. You'll be able to visit new planets as your amity and galactic reputation rise.

▼Patrols
Patrolling planets and defeating monsters there will raise your amity with those planets as well as your overall galactic reputation. Some locations yield items as well.

Try searching for "Kairosoft" to see all of our games!!

summary.핵심플레이: Kairobot 로봇들을 생산해 우주 식민지를 운영하고, 행성을 순찰하며 몬스터를 처치해 은하계 평판과 각 행성과의 우호도를 높인다. 15년의 게임 시간 안에 목표를 달성한다.
summary.특징: 임무 사이에 이동식 식민지를 실드나 상점 등으로 업그레이드해 다른 행성의 방문자를 유치할 수 있으며, 순찰 중 포획한 동물을 전시하는 요소가 있다. 우호도와 평판이 오르면 새로운 행성을 방문할 수 있다.

name: Grove Grown Guardians
input:
Grove Grown Guardians is a strategy game about growing plants and defending the grove from the threat of corruption. Periodically, creatures tainted by the corruption will attack the grove and the guardians will need to face them in auto-battling combat. In order for the grove to survive, resources and plants must be managed to provide guardians with the advantage they will need to win.

In game, there are "?" icons that when clicked will provide more info about nearby features.

summary.핵심플레이: 식물을 재배하고 자원을 관리하며, 주기적으로 그로브를 공격해 오는 부패에 오염된 생명체들에 맞서 가디언으로 자동 전투를 치른다.
summary.특징: 그로브를 부패의 위협으로부터 지키는 세계관을 다루며, 자원과 식물 관리를 통해 가디언에게 전투 우위를 제공한다. 게임 내 '?' 아이콘을 클릭하면 주변 요소에 대한 추가 정보를 확인할 수 있다.

name: CaveLoop
input:
CaveLoop is a short and challenging game. This game is for people who like a challenge, and like to get better and get further in the game. As the player you are stuck in a short loop and each time you restart the loop in a run, then the enemies get randomly more stronger. By enhancing their stats or attacks. You can keep looping the cave until you escape or you can play for a loop count / high score.

In this game you can upgrade your character, unlock new weapons and hats. Become powerful and skilled enough to escape being imprisoned in the Cave.

In general it takes a couple of hours to complete the game and escape. For people who enjoy finding out how far they can get, there is a few more hours of enjoyment.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 동굴 안의 짧은 루프에 갇혀 있으며, 루프를 반복할 때마다 무작위로 강해지는 적과 싸운다. 캐릭터를 업그레이드하고 새 무기와 모자를 잠금 해제하며 탈출을 시도하거나 루프 횟수 및 최고 점수를 노린다.
summary.특징: 루프를 반복할수록 적의 능력치와 공격이 무작위로 강화되는 구조이며, 게임 완료까지 대략 몇 시간이 걸리고 얼마나 멀리 갈 수 있는지 도전하는 플레이 요소를 포함한다.

name: Nightmare in the Old Mansion
input:
Dive into a first-person indie horror as you take on the role of John, a real estate agent invited to assess a mysterious old mansion. However, what starts as a simple assessment quickly turns into a desperate fight for survival when John finds himself trapped in a sinister nightmare within the ancient walls of the mansion. Explore the dark secrets, face unknown threats, and uncover the truth behind the mansion's mystery as you struggle for your own life.

"Nightmare in the Old Mansion" is a first-person indie horror game of the walking simulator genre where the average time to complete the game is 50 minutes.

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 부동산 중개인 John이 되어 오래된 저택을 1인칭 시점으로 탐색하며, 어두운 비밀을 조사하고 위협에 대응하면서 저택의 진실을 밝혀낸다.
summary.특징: 저택 평가를 위해 초대된 John이 저택에 갇혀 생존을 시도하는 이야기를 다루며, 평균 플레이 시간은 약 50분이다.

name: Steam Heroes
input:
Help three brave adventurers on their quest to stop the diabolical Baron Von Smog’s plot to conquer Steam Land. However, there is an army of evil minions that stand in your way. Challenge yourself in this new puzzle strategy game; includes 12 action-packed stages, a full soundtrack, competitive online play, all in stunning 720p HD Graphics. It's up to you to save Steam Land!



Using classic Match-3 gameplay, use your skill and cunning to give power to your 3 heroes and their unique abilities. Matching colours generates steam of that type; your character then utilise the Steam to heal, attack and defend your party. Unlike many other Match-3 games, not every match is a good one. Think ahead carefully and ensure that your character use their special combo attacks to defeat the bosses!

summary.핵심플레이: 같은 색을 맞추는 매치3 방식으로 해당 색의 스팀을 생성하고, 이를 사용해 세 명의 영웅으로 치료·공격·방어를 수행한다. 앞을 내다보며 매치를 계획하고 콤보 공격으로 보스를 상대한다.
summary.특징: Steam Land를 배경으로 Baron Von Smog와 적들을 막는 스토리를 가지며, 12개 스테이지, 사운드트랙, 온라인 경쟁 플레이, 720p HD 그래픽을 포함한다. 모든 매치가 유리하지는 않도록 설계되어 있다.

name: Third Front: WWII
input:
Have you ever wanted to rewrite history? Are you ready to take on the role of ruler of the nation and take responsibility for the destinies of millions of people?

This game will give you the opportunity to show yourself as a genius tactician and commander-in-chief of a huge army!

The allies will help you defeat your enemies and achieve your goals. Your task will be not only to seize cities and take care of their development, but also to defend the cities, because the enemy will constantly try to breach your defense!

Never stop on what has been achieved! Do not limit yourself to one region after total defeat of the enemy. Strike your former allies and prove that you are worthy to rule the world!

Choose from three nations - the USSR, Germany and the Allies - and pave your way for each of them.

Create your own army yourself! Discover new and new opportunities, manage not only infantry and tanks, but also the construction of a fleet of warships, lead the creation of fighters and much more! Do not forget about the defense of your cities - decide for yourself where to dig a trench and install Czech hedgehogs. Choose yourself which city will be an impregnable fortress for your enemies and where exactly you will entice the enemy. You completely control the battle, and it's up to you to decide how to dispose of your troops.

In addition to protecting your territory, you will often face enemy saboteurs and think carefully about how to get rid of spies.

Who will you be: a liberator who cares about his homeland or a tyrant, ready for anything, just to occupy a larger territory?

Don't linger and rather grab the reins of power in your own hands!

Write your own story!

summary.핵심플레이: 국가의 지도자이자 총사령관으로서 군대를 편성하고 도시를 점령·발전시키며, 적의 공격으로부터 도시를 방어한다. 보병과 전차, 함대, 전투기 등을 관리하고 참호나 방어물 배치를 결정하며 전투를 지휘한다.
summary.특징: 제2차 세계대전을 배경으로 소련, 독일, 연합국 세 진영 중 하나를 선택해 진행한다. 적 사보타주와 스파이에 대응해야 하며, 동맹을 공격하는 등 플레이어의 선택에 따라 전개가 달라진다.

name: CHUSHPAN
input:
Violent street gang wars have rocked the city. What do you remember about the main urban bands of the “USSR phenomenon” of the 1987s? Feel those times for yourself.

GAME DESCRIPTION:

Violent street gang wars shook the city. What are the main gangster groups of the “urban phenomenon” of the 1987s remembered for? “Kazlevsky” will tell us all about this with his program.

You will play the role of Vova, nicknamed “Chushpan”, who comes home two years after serving in the USSR army. Vova has grown up and is not at all happy with the affairs that the local bandits are doing. Vova also has a brother “Marasmatic” with a name “Golum”, a very colorful character.

You have to fight a lot with enemies for the territory of the city, upgrade your character and go to the gym. Solving various kinds of situations, communicating with different characters, the storyline is very rich. You will also communicate and “INTERACT” with your girlfriend. Go to the store for bread and much more... a kind of simulator of life in difficult times of the USSR.

FEATURES:

- Gang fights

- Everything in the style of the 90s

- Cool graphics

- Funny animations

- Lots of hand-to-hand techniques

- Soundtrack straight from the 90s

- Story quests

- Very colorful characters

- Large expanses of the city of the USSR

- Bosses in crimson jackets

In the game you will find an interesting plot, a lot of jokes, interesting gameplay that will not let you get bored.

All characters, events, music and locations are completely fictional, any coincidences with real people, other works, films and games are random.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Vova(별명 Chushpan)를 조작해 도시 구역을 놓고 적들과 근접 격투를 벌이고, 캐릭터를 성장시키며 체육관에 다닌다. 다양한 상황을 해결하고 여러 인물과 대화하며 스토리 퀘스트를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 1987년경 소련의 거리 갱단 항쟁을 배경으로 한 픽션 세계관을 다루며, 애인과의 상호작용, 빵 사러 가기 등 생활 시뮬레이션 요소와 90년대풍 연출 및 사운드트랙, 보스 캐릭터가 등장한다.

name: Maptroid: Worlds
input:
A metroidvania experienced entirely in the map!

Sequel to the acclaimed short browser game Maptroid. Maptroid: Worlds has you return exploring metroidvania style, and in multiple planets this time, filling out the map and collecting items, and powerups as you go. Can you make it home for dinner a second time?
Features:

- You can visit a number of planets, explore and fully map them out.

- Collect powerups to enable you to explore new areas, and zip through the map faster and faster.

- Quirky, but not outrageous story and lore writing connecting the worlds for you to discover.

- Improved ship graphic!

- 40 small puzzle levels for you to solve in puzzletroid mode.

- 40 small relaxing maps for you to explore freely in zentroid mode.

- Speedrun mode so you can get faster times unfettered by dialog!

- And a secret hard mode for a challenging replay if you want to experience something different.

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 행성을 탐험하며 맵을 채워 완성하고 아이템과 파워업을 수집한다. 파워업으로 새로운 지역에 접근하고 맵을 더 빠르게 이동한다.
summary.특징: 브라우저 게임 Maptroid의 후속작으로, 지도 화면 위에서 진행되는 메트로바니아 형식을 취한다. 여러 세계를 잇는 스토리와 함께 40개의 퍼즐 스테이지를 푸는 puzzletroid 모드, 자유롭게 탐험하는 zentroid 모드, 스피드런 모드, 숨겨진 하드 모드를 제공한다.

name: Tight Ride
input:
Two years ago the world was overrun by a strange crystalline anomaly known as the Crystal Plague.
Now you have to protect yourself and fight back against this new threat everyday.
Oh well…
With a mix of both classic and new survivors-like tropes, Tight Ride offers a different view on action rogue-lites:

- Ride an amazing vehicle that never slows down in a post-apocalyptic survival fantasy

- Play as a group of characters, each one having a unique arsenal and a set of perks

- Use different combinations of auto-aiming weapons (and their evolutions!) to your advantage

- Face multiple enemy types, each requiring different approach

- Experiment with dozens of different perks and upgrades

- Overcome challenges through your own skill and luck, not meta-progression and power creep

summary.핵심플레이: 멈추지 않고 움직이는 차량을 조종하며, 자동 조준 무기의 조합과 진화, 퍽·업그레이드를 활용해 다양한 종류의 적에 대응하며 생존한다.
summary.특징: 크리스탈 역병으로 붕괴한 포스트 아포칼립스 세계를 배경으로 하며, 고유한 무기와 퍽을 가진 여러 캐릭터를 플레이할 수 있고, 메타 프로그레션이나 파워 크립 없이 플레이어의 실력과 운으로 도전을 극복하도록 설계되었다.

name: The Aquarians
input:
The year is 1882, and it’s nearing a peaceful summer in the small American town of Thornsworth, New Hampshire.



Meanwhile, the prestigious yet mysterious organization Loci Quaerere has gathered evidence of a long-forgotten temple from a bygone society, the Aquarians. This temple has been determined to be somewhere in the woods surrounding the very same town. In a headline announcement, the organization has sought after a knowledgeable and capable local to perform the tasks of discovery and exploration. That local has turned out to be you.



In this playable short, point and click your way through various rooms, puzzles, and your assigned taskbook, to uncover the mysteries of the temple, collect artifacts for sponsors, and fulfill your ultimate purpose.

summary.핵심플레이: 방을 이동하며 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로 퍼즐을 풀고, 지정된 과제집(taskbook)의 임무를 수행하며 유물을 수집한다.
summary.특징: 1882년 미국 뉴햄프셔의 가상 마을 Thornsworth를 배경으로, 조직 Loci Quaerere의 의뢰를 받아 잊혀진 사회 Aquarians의 사원을 탐사하는 짧은 분량의 스토리를 다룬다.

name: CUBE-e 2
input:
CUBE-e 2 - 2D shooter about robots for one and two players, made in stylish hand-drawn graphics.
Background:
After the crash of the "Junior-1" station, our hero finds himself on the distant planet Mallar, but the pursuit of his mechanical soul does not stop. Hunters are sent after him from the station "Junior-1", whose purpose is to destroy the perpetrator of the crash. You have to fire at them, fight back in every possible way, trying to hold out as long as possible. Hide and shoot without falling into the saw-shaped traps, while picking up boosters that will help you survive the next wave. How long can you hold out under fire from enemy robots?
You can also measure your skills with your friend by starting a real war on the same computer. You have to run around the map and shoot at each other, jump on platforms to hide from enemy fire and try not to hit the saws, which are deadly, until the counter of one of you shows the number 5. Find out which of you is stronger and quirkier on an alien scale.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 로봇을 조작해 적을 향해 사격하고, 톱니 모양 함정을 피하며 몸을 숨기고 부스터를 획득해 몰려오는 적의 웨이브를 최대한 오래 버틴다. 2인 모드에서는 같은 컴퓨터에서 서로에게 사격하며 한쪽이 5점에 도달할 때까지 대결한다.
summary.특징: 손으로 그린 그래픽 스타일을 사용하며, 스테이션 '주니어-1'의 추격자들에게 쫓겨 행성 Mallar에 불시착한 로봇을 배경으로 한다. 1인 생존 플레이와 2인 로컬 대전을 지원한다.

name: Little Goody Two Shoes
input:
Dreaming Maidens: Pocket Mirror x Little Goody Two Shoes

In these narrative-driven horror adventure games, you will find yourself using your wits to solve puzzles and explore rich environments full of charm and wonder.

Your choices will determine your fate - try to discover as many endings as you can to uncover the truths to mysteries long forgotten!

This bundle contains:

- Pocket Mirror ~ GoldenerTraum: a modern RPG puzzle horror game that will have you playing as a young girl who, deprived of her memories, finds herself embarking on a dreamy and frightening journey of self-discovery.

- Little Goody Two Shoes: a fairy tale horror adventure game with a dark twist. Follow Elise, an ambitious girl determined to become rich, as she attempts to escape her humble life and finds herself getting more than she bargained for…

Little Goody Two Shoes Deluxe Edition

Take Little Goody Two Shoes’ music anywhere you go with the Deluxe Edition!

This bundle contains:

- Little Goody Two Shoes - a fairy tale horror adventure game with a dark twist. Follow Elise, an ambitious girl determined to become rich and escape her humble life in the village of Kieferberg.

- Official Soundtrack - The official soundtrack for Little Goody Two Shoes features 64 all-original tracks from the main game, including 3 unreleased bonus tracks.

PLAY THE DEMO NOW!

Try the demo today and enjoy the starting section of the game, where you explore Kieferberg and its mysteries, romance its bachelorettes and get a taste of the terrors of the Witching Hour...

About the Game

There once was Elise , a vibrant and ambitious young lass with a big dream – becoming filthy rich. In spite of this, the stars didn’t seem to have reserved our protagonist much fortune in life. Elise, who came from humble beginnings, had no choice but to spend her days away assisting her fellow neighbours with menial tasks to make a living.
One day, Elise discovers a pair of beautiful shiny red shoes buried in her backyard – what a surprise! Bewitched, Elise embarks on a fearful journey that pulls her closer and closer into the heart of the mysterious Woods!
Will Elise risk it all for the sake of a dream come true, or settle for her humble day-to-day life? The ending of this tale is yours to write…

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Elise를 조작해 마을 Kieferberg와 숲을 탐험하고, 퍼즐을 풀며 이야기를 진행한다. 플레이어의 선택에 따라 여러 결말이 갈리며, 마을의 여성들과 로맨스를 맺을 수 있다.
summary.특징: 동화풍 배경에 어두운 반전을 더한 세계관으로, 붉은 구두를 발견한 뒤 펼쳐지는 이야기와 'Witching Hour'의 공포 요소를 다룬다. 여러 엔딩을 통해 감춰진 진실을 밝혀나가는 구조를 갖는다.

name: SwooshCat
input:
SwooshCat – A precision platformer starring an adorable feline! Master simple jumps and dashes to embark on a challenging yet delightful adventure. 🐾

-
Slash, Parry, Break, Dodge – Your dash isn't just movement: it's a combat blade and puzzle key!

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 고양이 캐릭터를 조작해 점프와 대시를 사용하며 스테이지를 진행한다. 대시는 이동뿐 아니라 베기, 패링, 파괴, 회피 등 전투와 퍼즐 해결 수단으로도 활용된다.
summary.특징: 단순한 조작 방식을 바탕으로 정밀한 조작을 요구하는 플랫포머로, 대시 하나가 이동과 전투, 퍼즐을 아우르는 핵심 메커니즘으로 사용된다.

name: Roadworks - The Simulation
input:
This simulation transports you to the varied work in road construction. Re-enact typical assignments and scenarios on country roads and motorways. Get to work with the asphalt mill, steamroller, marking machine and many more special vehicles.

Build a new section of motorway, widen lanes and renew the road surface. Use tools like the jack hammer and secure the site with barriers. Includes detailed vehicles and a range of camera angles.
FEATURES

- Diverse assignments like building a section of motorway, renewing the road surface and widening lanes

- Lovingly detailed vehicles and different camera angles

- Challenging assignments ranging from standard road repairs to building an airport road

- Choose from lots of special vehicles: marking machine, steamroller, excavator

summary.핵심플레이: 아스팔트 밀링기, 스팀롤러, 마킹 머신, 굴착기 등 특수 차량을 조작해 도로 건설 작업을 수행한다. 고속도로 구간 신설, 차선 확장, 노면 재포장, 잭해머 사용 및 바리케이드 설치 등의 임무를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 시골 도로와 고속도로를 배경으로 표준 도로 보수부터 공항 도로 건설까지 다양한 임무를 제공하며, 여러 특수 차량과 다양한 카메라 각도를 지원한다.

name: Mind Flowers
input:
ABOUT THIS GAME

Mind Flowers is a narrative-driven psychological simulation with pixel art aesthetics, immersing you in a hauntingly beautiful dystopian world.

As a psychologist, you run a clinic in a decaying city, diagnosing patients with mysterious conditions named after flowers. Each case takes you deep into their memories, where you experience their past, uncover their struggles, and make life-changing decisions.

But be careful! A wrong diagnosis may lead them to irreversible consequences.

-
A deep and emotional storyline

-
Handcrafted pixel art visuals

-
A dark, immersive atmosphere

-
Decision-driven gameplay that shapes the world around you

Mind Flowers is not just a game; it's an exploration of the human mind and the fragility of emotions. Are you ready to uncover the truth? 🌸

summary.핵심플레이: 심리학자로서 도시의 클리닉을 운영하며 꽃의 이름으로 불리는 증상을 가진 환자들을 진단한다. 환자들의 기억 속으로 들어가 그들의 과거를 경험하고 진단과 선택을 내리며, 잘못된 진단은 돌이킬 수 없는 결과로 이어질 수 있다.
summary.특징: 쇠락해가는 도시를 배경으로 한 디스토피아 세계관과 픽셀 아트 비주얼을 사용하며, 플레이어의 선택이 주변 세계에 영향을 미치는 방식으로 진행된다.

name: QR DEAD
input: The village seems dead to me. Nobody's around. Only the silly crows keep scaring me... and a pitiful howl pierces the echo of memories every time I walk past the shack. It seems like only my grandfather and I are left.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 인적이 사라진 마을을 돌아다니며 주변을 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 까마귀와 오두막에서 들려오는 울음소리가 등장하며, 할아버지와 주인공만 남은 마을을 배경으로 한다.

name: Salthe
input:
This is the “ comedy” of Salthe—

A jester turns a human life to comedy,
and weaves a thrilling tale of Salthe's memory.

How did Salthe die, at the end of despair?
Join us, audience, as we wind our way there.
“ Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.”

At the end of a journey of blood, despair, regret, and madness—
a stage perched on the razor's edge dividing life and death.
With no audience to cheer, at a jester's direction, Salthe performs her past.
To learn the reason for her death.
To return to the world of life.
Each scene is full of scorn and mockery,
she writhes and struggles, through to the end
of the tale of Salthe's life—a comedy——
Dramatis Personae

- Salthe: The star of this performance, known far and wide as the finest actress in Mersin's national theatre troupe. Clever and competent, she has always balanced her stage work and her royal duties with skill. Now she relives her time as Mersin's crown princess while searching for the reason for her death on Kloun's phantasmagoric stage.

- Marie: A kind-hearted nun, Salthe's childhood friend. Lives alone in a church outside town, where she cares for children who have lost their parents. The orphanage's finances are dire, but she keeps a cheerful smile while making ends meet. She'll never back down once her mind is made up. Salthe has been helping her look for adoptive parents for the orphans.

- Kloun: An enigmatic jester who grants Salthe a chance to return to life from the liminal stage. Professes to be Salthe's friend, but never drops a theatrical facade.

Break a leg...

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Salthe의 과거 장면들을 무대에서 다시 연기하며 그녀가 죽음에 이른 이유를 찾아가는 방식으로 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 삶과 죽음의 경계에 놓인 무대를 배경으로, 어릿광대 Kloun의 연출 아래 왕녀이자 배우였던 Salthe의 기억을 연극처럼 되짚는 서사와 등장인물 구성을 갖추고 있다.

name: Frog Hop
input:
A cute and quirky classic adventure platforming game about a frog named Hoppy searching for his frog friend Jumpy.

Swing and launch yourself through levels with your tongue ability.

A vast array of mechanics, enemies, and obstacles; there's always something new you'll encounter in each level.

Unique and challenging boss fights, each with their own attacks and weaknesses.

Collect sparkly gems and spend them to buy charms that alter your play style, opening up possibilities for replayability and strategies to overcome levels.

Bouncy and catchy tunes. Each level has a unique song.

Dress yourself up with a wide range of cosmetics. Have ducks follow you around or make goofy sounds when you hit the ground.

For the classic hardcore platforming gamer. Enjoyable for speed-runners as well!

It has hats.

summary.핵심플레이: 개구리 Hoppy를 조작해 혀 능력으로 몸을 매달거나 발사시켜 레벨을 이동하며, 각기 다른 공격과 약점을 가진 보스와 싸운다. 반짝이는 젬을 모아 플레이 방식을 바꾸는 참을 구매할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 친구 개구리 Jumpy를 찾아 나서는 개구리 Hoppy의 이야기를 다루며, 레벨마다 새로운 메커니즘과 적, 장애물, 고유한 음악이 등장한다. 오리를 따라다니게 하거나 모자 등 다양한 코스메틱으로 캐릭터를 꾸밀 수 있고, 스피드러닝에도 대응한다.

name: Eye of the Owl - Bosch VR
input:
Eye of the Owl - The Hieronymus Bosch VR experience. Enabling you to go back in time to the artist’s studio and explore his masterpiece, The Garden of Earthly Delights. This application gives you the tools to explore the painting on your own in otherwise impossible detail, while the artist himself describes the bizarre and mystifying scenes. The painting has been digitized in ultra-high resolution, you can see the brushstrokes and into the cracks. Use a virtual magnifying glass you hold in your hand to discern the faintest details. Activate the magic carpet shrink transformation to see the characters life size and even more detail.
See what you can discover about Bosch and his masterpiece.
Instructions

- Only one controller is used

Studio

- Use the buttons on the magnifying glass controller

- Info/Shrink - select an information point by seeing the info icon thru the magnifying glass, then pressing the Info button to shrink to the region

- Zoom - Toggel magnification factor on mag glass (only available on the top studio level)

- Timer - Displayed around the Info button when in shrink mode

Keyboard

- Space bar = Restart

- D = Demo/Exhibition mode (shorter, only 3POIs)

- X = Exit/Quit

Key Features

- A virtual magnifying glass
You hold a magnifying glass in your hand and use it to magnify your view just like a real magnifying glass. Two different zoom levels available.

- Ultra-high resolution painting detail
You can see brushstrokes, and even the cracks in the painting. This is the highest resolution painting or likely any VR object to date.

- A painting soundscape
3D binaural sounds are positioned on the painting to alert the viewer to components in the scenes. Use headphones for 3D sound.

- Shrinking the viewer
You can shrink on the magic carpet for more close up detail and see the characters in life size.

- Vive Room Space
Ability to walk around and intimately examine this extraordinary painting.

- Information
Narration from the latest art historian research

summary.핵심플레이: 손에 든 가상 돋보기를 이용해 히에로니무스 보스의 회화 '세속적인 쾌락의 동산'을 확대해 관찰하고, 정보 지점을 선택해 해당 영역으로 축소 이동하며 세부를 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 초고해상도로 디지털화된 그림을 붓 자국과 균열까지 볼 수 있으며, 매직 카펫 축소 기능으로 등장인물을 실제 크기로 관찰할 수 있다. 3D 바이노럴 사운드와 미술사 연구 기반의 내레이션이 제공되고 Vive 룸 스페이스에서 이동하며 감상할 수 있다.

name: Hero's Quest: Lost Memories
input:
"Hero's Quest: Lost Memories" is a thrilling JRPG set in the magical kingdom of Arin. As the main hero, Aria, you will embark on a journey across the world to save the land from a growing darkness that threatens to engulf it. With your trusty bow and a fierce determination to succeed, you will fight many monsters and meet companions along the way who will help you in your quest.



The game features a unique sub-class system that allows players to create the perfect build for their team. Whether you want to specialize in archery, magic, or melee combat, you can choose the subclass that best suits your playstyle and strategy. With this system, you can customize your team and create a powerful and balanced group that can take on any challenge.



In addition to the sub-class system, "Hero's Quest" also has a robust crafting system that allows players to build a variety of weapons, armor, and items. You can gather resources and craft items that will give you an edge in battle or help you in other ways. With so many crafting options available, you can tailor your equipment to your specific needs and preferences.



As you journey through the world of Arin, you will explore different towns, cities, and environments. Each location is beautifully crafted with stunning visuals and immersive sound design. You will encounter diverse cultures and meet characters who will offer quests, trade items, or join your team. With a rich and detailed world to explore, "Hero's Quest" promises to deliver an unforgettable adventure.



With its engaging storyline, exciting combat, and robust customization options, "Hero's Quest: Lost Memories" is a must-play game for JRPG fans. Join Aria on her epic quest to save the kingdom of Arin and become a hero that the world will never forget.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Aria가 되어 왕국 Arin을 여행하며 몬스터와 전투하고 동료를 만나 팀을 구성한다. 자원을 모아 무기, 방어구, 아이템을 제작하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 궁술, 마법, 근접 전투 등을 선택할 수 있는 서브클래스 시스템과 제작 시스템을 통해 팀 빌드와 장비를 커스터마이징할 수 있다. 다양한 마을과 도시, 환경을 탐험하며 퀘스트를 제공하거나 거래하는 캐릭터를 만난다.

name: Ham(mer) It Up
input:
Ham(mer) It Up is a blacksmithing game for up to four local players. Before starting the day, players have the option to purchase various upgrades to help improve their store. Once the day starts, they'll have to manage the store by taking customers' orders, making those orders, and ensuring that the stations are in working condition.

KEY FEATURES

-
Cooperate with up to three friends locally.

-
Take orders and craft items quickly before the customers lose patience.

-
Take too long and the customers will leave unhappy and without having paid.

-
Unique Customers will only order certain items and their wait times will vary (some might wait longer than others, some might wait hardly at all), so watch out!

-
Day and World Events keep things fun and interesting and ensures no two days are alike.

-
Manage your store by purchasing upgrades using money earned from playing.

-
Customize your player by using money earned from playing to unlock different clothing options.

UPGRADES

Players will be able to purchase upgrades for the store as they play. Those upgrades range from adding another furnace so you can smelt bars twice as fast to getting a sprint upgrade so they can dash quickly and serve the last customer before the day ends. Upgrades also consist of unlocking new stations/items so as the store grows they'll be able to make more and more things.

AVERAGE WORK DAY

Players will take customers' orders as they come up to the front counter. Then, players will use the available resources and craft the items that the customers ordered. They must be quick about it though, because the customers won't stick around forever, and if they happen to run out of patience, they'll angrily leave and the players won't get paid.

NOT SO AVERAGE WORK DAY

No two work days are alike. Whether it's the customers that come in, the things that the customers order, or the day/world events, no two days should feel the same. Stations can break down, customers can leave angrily, and it's up to the players to manage it all.

INSPECTOR

After meeting certain criteria, eventually the inspector will come and it's the players' job to make sure the inspector leaves happy. If he does, the players can purchase the next store upgrade which will give them more room and well as a whole slew of new upgrades to unlock.

summary.핵심플레이: 최대 4인 로컬 협동으로 대장간을 운영하며, 손님의 주문을 받고 자원을 이용해 아이템을 제작해 인내심이 떨어지기 전에 완성해 판매한다. 손님이 기다리다 떠나면 대금을 받지 못한다.
summary.특징: 손님마다 주문 품목과 대기 시간이 다르며, 하루·세계 이벤트와 작업대 고장 등으로 매일 상황이 달라진다. 게임으로 번 돈으로 용광로 추가·질주 등 상점 업그레이드와 새 작업대·아이템, 캐릭터 의상을 해제할 수 있고, 일정 조건을 충족하면 검사관이 방문해 통과 시 상점 확장이 가능하다.

name: Elf World Adventure 6
input:
GAMEPLAY:
Elf World Adventure 6 is the next installment in the erotic anime-style puzzle series where you’ll meet even more enchanting elf girls in a magical fantasy setting. Solve puzzles to unlock beautiful illustrations, relax with soothing music, and choose your challenge — go Easy for a laid-back experience or Hard for a real test of skill.

FEATURES:

- New levels featuring charming elf girls in fantasy outfits

- Difficulty selection: Easy and Hard modes

- Steam achievements to decorate your profile

- A cozy atmosphere with gentle music and beautiful illustrations

- Simple controls and accessible gameplay

summary.핵심플레이: 퍼즐을 풀어 일러스트를 잠금 해제하며, Easy와 Hard 두 가지 난이도 중에서 선택해 진행한다.
summary.특징: 애니메이션풍 판타지 배경에서 엘프 캐릭터 일러스트를 감상하는 성인 퍼즐 시리즈의 후속작으로, 새로운 레벨과 스팀 도전 과제, 음악을 제공한다.

name: Capslock
input:
You've just inherited your Grandpa's quaint typewriter store... but, there's a twist: you need to revamp this business for the modern world through custom keyboard designing!

It's now your job to turn boards into coins. Design the keyboard of your dreams down to the individual key; apply skins, swap to custom key caps, mix in symbols, perfect your lighting & challenge your imagination. Can you earn enough coins, manage your stock and unlock the best from the Capslock Catalogue?

Capslock is a casual game focused on design and testing your imagination. Choose between 130+ skins, 260+ custom keys, 270+ symbols and more to test your designs and make unique keyboards. Relax as you listen to the 'clicky' sounds to help you unwind and immerse into a keyboard building environment.

Start from scratch - solve the puzzle of dragging and dropping each key into its' slot to build out your keyboard, or dive straight into designing and auto-fill all your keys with the press of a button! You can edit one key at a time, or make changes to your whole board - Capslock moves at a pace which suits you.

Capslock is a stock based game! The more boards you sell, the more coins you will have to explore the "Capslock Catalogue". You will need to keep an eye on your stock levels and purchases to ensure your business stays profitable and you have access to the best content !

There are many features, big and small, to ensure complete freedom in designing a keyboard. Tweak each keys lighting or have fun with various RGB sequences. Rotate keys, write out your text, change keyboard & background colours or try your designs out on multiple boards! Capslock is the tool to create your dream boards.

Capslock is our first release from an indie team - it is our dream to create a keyboard designer community and listen to our players to enhance the game as it develops !

summary.핵심플레이: 각 키를 슬롯에 배치해 키보드를 조립하고, 스킨과 커스텀 키캡, 심볼, 조명을 적용해 키보드를 디자인한다. 완성한 보드를 판매해 코인을 벌고 재고를 관리하며 카탈로그의 콘텐츠를 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 할아버지에게 물려받은 타자기 가게를 운영하는 설정으로, 130종 이상의 스킨, 260종 이상의 커스텀 키, 270종 이상의 심볼을 제공한다. 키별 조명과 RGB 시퀀스 조정, 키 회전, 배경·키보드 색상 변경 등의 커스터마이징 기능과 타건음 요소를 포함한다.

name: Metro PD: Close to You
input:
This is a Steam version of a hit visual novel game released on the mobile reader app Love 365: Find Your Story by Voltage Inc. It is a collection of romantic, richly illustrated interactive stories with the following premise:

In Metro PD: Close to You, join an elite group of detectives at the Metropolitan Police Department. Partner up with a handsome senior detective to go on undercover investigations and solve dangerous cases such as serial bombings - and of course, overcoming these life-or-death situations will bring you two closer together... Experience a world straight out of a procedural drama, as thrilling as it is romantic.

An opening movie and adventure feature have been added to the Steam release, so even players that have previously read the app version will discover more things to enjoy.

The Story:
"You're my partner as of today."

You're a rookie detective. Your training?
Trial by fire, solving a dangerous case together!

Get yourselves out of tight binds
and discover an even stronger bond with each other.

Will you catch the real culprit?
And will your case come to a romantic conclusion?

A lethal love where you watch each other's backs.
What will come of your dangerous and thrilling romance?!

Whether on the job or in love,
there's never a dull moment!

Characters:
Hiroshi Kirisawa "The Rugged Boss"
Kazusa Hanai "The Perfectionist Detective"
Yutaka Tennoji "The Unmatched Senior Detective"
Tadanobu Nomura "The Flirty Deputy Chief"
Masashi Himuro "The Ruthless Coroner"

Contents:
Includes Main Stories from the app Love 365: Find Your Story up until "24 Hours and Counting" (Except Nomura)
*His PoV Stories are counted as Special Stories and thus not included

summary.핵심플레이: 신입 형사가 되어 선배 형사와 짝을 이루어 연쇄 폭발 사건 등 위험한 사건을 수사하는 스토리를 선택지에 따라 진행한다. 사건 해결과 함께 상대 캐릭터와의 관계 전개를 읽어나간다.
summary.특징: Voltage Inc.의 모바일 앱 Love 365: Find Your Story에 나온 비주얼 노벨의 Steam 버전으로, 경찰 수사물 배경의 로맨스를 다룬다. Kirisawa, Hanai, Tennoji, Nomura, Himuro 등 공략 캐릭터가 등장하며, Steam판에는 오프닝 무비와 어드벤처 기능이 추가되었다.

name: Candle Knight
input: Wield your flame to overcome menacing creatures lurking in the shadows of a ruined castle, use the dynamic difficulty system to your advantage, traverse challenging platforming sections and solve cryptic puzzles inside surreal paintings in this 2.5D action adventure platformer.

summary.핵심플레이: 불꽃을 사용해 그림자 속에 숨어 있는 적들을 상대하고, 도전적인 플랫포밍 구간을 통과하며 퍼즐을 해결한다.
summary.특징: 폐허가 된 성을 배경으로 하는 2.5D 게임으로, 동적 난이도 시스템과 초현실적인 그림 속에서 진행되는 퍼즐을 포함한다.

name: The Secret Of Hildegards
input:
Abigail Hildegard, daughter of the leader of secret order, once she was told that her father disappeared. She should go to the family estate, headquarters of the Order, to find out what happened. She finds the family butler there. He was lucky not to suffer in a raid on a house and told Abigail that a secret weapon is kept in the house. And with it help it will be able to rescue her father out of trouble.
What kind of weapon it is and how to find it you will know by passing game, "The Secret of Hildegards"
Features:

- Mystifying storyline

- Hilarious gameplay

- A lot of mini games

- More than 100 draw-by-hand scenes

summary.핵심플레이: 실종된 아버지의 행방과 저택에 보관된 비밀 무기를 찾기 위해 저택을 탐색하며, 다양한 미니게임을 풀어 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 비밀 결사의 지도자 딸 Abigail Hildegard가 주인공으로 등장하는 스토리 중심 구성이며, 100개 이상의 손으로 그린 장면과 여러 미니게임을 포함한다.

name: PANGIT
input:
A linear storyline in which the protagonist is a special agent infiltrating a restricted area—a former military base. Previously, archaeological excavations were conducted here, and upon uncovering an ancient burial site, scientists released a deadly pathogen.

The infection turns people into mutants, and the survivors have split into warring factions:

-
Some seek salvation,

-
Others attempt to weaponize the virus,

-
While others kill indiscriminately.

To prevent the spread of the contagion, the zone has been completely isolated—no one can leave. Yet, for unknown reasons, the authorities refuse to destroy the infected territory. Instead, once a month, they send in teams of special agents with classified missions.

The protagonist is one such operative, but he has become separated from his squad and must now find them to complete the mission…

summary.핵심플레이: 특수요원을 조작해 격리된 옛 군사 기지에 잠입하여, 헤어진 분대원을 찾아 임무를 완수하기 위해 구역을 탐색한다.
summary.특징: 고대 매장지 발굴 중 방출된 병원체로 사람들이 뮤턴트로 변하고 생존자들이 여러 파벌로 나뉜 상황을 배경으로 하는 선형 스토리 진행 방식이다. 감염 구역은 완전히 격리되어 있으며, 당국은 매달 기밀 임무를 띤 특수요원 팀을 투입한다.

name: Mimir Studio
input:
Mimir Studio overlays your games with translated text. Using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), Mimir Studio automatically recognizes, translates, and then places the translated text in your native language on top of your game with the same colors in a way that lets you play your game as if it were translated into your chosen language.
Text Recognition

Using state of the art visual recognition technology, Mimir Studio can detect words written in English, Chinese, or Japanese, providing coverage for 99% of games available today. Text is detected and translated from textures, meshes, from dialogue, from buttons, from anywhere it shows up on the screen. Unlike traditional solutions which require memory hacking or worse, Mimir Studio simply looks at what the screen displays in the same way a natural language reader does.
Immersive Overlay

Mimir Studio matches the color, size, and location of the text that it detects on your game screen, replacing it with an identical overlay for a truly native feeling. The original text is displayed in a small font at the top of the overlay, so that you can see what was written and what is the translation at the same time.

On supported devices, high framerate recognition allows overlays to follow as you pan the camera, providing a seamless experience. For all devices, Mimir Studio overlays can be turned on and off with a hotkey, increasing performance during demanding action sequences.
Multiple Language Support

Translate from English, Chinese, or Japanese into a number of languages in real time. Translate into:

- English

- Chinese (Simplified)

- Japanese

- Russian

- Spanish

- Portuguese

- German

- French

- Korean

- Polish

- Turkish

- Thai

- Italian

- Czech

- Hungarian

- Swedish

- Dutch

- ...And more!

summary.핵심플레이: OCR 기술로 게임 화면에 표시된 텍스트를 인식해 사용자가 선택한 언어로 번역하고, 원래 텍스트와 동일한 색상으로 화면 위에 오버레이를 덧씌운다. 단축키로 오버레이를 켜고 끌 수 있다.
summary.특징: 영어, 중국어, 일본어를 인식해 한국어를 포함한 여러 언어로 실시간 번역하며, 감지한 텍스트의 색상·크기·위치를 맞춰 원문은 상단에 작은 글씨로 함께 표시한다. 메모리 해킹 없이 화면에 표시되는 내용을 시각적으로 인식하며, 지원 기기에서는 고프레임 인식으로 카메라 이동에 오버레이가 따라간다.

name: Six Days of Snow
input:
In the dim and distant past, Tanabe Eiji was a promising young writer, well-known for his poem Fireworks, which detailed the beginnings of his youthful and idealistic romance with his wife, Sachiko.

Twenty years later, however, Eiji's life has lost much of its shine. His poems, save for Fireworks, have fallen into obscurity, while his first (and last) novel was critically panned for being too depressing. Worse still, his relationship with his wife has started to stagnate.

In a desperate attempt to rekindle his lost creativity, Eiji embarks on a journey to the snowy mountains of Hakuba.

During his six day stay at the Azami Inn, an old and lonely building in the middle of nowhere, Eiji meets the inn's proprietress, the stern and indomitable Miss Kakiuchi, and her unwordly daughter, Reiko.

Eiji isn't sure why, exactly, but something about Reiko catches his attention. Though he tries to resist, he finds himself drawn to her charms all the same.

Could Reiko be his muse, who will inspire him to pen another masterpiece? Or will his obsession with her ruin the both of them?

- Around 35,000 words
- A kinetic storyline with no choices
- Realistic and softly rendered character artwork
- Beautiful backgrounds
- An entirely custom soundtrack
- An ornate and overwrought writing style

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 선택지 없이 진행되는 이야기를 읽으며 스토리를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 창작력을 잃은 작가 Tanabe Eiji가 하쿠바의 눈 덮인 산속 여관 Azami Inn에 6일간 머물며 여관 주인의 딸 Reiko에게 끌리는 과정을 그리며, 약 3만 5천 단어 분량의 선택지 없는 키네틱 노벨로 커스텀 사운드트랙과 부드러운 캐릭터 아트를 포함한다.

name: Deus Ex: The Fall
input:
OVERVIEW:
Deus Ex: The Fall is set in 2027– a golden era for science, technology and human augmentation, but also a time of great social divide and global conspiracy. Powerful corporations have seized control from governments and command the drug supply needed by augmented humans to survive.
In this chaos Ben Saxon, a former British SAS Mercenary who underwent physical augmentation, is desperate for the truth behind the drug conspiracy. Betrayed by his private military employers, the Tyrants, not only is his own life at risk but for all augmented humans, time is running out…
Developed in collaboration with the original DEUS EX: HUMAN REVOLUTION® team at Eidos-Montréal and N-Fusion; Deus Ex: The Fall includes full Steam Achievements, Mouse & Keyboard control configurations, and Control Pad support.
FEATURES:
This is a port of the original DEUS EX: THE FALL experience, first released on iOS and Android in 2013 – action, stealth, hacking, and social gameplay. A prequel story to Deus Ex: Human Revolution that builds on the DEUS EX universe. Fight for survival in a global conspiracy.
STORY DRIVEN ACTION-RPG:

- The search for the truth spans from mafia hideouts in Moscow to the slums of Panama

- Every action has a consequence

- Hours of gameplay with multiple ways to play

THE DEUS EX EXPERIENCE:

- Play the way you want- high-impact action or stealth

- Original, immersive storyline

- Numerous side quests

- Fully explorable environments

- Social and hacking skills

- High impact action and combat

- Unique visual design

PC STEAMWORKS OPTIMIZATIONS:

- Full Mouse & Keyboard control scheme (please note keyboard bindings are not configurable)

- Microsoft Controller support

- 28 Steam achievements

- Steam Trading Cards and Badges

- Adjusted Artificial Intelligence

- Revised game tutorial

- Removal of auto-target options

- Revised aiming reticule

- Removal of in-game purchase options, with rebalanced game economy

- Revised cover options - now matches Deus Ex: Human Revolution (HOLD or Toggle)

- Resolution, Anti-Aliaising and Vertical Sync options

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 주인공 Ben Saxon이 되어 액션 전투와 잠입 중 원하는 방식을 선택하고, 해킹과 대화를 활용하며 음모의 진실을 추적한다. 모스크바의 마피아 은신처부터 파나마의 빈민가까지 이동하며 다양한 사이드 퀘스트를 수행한다.
summary.특징: 2027년을 배경으로 기업이 정부를 대체하고 증강 인간에게 필요한 약물 공급을 장악한 세계관을 다루며, Deus Ex: Human Revolution의 프리퀄 이야기를 구성한다. iOS 및 Android로 출시된 원작을 PC로 이식하면서 마우스·키보드 및 컨트롤러 지원, 조준·엄폐 방식 수정, 인게임 구매 제거와 경제 재조정 등을 적용했다.

name: Pengu Never Left
input:
Fish, listen to music and relax as the days pass by in this relaxing minimalistic game. Maybe you'll fish up something interesting? There's plenty to unlock and discover from an old cassette player to old letters from friends!

The island changes over time, not just with your progression but with the seasons too! expect slight changes in weather, and the island as the seasons come and go!

What to expect in terms of 'content':

- 9 collectable items

- 2 unlockable rooms to the house

- 9 types of fish (which can all be viewed in the fish log)

- 7 collectable cassettes

- 9 collectable letters

summary.핵심플레이: 섬에서 낚시를 하며 물고기를 잡고 음악을 들으며 시간을 보낸다. 낚시로 다양한 아이템을 발견하고 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 시간과 계절에 따라 섬의 날씨와 모습이 변화한다. 카세트, 편지, 물고기 도감 등 수집 요소와 집에 추가할 수 있는 방이 있다.

name: SOLAR CAGE
input:
“SOLAR CAGE” is a challenging parkour-shooter that takes place in the distant future, where a majority of humanity has been converted into mechanical monstrosities. They’ve built a Dyson sphere surrounding the Sun, using its energy to fuel their highly inefficient lifestyle. Using something known as the CATALYST, their consciousness exists as a copy of their original brain within these bodies. You play as JANITOR-2828, a designated cleaning robot who is suddenly contacted by an unknown entity. Your abilities are upgraded from cleaning to being able to jump, wall run, and slide with ease. It was even nice enough to give you a signature rail gun. All of these achieve a simple task: BLOW UP THE SUN.
RUN. SHOOT. REPEAT.

- Pull off crazy acrobatics as you run, slide, and jump around each area in the facility.
- One bullet, one chance. If you miss, you'll have to beat down robotic combatants to reload your gun. Make every shot count.
- Chain your parkour and combat skills together to pull off epic, precisely timed traversal combos!

-
-
-

-
-
-

summary.핵심플레이: 각 시설 구역을 달리고 벽을 타고 슬라이드하며 이동하고, 레일건으로 적을 조준 사격한다. 총알은 한 발뿐이라 빗나가면 로봇 적을 때려 재장전해야 하므로 사격과 파쿠르를 연계해 이동한다.
summary.특징: 인류 대부분이 기계 존재로 변한 먼 미래를 배경으로, 태양을 감싼 다이슨 스피어에서 벌어지는 이야기다. 청소 로봇 JANITOR-2828이 되어 태양을 폭파하는 것이 목표이며, 파쿠르와 전투를 연결한 타이밍 기반 이동 콤보를 구현한다.

name: VENARI - Escape Room Adventure
input:
Embark on an epic adventure to an ancient, mysterious island where your escape room puzzle skills will be put to the test!

After a surprising encounter with an old friend, you are handed a secret map revealing the location of a long-lost, mystical object known as the Venari artefact. Intrigued by the mystery and driven by curiosity, you charter a sea plane to an uncharted island shrouded in mystery.

As you touch down at the island’s shore, you quickly realise that this journey will demand every ounce of your puzzle-solving prowess. The island is a labyrinth of ancient ruins, hidden chambers, and intricate puzzles, each guarding clues and secrets that inch you closer to the artefact.

Gameplay
Venari offers a rich and immersive experience, combining elements of adventure and challenging puzzles. Navigate through beautifully crafted environments, each filled with intricate details and challenging puzzles designed to test your wits.

- 🗺️ Explore the Island: Traverse through rocky terrain, forgotten temples, and eerie caves. Each location is meticulously designed, offering a unique challenge and atmosphere.

- 🧩 Solve Challenging Puzzles: Engage in a variety of puzzles that range from logic-based challenges to intricate mechanical devices. Every solved puzzle brings you one step closer to the Venari artefact.

- 🔍 Uncover Hidden Secrets: As you delve deeper into the island, discover hidden secrets and pieces of lore that unravel the history of the Venari artefact and the ancient civilisation that once thrived here.

Controls
⌨️🖱️Movement: WASD + Mouse
💼 Inventory: I
📋 Menu: ESC

Will You Succeed?
The path to the Venari artefact is fraught with challenges. Can you navigate the island’s secrets and overcome the challenges that lie ahead? Will your puzzle-solving skills be enough to claim the Venari artefact and uncover its mysteries?

summary.핵심플레이: 섬의 유적과 동굴, 신전을 탐험하며 논리 퍼즐과 기계 장치 등 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어 Venari 유물에 다가간다. 아이템을 수집·활용해 숨겨진 단서와 비밀을 찾아낸다.
summary.특징: 오래된 친구에게서 받은 지도를 따라 미지의 섬에 도착해 유물을 추적하는 스토리를 배경으로 한다. 진행하면서 고대 문명과 Venari 유물의 역사에 관한 로어가 드러난다.

name: Bloody Bunny 3D
input:
INTRODUCTION:

The living dead roam the Earth, controlled by their master, sent out to kill every last human being on this planet. You are a lone bunny, protecting your very pregnant wife, and trying to salvage what is left of your owner's house. However, the one behind raising the dead sees your effort to exterminate their soldiers. So you are faced with endless hordes of MUTATED FREAKS trying to rip you to little bunny bits.

GAMEPLAY:

This is a 3D top-down horde survivor. You start off with nothing, and only your hands. Throw zombies until you get enough blood for the shop. Your house unlocks every time you finish a wave, but be careful with little time to spare, you must choose between buying weapons, or setting up ridiculous traps on your property to keep THEM away. SHOOT, SLASH, TRAP, but most importantly THROW THESE FREAKS until every last undead is dead… again. Every third level you face a BOSS, ranging from LITTLE ZOMBIE FREAKS, to RABID CHIHUAHAS.

SETTING / TONE / GRAPHICS:

The graphics are cartoony and meant to give a fun vibe off. Seeing guts fly out of the zombies is pretty kickass!

With vibes from MEDIEVAL days, to THE FREAKING MOON, you will surely get a range of settings to mow down these monsters.

Most moments are funny, but there are some heart-wrenching moments you will not want to miss, that will surely make you bite your nails off till there's nothing but a fleshy bed.

One second you’ll be balling your eyes out, the next you’re filled with rage and weirdly laughing?

GORE:

Gore is a central part of this game. I believe every zombie game needs gore. You need to see bones, guts, blood, brains, jaws, ribcages, and even…. Testicles? With every zombie having multiple unique animations, and reactions depending on which type of weapon you use and how you use it. These zombies are sure to die in such glorious ways that’ll not only leave your smile wide for days, but absolute disgusting piles of messy bits on your farm.

List of some things you can do to the zombies:

-
Throw them on the ground, into each other, into blades, and basically everywhere!

-
Shoot their heads, legs, arms, chests off.

-
CUT THEM IN HALF (both horizontally and vertically)

-
Set up traps that can entomb these zombies and blow up seconds after.

-
Mow down these zombies with a lawnmower (my favorite)

-
Punch them with boxing gloves

-
Blow them up

-
Throw a cow at them

ENEMIES:

With a great zombie game comes great enemy types. We got a basic zombie, we got the leech, we got the pimp, we got the bloater, we got the cagecrab, we even got the NAKED ZOMBIE!

Each zombie is different, both in speed, and use cases! For example, when thrown THE NAKED ZOMBIE EXPLODES

WEAPONS:

There are many different and unique weapons in this game, for firearms we have pistols that shoot normal bullets all the way to lighting. We have shotguns that shoot bullets or brains! We also have assault rifles that tear the limbs off the zombies and even have a goat that shoots a laser out of its butt!

For melee it only gets better, from light weapons like a machete, to large weapons like the cleaver, chainsaw (every zombie game needs a chainsaw), and lawnmower, these zombies won’t stand a snowball's chance in hell!!!!

Disclaimer: Gameplay and visuals are subjects to change and look way more gorier than they do now!

Want to play a really old version of the game? Do so on my itch! The title is Bad Hare Day. However, that game is very much different than this one.

summary.핵심플레이: 토끼 캐릭터로 몰려오는 좀비를 처치하며, 던지기·사격·베기·함정 설치로 웨이브를 버틴다. 좀비를 처치해 얻은 피로 상점에서 무기나 함정을 구매하고, 세 레벨마다 보스와 싸운다.
summary.특징: 카툰풍 그래픽에 고어 연출을 중심으로 하며, 좀비 종류와 사용 무기에 따라 다양한 반응이 나타난다. 중세부터 달까지 여러 배경이 등장하고, 벌거벗은 좀비(던지면 폭발), 권투 글러브, 잔디깎이, 소 던지기 등 다양한 무기와 적 유형이 있다.

name: Demon heart
input:
Welcome to Demon heart. Accompany Syael in her journey to the other world where demons live on floating islands. Find out what happened on every island. Investigate who and why did this.

Defeat island masters and talk to them. Meet the demon royal family.

Which side will you choose? Will you find demons' heart delicious?

In this game you will find:

*5 unique islands

*Bosses that demand a specific approach to each one

*Puzzles with unobvious solutions

*Arcade machine without winning

*Completely different characters

*Heaps of treasure and cakes

*Store where nothing will be sold to you

*WALKING

*Three different endings

summary.핵심플레이: Syael을 조종해 악마들이 사는 다른 세계의 떠 있는 섬들을 탐험하며 각 섬에서 일어난 일을 조사한다. 섬의 주인들을 물리치거나 대화하고 퍼즐을 풀며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 5개의 섬과 각기 다른 공략이 필요한 보스, 명확하지 않은 해법의 퍼즐이 있으며 악마 왕족을 만난다. 이길 수 없는 아케이드 기계, 아무것도 팔지 않는 상점 같은 요소가 있고 선택에 따라 세 가지 엔딩으로 나뉜다.

name: Deathly Storm: The Edge of Life
input:
Deathly Storm: The Edge of Life

Story:

You are in the most livable area of the city after the explosion of nuclear and chemical warheads. You have spent too much time in this quarantine zone. Everything has begun to seem meaningless since you lost the track of time. Whereas, you still remember the dull life you had in front of your computer like it was yesterday. Your wife and children were the happiness you had. Now everything has changed...

Every day you try to get out of town by breaking the quarantine so you can learn the condition of your loved ones. Every day is a new hope... You kept pace with change but time is running out. The sun you do not see from the pollution, tries to illuminate the streets filled with zombies. The city does not want you... Are you eager enough to live and see your loved ones again?

Gameplay and Key Features:

- Post-apocalyptic atmosphere

- Story consists of 6 chapters

- Standard fps mechanics

- 17 different weapons to choose

- Run away or kill zombies

- Find the key to escape the city

- Action - thriller

- Based on a novel

- Option to play the story with pixel-based graphics for retro lovers

- Option to play Early Access TPS mode

Developer's Note:

The other stages of our project, which we continue to develop as an indie team, will be with you in the forthcoming years as books, series, movies, and animation.

Moreover, we are working on VR, iOS, and Android support as well as multiplayer adaptation of games.

summary.핵심플레이: 핵·화학 무기 폭발 이후 격리 구역에서 도시를 탈출하기 위해 열쇠를 찾고, 좀비를 피하거나 17종의 무기로 처치하며 진행한다. 표준적인 FPS 조작으로 6개 챕터의 스토리를 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 소설을 원작으로 한 포스트 아포칼립스 배경의 스토리 중심 게임으로, 픽셀 그래픽 모드와 얼리 액세스 TPS 모드를 선택해 플레이할 수 있다.

name: Rush to Adventure
input:
Rush to Adventure is a retro fantasy speedrunning adventure. Inspired by classic NES titles like Zelda, Mario and Castlevania. You awaken on the shore of a cursed island. Your only way off the island is to fight the monsters and lift the curse.
Exploration and action
The game is divided into two parts. You explore the non-linear island in a top-down view. This is where you talk to islanders, visit shops etc. The levels are played as a side-scrolling platformer. You must reach the end of the level or fight a boss to unlock more parts of the island.
Adventure and speedrunning
Slay monsters to gain xp and level up. Collect coins to buy items and weapons. At the end of each level you are scored and receive a rank. Play for the adventure or replay levels for better times and higher scores, to improve your rank.

- Highly replayable through ranking system and 4 difficulties

- 41 levels (6 types: fields, forest, cave, tower, graveyard and temple)

- 5 golem mini-bosses and 4 bosses

- 9 high quality retro NES style songs

- 14 different swords, shields and armors

- 4 attributes to level up (strength, health, stamina and speed)

- 3 unlockable abilities (Dive Attack, Power Attack and Sprint)

- 8-bit NES style graphics and gameplay

summary.핵심플레이: 탑다운 시점으로 비선형 섬을 탐험하며 주민과 대화하고 상점을 이용하고, 사이드스크롤 플랫포머 형식의 레벨을 진행해 끝까지 도달하거나 보스를 처치한다. 몬스터를 처치해 경험치를 얻고 레벨업하며, 코인을 모아 아이템과 무기를 구매한다.
summary.특징: NES 스타일의 8비트 그래픽과 음악을 사용하며, 레벨 클리어 후 점수와 랭크를 부여하는 랭킹 시스템으로 기록 단축을 노린 반복 플레이가 가능하다. 41개 레벨, 4단계 난이도, 골렘 미니 보스와 보스, 14종의 장비, 4가지 능력치, 3가지 해제형 능력을 포함한다.

name: Labyrinths of Atlantis
input:
Labyrinths of Atlantis will give you the opportunity to test your intuition. You will fall into a mysterious labyrinth. The labyrinth is far away in the ocean and you will have nothing to do to solve its mystery. Collect all the tips and arrange them in your head, you can leave the labyrinth. Check your patience and logic in this game.

Features:

1) Procedural generation of the labyrinth.

2) You will be assisted by a shotgun and a flashlight.

3) Mysterious and mean anomalies.

4) Beautiful setting.

5) Musical accompaniment.

summary.핵심플레이: 바다에 위치한 미로 속에서 단서를 모아 조합하며 미로를 빠져나가는 방법을 찾는다. 산탄총과 손전등을 활용하며 진행한다.
summary.특징: 미로가 절차적으로 생성되며, 미로 안에는 이상 현상이 존재한다. 배경음악이 함께 제공된다.

name: Axiel
input:
Axiel is a puzzle game where you control two characters, each moving along one axis - vertical or horizontal.



Control the characters' movement and interact with objects to complete each level.



There are no scoreboards or timers.

summary.핵심플레이: 두 캐릭터를 조작해 각각 수직축 또는 수평축을 따라 움직이며, 캐릭터 이동과 오브젝트 상호작용을 통해 각 레벨을 완료한다.
summary.특징: 각 캐릭터가 하나의 축으로만 이동하는 방식을 사용하며, 점수판이나 타이머가 없다.

name: Mr Rabbit's Jigsaw Puzzle
input:
Welcome to Mr. Rabbit’s Jigsaw Puzzle!

Mr. Rabbit has been very active recently releasing game after game and the newest addition to your collection of games for toddlers is this colourful puzzle game.

What can you expect from the game? Well it’s a puzzle game so it’s pretty straightforward. You start the application and you’re being presented with a wonderful photo of an animal which is being scrambled into puzzle. Every time you start to solve it it’s different as the puzzle are generated randomly. There are also different levels of difficulty so you can adjust it to your kid’s age and device size.

There also is a built in watch which measures the time from start to completion and the number of moves used to solve the puzzle.

Why solve puzzle? Puzzle are wonderful exercise for children as they improve attention focus and solving problems, finding matching elements and improving memory. All great things for your child’s development.

Mr. Rabbit’s Puzzle:

◆ Have over 20 beautiful photos of animals to use as basis for your puzzle.

◆ Adjustable difficulty level from simple basic puzzle to very hard and small pieces.

◆ Are completely random and allow solving same photos many times as the puzzle change every time.



Music credits:

"Divertimento K131", "Dreamy Flashback", "Nothing Broken", "Somewhere Sunny (ver 2)"

Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)

Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 3.0

summary.핵심플레이: 뒤섞인 동물 사진 조각을 맞춰 직소 퍼즐을 완성하며, 완성까지 걸린 시간과 이동 횟수가 측정된다.
summary.특징: 20종 이상의 동물 사진을 기반으로 하며 퍼즐 배치가 매번 무작위로 생성되어 같은 사진을 반복해 풀 수 있고, 아이 연령과 기기 크기에 맞춰 난이도를 조절할 수 있는 유아용 퍼즐 게임이다.

name: Titan Station
input:
Titan Station is a single-player first-person mystery set in a retro-sci fi universe.
Far into the future, in the year 1999: David, a systems operator, runs from his troubles by taking a job on a space station.
After arriving, his mundane work turns into a struggle for his very life as he makes a shocking discovery.
Escape all your troubles by taking a job at an isolated refueling depot.
Titan station is connected to Saturns moon Titan by an elevator and pipeline system.

summary.핵심플레이: 우주 정거장에 도착한 시스템 운영자 David로서 정거장을 탐색하며 사건과 발견을 통해 이야기를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 1999년 미래를 배경으로 한 레트로 SF 세계관을 다루며, 정거장은 엘리베이터와 파이프라인 시스템을 통해 토성의 위성 타이탄과 연결되어 있다.

name: Loop! Loop! Sushi
input:
🐾 ABOUT THIS GAME

Become the ultimate sushi chef for cats!
You run a revolving sushi restaurant that attracts all kinds of adorable feline customers.
But beware — if you fail to meet the daily sales target, your shop goes bankrupt!

🍣 Features

🔥 Programming-based Puzzle Cooking
Place sushi cards into condition and result blocks to create the most profitable programming loops.
Plan, simulate, and serve the perfect dishes tailored to each cat’s taste.

🌌 Puzzle on a Rotating Sushi Rail
Sushi plates move along a circular conveyor belt and are served to cats in sequence.
Place your sushi in the right order and position to deliver the perfect meal to the right customer.

🐱 Adorable Cat Customers
Loop! Loop! Sushi is visited by quirky and charming feline guests.
Enjoy their cute animations and reactions as they dine in your cosmic sushi bar!

🍲 Card Game Meets Puzzle Gameplay
Enjoy a familiar card-dragging system combined with fresh, logic-based puzzles.
Simple controls, but plenty of room for deep strategic thinking.

Are you ready to prove yourself as the galaxy’s greatest sushi chef?
The cats are hungry. The rail is turning. Let’s get cooking! 🐟🍣🔥

summary.핵심플레이: 스시 카드를 조건 블록과 결과 블록에 배치해 프로그래밍 루프를 만들고, 회전하는 컨베이어 벨트 위에 스시를 순서와 위치에 맞게 놓아 각 고양이 손님의 취향에 맞는 요리를 제공한다. 매일의 매출 목표를 달성하지 못하면 가게가 파산한다.
summary.특징: 카드 드래그 방식과 논리 기반 퍼즐을 결합했으며, 회전 스시 레일과 고양이 손님이 등장하는 세계관을 배경으로 한다.

name: FireFly
input:
PLOT
Natsume Hanabi, a girl suffering from autism and mild anxiety.

On the way to growth,
Parents divorced, grandmother passed away, villain’s coercion, sincere friendship, father’s care.
and finally, maybe she can find true love ?

Different decision, different endings.
How will her life be?

Key Features
1. A unique & non-combat story-driven experience
2. Classic RPG game elements
3. A touching story
4. Multiple endings

NOTICE!
This game dont have exciting shooting scenes, or H scenes. This is just a story about an ordinary girl with mild autism and anxiety. Therefore, this game may not be suitable for everyone.

The story touches on real-life issues and is mature in tone, so the game is may not intended for children. Some may even find some scenes in the game to be disturbing or upsetting.

Firefly is not a tranditional RPG game, it relies on atmosphere, and storytelling. The game has multiple endings where the player must rely on their past interactions to make the choice.

summary.핵심플레이: 자폐와 경미한 불안을 겪는 소녀 Natsume Hanabi의 이야기를 따라가며, 플레이어의 선택과 과거 상호작용에 따라 서사가 진행된다. 선택에 따라 여러 결말로 이어진다.
summary.특징: 전투가 없는 스토리 중심 게임으로 분위기와 서사에 의존하며, 부모의 이혼, 조부모의 죽음, 우정 등 현실적 주제를 성숙한 톤으로 다룬다. 고전 RPG 요소와 다중 결말을 포함한다.

name: EOPRISM
input: EOPRISM is the educational puzzler that Millennial & Gen Z gamers wished they grew up with. You'll shoot solutions at your foes and obstacles as you quickly solve mathematical expressions in our 3 available game modes.

summary.핵심플레이: 화면에 제시되는 수학식을 빠르게 풀어 그 해답을 적과 장애물에 발사하여 제거한다.
summary.특징: 교육용 퍼즐 게임으로 세 가지 게임 모드를 제공하며, 무료로 플레이할 수 있다.

name: Lucky Mark
input:
This is a sandbox game with role-playing elements, in which you become a young programmer. You move to the house of your boss, where the main events will take place.
The game consists of two parts:
INTRO - an introductory part in the form of a visual novel.
GAME - a sandbox and logical continuation of INTRO.

An incredibly challenging sandbox game! It will not be easy! Forget everything you've played before - and don't say you weren't warned!
A lot of stats that affect the game: hunger, physical attractiveness, education, imagination, lust, vigor, affection from other characters in the game and so on - you will have to try hard to keep them at the right level! A lot of explicit scenes will be revealed to you if you are persistent and persevering!

summary.핵심플레이: 젊은 프로그래머가 되어 상사의 집으로 이사한 뒤 그곳에서 벌어지는 사건을 진행하며, 허기·매력·교육·상상력·욕정·활력·다른 캐릭터의 호감도 등 여러 스탯을 관리한다.
summary.특징: 비주얼 노벨 형식의 도입부 INTRO와 그 연속인 샌드박스 파트 GAME 두 부분으로 구성되며, 조건을 충족하면 노골적인 장면이 등장한다.

name: GrigoriNightDragon
input:
GrigoriNightDragon

For the community join here for updates in new features

An open-world, story-driven RPG game set in the fantasy world of Elyria. Explore a realm brimming with quests, adventures, foes, secrets, and formidable dragons guarding each castle. With multiple endings, GrigoriNightDragon offers endless replayability and fun.

summary.핵심플레이: 판타지 세계 Elyria를 탐험하며 퀘스트와 모험을 수행하고 적 및 드래곤과 전투를 벌인다. 성마다 드래곤이 지키고 있어 이를 상대한다.
summary.특징: 오픈 월드 기반의 스토리 중심 RPG로, 여러 엔딩을 제공해 반복 플레이가 가능하다. 각 성을 지키는 드래곤과 세계 곳곳의 비밀 요소가 배치되어 있다.

name: Treasure of Barracuda
input:
A Point & Click Puzzle Adventure, exploring the Treasure of Barracuda, a real brick built puzzle box.
Find the treasures within using The Map, your Old Grandfathers Amulet, and Solve the Riddle!

Fully buildable and functional in real life as well!
Support now on Lego Ideas and this can become a real Lego set!

Includes Easy and Medium difficulties.
Hard difficulty unlocked when we reach 5000 supporters on Lego Ideas!

summary.핵심플레이: 지도와 할아버지의 부적을 사용해 벽돌로 만든 퍼즐 상자 내부를 탐색하고, 수수께끼를 풀어 보물을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 실제로 조립 가능한 브릭 퍼즐 상자를 소재로 하며, Easy와 Medium 난이도를 제공하고 Lego Ideas 지지자 5000명 달성 시 Hard 난이도가 잠금 해제된다.

name: Progetto Ustica
input:
Progetto Ustica is a serious game that aims at keeping alive the memory of one of the most tragic events in recent Italian history. It is a short exploratory experience created for PC/MAC and, soon, supporting Oculus Rift VR and HTC Vive.

Progetto Ustica recreates the main events of the 50 minutes flight of the ITAVIA DC9 shot down from the sky over the Tyrrhenian Sea at 8:58 PM on June 27, 1980. The project aims at keeping alive the memory of this event attracting also those who do not know anything about it.

Progetto Ustica benefits from the help of Daria Bonfietti and Andrea Benetti of the Associazione parenti delle vittime della strage di Ustica and from the support of Carlo Lucarelli and Bottega finzioni, whose students are working on the research and educational materials of the project.

Progetto Ustica puts the player inside the DC9 shortly after its take off, from a first person point of view. The player explores its cabin, interacts with objects and people, and finds several objects that unlock additional features:

- new points of view, freely selectable by the player, that show what is happening from the perspective of the military aircrafts, a radar vision that encompasses the whole scenario, a lone nocturnal fisherman watching the sky, and more;
- audio transcripts of that night radio communications, both between the DC9 and the control towers contacted during the flight and between military aircrafts and their control centers;
- contextual information on the military activity in the Tyrrhenian Sea, new hints on events of that night and on what followed: investigations, cover-ups, suspicious deaths, and more.

The player retraces the events of that night through multiple points of view, each one contributing to build a different path among several cameras.

Progetto Ustica is not intended as a scientifically accurate recreation of facts, or as an investigative game that aims at discovering the truth. Progetto Ustica is a game for memory. some details of the scenario are true, others are plausible. we leave the player the task to further research and not to forget.

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점으로 이륙 직후의 ITAVIA DC9 기내를 탐험하며 사물과 인물과 상호작용하고, 특정 오브젝트를 찾아 추가 요소를 해금한다. 군용기 시점, 레이더 시점, 야간 어부 시점 등 여러 시점을 오가며 그날 밤의 사건을 되짚는다.
summary.특징: 1980년 6월 27일 티레니아해 상공에서 격추된 ITAVIA DC9 항공기의 약 50분간 비행을 소재로 한 기억 보존 목적의 짧은 경험물이다. 그날 밤의 무선 교신 음성 기록과 군사 활동에 관한 맥락 정보, 이후 조사와 관련 정황을 제공하며 PC/MAC 및 추후 Oculus Rift, HTC Vive VR을 지원한다.

name: Golfie
input:
“Golfie is Slay the Spire meets Golf With Your Friends” - Lewis Brindley, Yogscast.

Golfie is a roguelike, deckbuilding minigolf game for 1-8 players. Each run requires strategy, planning, and skill. Build unique decks which will unlock incredible new ways to play, giving you the power to pull off some spectacular shots - or die trying.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 미니골프 코스를 공략하며 샷을 성공시키고, 매 플레이마다 전략과 계획을 세워 코스를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 카드로 덱을 구성해 새로운 플레이 방식을 잠금 해제하는 덱빌딩 시스템과 로그라이크 요소를 결합했으며, 1~8인 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Pro Cycling Manager 2015
input:
TAKE YOUR TEAM RIGHT TO THE TOP!

Become the sporting director of one of the pro cycling circuit's 90 teams, and compete in a thrilling 2015 season. Participate in over 200 competitions (550 stages) and the ultimate challenge: the prestigious Tour de France 2015 and its official route. Recruitment, personnel management, finances, contracts with riders and sponsors, training programs and the race calendar: leave nothing to chance. Your role will be equally important during the race, where every decision will be crucial in your bid for victory!

Embark on a season in Solo mode or organize online competitions against virtual managers around the world!

Pro Cycling Manager 2015 is packed with new features:

- Pro Cyclist: a new game mode where you create and control a cyclist from the start of his career and turn him into an international star!

- Career: a revised rider progress system, specific training programs, a more extensive scout management system and the opportunity to manage a reserve team!

- More realistic and strategic sprint sequences with the option to choose your sprinter’s preferred trajectory

- Even more meticulous graphics with richly detailed environments and a high-performance AI to make the action more challenging

- New interface and design of the menus and in the race

summary.핵심플레이: 프로 사이클링 팀 90개 중 하나의 스포팅 디렉터가 되어 선수 영입, 인사·재정 관리, 선수·스폰서 계약, 훈련 프로그램과 레이스 일정 등을 운영한다. 200개 이상의 대회와 550개 스테이지에 참가하며, 레이스 중에도 실시간으로 전략적 결정을 내린다.
summary.특징: 2015 시즌과 투르 드 프랑스 2015 공식 코스를 다룬다. 선수를 처음부터 육성하는 Pro Cyclist 모드, 개편된 선수 성장 및 스카우트·리저브 팀 관리 시스템, 주자의 주행 경로를 선택할 수 있는 스프린트 구간, 솔로 및 온라인 경쟁 모드를 제공한다.

name: Ballistic M.A.D.ness
input:
Ballistic M.A.D.ness is a casual aiming game with some strategy aspects. The goal of the game is to accumulate as many points as possible by blasting your enemies with thermonuclear warheads.

You shoot these warheads with a REALLY big gun: It is capable of blasting shells all the way to the other side of the planet!

And this is where it gets difficult, you need to set the gun to the correct heading, azimuth, and load it with the right amount of gunpowder such that your shells land on the targets.

As you progress in levels, the difficulty will increase, and the planets that you battle over will change in size and gravity which will affect the trajectory of your shells.

summary.핵심플레이: 대형 포를 조준해 열핵 탄두를 발사하고 적을 맞혀 점수를 쌓는다. 방위, 앙각, 화약량을 조절해 탄이 목표에 착탄하도록 조정한다.
summary.특징: 포탄이 행성 반대편까지 날아갈 수 있으며, 레벨이 진행될수록 행성의 크기와 중력이 달라져 탄도에 영향을 준다.

name: Yeli Orog
input:
Yeli Orog is a short atmospheric FMV game about an immense archaeological discovery: A bizarre stone tablet written in the Celtiberian language found buried underneath an ancient dolmen in northern Spain. The inscription written on the tablet tells a ghoulish tale believed to be the Celtiberian origin myth.



You play the role of Johnny Robin, an archaeologist sent to Asturias, Spain to assist in the recovery of Celtiberian remains. Upon arrival to Asturias you find yourself unexpectedly transported to an alien world, experiencing first-hand the terrifying story written on the ancient tablet.



If you are a fan of Myst-like games, interactive stories with puzzle elements, and FMV games, you will appreciate Yeli Orog.



Average play time: 1-2 hours. Please note that this game has a lot of reading in English. The reading is essential to understand the story, if you are not fluent in English you might not enjoy the game.

summary.핵심플레이: 고고학자 Johnny Robin이 되어 스페인 아스투리아스에서 켈트이베리아 유물 발굴을 돕던 중 낯선 세계로 이동해 이야기를 진행하며 퍼즐을 풀어나간다.
summary.특징: 스페인 북부의 고대 돌멘 아래에서 발견된 켈트이베리아어 석판과 그에 새겨진 기원 신화를 소재로 한 실사 영상 기반 인터랙티브 스토리로, 평균 플레이 시간은 1~2시간이며 영어 텍스트 읽기가 많다.

name: Potion island
input:
This is a game in which you will master the craft of cooking magical potions.You have many recipes and resources at your disposal. Process materials, create different potions and sell them.



Features:
