-Low poly graphics



-A variety of recipes and resources



-Good and measured gameplay

summary.핵심플레이: 재료를 가공하고 다양한 레시피에 따라 마법 물약을 제조한 뒤 판매한다.
summary.특징: 로우 폴리 그래픽으로 제작되었으며 여러 종류의 레시피와 자원을 제공한다.

name: Angrbotha Mountains
input:
"Demons and undeads roam the land they say..."
Imagine yourself being unwillingly caught in the fight between your world and the evil god Nemurtviya. The evil god has been trying to enter the world once more, and this time, he intends to stay and rule a desolate world forever. Forces of good have spent a long time keeping him away but have forgotten the weapons and alliances that stopped him hundreds of years ago. In this situation, you hear rumors in the inns that demons and undeads roam the land. Evil cults are popping up everywhere. And you need to take your blacksmithing supplies to Fallegthorp as usual. To get there you cross the Angrbotha mountains as usual. This is where the adventure begins.

Angrbotha Mountains, an adventure RPG game that immerses you in a dark story and cinematic experience. It is a short cinematic, story-driven adventure RPG game. Regard it as a short solo RPG session with a game master. Levelling up, meet wandering creatures, putting the story together, making choices, exploring and finding items are important parts to put the events to rest. Sneak up on enemies and make kills in one hit if successful, so called Assasination mode.

In Angrbotha Mountains you will take on the role of a hero on a quest to uncover the truth about the past and stop the terrifying from happening. The game is short but packs an intense punch with its storyline and cinematic elements.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공이 되어 이야기를 진행하며 레벨업, 아이템 탐색과 발견, 선택을 통해 사건을 풀어나간다. 적을 몰래 접근해 성공 시 한 방에 처치하는 암살 모드를 사용할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 악신 Nemurtviya의 재림을 막는 다크한 스토리를 다루며, 대장장이 물품을 Fallegthorp로 옮기기 위해 Angrbotha 산맥을 건너는 여정에서 시작된다. 게임 마스터와 함께하는 짧은 솔로 RPG 세션처럼 구성된 시네마틱 스토리 중심의 단편 게임이다.

name: Shennong: Taste of Illusion
input:
About this VR Animation?
Shennong:Taste of Illusion is Pinta studios' second VR animation. (The first one is 'The Dream Collector')

In this work, we hope to create an unprecedented environment in ancient China through VR, with a strong sense of immersion in multiple illusions and an exciting action play.
I believe this is a very interesting VR film experience.
Fortunately, the film has also been nominated and shown at dozens of festivals, including the Venice Film Festival, the raindance Film Festival and the Kaohsiung Film Festival.

Story of this VR Animation
In ancient times, Shennong explores the forest deep in the valley to collect unknown plants with unique tastes and effects. A glamorous flower seduces Shennong and he is poisoned by tasting the petal. Shennong falls in illusion as the flower turns into a mythical beast, which torches Shennong to his last breath. In the despairing darkness, Shennong is revived by a secret friend. With the awakening superpower, he conquers the beast, breaks the illusion and acquires another valuable plant.

About 'Shennong'
Shennong is a mythical sage ruler of prehistoric China, the God-King of Chinese medicine and agriculture, who tests a hundred varieties of herbs with his holy red whip, tastes them all, encounters seventy poison in one day, knows the properties of all plants and finally catalogs of 365 species of medicinal plants into a book, "Shennong's Classic of Herbal Medicine".

summary.핵심플레이: 관람자는 VR 환경에서 신농이 계곡 속 숲을 탐험하고 미지의 식물을 채집하는 과정을 따라가며, 환상 속에서 벌어지는 액션 장면을 체험한다.
summary.특징: 고대 중국을 배경으로 신농이 꽃의 독에 중독되어 환상에 빠지고 신화적 야수와 맞서 이를 극복하는 이야기를 다룬다. Pinta Studios의 두 번째 VR 애니메이션으로, 베니스 영화제 등 여러 영화제에 노미네이트되어 상영되었다.

name: Pumpkin's Revenge
input:
Embark on an Epic Adventure with the Pumpkin-Head Hero. Step into the shoes of the Pumpkin-Head, a seasoned adventurer with a glowing gaze that pierces through the darkest dungeons. Armed with a trusty pumpkin mace, smash through skeletal warriors, outmaneuver goblins, and face off against a fire-breathing dragon. As you conquer each dungeon, collect valuable loot and become a legendary beacon of hope in a world overrun by monstrous creatures.
Gameplay

Choose Your Path Wisely. Navigate through treacherous dungeons by selecting hex grids to move forward. Every step matters as you clear paths, collect items, and prepare for battles. Encounter monsters and bosses that will test your skills and strategy. Each enemy you face has a unique attack value, challenging you to balance offense and defense.

Dynamic Combat and Strategy

Hexgrid Movement: Plan your moves on a hexagonal grid to outsmart enemies and uncover hidden treasures.

Diverse Enemies: Face various foes that can poison, blind, or overpower you. Beware of powerful bosses that guard the deepest parts of the dungeons.

Unique Items: Combine rare items, each offering distinctive powers to enhance your gameplay.

summary.핵심플레이: 육각형 그리드에서 이동 경로를 선택해 던전을 탐험하며, 스켈레톤·고블린·드래곤 등 고유한 공격 수치를 가진 적과 보스를 상대로 전투를 벌이고 아이템과 전리품을 수집한다.
summary.특징: 펌킨 헤드 캐릭터가 호박 메이스를 사용하며, 독·실명 등 상태 효과를 가진 적과 조합 가능한 희귀 아이템 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Ace Attorney Investigations Collection
input:
Experience both Ace Attorney Investigations games in one gorgeous collection! Step into the shoes of Miles Edgeworth, that prosecutor of prosecutors from the Ace Attorney mainline games!

Leave the courtroom behind as you walk with Edgeworth around the crime scene, gathering evidence and clues and talking with persons of interest. Use your wit and what you discover to solve tough, intriguing cases through logic and deduction.

- Both games have been given the full HD treatment, including all-new designs for the chibi characters! Classic pixel art style is also available for a more retro vibe!

- Quality of life improvements including Chapter Select have been added, making it a breeze to replay your favorite parts!

- Autoplay and Story Mode have also been added. Autoplay will progress the dialogue for you, while Story Mode will solve even the toughest puzzles on your behalf -- perfect for those who just want to sit back and enjoy a good mystery!
*You can turn Story Mode on and off at any time.

- A Gallery section packed with bonus materials that are sure to please is also included! View in-game illustrations and character animations along with character design sketches and more! Listen to the background music of each game or bask in the beauty of some orchestral arrangements!

- Play the games in English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, and Simplified Chinese!

summary.핵심플레이: 검사 Miles Edgeworth가 되어 범죄 현장을 돌아다니며 증거와 단서를 수집하고 관련 인물과 대화한다. 수집한 정보를 바탕으로 논리와 추리를 통해 사건을 해결한다.
summary.특징: Ace Attorney Investigations 두 편을 한데 모은 컬렉션으로, HD로 새로 그린 캐릭터 디자인과 클래식 픽셀 아트 스타일을 선택할 수 있다. 챕터 선택, 대사를 자동 진행하는 오토플레이, 퍼즐을 대신 풀어주는 스토리 모드, 일러스트·음악 등을 모은 갤러리를 제공하며 한국어를 포함한 여러 언어를 지원한다.

name: Tiny Monster Haven
input:
Tiny Monster Haven is an idle creature collector that sits on the side of your screen allowing you to go about your day while having cute monster companions roaming around.

Choose your Starter:
Take on your role as monster caretaker by hatching your first monster companion.

Grow crops:

Plant various types of crops and watch them grow while you play with your monsters. Once they're ready you can harvest and feed them to your monsters to improve their stats!

Cook delicious meals:

Spoil your monsters by cooking them a variety of tasty snacks and meals! These delightful treats will further boost and level-up your monster's skills, making them more effective in combat. Each meal will boost different stats.

summary.핵심플레이: 몬스터 알을 부화시켜 동료 몬스터를 수집하고, 작물을 심고 수확해 몬스터에게 먹여 능력치를 올린다. 다양한 음식을 요리해 몬스터의 스킬을 강화하고 레벨을 높인다.
summary.특징: 화면 한쪽에 배치되어 다른 활동을 하는 동안에도 몬스터들이 돌아다니는 방치형 구조이며, 음식마다 서로 다른 능력치를 향상시킨다.

name: Anamorphine
input:
Wishlist our new game

About the Game

Explore the past as you resolve the present in Anamorphine, a surreal adventure of rendered emotions.

Discover what it feels like to lose your grip on reality as you inch closer to the darkest corner of your mind. Anamorphine’s narrative comes together through Tyler’s dream-like memories, contorting and bleeding into each other as his mental state changes. Ideal for environmental exploration and contemplation, the story is told with no dialogue or action button.

Will you confront the past and try to find a way to move on, or will you let it consume you?
Featuring

- A story-rich setting exploring an evolving relationship.

- A surreal environment without text or language that changes in fantastic ways to represent the protagonist's feelings.

- Exploration gameplay that resonates with hardcore and new gamers alike. Take your time to uncover secrets and focus on the experience.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Tyler의 꿈 같은 기억으로 구성된 환경을 탐험하며 과거를 되짚고 이야기를 진행한다. 대사나 액션 버튼 없이 환경 탐색과 관찰을 통해 서사를 따라간다.
summary.특징: 주인공의 정신 상태 변화에 따라 기억이 뒤틀리고 서로 뒤섞이는 초현실적 연출을 사용하며, 텍스트나 언어 없이 관계의 변화를 다루는 서사 중심 구성을 갖는다.

name: Corkscrew
input:
CORKSCREW: THE ONLY GAME OF IT'S KIND.

Have you ever found a game with all of the following:

-
Randomly Generated Level Layouts, for a fresh dynamic game every time you want another round!

-
HD Artstyle, reminiscent of a cartoon or anime, giving a genre that is usually Pixel-Art a lick of fresh paint.

-
Momentum-Based Physics, the player is capable of going as fast as you are willing to make it go! The physics are reminiscent of another game series with a fast main character.

-
Crass Humour, with or without voice acting (#knowingsmile), the expressions and actions of the characters along will be enough to get a giggle or 2 out of you!

CORKSCREW sets you in Rural England in the year 2019, where you play as a young 10 year old lad who's work is rudely interrupted by a weird kid from his school (he's the guy in the game with a cat-face stuck to his face like a mask, dodgy guy lmao), who has used the power of evil (and having a fetish) to take over his small nation! And getting under the young lad's skin by taking the one thing he loves the most, his Cash! The Player must traverse the levels to not only grab back his cash, but to give this weird kid a right walloping!

summary.핵심플레이: 10세 소년 캐릭터를 조작해 무작위로 생성되는 레벨을 통과하며, 빼앗긴 돈을 되찾는 것이 목표다. 모멘텀 기반 물리로 빠른 이동이 가능하다.
summary.특징: 2019년 잉글랜드 시골을 배경으로, 고양이 가면을 쓴 아이가 마을을 장악한다는 설정을 다룬다. 픽셀아트 대신 카툰·애니메이션풍의 HD 아트스타일을 사용하며, 음성 지원을 켜거나 끌 수 있는 저속한 유머 요소가 포함된다.

name: Hacked: Hentai prison

summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점의 미로를 탐색하며 감옥에서 탈출하는 것을 목표로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 1990년대 분위기의 올드스쿨 디자인과 각 레벨마다 다른 음악을 사용하며, 헨타이 요소와 이진 코드로 세계를 인식하는 설정을 담고 있다.

name: Legend of the Tetrarchs
input:
The holy sword that sealed away an ominous power has been drawn out and darkness starts to spill out across the land, mutating people into monsters. The four Tetrarch heroes of ancient times will meet a new band of brave warriors to slash through the darkness with the light of courage! What will they find beyond the chaos?



This is a full-fledged fantasy RPG with thrilling turn-based battles. Throw yourself into command battles with up to 10 allies and your own strategy using skill sets. The beautiful pixel animation and art aren't just present in combats but also while you adventure around the expansive openworld or dungeons! Go on treasure hunting to boost your status, take on side quests and speed up battles to become the legendary new hero! A grand fantasy tale is ready for you to save the world!

summary.핵심플레이: 최대 10명의 아군을 지휘하며 스킬 세트를 활용한 턴제 전투를 진행한다. 오픈 월드와 던전을 탐험하고 보물찾기, 사이드 퀘스트를 수행해 캐릭터의 능력치를 강화한다.
summary.특징: 봉인된 성검이 뽑혀 어둠이 퍼지고 사람들이 몬스터로 변하는 판타지 세계관을 배경으로 한다. 전투와 탐험 전반에 픽셀 애니메이션과 아트가 사용되며, 전투 속도 조절 기능을 제공한다.

name: Call of Sentinels
input: Prepare to enter a world of epic battles, diverse characters, and an endless flow of action in Call of Sentinels! This fast-paced bullet hell arena shooter will test your reflexes and strategic skills as you fight your way through hordes of enemies and powerful bosses. Think of it like a fusion of Hades' strategic depth and Crimsonland's frenetic combat, but with a Vampire Survivors twist that lets you unleash a whirlwind of abilities and customize your build to an extreme.

summary.핵심플레이: 아레나에서 다수의 적과 보스를 상대로 전투를 벌이며, 능력을 사용하고 빌드를 커스터마이징해 진행한다.
summary.특징: 탄막 슈팅과 로그라이트식 빌드 구성 요소를 결합했으며, Hades, Crimsonland, Vampire Survivors의 요소를 참고한 아레나 슈터다.

name: Kawanakajima no Kassen
input:
To commemorate Kou Shibusawa's 35th anniversary, the "Kou Shibusawa Archives" will be opened in the Steam Store. Here we will revive popular previously released titles.



In this tenth round of releases, we offer the first game developed and sold (10/26/1981) by Kou Shibusawa, "Kanakawajima no Kassen."

It is a Strategy simulation game. Players become Shingen Takeda and clash with Kenshin Uesugi at Kawanakajima in an attempt to wipe out his rival.

Players can try two different game modes. The "Original mode" has remained faithful to the original release as much as possible, while the "Remake mode" has redone graphics and controls to allow for easier play.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 다케다 신겐이 되어 가와나카지마에서 우에스기 겐신과 맞서 싸우며 상대를 격파하는 것을 목표로 한다.
summary.특징: 1981년 발매된 코에이 시부사와 코우의 첫 개발·판매 작품으로, 원작을 최대한 유지한 '오리지널 모드'와 그래픽·조작을 개선한 '리메이크 모드' 두 가지를 제공한다.

name: Sumo Seals
input:
Sumo Seals is the perfect game for players who like to be dropped right into the heart of the action and revel in the chaos of the unpredictable. Solo or with friends, the game includes various modes and maps to cater to players of all skill level and preferred gameplay styles. From sports modes where teamplay is crucial to protecting seal pups against waves of grime for cooperative play, there is something for everyone. No need to grind endlessly for unlockables, Sumo Seals lays everything on the table the first time you boot up the game.

Solo & Local Multiplayer/Coop

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 솔로 또는 여러 명이 함께 다양한 모드와 맵에서 플레이하며, 팀플레이가 중요한 스포츠 모드나 물밀듯 밀려오는 오염물로부터 새끼 물개를 지키는 협동 모드 등을 즐긴다.
summary.특징: 솔로 및 로컬 멀티플레이/협동 플레이를 지원하며, 언락 요소를 반복 파밍할 필요 없이 처음 게임을 실행할 때부터 모든 콘텐츠가 제공된다.

name: Grand Casino Tycoon
input:
Welcome to Vegas! Grand Casino Tycoon is a fresh and colorful tycoon with unique puzzle elements. Design stunning casinos and lure in your guests by building what they love: Slots, gambling tables, buffets, bars, and yes, even toilets. But you can’t always pick your neighborhood…

Different gambler types have different, sometimes opposite demands! Find out what your gamblers like:
1) Analyse their routine.
2) Craft a strategy to separate them by manipulating their decisions, lure them into different parts of your casino and make them enjoy their night out. It’s great, manipulate!
3) Keep them separated ;)
4) Fill your own pockets and profit, profit, profit!
(You can even charge your guests for using the toilet. Consider this a valid option for point 4.)

summary.핵심플레이: 슬롯머신, 도박 테이블, 뷔페, 바, 화장실 등을 배치해 카지노를 설계하고 손님을 끌어들인다. 손님들의 동선을 분석하고 그들의 결정을 조작해 원하는 구역으로 유도하며 수익을 낸다.
summary.특징: 라스베이거스를 배경으로 한 카지노 운영 게임으로, 서로 다른(때로는 상반된) 요구를 가진 여러 도박꾼 유형을 분리·관리하는 퍼즐 요소가 포함되어 있다.

name: Colorful Colore
input:
Colorful Colore is a Puzzle Labyrinth game, where your goal is to reach the exit while matching the right colors in the room and interacting with different mechanics.

Features

- 50 Different levels.

- Various mechanics.

- 3 Colors for you to match!

summary.핵심플레이: 미로 형태의 방에서 색을 맞추고 다양한 장치와 상호작용하며 출구에 도달하는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 50개의 레벨과 여러 종류의 장치가 있으며, 3가지 색을 맞추는 방식으로 진행된다.

name: Lighter
input:
受到诅咒生命只剩下七天却依然心大的少女；

心高气傲身份不明同样寿命只剩七天的黑猫；

她们要在七天之内解决一名问题少女的恋爱问题才能保住自己的性命。



一者是疯狂的富家大小姐；一者是精神不稳定的灾后幸存者；一者是忽近忽远的观测者；



性格扭曲的她们究竟想要什么？



一人一猫又该如何解决这场困境？



“别开玩笑了好吗？这简直就是keter级别的游戏啊！你给个痛快点的不行吗？”少女不爽的说道。

“大姐！！你别放弃啊!!你想死我可不想死啊！”黑猫使劲抱住少女的大腿，哭丧着脸喊道。

summary.핵심플레이: 저주로 생명이 7일 남은 소녀와 흑묘가 되어, 일주일 안에 한 소녀의 연애 문제를 해결해 자신들의 목숨을 지키는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 부잣집 아가씨, 재난 생존자, 관측자 등 성격이 뒤틀린 인물들이 등장하며, 소녀와 흑묘의 대화를 중심으로 이야기가 전개된다.

name: AQK
input:
"AQK" is a job interview simulation game where you, a job seeker, face off against a series of eccentric interviewers in pursuit of that coveted job offer.

In this game, you’ll face off against a cast of quirky interviewers who seem to have made it their mission to ask the most mind-bending questions possible..

Features

The core gameplay involves answering interview questions within a time limit.

However, as time passes, your available response options may decrease—or even increase—depending on the situation.

Additionally, the interviewers’ reactions may change based on your timing and choices.

How you answer—and when you answer—will be the key to landing the job.

summary.핵심플레이: 구직자가 되어 제한 시간 안에 면접관의 질문에 답변을 선택한다. 시간이 지남에 따라 선택 가능한 답변 옵션이 줄거나 늘어나기도 한다.
summary.특징: 다양한 성격의 면접관과 면접을 진행하는 취업 면접 시뮬레이션으로, 답변 내용과 답변 타이밍에 따라 면접관의 반응이 달라진다.

name: RESEQUENCED
input:
While investigating the mysterious disappearance of her parents, a college student's DNA is modified.



RE*SEQUENCED is a 3D open-world adventure game focused on story, exploration and combat. You play as Lux Hart, a college student who travels to her parents' rural home during summer break, only to find them missing. While investigating their disappearance, she uncovers their connection with the mysterious underground agency The Redaction Commission. Using alien tech acquired by the Commission, her DNA is edited and resequenced, arming her with extraordinary abilities.



Here are some of the mechanics and features of the game:



* Lux can fight with DNA mods, which are essentially superpowers that are grouped into four classes: Incinerate, Freeze, Shock and Invoke.



* She can also use guns. At present, there are eight gun types defined.



* Guns can be upgraded using weapon parts, which can be looted from fallen enemies, and found in crates placed throughout the game. Six weapon attributes can be upgraded, including damage, reload speed, range, etc.



* Lux gains skill points as she levels up. These can be spent to customise her abilities; e.g. permanently increase her overall health, reduce the cooldown time of her DNA mods, etc.



* Lux’s outfits (and hair) can be changed. There are over 800 different clothing and hair items in the game, so it's easy to customise Lux to a unique look.



* Collectibles are scattered across each level. There are almost 100 collectible items in the game, such as documents, audio files, etc. In addition, consumable items such as medkits and shield energy packs can be found near combat areas.



* Each level contains tasks (e.g. "remove propaganda posters") which can be used to earn XP. Lux can also earn XP by completing challenges (e.g. "kill 10 enemies with the sniper rifle").



* There are a huge variety of enemies. We won’t spoil the journey here, but once you get into the story, you’ll understand why there are so many different creatures from mythology, urban legends and horror that actually exist in the game.



* The game has 12 distinctly different environments, including a deserted nuclear testing facility, a derelict Chinese spacecraft, a post-apocalyptic town, a middle Eastern desert, underground caves, snowfields, and more.



All of the above features are already implemented and running in the game right now. We have a lot of ideas about what we’d like to add, but we’d love to get feedback from the gaming community!



RE*SEQUENCED is available now on Windows and Mac.

summary.핵심플레이: 대학생 Lux Hart를 조작해 오픈월드를 탐험하며, DNA 개조로 얻은 능력과 총기를 사용해 적과 전투한다. 레벨업으로 얻은 스킬 포인트로 능력을 강화하고, 무기 부품으로 총기를 업그레이드하며 임무와 도전 과제를 수행해 경험치를 얻는다.
summary.특징: 실종된 부모를 조사하던 중 외계 기술로 DNA가 재배열되어 Incinerate, Freeze, Shock, Invoke 네 계열의 능력을 사용한다. 8종의 총기와 800여 종의 의상·헤어 커스터마이징, 100여 개의 수집품, 핵실험 시설·폐우주선·사막·설원 등 12개 환경이 포함되며 신화와 도시전설, 호러에서 유래한 다양한 적이 등장한다.

name: 翔太の毕业季
input:
Game description:
The male protagonist, Shota, is a college student who is about to enter the workplace, and he decides to do a workplace internship before graduation. I hope to gain more experience and growth through internships. During his internship, he met his colleague Narisse, who is a business expert in the company and is extremely serious and responsible for her work.
At the same time, Shota has a very close relationship with his classmates who have always adored him at school, and they help each other complete their graduation homework.
Throughout the story, many conversations and interactions take place between Shota and his friends, and their previous relationship becomes closer through the development of the plot.
One day, Shota heard that there were always some strange sounds in the school building at night, which made the students feel strange and uneasy, what caused it? Shota decided to find out for himself.

Game elements

Storyline
Modern background
Novel content
Multiple endings
Players interact with the protagonist to communicate with company colleagues, school classmates, etc., and interact to complete the main story progression
The story has few missions and a simple plot, defeating the witch to win the game!
The game is available in both Japanese and Chinese languages, and players can switch between settings and switch running modes

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Shota가 되어 회사 동료와 학교 친구들과 대화하고 상호작용하며 스토리를 진행한다. 학교 건물에서 들리는 이상한 소리의 원인을 조사하는 것이 주된 목표다.
summary.특징: 현대를 배경으로 한 스토리 중심 노벨 게임으로 여러 결말이 존재한다. 일본어와 중국어를 지원하며 설정에서 언어와 실행 모드를 전환할 수 있다.

name: Dynasty Game 2
input:
游戏核心玩法：大地图操作，种田、纳贤、治理、造物、贸易、建军、攻城略地、坚守要隘保一方平安。首发版本包含了六个历史剧本，包括秦末·楚汉之争、汉武帝·开疆拓土、三国·群雄割据、三国·袁术称帝、三国·赤壁之战、五胡十六国。

游戏地图十分宏大，东至日本，西至中亚咸海，北至贝加尔湖，南至爪哇；

➊ 美术立绘和界面UI

➋ 上帝视角的大地图

地图充分考虑了江河山川分布和州郡【省、府】的边界。每一个城市都有所属的郡和州，郡有郡治(主城)，州有州治(省会)。占领了郡治才可以征收郡内的矿产，占领了州治才能有效征收州内赋税。有城廓的城市，只有城门可以进出部队，城门的性质相当于关口。在城市界面可以选择城门的防御模式。如重点防御某个门，或者平均防御。系统会根据防御方针，在执行时调配各个城门的兵力。

➌ 产品的生产与经营贩售系统

我们把全部生产设定为“官营”方式，就是官家负责所有生产工人的工资，所产产品全归官家自由使用或出售。所以跑商、组建军队、送礼及生产环境调用材料，都无需支付费用。跑商是获得收入的重要途径，由于现在所有商品属于官家，所以商队的意义在于运输产品到其他地方的市场。但由于商品种类繁多，有些需要，有些可售，所以新增了商品待售区。在待售区里面的商品，商队和军师都可以随意变卖。

➍ 官僚体系、爵位体系及内政影响

封官可称为“成体系”了。首先是分文官、武职和爵位，每个人物都可以同时拥有三类各一。郡侯可以封郡侯及以下的官职，官职有上下级体系，必须上级有人，下级才能封。官位对行政的方方面面都有影响，可以大大方便内政操作和促进施政效果。另外就是体系，如每个势力等级都拥有相应的官职图，如孙坚的【郡侯】：

➎ 城市、名胜扩建以及长城与驰道的修建，获得更多的资源和产能

➏ 闭环平衡的经济运行模式，核心原则是货币是流通的，不会凭空出现，不会凭空消失。当游戏开局，官府的钱和城市民间的钱，就是所有的流通货币。官府库金通过工资俸禄建设军饷等流向民间，民间金钱通过税赋购买等回流到官库，形成经济循环。玩家可以通过找到金银矿铸币，外贸出口等方式加大货币量，从而扩大经济规模。

➐ 完善的数据统计，每年的经济规模、人口、农业、官员政绩、将帅战绩都有完善统计。

➑ 战斗系统、单挑系统、攻城系统；

➒ 自定义人物，自创势力开局；

➓ 游戏机制很多，其宗旨是为了完全模拟中国古代的社会运作，除上述机制外，还有祭祀、司法、人才选拔、议政朝会、驿站漕运系统、科技研发、外交等多方面。适合喜欢治国理政种田开疆的玩家。

summary.핵심플레이: 대형 지도에서 도시와 영토를 점령하고 농업·인재 등용·통치·생산·무역·건설·축성을 수행하며 세력을 운영한다. 상단(무역)으로 생산품을 다른 지역 시장으로 운송해 수익을 얻고 군대를 편성해 공성전과 요충지 방어를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 동쪽 일본, 서쪽 중앙아시아 아랄해, 북쪽 바이칼호, 남쪽 자바에 이르는 지도와 진말 초한쟁패, 한무제, 삼국, 오호십육국 등 여섯 개 역사 시나리오를 제공한다. 문관·무직·작위로 나뉜 관료·작위 체계, 화폐가 관부와 민간을 순환하는 폐쇄형 경제 모델, 제사·사법·인재 선발·조회·역참 조운·기술 연구·외교 등 고대 중국 사회 운영을 모사하는 시스템을 갖췄다.

name: The Monster PIMP
input:
[Story]
He wasn't very popular with the ladies...
But he had a special power...

He can see monsters that
others can't!

With supernatural events happening around town,
he decides to use his abilities to find the monsters in hiding...!

[Game system]
Taking out the Evil Spirits
Take out the 60+ Evil Spirits lurking around the world!
Fight them using an orthodox turn-based fighting system.

Monsters
- Nekomata
- Ittan-momen
- Water Imp
and many more!
Try to find them all!
Use special items at certain fights to unlock hidden events...!

summary.핵심플레이: 마을에 숨어 있는 60종 이상의 악령을 찾아내고, 정통 턴제 전투 시스템으로 전투를 벌인다. 특정 전투에서는 특수 아이템을 사용해 숨겨진 이벤트를 해금한다.
summary.특징: 다른 사람에게 보이지 않는 몬스터를 볼 수 있는 능력을 가진 주인공이 마을의 초자연적 사건을 조사한다. 네코마타, 잇탄모멘, 갓파 등 다양한 요괴가 등장한다.

name: Trophy Truck Racing Tour
input:
Can you become the best driver on the Trophy Truck Racing Tour?  Battle against other drivers at several different off-road dirt tracks and experience what it's like to drive one of the most intense off-road trucks ever built.  Master each track and post the best lap time to secure your reputation as one of the best drivers!

Trophy Truck Racing Tour:

Take to the track against a full field of drivers and battle for every position in every corner.  Slide around and try different racing lines to move forward through the field of trucks.

Someone holding you up?  No problem, because these heavy-built trophy trucks can handle a few bumps and scrapes.  Knock your opponents out of the way and test your abilities behind the wheel as you master various off-road tracks.

Online Trials:

Battle against the clock and post the best lap time while competing on the Steam Leaderboards.  Every tenth of a second could make a difference as you try to secure your reputation as one of the best drivers.

Customization:

Customize your Trophy Truck Racing Experience by choosing your number and livery.  Customize the length of your racing sessions and choose from several intense off-road dirt tracks that will test your abilities.

Steam Integration:

-
Steam Leaderboards

-
Steam Achievements

Additional Information:

Controllers and Gamepads are supported for driving controls.

summary.핵심플레이: 오프로드 트로피 트럭을 몰고 여러 흙길 트랙에서 다른 드라이버들과 순위를 다투며 주행하고, 코너마다 라인을 조절하고 상대를 밀어내며 앞서 나간다. 온라인 트라이얼 모드에서는 랩 타임 기록에 도전한다.
summary.특징: 트럭 번호와 리버리를 선택하는 커스터마이징과 세션 길이 및 트랙 선택 기능을 제공하며, Steam 리더보드와 도전 과제를 지원한다. 컨트롤러와 게임패드로 조작할 수 있다.

name: The Idle
input:
The Idle is the absolute version of all idle clicker games brought together. Infinite possibilities, infinite gameplay, infinite fun.
CLICKS OR GENERATORS
Choose the way you prefer more to generate income. Or use both of them simultaneously. No limits!
CURRENCIES AND POSSIBILITIES
Earn seven different currencies that can be exchanged between each other. Each currency can be used to buy specific upgrades.
INTEREST AND RISKY INCOME
Invest your funds into stable interest profit or take the risk and use a bets system to get a jackpot instantly!
ULTIMATE PRESTIGE
You can buy prestige upgrades almost for everything. Don't limit yourself choosing between two or more options. Just buy them all!
PERKS AND SUPER UPGRADES
Enormous amount of perks is available to boost your income. Buy special super upgrades that change the whole game!
ACHIEVEMENTS AND CHALLENGES
Try to collect all one hundred achievements and sooner or later complete the game.
SETUP YOUR OWN LOOK
Choose between dark and light theme, change in-game fonts and many more!

The Idle offers endless possibilities and fun. Try it now and see for yourself!

summary.핵심플레이: 클릭 또는 자동 생성기를 이용해 수익을 만들고, 그 재화로 업그레이드를 구매하며 진행한다. 안정적인 이자 투자나 베팅 시스템을 통한 위험 수익을 선택할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 서로 교환 가능한 7종의 재화와 다양한 프레스티지 업그레이드, 퍼크, 게임 전반을 바꾸는 슈퍼 업그레이드를 제공하며, 100개의 도전 과제와 다크·라이트 테마 및 폰트 등 외형 설정을 지원한다.

name: Fatal Passion: Art Prison Collector's Edition
input:
One man's art is another man's prison. An eccentric artist's creations have sprung to life, and they're terrorizing a small town. And it just happens to be the day the love of his life marries another man. Can you beat the painted traps and find the missing bride and groom in this exciting new hidden-object adventure story? Find out in Fatal Passion: Art Prison!



This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won't find in the standard version. The Collector's Edition includes:



Bonus Chapter

Strategy Guide

Collectables

Achievements

Mini-games

summary.핵심플레이: 작은 마을을 배경으로 숨은 오브젝트를 찾고 미니게임과 함정을 풀어나가며 실종된 신부와 신랑을 추적한다.
summary.특징: 창작물이 살아나 마을을 위협하는 예술가의 이야기를 다루며, 컬렉터스 에디션에는 보너스 챕터, 전략 가이드, 수집품, 도전과제, 미니게임이 포함된다.

name: The Indomitable Rocket Dog
input:
Welcome to the Good Dog Club. Bark fast and bark strong. Rocket jump your way through increasingly difficult levels and don't let anything slow you down.

The Indomitable Rocket Dog is a fast paced, physics-based, 2D platformer time-trial game. Use your rockets to propel yourself through each area as fast as you can and earn a perfect rank on each level.

Inspired by games like N++, Neon White, & Sonic, you'll have to master your physics and momentum to get perfect times.

The game includes a full level editor & leaderboards with the ability to watch world-record runs. It is currently under development and will hopefully release in 2026!

summary.핵심플레이: 로켓 점프로 캐릭터를 추진시켜 각 구간을 빠르게 통과하며, 레벨마다 최대한 짧은 기록으로 완벽 등급을 노리는 타임 트라이얼 방식이다.
summary.특징: 물리 기반 이동과 관성을 활용하는 2D 플랫포머로, 레벨 에디터와 리더보드를 제공하며 세계 기록 주행을 관전할 수 있다. 현재 개발 중이며 2026년 출시 예정이다.

name: Fight Club - All Stars
input:
Kick enemies & knock them out of the arena in this funny fighting simulator!

You’re on the top of the roof or on the island or on the boat. What will you do?

Kick, punch, knockout — fight for the survival of course!

There's only room for one fighter in this ring. So take it!



Features:

● Single player mode

● Local multiplayer co-operative

● Local multiplayer up to 4 local players



● Kick them all - make them fall!

● Kick them hard - make them fart!

● Punch the head - no regret!

● Shout loud - amuse crowd!



Choose characters to play:

● Kids ● Hyper-Casual ● Cuboids ● "I, The One"

● Mini Fighters ● Real Fighters ● Dogs

● Musculans ● Papers



Choose your favorite fight style:

● Street Fighter ● Capoeira ● Karate

● Boxing ● Jeet Kune Do ● Pub Fighter

● Muay Thai ● Kung-Fu



Additional Notes:

● Controller is highly recommended.

● Controllers are required for 2-4 players.

summary.핵심플레이: 발차기와 주먹으로 상대를 공격해 아레나 밖으로 떨어뜨리는 격투를 진행한다. 지붕, 섬, 보트 등 여러 무대에서 마지막까지 살아남는 것이 목표다.
summary.특징: 싱글 플레이와 최대 4인 로컬 멀티플레이를 지원하며, Kids, Cuboids, Dogs 등 여러 캐릭터와 스트리트 파이터, 카포에라, 무에타이 등 다양한 격투 스타일을 선택할 수 있다. 2인 이상 플레이 시 컨트롤러가 필요하다.

name: Brothers of The Three Kingdoms
input:
"Brothers of The Three Kingdoms" is a top-down action roguelike where players take on the role of legendary warriors from the Three Kingdoms era (such as Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, or Zhao Yun), wielding multiple weapons and skills simultaneously to fend off waves of relentless enemies.

Each run allows you to customize your hero by combining randomly generated traits, weapons, and items to create unique combat builds. Will you dominate the battlefield with Zhang Fei’s brutal twin halberds, or weave through enemies with Zhao Yun’s agile spear techniques? Different loadouts deliver entirely distinct playstyles!

Survive against the clock as enemy forces grow ever stronger. Your arsenal and abilities evolve with each battle—but can you hold out until reinforcements arrive and cement your legacy as an unstoppable warlord?

summary.핵심플레이: 삼국지 시대의 무장을 조작해 여러 무기와 스킬을 동시에 사용하며 몰려오는 적들을 상대한다. 매 플레이마다 무작위로 생성되는 특성, 무기, 아이템을 조합해 전투 빌드를 구성한다.
summary.특징: 관우, 장비, 조운 등 삼국지 무장을 선택할 수 있으며 캐릭터별로 서로 다른 무기와 플레이 스타일을 제공한다. 시간이 지날수록 적이 강해지는 가운데 무기와 능력을 성장시키며 지원군이 도착할 때까지 생존하는 것이 목표다.

name: Hentai VR 18+
input:
Welcome to a world that brings to life the brothels of the future.

Here, you'll experience a realistic, intimate encounter with a beautiful girl in VR that is so shockingly immersive that you'll swear you were actually right there. As well as titillating VR experiences that are sure to get your pulse racing.

You'll be free to do whatever you wish, and to revisit as many times as you like. So why not dive in, and experience pleasures that are at once real and far beyond the limits of reality.



Controls:

The player is able to move freely, and to change the situation by touching the cube.

Touching the ball allows the player to switch between dickgir(Futanari) and female versions.

The player can view their gorgeous beauty from a range of different angles.



Features:

- Physics engine recreates situations in vivid detail.

- Supports 6DoF, allowing for unlimited freedom and greater immersion.

- The room will be automatically cleaned if it's dirty.

summary.핵심플레이: VR 환경에서 자유롭게 이동하며 큐브를 만져 상황을 바꾸고, 볼을 만져 여성형과 후타나리형을 전환한다. 다양한 각도에서 캐릭터를 보고 원하는 만큼 반복해 방문할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 물리 엔진으로 상황을 표현하며 6DoF를 지원한다. 방이 더러워지면 자동으로 정리된다.

name: Exo-Adventures
input:
Join the exploration in this fast-paced space platformer video game. Take control of your astronaut as you explore and clear out sectors of hostile exoplanets.



Key Features/Details

- Beamed down onto the surface of a hostile planet your goal is to reach the end of each zone.

- Quick and responsive movement combined with your rocket boosters, which allow for multiple jumps, provide a fast pace and action-packed gameplay experience.

- When you first beam down you will have a small shield. This can protect you for a short time and when it runs out you will start to take damage to your health.

- You start your mission with 3 re-links. These allow you to teleport back to the start of the zone or to an activated re-link station when your health reaches critical levels.

- Be on the lookout for both med-packs and extra re-links scattered across the surface. These will greatly increase your chances of survival!

- Avoid dangerous alien life and hazardous terrain so you can make it to the end in one piece.

- An experience that is both challenging and fun, how quickly can you make it to the end?

summary.핵심플레이: 우주비행사를 조작해 적대적인 외계 행성의 각 구역을 통과하며 끝 지점에 도달하는 것이 목표다. 로켓 부스터를 이용한 다중 점프로 이동하면서 외계 생명체와 위험 지형을 피한다.
summary.특징: 착륙 시 일정 시간 보호하는 실드가 있으며, 체력이 위험 수준에 이르면 구역 시작점이나 활성화된 리링크 스테이션으로 순간이동할 수 있는 리링크를 3개 보유한다. 지형 곳곳에 흩어진 회복 팩과 추가 리링크를 수집할 수 있다.

name: Advent Rising
input:
A common legend pervades the galaxy-that of a powerful, highly intelligent ancient race that will one day deliver the universe. They are known as Humans.

Some claim they are the messiah. Others believe they exist only in the imaginations of the young. The Seekers, however, know Humans exist and believe they are an enemy that must be destroyed. Under the guise of benevolent explorers, Seekers comb the universe and eradicate any Human colonies they find. Until now.

Working with award-winning science fiction author Orson Scott Card, GlyphX Games has created a gripping storyline that will thrust gamers into an incredible intergalactic saga.

The Advent of Humanity Begins...

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 인간 캐릭터로서 우주를 배경으로 한 전투와 스토리 진행을 이어간다.
summary.특징: 공상과학 작가 Orson Scott Card와 협업해 제작된 스토리를 바탕으로, 인간을 전설 속 강력한 종족으로 여기고 이들을 말살하려는 세력 Seekers와 대립하는 은하계 서사를 다룬다.

name: Brother Brother
input:
Brother Brother
You awake in a small world, in the small house that you share with your brother. His bed is cold and empty, and there’s no sign of his whereabouts. Something doesn’t feel right. Explore the land and gear up, finding your brother is going to be no walk in the park.
Wishlist my upcoming game - Greenwood Falls!

Brother Brother is a nostalgic journey through a small land. Venture out and enjoy all the small details about the game. The satisfying sound of slashing through grass, the scared frogs fleeing to the safety of the water, the small birds who fly away because they don't want to meet you. Find the hidden bosses of the Forest and gear up to rescue your brother!
What can you expect?
Get ready to spend a few hours immersed in this tiny world. You'll explore caves, dungeons, defeat bosses, help people around town, and more. This pint sized action RPG is reminiscent of the classic console days, and weekends spent sitting on the floor in front of the big tube TV. The gameplay is simple, gather your gear and talk to the townsfolk to figure out where your brother is. Use your sword to hack away at enemies, and find upgrades - like the Fire Ring, and the Shield - to prepare yourself for what's to come.

- 8 Unique Bosses

- 9 Unique enemies

- Steam achievements

- Lots of people and items to collect and interact with

- Fishing!

- Classic RPG Soundtrack and sounds

- Optimized for QWERTY Keyboard or Gamepad

Explore a small, vast land - with plenty of hidden places and enemies waiting for you. It will take everything you can muster to overcome your challenges.

Explore and Find:

- Hidden caves

- Hidden Dire Wolf Bosses

- The Bosses holding the Key Stones

- Hidden equipment to help you get your brother back

Get ready to defend yourself! Finding your brother will be no easy task, there are enemies around every corner waiting to end you quest! Use your sword to tear enemies apart, and possibly find the a magic Fire Ring to light up enemies from a distance.

Defeat:

- Skeletons

- Bats

- Slimes

- Skeletons

- & More!

summary.핵심플레이: 작은 세계를 탐험하며 검으로 적을 처치하고, 마을 주민과 대화해 사라진 형제의 행방을 찾는다. 동굴과 던전을 돌며 파이어 링, 방패 같은 장비를 모으고 보스를 처치한다.
summary.특징: 고전 콘솔 시대를 연상시키는 소규모 액션 RPG로, 8종의 보스와 9종의 적, 숨겨진 동굴과 다이어 울프 보스, 낚시 요소를 포함한다. 스팀 도전과제와 클래식 RPG 사운드트랙을 제공하며 QWERTY 키보드와 게임패드를 지원한다.

name: Unbox Tactics
input:
Unbox Tactics is a rogue-like, turn-based tactical game that challenges you to strategically lead your party through procedurally generated dungeons. Each character is unboxed with unique abilities, and it's up to you to form the ultimate party to tackle an ever-evolving array of enemies and obstacles.



As you progress through dungeons, you’ll earn gold and resources by defeating enemies and clearing challenges. These resources allow you to unlock and unbox new characters, each bringing distinct skills and combat styles to your party. Additionally, you’ll encounter various items during your runs that can be combined to create powerful synergies, enabling your party to overcome tougher foes with enhanced tactics.



Beyond the immediate dungeon-crawling experience, Unbox Tactics offers meta-progression in the form of permanent upgrades. Between runs, you can invest in long-term upgrades that enhance your characters or provide your party with extra advantages for future attempts. This system allows you to grow stronger with each run, even if you fall short, ensuring that every attempt brings you closer to victory.

summary.핵심플레이: 절차적으로 생성되는 던전을 파티를 이끌고 턴제 전투로 진행하며, 적을 처치하고 도전을 클리어해 골드와 자원을 얻는다. 자원으로 새 캐릭터를 언박스해 파티를 구성하고, 획득한 아이템을 조합해 시너지를 만든다.
summary.특징: 각 캐릭터는 고유 능력을 지니며, 런 사이에 영구 업그레이드에 투자하는 메타 프로그레션 시스템으로 실패하더라도 캐릭터와 파티를 강화해 다음 시도를 준비할 수 있다.

summary.핵심플레이: 가상 캐릭터를 앱에 업로드하고 웹캠만으로 캐릭터를 조작하며, 말하는 내용에 맞춰 립싱크를 적용해 영상을 녹화한다. 영상·이미지 삽입 등 미디어 구성 후 1080P로 내보낸다.

name: Afternoon of Resurrection
input: In this top-down psychological horror game with 2D graphics, you will take on the perspective of a citizen isolated from society and will have to deal with your hallucinations to survive for 3 nights in a simple, time-worn cabin. Explore the house using point-and-click mechanics to survive.

summary.핵심플레이: 사회로부터 고립된 시민의 시점에서 오래된 오두막을 포인트 앤 클릭 방식으로 탐색하며, 환각에 대처해 3일 밤 동안 생존한다.
summary.특징: 탑다운 시점의 2D 그래픽으로 진행되며, 낡은 오두막을 배경으로 환각을 다루는 심리 호러 요소를 담고 있다.

name: They Are Beasts
input:
Try an atmospheric top-down shooter in which you find yourself in the role of a desperate fighter, whose sole purpose is to avenge your own suffering, killing as much evil as possible... and bring your soul back.



You are the victim of a bloody ritual of devil worshipers, eager to please their master. But during the sacrifice something went wrong - the demon got your soul, but the cultists could not break your body. Armed, you seek to destroy as many creatures of hell as possible. They took your soul, and now you do not know what the fear or pity is... But is it possible to become yourself again? In whose hands is your immortal soul? Embark on a dark journey through the real hell in story mode and learn the secret of the bloody cult! Or try a survival mode in which your main task is to destroy as many hellish creatures as possible, using various types of weapons, and avenge all that you had to go through!



They Are Beasts is:



• Hardcore third-person shooter, in which the power of opponents increases as mush as yours – try to beat them all!

• Several types of weapons with unique characteristics – use as many grenades as you want.

• Character’s progress and various achievements at each stage of the walkthrough.

• Dynamic gameplay, immersing in the dark atmosphere of despair and pain: there is only one way to get out of this hell – kill them all!

• Two game modes: storyline – for those who want to immerse themselves in a tangled story, and survival mode, where there is only one rule – kill or be killed.



Danger at every turn – do not forget to recharge!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 무장한 캐릭터를 조종해 다양한 무기와 수류탄으로 지옥의 적들을 처치하며 진행한다. 적의 강함이 플레이어의 성장에 맞춰 증가하는 방식이다.
summary.특징: 악마 숭배자의 의식 희생자가 되어 빼앗긴 영혼을 되찾으려는 설정을 배경으로 한다. 스토리 모드와 생존 모드 두 가지 모드를 제공하며, 각 단계에서 캐릭터 성장과 업적을 얻을 수 있다.

name: Where Is Mrs Peregrine?
input:
Story

"Mrs Peregrine is very precious to Maple. They're inseparable ever since the moment she was born... or so, that's what I heard.

For various reasons, Maple adores her. She is very, very, very cute... She really is! Nobody understands how absolutely adorable she is! She also works so hard! Do you know how cute she is when she's picking the tomatoes? She's really lovely, unlike Mrs Peregrine...

W-WAIT! I-I was definitely not talking about Maple!

*clears throat* Anyway, it's really chilly today, so I'm going to Maple's place to spend my day with her. Mrs Peregrine will be there too, I guess. She should be lounging on the porch -- a boring, I mean, calm activity befitting her age and personality -- as usual.

Huh? She's not there? Where is she?

Is she taking a walk somewhere? In this almost-freezing weather?? Isn't she in a bad health condition recently? Going out in this weather is really bad for her, she could even be in danger! Oh no! Maple's precious family member is missing... I have to find her!"

Features

-
Linear visual novel with no choices

-
Around 15,000 words (around an hour of reading time)

-
Cosy late autumn/early winter vibe

-
Warm and happy ending 💕

Credits

Mrs Peregrine is a random idea that came to my mind on one autumn day, 2023.

Thank you very much from the bottom of my heart! I hope you enjoyed this silly little VN that I made.

summary.핵심플레이: 선택지가 없는 선형 진행의 텍스트를 읽으며 이야기를 따라간다. 약 15,000단어 분량으로 읽는 데 약 1시간이 걸린다.
summary.특징: 늦가을에서 초겨울을 배경으로, 사라진 Mrs Peregrine을 찾는 이야기를 담고 있으며 따뜻하고 행복한 결말로 마무리된다.

name: 罗森图鉴Online
input:
在被人遗忘的世界角落，传闻存在着一个伟大的遗作：罗森图鉴。

那是由某位智者打造的一座层层相连的立于深空的高塔，是由数十座不同环境的浮空岛组成的深邃的迷宫空间，其中有森林与沙漠、有冰原与火山，有着各种奇异的生物与数不尽的财富。

不知何时，你的意识进入一副陌生的身躯，从罗森图鉴的内部醒来。

你的命运——该何去何从？

#浮空岛与传送门

罗森图鉴由数十座浮空岛构成，由传送门相连接，难度逐步提升，供玩家探索与挑战。

#职业与技能

游戏提供了5种职业用于构建玩家的战斗风格，扮演团队中不同的角色，在此基础上玩家可以自由组合技能，发挥智慧与想象力。

#装备和道具

材料、图纸、道具和装备等等可以从npc商店购买或者击败魔物来获得，利用游戏内的一切资源充分武装自己，提高战斗力。

#建造专属领域

达到一定等级后，玩家可以解锁专属领域。玩家可以在领域内建造金矿、炮台、攻城战车等各种各样的建筑，用于帮助玩家成长或者进攻与防御。

#排位与团战

在充分建设专属领域并布置好阵型后，玩家可以邀请好友一起参与排位战，与其他拥有专属领域的玩家对战，击败他们以提升段位与积分并获取丰厚的奖励。

#极高的组合与操作上限

虽然每个职业的技能树有限，但游戏支持角色利用扩展插槽来扩充自己的技能库，随着游戏不断更新推出新的技能，玩家可以用的技能组合也会越来越多。

在战斗中，绝大多数技能都需要玩家自己瞄准并释放，这也意味着玩家可以通过自己的移动跳跃或位移技能来规避伤害。此外，较快的战斗节奏要求玩家快速做出决策。

#排兵布阵的策略

排位战一旦开始，对战双方的进攻与防守将同时进行，攻城武器将沿着预先设定的位置投入敌方领域，确保自己领域不被摧毁的同时尽可能破坏敌方的阵地！请务必在合适的位置摆放合适的建筑，以确保它们能够充分配合并发挥最大的作用！

summary.장르: 캐주얼, 인디, 대규모 멀티플레이어, RPG, 전략
summary.핵심플레이: 5종의 직업 중 하나를 골라 기술을 조합하고, 대부분의 기술을 직접 조준·발동하며 이동과 점프로 피해를 회피하는 전투를 진행한다. 전송문으로 연결된 부유섬 미로를 탐험하고 상점 구매나 몬스터 처치로 재료·도구·장비를 획득해 전투력을 높인다.
summary.특징: 일정 레벨에 도달하면 전용 영역을 해금해 금광·포탑·공성 전차 등 건축물을 배치할 수 있으며, 진형을 갖춘 뒤 다른 플레이어의 영역과 공격·방어가 동시에 진행되는 랭킹 팀전을 벌여 단계와 점수를 올린다. 확장 슬롯으로 기술 라이브러리를 늘려 기술 조합을 확장할 수 있다.

name: New Cycle
input:
Roadmap

About the Game

New Cycle is a city building game with focus on survival. After an apocalyptic series of solar flares, human society has been thrown into disarray. Establish a settlement and develop it all the way from humble beginnings to industrial metropolis.

summary.핵심플레이: 정착지를 세우고 초기 단계부터 산업 도시로 발전시키며 주민의 생존을 관리한다.
summary.특징: 태양 플레어로 인한 종말 이후 붕괴된 인류 사회를 배경으로 한다.

name: 13F
input:
You are a tired office worker who works overtime until late at night because of the heavy workload. You have to go home and rest quickly because you have to go to work tomorrow morning. The elevator is broken, which means you need to walk to the first floor by stairs, and today's office building seems to be a little weird. . .



Inspired by "Exit 8", it is presented in the form of hand-painted pixel art and 2D platform, each pixel is carefully crafted!



35 carefully designed and interlocking abnormalities, and other secrets hidden in the office building, are waiting for your discovery!



If there is no abnormality, just go downstairs normally. If there is an abnormality, you can go to the next floor by going upstairs. So just find the abnormality, but sometimes things are not that simple.



This game is scary. Players with heart disease, high blood pressure, etc., please enter with caution and listen to the doctor's advice!

summary.핵심플레이: 야근을 마친 회사원이 되어 고장 난 엘리베이터 대신 계단으로 1층까지 내려간다. 각 층의 이상 현상 유무를 판단해, 이상이 없으면 아래층으로 내려가고 이상이 있으면 위층으로 올라가는 방식으로 진행한다.
summary.특징: 'Exit 8'에서 영감을 받은 작품으로 손으로 그린 픽셀 아트와 2D 플랫폼 형식을 사용한다. 35개의 이상 현상과 사무실 건물에 숨겨진 비밀이 배치되어 있으며 공포 요소를 포함한다.

name: WarpedSpace
input:
WarpedSpace is a sci-fi survival adventure game set in deep space. A massive, open environment full of wonder and peril awaits you!

Dive Into a Vast Space Adventure

Stranded in deep space. No way back. Only forward.

Alone in the void, you must explore, adapt, and survive. Navigate vast asteroid belts, abandoned outposts, and eerie space wrecks as you uncover the secrets of WarpedSpace.

-
Explore the Unknown: Asteroids, gas clouds, wrecks, outposts, and more.

-
Survive the Void: Manage oxygen, food, and water—or perish.

-
Adapt & Upgrade: Enhance your EVA suit and ship for deeper exploration.

-
Not Alone: Some lifeforms help… others hunt.

🛸 Play the Demo NOW on Steam! 🛸
💾 Wishlist & Follow to stay updated! 💾

Tell me more

Awoken from stasis into an unexpected and hostile environment, the traveler must explore the mysteries of WarpedSpace.

WarpedSpace creates environments that provide opportunities to immerse yourself in a Sci-Fi world like no other.

Exploration is key in this open-world adventure and leaving the comforts of your ship to explore caves and wrecks may result in untold rewards.

To bring the world to life-- Creatures may find your ship more appetizing than you-- but you and your ship may not always be the most enticing items on the menu.

Organic and inorganic lifeforms with needs or goals may ignore you unless you get in their way. Not everything is out to kill you so choose your actions wisely. Encounters with hostile forces may be too much to handle so escape may be a smarter and more thrilling strategy than expected.

Being mindful of where you leave your ship will play a critical role when a quick escape is key. Masking or lowering your ship's signature will be useful when operating in more hostile areas and can protect against creatures that might be drawn to it.

Explore, mine, hunt, harvest, build and upgrade to survive and uncover the mysteries of WarpedSpace.

Wake up, traveler. THEY are coming!

Want to make suggestions ?

Then join our Discord ! ( See Steam Link Section )

Latest Features Added :

-
Jump Gates

-
Updated Ui

-
Mining for Ships & Player Character

-
Tractor Beams and Salvage for Ships & Player Character

-
Per Environment Gravity

-
Oxygen & Life Support for Base Building

-

-
Research

-
