-
EVA Boost VFX

Features being Developed

-
Exploration Explore an open world environment on foot, EVA and in your ship.

-
Environments Environments range from asteroid belts, wrecks, gas clouds, alien outposts and more.

-
FPS Combat Not everywhere is safe find and upgrade a weapon or two as you explore the different environments and points of interest.

-
Space Combat Where Classic Arcade Meets Cosmic Exploration.

-
Base Building With the Recent Addition of Base Building you now have the opportunity to set up camp and live among the star. (currently being reworked)

-
Story Enjoy the open world or settle down it's up to you how much of the mystery you discover.

-
Repair Maintain your ship, you'll have to find a safe place to Eva and restore your ship to battle ready status

-
Salvage Salvage material as you explore to build your base or repair your ship

-
Survival Oxygen and food, fuel and more. Suggestions are welcome.

Upgrade Your Ship

See you in WarpedSpace aka Spacenautica

Explore the mystery of this Space Adventure

What happened to the planets? Who is with you in this system? Discover outposts underground bases Alien tech and more.

summary.핵심플레이: 우주 공간에서 소행성대, 버려진 전초기지, 난파선 등을 도보와 EVA, 우주선으로 탐험하며 산소·식량·물·연료 등을 관리해 생존한다. 채굴, 수집, 사냥, 제작을 통해 EVA 슈트와 우주선을 개조하고 거점을 건설한다.
summary.특징: 오픈 월드 환경에서 유기·무기 생명체가 각자의 목표에 따라 행동하며, 우주선의 신호를 낮춰 적대적 생명체를 회피하거나 전투 대신 도주를 선택할 수 있다. FPS 전투, 우주 전투, 점프 게이트, 견인 빔, 환경별 중력, 연구 시스템 등을 포함한 얼리 액세스 작품이다.

name: Dice Up
input:
In Dice Up, eating food gives you powers. Eating a large block of food gives you a powerful effect but can only be used once. Dicing up your food into smaller piece allows you to use you power multiple times but at a reduce strength. Determine how to dice up each food to gain the right quantity and strength of powers to reach the exit.

Dice up your food into either big, medium or small pieces. Dicing into smaller pieces will give you more pieces to use but with a weaker effect.

-

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 음식을 큰 조각, 중간 조각, 작은 조각으로 나눠 능력을 얻고, 각 음식을 어떻게 자를지 결정해 적절한 능력의 수와 강도를 확보하여 출구에 도달한다.
summary.특징: 큰 음식 조각은 강력하지만 한 번만 사용할 수 있고, 작게 자를수록 사용 횟수는 늘지만 효과는 약해지는 트레이드오프 시스템을 갖는다.

name: Realms of Reverie
input:
Have you ever wanted to step into a quiet world shaped by myth and memory? Realm of Reverie is a short VR adventure game developed in Unreal Engine 5. Explore and interact with simple puzzles in this short student game.

After a disaster leaves a sacred village in ruins, you awaken as the spirit of its last priest. Explore the remnants, gather lost energy, and restore the shattered Sun Stone. Inspired by artifacts from Mexico’s National Museum of Anthropology, this 10-minute journey offers gentle exploration and a moment of quiet reflection.

Realm of Reverie is the product of two person team Maggie Lin and Yichen Xiong for Senior Thesis 2025.

summary.핵심플레이: 신성한 마을의 마지막 사제의 영혼이 되어 폐허를 탐험하고, 잃어버린 에너지를 모아 부서진 Sun Stone을 복원한다. 탐험과 간단한 퍼즐 상호작용으로 진행된다.
summary.특징: Unreal Engine 5로 개발된 약 10분 분량의 짧은 VR 게임으로, 멕시코 국립인류학박물관의 유물에서 영감을 받은 세계관을 담았다. 두 명으로 구성된 팀의 2025년 졸업 작품이다.

name: 小枠内館の祝 KOWAKUNAI CELEBRATION
input:
"KOWAKUNAI CELEBRATION" is a horror Jokes 3D action game.
Pick up items such as flashlights and keys to reach the goal.
The mantion looks scary, but don't worry.
There are no monsters in this game.

Goal of this game

Go to the goal room.

What is included in this game

-
Bright flashlight

-
Reliable weapons

-
POOP

-
Jumpscare to be announced in advance

What is not included in this game

-
Scary stories

-
Attacking monsters

-
Grotesque expression

-
Difficult puzzles

-
Save & Load

About Video and Live Streaming

You are free to do so with or without revenue.

summary.핵심플레이: 손전등과 열쇠 등의 아이템을 주워 목표 방까지 도달하는 것이 목적이다.
summary.특징: 공포를 표방한 3D 액션 게임이지만 실제로는 몬스터나 무서운 이야기, 그로테스크한 표현, 어려운 퍼즐이 없으며, 점프스케어는 사전에 예고된다. 세이브 및 로드 기능은 없고, 밝은 손전등과 무기, POOP 등이 포함되어 있다.

name: Riser of Babel
input:
Riser of Babel is endless 2d jump platform puzzle game.
Avoid all obstacles and get high as you can!

Classic Mode
Stack different shapes block to avoid flame from bottom and to get higher score!
Flame and block drop cycle will getting faster!

Rage from above
Existence from sky found you!
Avoid Debris from sky and keep advance for top!

Sisyphus challenge
Are all these things meaningless?
Avoid Lighting Strike has Knockback and recover what its broke
Keep stack and leap despite of hardship of Thunder!

Dual control option
Is all these things are too easy for you?
Don’t worry, You can control blocks and character simultaneously!
All Hardship and drops going much faster in this option!

summary.핵심플레이: 다양한 모양의 블록을 쌓아 아래에서 올라오는 불길과 장애물을 피하며 위로 올라간다. 시간이 지날수록 블록 낙하와 불길 상승 주기가 빨라진다.
summary.특징: 클래식 모드, 하늘에서 떨어지는 잔해를 피하는 모드, 넉백을 주는 번개를 피하며 부서진 것을 복구하는 시시포스 챌린지 등 여러 모드를 제공하며, 블록과 캐릭터를 동시에 조작하는 듀얼 컨트롤 옵션을 선택할 수 있다.

name: Thunderbowl
input:
Use of Gamepad Strongly Recommended

A gamepad is recommended for single-player. Additional gamepads are required for local multiplayer. Xbox 360 and Xbox One controllers for Windows are officially supported. Layouts on other gamepads may vary.

About the Game
Thunderbowl is a 3rd-person, local multiplayer, vehicular combat game designed to be quick, deadly and easy to pick up and play. Blending elements from shooters, action and racing games, it is ideal for play with friends and family. Up to 4 players simultaneously for multiplayer. Single-player supports both gamepad and PC controls for compatibility.

Cycle between a mini-gun, flamethrower and rocket launcher to blindside your opponents. Race maddeningly about the center of the Thunderbowl to collect the precious ammo before they do. Stay on your guard and don't fall off!

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 차량을 조종해 Thunderbowl 중앙을 돌며 탄약을 수집하고, 미니건·화염방사기·로켓 런처를 번갈아 사용해 상대를 공격한다. 경기장에서 떨어지지 않으면서 최대 4인이 동시에 대결한다.
summary.특징: 3인칭 시점의 로컬 멀티플레이 중심 게임으로, 슈터·액션·레이싱 요소를 결합했다. 싱글플레이는 게임패드와 PC 조작을 모두 지원하며 로컬 멀티플레이에는 추가 게임패드가 필요하다.

name: Torches of Fate
input: Torches of Fate, a love letter to old school 16 bit RPGs. Made with the RPG Maker MV engine embark on an epic journey throughout the land of Alga to find the source of the monster outbreak plaguing the land. It will be up to you to lead our cast of characters on their journey to save and explore Alga!

summary.핵심플레이: Alga 대륙을 탐험하며 여러 등장인물로 구성된 파티를 이끌고 몬스터 창궐의 근원을 찾아가는 여정을 진행한다.
summary.특징: RPG Maker MV 엔진으로 제작되었으며, 16비트 시절 RPG를 지향하는 스타일로 Alga 대륙의 세계를 탐험하는 스토리 중심 구성이다.

name: Tarmac Legends®
input:
3 years ago, Aaron Mitchell was put on the path of a personal vendetta, framed for an innocent person’s death while the killer got away; now it’s time to hunt them, from both sides of the law. With Agent Aya Nowak in your passenger seat, and your connections in the racing underworld, find the man who ruined your life and don't let anyone get in your way. Face off against many brutal characters, hired to take you down and cover up the truth. The path is twisted and winding, who knows what lead will get you closer to the man who started this mess?

Career mode is a classic, non-canon racing experience. Buy and customise hundreds of cars from everyday family cars to high-powered supercars, D class to S class, as a racer and a cop. Repaint your ride, add decals, change body kits (or police gear) and fit custom wheels. You can tune your car to your personal taste with engine, body, boost and suspension tuning. Race in 5 fully explorable open world locations, as well as a multitude of challenge series events consisting of different themes, giving you the chance to try and buy cars from all across the globe in all varieties.

The mini open world environments have multiple event types to complete as both a racer and a cop, and bosses to take down before you can move to more events. They also feature extra challenges such as stunt runs where you can find hidden packages and unlock additional premium cars.

- Dual Progression Experience: The linear, story heavy "Campaign", and the traditional open-ended "Career".

- Cops VS Racers Gameplay: Drive, battle and customise both racer and police vehicles. Racers have the edge on customisation, being able to choose from custom body kits, decals and wheels, but the cops have "Perks" - offensive power-ups they can access while racing such as bolts or spike strips to deal extra damage.

- Car Collect-a-Thon!: Buy hundreds of vehicles in career, with attention to detail for every car. In Career, you will have event types limited to certain cars, so as you play you will build a diverse collection of rides.

summary.핵심플레이: 자동차를 운전해 레이스와 추격전을 벌이며, 레이서와 경찰 양측 차량을 몰고 경쟁한다. 수백 종의 차량을 구매·튜닝·커스터마이즈하고 5개의 오픈월드 지역과 다양한 챌린지 이벤트에서 보스와 이벤트를 클리어한다.
summary.특징: 스토리 중심의 '캠페인'과 개방형 '커리어'로 나뉜 이중 진행 구조를 갖추었으며, 레이서는 바디킷·데칼·휠 커스터마이즈에 강점이 있고 경찰은 스파이크 스트립 등 공격형 퍽을 사용할 수 있다. 누명을 쓴 Aaron Mitchell이 진범을 쫓는 캠페인 서사를 담고 있다.

name: Reign and Ruin
input:
Reign and Ruin is an immersive multiplayer medieval experience in which you must survive, craft, build, fight, siege, and ultimately establish your reign across the realm.

You wake up on the stranded shores of an unfamiliar land, with nothing but a club made of driftwood to defend yourself. Hunt wildlife, gather resources, build your settlement, and forge weapons and armor to protect yourself. With each resource you refine, fortification you lay, vassal you recruit, alliance your form, and battle you triumph, you will slowly establish your medieval dynasty.

Explore a vast world teeming with danger and beauty. Journey through dense forests, flowering fields, rolling hills, murky swamps, scorching deserts, dark caverns, plagued cities, towering waterfalls, erupting volcanoes, and snowy mountain peaks. Discover valuable resources and encounter ancient terrors, as you make friends and foes along the way.

A feature unique to Reign and Ruin in the survival genre is the ability for players to engage in a struggle against one another to become the King (or Queen) of the server and realm. The King will receive the ability to collect a resource-gathering tax from every player within the server. This means that as other players are out gathering resources (wood, stone, iron, coal, etc), the King will automatically deduct a portion of those gathered resources and receive them for himself. In addition, the King may wield the Ancient Godsword, don the Elder Crown, and lob the Holy Hand Grenade.

Our skill-based combat system is designed to be fast-paced, bloody, and experienced in both first-person and third-person. Fight your opponents with melee, ranged, or magic combat.

Melee combat is inspired by Chivalry and Mordhau, allowing you to perform unique attacks including standard swings, fast stabs, and powerful overhead strikes. Additionally, you can go on the defensive by using a block, parry, riposte, jump, or duck. Those who wish to take out their opponents from a distance can use bows, crossbows, and throwing weapons. Meanwhile magic grants you the versatility of performing a variety of spell types including standard elemental, area-of-effect, healing, summoning, and denial-of-area.

With such an incredibly diverse approach to combat, be prepared to experience a plethora of clever strategies on the battlefield.

Each time you land a strike on your opponent, their warm gushing blood will coat your weapon and spurt into the air. A vast array of period-realistic weapons and armor will be at your disposal to paint the landscape with the freshly drawn blood of your enemies.

We will support decapitation and delimbing to represent the visceral and brutal experience of close-quarters medieval combat. With some lucky strikes, you may return home with trophies of your foes that you can proudly display for all to see.

Capture, hold, and execute other players. Use simple shackles to detain nearby injured opponents, or employ lassos to capture players from a distance once you’ve become more skilled in the art of capture.

Gain control of your captive and you'll have several options available for managing them. Options range from simply locking your prisoner in a cage, slowly torturing them in an iron chair, burying them alive in a coffin, publicly humiliating them in the pillory, or setting an example by executing them on the gallows. You can deliver medieval justice as you see fit.

Build anything from a small farm dwelling to an entire fortified castle citadel, piece-by-piece using our powerful and flexible building system. Place traps, external high walls, machicolations, and then deck out your living space with furniture, paintings, hearths, banners, and more. Build a castle where you can store your hard-earned loot and invite visitors to evoke their awe.

Our goal with Reign and Ruin’s crafting system is to bring the medieval professions to life. You can utilize historically accurate crafting and production stations such as tanneries, looms, forges, smithies, granaries, apothecaries, fletchers/bowyers, baking ovens, chandleries, bee skeps, siege engineer-shops, and much more. Harvest resources to craft tools, weapons, armor, and building materials. Refine your raw resources in refining stations and craft them into useful items at the appropriate production station. Progress to crafting higher-tier items by upgrading your production stations.

Pesky neighbors? Just plop down a trebuchet and greet your neighbors with a 90kg stone projectile from over 300 meters away.

Once players fortify their settlements with stone walls and reinforce their gates with iron, you can no longer bash your way inside with handheld weaponry. You need to engineer advanced siege machinery such as siege ladders, battering rams, catapults, and trebuchets in order to gain entry and plunder their loot!

Form a guild to expand your influence. You can choose your guild sigil, colors, and create a guild name that will be known across the lands. Represent your guild with tabards, banners, and shields that reflect your sigil as you march into the battlefield with your fellow men.

When the battles are over, celebrate with your friends through expressive emotes including dancing, lounging, laughter, salutations, and more! Set the scene with realistic, detailed furniture and base decorations. Finally, clothe yourself in a variety of period-accurate outfits to help you immerse into the medieval world of Reign and Ruin!

summary.핵심플레이: 자원을 채집하고 무기·방어구·건축물을 제작하며 정착지를 건설하고, 근접·원거리·마법 전투로 다른 플레이어와 싸우며 공성전을 벌인다. 사냥, 동맹 형성, 길드 결성 등을 통해 세력을 확장한다.
summary.특징: 서버에서 왕(또는 여왕)이 되면 다른 플레이어의 채집 자원 일부를 세금으로 자동 징수하고 고대 무기와 왕관을 사용할 수 있다. 상대를 포박·감금·처형할 수 있으며, 참수·절단 등의 전투 연출과 투석기·공성 사다리 등 공성 장비, 역사적 제작 시설을 제공한다.

name: Void Harvest
input:
Convicted of the highest crimes against the United Federation, you are sentenced to Void Harvest - a life of labor in the endless abyss of space. With nothing but a barely functional ship and the will to survive, you must mine asteroids, scavenge derelicts, refine resources, and upgrade your vessel to withstand the merciless void. Every scrap of ore you extract serves the Federation, but the real question remains - can you outlast the sentence, or will the void claim you?

🌌 Explore the Unknown:

summary.핵심플레이: 우주에서 소행성을 채굴하고 버려진 잔해를 회수하며 자원을 정제한다. 획득한 자원으로 함선을 업그레이드하며 생존을 이어간다.
summary.특징: United Federation에 대한 중범죄로 유죄 판결을 받고 우주 노동형에 처해진 죄수가 되어, 겨우 작동하는 함선으로 우주 공간에서 살아남는 설정을 갖는다.

name: DesertShootout
input:
Checkout And Wishlist Little Kingdoms

About the Game
GamePlay: A town in the desert filled with bad guys. Buy some guns and take them out.

Features:

• Town: A town in the middle of the desert.

• KillCount: Keeps track of all the enemies killed.

• Cash: Kill enemies for cash.

• Enemies: Lots of enemies in town to kill.

• Time: Keeps track of playtime.

• Guns: Use cash to buy guns, your need lots of guns!

• Hardcore: DesertShootout is a is a hardcore fps. No save/lord, no health bar.

summary.핵심플레이: 사막의 마을에서 적을 처치하고, 그 대가로 얻은 현금으로 총기를 구매해 더 많은 적을 처치한다.
summary.특징: 세이브·로드 기능과 체력 바가 없는 하드코어 방식이며, 처치 수·현금·플레이 시간을 기록한다.

name: Sunrise GP
input:
Cruise along breathtaking roads, immersing yourself in the beats of synthwave music in this one-of-a-kind, laid-back Grand Prix experience. Break time records, claim exciting prizes, and customize the look of your favorite cars inspired by European classics.
🔥 Motoculture 🔥
Sunrise GP takes you on a nostalgic journey with its retro-styled cars, racing through breathtaking locations. Personalize the look of your beloved car, immerse yourself in a soothing soundtrack, and continuously improve your racing times - everything is designed to help you relax and soak up the laid-back atmosphere.

summary.핵심플레이: 유럽 클래식 자동차에서 영감을 받은 차량을 몰고 다양한 도로를 주행하며 기록을 단축하고 상품을 획득한다. 차량의 외형을 커스터마이징할 수 있다.
summary.특징: synthwave 음악과 레트로 스타일 차량을 배경으로 한 여유로운 그랑프리 경험을 지향하며, 편안한 분위기의 사운드트랙과 다양한 지역이 포함되어 있다.

name: Bestiary of the Mountains and Seas
input:
Shanhaijing Bestiary" - A Matching and Purification Journey in a Fantasy World

In this mysterious universe hidden deep in the wilderness, the once-prosperous Shanhai world is being eroded by dark magic puppets. Only through your power of manipulation, by matching and fusing all things, can you awaken vitality and restore the glory of this land. This is a fantasy synthesis and cultivation game based on the "Shanhaijing", where you match spiritual beasts, purify cursed lands, and create your own magical fairy island.

Core Gameplay Highlights

▶ A Fantasy World Where Everything Can Be Matched

• Explore over 500 unique creations: From spiritual beast eggs to mythological creatures, from trees of spiritual power to mysterious treasure chests, all can be interacted with and matched.

• Innovative three-in-one evolution mechanism: Freely drag objects in beautiful scenes, and combine three of the same items to evolve into a higher-level form.

• Life Sphere Purification System: Release purification energy through matching to gradually dispel the dark curse on the continent.

• Goddess Statue Puzzle Challenge: Each map hides a sealed goddess statue, and high-level synthesis can remove the seal to obtain secret realm rewards.

• Spiritual Beast Breeding: Match spiritual beast eggs to hatch offspring and unlock over 120+ Shanhaijing divine beasts waiting for you to synthesize and evolve.

Embark on your Shanhai journey now!

You can purchase the Spirit Beast Pearl at the corresponding price tier directly from the inventory store or by jumping to the purchase option within the game：

Renminbi（￥）: 2 12 18 25 38 198 328 428 648

US Dollar（＄）： 0.3 1.5 2 3 4.99 25 45 59.99 89.99

The corresponding number of Spirit Beast Pearls that can be obtained：20 150 240 350 560 2400 3840 5000 8000

Rare items and the stamina required to enter levels can be purchased using Spirit Beast Pearls, which are a valuable in-game currency.

summary.핵심플레이: 장면 속 오브젝트를 드래그해 같은 아이템 3개를 합쳐 상위 형태로 진화시키고, 매칭으로 정화 에너지를 방출해 저주받은 대륙을 정화한다. 영수 알을 매칭해 부화시키며 신수를 수집·진화시킨다.
summary.특징: 산해경(Shanhaijing)을 소재로 한 세계관에서 500종 이상의 오브젝트와 120종 이상의 신수를 다루며, 각 맵에 봉인된 여신상을 고레벨 합성으로 해제해 보상을 얻는다. 스태미나와 희귀 아이템은 유료 재화 영수 진주로 구매할 수 있다.

name: Jixo 3: Hidden Horizons Collector's Edition
input:
From the creators of RestorArt and Twistingo comes your next must-play adventure: Jixo 3: Hidden Horizons!

Pack your bags and get ready to explore a world of wonder, where every puzzle is a passport to discovery. Journey through breathtaking destinations - from sun-soaked shores to vibrant cityscapes - each scene rich with cultural charm, stunning details, and the thrill of global adventure.

Enjoy a delightful mix of immersive gameplay, featuring a brand-new logic puzzle, captivating hidden-object puzzles, inventive jigsaw challenges, and a variety of picture games inspired by the sights and spirit of travel. All accompanied by a soothing soundtrack that lets you relax as you roam.

Unlock the intriguing Locked Boxes for a satisfying brain teaser, with each one revealing a new collectible treasure from around the world.
Whether you're puzzling from your favourite reading nook or daydreaming of far-off places, Jixo 3: Hidden Horizons is your perfect companion for a globe-trotting escape.

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.
The Collector’s Edition includes:

-
24 additional levels, exclusive bonus games

-
Collect travel-themed achievements and stunning artwork

-
Enjoy your favourite tunes with the built-in music player and visit the gallery

-
Grow your ultimate travel collection of souvenirs

summary.핵심플레이: 여러 여행지를 배경으로 한 장면에서 숨은 그림 찾기, 직소 퍼즐, 논리 퍼즐, 그림 게임 등 다양한 퍼즐을 풀어나간다. 잠긴 상자를 열어 각 지역의 수집품을 획득한다.
summary.특징: 세계 각지의 여행지를 테마로 한 장면과 배경음악을 제공하며, 컬렉터스 에디션에는 추가 24개 레벨과 보너스 게임, 여행 테마 도전과제, 음악 플레이어, 갤러리, 기념품 수집 요소가 포함된다.

name: The Core
input:
Raiders have hacked and shut down the defences of the reactor core that feeds the planet. You must protect your core until the reactor defences are restored.



A game in the TPS / Topdown Shooter genre. eliminate enemies with various abilities such as slowing down time, protect the core until it activates again, defeat the boss. You can try again and again with various challenges.

summary.핵심플레이: 다양한 능력을 사용해 적을 처치하고 리액터 코어가 다시 작동할 때까지 방어하며, 보스를 물리친다.
summary.특징: 시간을 느리게 하는 등의 능력을 활용할 수 있으며, 여러 도전 과제와 함께 반복 플레이가 가능하다.

name: GEODE CLIMB
input:
"GEODE CLIMB"

Take control of the creatures born from the depths of the earth, the Geode Climbers, and embark on an adventure through the tranquil world of geodes. Aim for the surface in this thrilling climbing-based jump-action adventure.

summary.핵심플레이: 지오드에서 태어난 생물 지오드 클라이머를 조작해 점프와 등반을 하며 지상을 향해 올라간다.
summary.특징: 지오드로 이루어진 세계를 배경으로 한 클라이밍 기반의 점프 액션 어드벤처다.

name: One Last Try
input:
One Last Try is an online platform game of up to 4 players, where your objective is to survive as long as possible, being it alone or with friends.

5 years after the outbreak, you are one of the few humans left. You are running out of resources, and hiding is not an option anymore. Tomorrow you will fight them. Using the remaining communication you have with other survivors, you all agreed to fight one last stand. One last try in getting their numbers down... the hard way.

Equip and upgrade weapons, stock healing items for yourself and your allies, build defensive or offensive structures to aid you, level up the 6 different classes, each one with their own Skill Tree, and buy a jetpack... just in case.
Key features

- Online Co-Op - Up to 4 players. No IP addresses needed, just invite and play together

- 31 Weapons - If you count your fists, 32

- Upgrade your weapons - Use gears to level up your weapons's stats, up to the Legendary level

- Structures - Build structures to hold the infected off

- Survival or Chaos - Play a wave defense mode or start with a lot of resources to build an only defense, to last as long as you can.

- 11 unique enemies - "Stalkers are coming!"

- 4 Maps - Choose the place for your last stand

- Consumables - You can use a First Aid Kit to heal your friends, or take some vitamins to boost your damage

- 6 Classes - Each class has its own strengths

- Skill Trees - Each class has its own skill tree with 18 skills

- Airdrops - Airdrops will eventually drop to aid you

- Special Weapons - Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, and a Minigun. Because why not?

- Day and night cycles - The world can't stop spinning, right?

- 50 Achievements - 17 Bronze, 20 Silver, and 13 Gold Achievements

summary.핵심플레이: 최대 4인 온라인 협동으로 밀려오는 적을 상대하며 최대한 오래 생존하고, 무기를 장착·강화하고 방어 구조물을 건설한다. 웨이브 방어 모드 또는 초반부터 자원을 많이 주는 모드를 선택해 플레이한다.
summary.특징: 발병 5년 후 살아남은 인간이 감염체와 맞서는 설정으로, 6개 클래스와 각 18개 스킬로 구성된 스킬 트리, 32종 무기, 로켓 런처·화염방사기·미니건 등 특수 무기, 4개 맵, 낮과 밤 주기, 보급 낙하를 제공한다.

name: Aolta
input:
You've woken up after a millennium with no memory of your life before. You've become an alien in your own planet. This world is yours to discover.

Aolta is a casual RPG where you play as an eponymous alien who lives in a romantically wretched city. Sit back and enjoy the game world... relax at the night club, stroll down the streets and meet interesting creatures and discover their stories. You can find a job that suits your abilities or you can skip work and resort to foraging. Meet someone to love, become the lord of the local music industry, retire to another planet, and/or maybe get married.

Get the best of both worlds: Aolta features multiple endings and a sand box mode. The game will also get a physical release subsequent to its digital launch of February 14.

Key Features:

-
Discover many activities around the city which includes dancing, loitering, smoking, drinking, getting high and fighting in the pits.

-
Romance up to six main characters and unlock their endings.

-
Befriend dozens of other characters and learn their secrets.

-
Collect spirits for your bottle city!

-
Develop your character by working on your stats which allow you to survive and ultimately get what you want.

-
Features several animated sexual scenarios.

-
Unlock several endings, collections and achievements.

-
Engaging music and atmosphere.

summary.핵심플레이: 기억을 잃고 깨어난 외계인 캐릭터로 도시를 돌아다니며 나이트클럽에서 쉬거나 거리를 거닐고, 다른 캐릭터를 만나 이야기를 알아간다. 직업을 구하거나 채집으로 생활하며 능력치를 키우고, 최대 6명의 주요 캐릭터와 연애해 각각의 결말을 해금한다.
summary.특징: 여러 결말과 샌드박스 모드를 제공하며, 정령을 모아 병 속 도시를 채우는 요소가 있다. 애니메이션 성적 장면과 다수의 컬렉션·업적이 포함되어 있고, 디지털 출시 이후 실물판 발매가 예정되어 있다.

name: Stick 'Em Up 2: Paper Adventures
input:
Spiritual Sequel Coming Soon

Hero Team is the new spiritual sequel to Stick 'Em Up 2, with the same classic side-scrolling shooter gameplay, but now with full 4v4 online play, deep loadout customization, and modern presentation:

-

-

summary.핵심플레이: 횡스크롤 방식으로 이동하며 적을 사격하는 슈팅 플레이를 진행한다.
summary.특징: 종이를 모티브로 한 연출을 사용하며, 후속작에서는 4대4 온라인 플레이와 장비 커스터마이징이 예고되어 있다.

name: The Chronicles of Robin Hood - The King of Thieves
input:
Join forces with Robin Hood in this thrilling match3 game! Returning home from war, a young nobleman finds that the corrupt Sheriff of Nottingham has taken over and now rules with an iron fist. Determined to make things right, he attempts to fight back against the Sheriff, only to find himself on the run. Now he is a fugitive, an outlaw, but he has no intention of giving up.



Banding together with a group of thieves in the forest, the nobleman sets out to steal from the rich and give to the poor, all with the ultimate goal of removing the Sheriff from power. In his new role as noble thief, he also takes on a new name: Robin Hood.



Help Robin Hood and the Merry Men in their quest to take down the Sheriff of Nottingham!



Game Features

- The classic story of Robin Hood, now retold across five chapters.

- Join Robin Hood, Little John, Marion, and other familiar figures as they fight back against the corrupt Sheriff.

- Enjoy challenging match-3 puzzle levels as Robin Hood’s reputation spreads across the land.

- Unlock 20 upgrades as Robin Hood goes from being a fugitive to one of the most respected and feared thieves in the land.

summary.핵심플레이: 매치3 퍼즐 레벨을 진행하며 로빈 후드의 이야기를 다섯 개의 챕터에 걸쳐 따라간다. 레벨을 클리어하면서 20개의 업그레이드를 잠금 해제한다.
summary.특징: 부패한 노팅엄 보안관에 맞서는 로빈 후드 전설을 소재로 하며, 리틀 존, 마리온 등 관련 인물들이 등장한다.

name: Contingency Creatures
input:
(Note: This game is currently an Open Beta release. Additional functionality will be implemented in the future. Also, current functionality may be altered or removed with or without notice.)

A PvP indie pixel-art monster battler with a unique approach to turn-based combat. Choose your moves 3 turns ahead... and create a "Plan B" for if things go wrong! Will you wield your contingency plans to create ambiguous multi-layered strategies, or to fortify a brute-force offense?

Choose from a diverse pool of Creatures, each with their own unique attacks and animations, to build a team that suits your preferences. Then go head-to-head against other players online.

This game's system is unique in that players must publicly declare their moves up to 3 turns in advance. However, what a player says they're going to do might not match their real intentions -- with "Contingency Plans," a player can make secret modifications to their publicly-stated orders that only take effect if certain conditions are met! The key to victory is to thwart the opponent's publicly-declared moves while trying not to inadvertently trigger their Contingency Plans.

summary.핵심플레이: 다양한 크리처 중에서 팀을 구성하고, 최대 3턴 앞의 행동을 미리 공개 선언한 뒤 온라인으로 다른 플레이어와 대전한다. 상대의 공개된 수를 저지하되 상대의 숨겨진 계획을 발동시키지 않도록 하는 것이 승리의 관건이다.
summary.특징: 공개 선언한 명령에 특정 조건이 충족될 때만 발동하는 비밀 수정 사항인 'Contingency Plans'를 설정할 수 있어, 선언한 행동과 실제 의도가 달라질 수 있다. 픽셀 아트 스타일의 크리처 대전 게임이며 현재 오픈 베타 단계로 기능이 추가·변경·삭제될 수 있다.

name: Chronophobia
input:
Welcome to Chronophbobia!

A collection of wars and time altering discoveries has prompted a newer, deadlier tech-arms race than any other in history. The experiments were negligent, unpredictable, and have impacted the time-lines irreparably. During a military withdraw you are quickly swept away into a nightmarish hellscape that is, The Void. Death is a cycle here, and the abominations will hunt you until the end of time unless you can escape.

But you aren't defenseless, you're a trained soldier in a battlefield full of unique weapons and equipment, just waiting to be used! Be careful, explosive ammunition hurts both of you... Rebuild your Galileo Device with the help of the built in AI, and heal yourself, locate nearby enemies, or just drop some artillery on their unsuspecting heads with the Device's built in power-ups!

Execute every ungodly creature in your way or sneak through the bloody rat infested trenches undetected to unravel the secrets of The Void. Return to reality or surrender to the abominations in this single player horror FPS campaign.

summary.핵심플레이: 군인 캐릭터를 조작해 다양한 무기와 장비로 적을 처치하거나 은신으로 회피하며 진행하는 싱글플레이 캠페인을 플레이한다. Galileo Device를 재건해 회복, 적 위치 탐지, 포격 등의 능력을 활용한다.
summary.특징: 시간 조작 실험으로 발생한 The Void라는 공간을 배경으로 하며, 죽음이 반복되는 순환 구조 속에서 탈출과 세계의 비밀을 밝히는 것을 목표로 한다. 폭발성 탄약은 플레이어에게도 피해를 준다.

name: Anime Dream Match: Boys
input:
Anime Dream Match: Boys is a delightful and soothing memory game featuring captivating artwork of adorable anime boys. Test and enhance your memory skills by finding matching pairs of images to complete each level. As you progress, the game becomes more challenging and exciting, offering a truly enjoyable experience.

Immerse yourself in a cute and calming world, perfect for relaxing and sharpening your memory!

Features of Anime Dream Match: Boys:

• 50 engaging levels

• Beautifully crafted anime art

• Simple and intuitive controls (mouse)

• Achievements to unlock

• Relaxing and charming music

summary.핵심플레이: 카드를 뒤집어 같은 이미지 쌍을 찾아 맞추며 각 레벨을 완료한다. 진행할수록 난이도가 올라가는 총 50개의 레벨로 구성된다.
summary.특징: 애니메이션풍 남성 캐릭터 일러스트를 소재로 하며, 마우스로 조작한다. 도전 과제와 배경 음악이 포함되어 있다.

name: Heroes of a Broken Land
input:
Heroes of a Broken Land is a turn-based, dungeon crawling, town management RPG.

Explore procedurally generated worlds and dungeons with multiple parties of heroes. Ally with other towns to recruit new and more powerful heroes. Explore and loot countless dungeons on your quest to save the world.

- First person, turn-based dungeon crawling action

- Manage multiple 6 parties of up to 6 heroes each to explore the word

- Manage towns, constructing buildings to upgrade your heroes and kingdom

- Recruit heroes from the realm and turn novices into powerful adventurers

- Each game is a unique world unto itself, with countless worlds and dungeons

- Choose the size of your world: explore a small Fragment for quick adventure, or an enormous one for an epic quest

A Broken Land, shattered by the Wizards of old, the Fragments of the Old World are adrift in the Void. You must visit and restore each Fragment of the Void, only then can the World be rebuilt. However you are trapped in a crystal body, unable to act alone.

You must gather and recruit the many Heroes of each Fragment to act for you. You must explore each Fragment of the World. Delve into every dungeon to gather the resources and power needed to purify each Fragment. Expand your outpost to train and equip your heroes. Make allies with the other towns and settlements, convince them to join in your quest.

summary.장르: 턴제 RPG, 던전 크롤러, 도시 경영
summary.핵심플레이: 1인칭 시점의 턴제 전투로 절차적 생성된 세계와 던전을 탐험하며, 최대 6명씩 구성된 여러 파티를 운영해 던전을 공략하고 자원과 전리품을 수집한다. 도시에 건물을 건설해 영웅과 왕국을 강화하고 초보 영웅을 육성한다.
summary.특징: 마법사들에 의해 부서진 세계의 조각들이 공허 속을 떠도는 세계관으로, 크리스탈 몸에 갇힌 플레이어가 각 조각의 영웅들을 모집하고 다른 마을과 동맹을 맺어 세계를 복원한다. 세계 크기를 선택할 수 있으며 각 게임마다 고유한 세계와 던전이 생성된다.

name: EA Play
input:
Don’t just get the game. Get more from your game with EA Play. Members get more rewards, more exclusive content, and unlimited access to more top titles.

- Get more from the games you love with members-only challenges and in-game rewards. Take your favorite titles to the next level with content that lets you stand out from the competition.

- Get instant access to a collection of EA’s best-loved games on Steam. Plus, try select new-release games — not betas or demos — and your progress carries over if you decide to buy.

- Members receive a 10% discount on EA digital purchases on Steam, including full games, Season Passes, DLC, and more.
Ready to play the best of EA? Sign up now. Cancel anytime.

summary.핵심플레이: EA 게임 모음에 접근해 게임을 플레이하고, 신작 일부를 정식 출시 콘텐츠로 시험 플레이할 수 있다. 시험 플레이한 게임을 구매하면 진행 상황이 이어진다.
summary.특징: 멤버 전용 챌린지와 인게임 보상을 제공하며, Steam에서 EA 디지털 구매 시 10% 할인이 적용된다. 언제든지 구독을 취소할 수 있다.

name: Christmas Puzzle 2
input:
Visit Christmas penguins in Arctic, ride on a fairy train in Alps and get more Santa’s gold at the Old Watermill.



Play through cool Match 3 levels, collect Santa’s coins and prepare your house for Christmas with beautiful ornaments and decorations!



Use incredible powerups to blast through the puzzles and have a fantastic Christmas Puzzle holiday! Beat the timer and earn all the golden stars in the Timed mode or just play without limits in the Relaxed mode.

Light the fireplace, decorate the fir-tree and get ready for the coziest Christmas ever.



Features:

80 exciting levels!

Fantastic soundtrack

Explore beautiful locations

Cool power-ups

summary.핵심플레이: 매치 3 퍼즐 레벨을 진행하며 산타의 코인을 모으고, 파워업을 사용해 퍼즐을 해결한다. 모은 재화로 집을 크리스마스 장식으로 꾸민다.
summary.특징: 북극, 알프스 등 크리스마스 테마의 여러 장소를 배경으로 하며, 시간 제한이 있는 타임드 모드와 제한 없는 릴랙스 모드를 제공한다. 80개의 레벨과 사운드트랙이 포함된다.

name: LISA: The First
input:
Explore Lisa Armstrong’s mind as she tries to cope with the burden caused by her father Marty.

Traverse a slipping reality as you attempt to leave home and recover your memories.

Only, escape is not so easy.



Features and Gameplay



- LISA the First is a short and surreal exploration game reminiscent of retro-RPGs.

- Navigate the twisting world of Lisa’s mind, finding hidden doors and pathways to strange and exotic places.

- Explore these spaces to uncover Lisa’s memories and unveil the sinister forces laying in wait.

- Interact with a cast of dark and strange characters who persist across multiple memories.

- Collect faded thoughts as VHS tapes, and seek a way to replay them in order to gain insight into the sights and sounds you encounter.

summary.핵심플레이: 주인공 Lisa의 정신 속 세계를 이동하며 숨겨진 문과 통로를 찾아 이동하고, 공간을 탐험해 기억을 되찾는다. VHS 테이프 형태의 흐릿한 기억을 수집하고 다시 재생할 방법을 찾는다.
summary.특징: 아버지 Marty로 인한 부담을 다루는 Lisa의 정신 세계를 배경으로 하는 초현실적 탐험 게임으로, 여러 기억을 넘나들며 등장하는 인물들과 상호작용한다. 레트로 RPG를 연상시키는 짧은 분량의 작품이다.

name: One4
input:
One4
Is a 3D puzzle game where you compete against Artificial Intelligence or your Steam mate in a formation of cubes made in glass.
Your aim is to fill four cubes with your characters in a row.
There are three game modes:

- Basic - a game where you put characters in their respectable places

- Drop - you have gravity, and you drop the character into the set of cubes. After dropping, you need to spin a slice of the cube. Characters fall down as gravity hits like a hammer.

- Rotate - similar to drop, but you don't have the gravity

And three difficulty levels:

- Easy

- Medium

- Hard
Difficulty levels only apply to single player games
Two player game
To play the two player game, you need to make friends of other Steam players first.
Do the following:

- If you know a friend, who plays on Steam, ask him/her to be your friend

- Launch One4, and select 2 player game

- Select your friends name from the drop down

- If you have not chatted with your friend, you can try to invite by pressing the button underneath the dropdown

- You may also click to open the chat and decide which game you wish to play

- Once both of you are in the game, you can play together

Music

Artist: Bump Nasties
Song: Acid Tick
© Ouranio Recordings
℗ Ouranio Recordings

summary.핵심플레이: 유리 큐브 배열 안에 캐릭터를 배치하여 한 줄에 네 개를 채우는 것을 목표로 하며, AI 또는 Steam 친구와 대결한다.
summary.특징: 캐릭터를 지정된 자리에 놓는 Basic, 중력을 이용해 떨어뜨린 뒤 큐브의 한 층을 회전시키는 Drop, 중력 없이 회전시키는 Rotate의 세 가지 모드를 제공하며, 싱글플레이에는 쉬움·보통·어려움 난이도가 적용된다. 3D 입체 큐브 구조로 진행된다.

name: The Watcher
input:
Our heroes catch wind of a mysterious land teeming with monsters, compelling them to uncover the truth behind its turmoil. Venture deep into this perilous realm and journey as far as you can to discover the origin of the monsters.

FEATURES

Idle Mode: Heroes will auto move and attack, monsters will auto appear one by one or group. Beware some boss will randomly appear too.

summary.핵심플레이: 몬스터가 가득한 미지의 땅으로 진입해 최대한 멀리 나아가며 몬스터의 기원을 밝힌다. 영웅이 자동으로 이동하고 공격하며 하나씩 또는 무리로 나타나는 몬스터와 전투한다.
summary.특징: 영웅이 자동으로 이동·공격하는 방치형 모드를 제공하며, 전투 도중 보스가 무작위로 등장한다.

name: AI探案集
input:
开发者的话

亲爱的侦探们，你们好呀！这里有一些小小的解释关于为什么游戏中需要内购买聊天次数哦。你们知道吗，AI聊天可是需要一定的算力成本的呢，如果你们无限制地聊天，那对我们可是会产生超大的成本哦 (；´Д`A

所以，我们希望你们能够尽可能地就重点内容和角色进行聊天，仅用游戏赠送的次数进行聊天也是可以破案的哦 (〃'▽'〃)

再告诉你们一个小秘密，每当你们通关一关后，聊天次数会增加80次哦，如果你们能够完美通关的话，还能再增加50次呢！ヾ(≧▽≦*)o

希望你们的侦探大脑能够充分发挥作用，在尽可能少的聊天次数下成功破解案件哦。加油，我相信你们一定可以的！٩( 'ω' )و

About the Game
《AI Detective Collection》

《AI Detective Collection》 is a detective decryption game that gathers the latest AI large language model technology, which brings players into a reasoning world full of suspense and challenges. Here, you will be incarnated as a keen detective, using your intelligence and the unlimited potential of AI assistant to explore complex cases in depth and expose the truth hidden under the surface.

In the game, you will face a series of well-designed cases, each of which is a test of your reasoning ability. You need to collect and analyze clues, examine evidence, and use logical thinking and deduction skills to solve the mystery step by step. the AI assistant will be your strong backing, providing key information and analysis to help you make the right judgments in the reasoning process.

《AI Detective Collection》 is characterized by its unique AI interactive experience. the AI assistant not only provides clues and evidence, but also engages in an in-depth dialogue with you, reacting to your choices and actions. This high level of interactivity and realism makes players feel as if they are in a real detective story, experiencing an unprecedented sense of immersion.

In addition, each case in the game is designed with core and fringe issues, and players need to keep trying and exploring, combining their own insight and the technical support of the AI assistant, in order to gradually unlock the clues and ultimately find the truth of the case.

《AI Detective Collection》 is not just a game, it is a new intelligent experience, an exploration of the potential of AI technology. It allows players to feel the intelligence and power of AI while enjoying the fun of the game. Now, let's join AI Detective Collection, challenge the limits of our own reasoning, and uncover the mystery behind each case!

summary.핵심플레이: 탐정이 되어 단서를 수집·분석하고 증거를 검토하며 논리적 추론으로 사건을 단계적으로 해결한다. AI 어시스턴트와 대화하며 정보를 얻고 판단을 내린다.
summary.특징: AI 대규모 언어모델 기술을 활용해 어시스턴트가 플레이어의 선택과 행동에 반응하는 대화형 방식이며, 각 사건은 핵심 문제와 부차적 문제로 구성된다. 채팅 횟수가 제한되어 게임 내에서 지급되는 횟수 안에서 사건을 해결하며, 스테이지 클리어 시 채팅 횟수가 추가된다.

name: Counter-Terrorism Ops
input:
Counter-Terrorism Ops is a tactical action game in which the player takes on the role of a counter-terrorism unit. Make decisions, take down terrorists and save hostages!

A good audiovisual setting, combined with interesting game mechanics, allows players to experience highly immersive production! Welcome to Counter-Terrorism Ops!

Choose the right equipment for a given action, make tactical decisions for the entire group, and shoot from the perspective of one of them!

Features:

- great audiovisual

- playas counter-terrorist

- save hostages

- make a decision that affects your game

- choose the right equipment & tools

summary.핵심플레이: 대테러 부대의 일원으로 임무에 맞는 장비를 선택하고, 부대 전체의 전술적 결정을 내리며, 대원 중 한 명의 시점에서 사격해 테러리스트를 제압하고 인질을 구출한다.
summary.특징: 플레이어의 선택이 게임 진행에 영향을 미치는 의사결정 요소와, 장비·도구 선택 시스템을 갖추고 있다.

name: Back to Dust - Hold it Together
input:
Back to Dust is a survival game focused on decision making and inspired by the true stories of refugees.

You and your daughter are in a conflict zone and running low on food, you must travel to the border and try to enter the neighboring country. The path to the border is full of other refugees asking for your help. The more refugees you accept in your party, the tougher will be your journey.

Will your humanity prevail? Or will your self-preservation instinct overcome?

-
Decision Making is Key: Back to Dust is all about decision making. There is no complicated or innovative mechanics. Player must analyze the group situation and select options that best suits their needs.

-
Decisions Drive the Story: More than earning resources or status changing, player’s decisions will change the course of the story, making events happen, revealing new paths or changing the game's ending.

-
Trade Mechanics: Sometimes your extra resources can be useful to someone and vice versa.

-
Changing Economy: Items can be traded one-by-one with other refugees or freely negotiated with travelling merchants.

-
Bargaining System: Characters can even bargain (or beg) if they have the knack for it.

-
Unique Character Habilities: Many characters have unique habilities that can be used to take advantage in many kind of situations.

-
Immersive Storytelling: Truly feel what it is like to walk in the shoes of a family in the midst of a refugee crisis.

-
Multiple Endings: 8 unique endings based on players choices during their journey.

-
Real World Inspirations: Imagery and story points are inspired by real refugee stories.

-
Empathy: Sometimes the good choice is not the right choice to make. What will be the limit of your kindness?

Average playtime: 2h (shortest path), 5h (longest path)

summary.핵심플레이: 딸과 함께 분쟁 지역에서 국경을 향해 이동하며, 상황을 분석해 선택지를 고르고 다른 난민을 일행에 받아들일지 결정한다. 자원 교환과 협상, 흥정을 통해 여정을 이어간다.
summary.특징: 난민들의 실화에서 영감을 받은 세계관으로, 플레이어의 선택이 이야기 전개와 경로, 결말을 바꾸며 8가지 엔딩으로 이어진다. 일부 캐릭터는 상황에 활용할 수 있는 고유 능력을 가진다.

name: Last Man
input:
Last Man is a damage management 2D shooter, how does that work? well, you are going to take damage inevitably, but you must keep going forward before your health is depleted. Explore the levels while the beasts of another dimension go after you. Find all the map pieces to exit the level and destroy every creature in your path.



Use the box spawner, a bizarre device that puts and stacks boxes below you. Maneuver enemies by blocking their path, forget about jet packs and traverse the map by building tall box towers that will annoy friends and foes! Get creative and throw the boxes, kill enemies to refill or wait for them to replenish on their own.



Play as one of 4 friends, with zero character development. No dialogs or mediocre subtitle acting. Perfect for those who skip cutscenes! (none included). So bring your friends together! if you have any, and play a couch coop local session, no split screen with them. Gamepad required.



Enjoy more than 45 levels filled with erratic enemies made by hand by the best non-organic pizza-powered free grazing indie craftmen. With hundreds and hundreds of little details and just a few locations such as: city by day, city by night, forests, sewers, caves, train stations, more city, mountains, highway, suburbs and cyberpunk I think.

summary.핵심플레이: 체력이 소진되기 전에 계속 전진하며 다른 차원에서 온 생물들을 처치하고, 맵 조각을 모두 찾아 레벨을 탈출한다. 상자 생성 장치로 아래에 상자를 쌓아 적의 경로를 막거나 높은 상자탑을 쌓아 맵을 이동한다.
summary.특징: 피해 관리를 중심으로 한 진행 방식과 상자 쌓기 이동 시스템이 특징이며, 캐릭터 성장이나 대사·컷신이 없다. 4명의 캐릭터 중 하나를 선택할 수 있고 분할 화면 없이 로컬 협동 플레이를 지원하며 게임패드가 필요하다. 도시, 숲, 하수구, 동굴, 기차역, 산, 고속도로 등 다양한 배경의 45개 이상 레벨을 포함한다.

name: Blade Runner 2033: Labyrinth
input:
"Lots of people lost things in the Blackout.

I was lucky, I just lost a job.

But now they want me back."

From Annapurna Interactive, Blade Runner 2033: Labyrinth brings the revered franchise back to games for the first time in 25 years.

Set between the original film and 2049, Blade Runner 2033 takes place after the events of the Blackout, the devastating terrorist attack that brought an end to Tyrell Corp and Replicant production.

More details about the game will be revealed in the coming months, so keep an eye on this Steam page for updates.

summary.핵심플레이: 플레이어는 블레이드 러너 세계관을 배경으로 한 어드벤처를 진행한다. 구체적인 플레이 방식은 아직 공개되지 않았다.
summary.특징: 오리지널 영화와 2049 사이 시점을 배경으로 하며, 타이렐사와 리플리컨트 생산을 종식시킨 블랙아웃 사건 이후를 다룬다. Annapurna Interactive가 25년 만에 이 프랜차이즈를 게임으로 선보이는 작품이다.

name: Storm of spring
input:
Synopsis

Draw the wind and let the fluffy jellyfish fly!

Go to the right place to sprout and put down roots, to a well-sunlit area.

Gameplay

Use only the mouse. Let the wind blow and let the fluffy jellyfish fly high!

This game is a so-called Foddian type "climbing" game. Climb, fall, and climb again.

Two difficulty levels and two endings.

Easy Mode

If you are not good at climbing games, don't worry!

You can retry as many times as you want from a checkpoint.

However, there are some areas and endings that cannot be reached.

Hard Mode

Normal game. Checkpoints are just decorations.

Scenery

Don't get fed up with the ever-changing road, the game changes from day to night.

At night it is dark and hard to see the terrain? If that's the case, you can fix the time in the options.

Video Streaming

For live streaming and video submissions using this game.

Individuals, corporations, with or without revenue are allowed.

If possible, please include the title of the game and a link to the Steam store page.

For bug reports

Please post to the Discussion.

summary.특징: 두 가지 난이도와 두 가지 엔딩을 제공하며, 이지 모드는 체크포인트에서 무제한 재시도가 가능하지만 일부 지역과 엔딩에는 도달할 수 없다. 낮과 밤으로 변하는 풍경을 담았고, 옵션에서 시간을 고정할 수 있다.

name: Yesterday's Crossroads
input:
Follow the story of a flawed man who, after losing the love of his life, finds himself at a crossroads, unsure whether to open his heart once more. Though there is no perfect path forward, life always has a way of surprising us.

Reconnect with old friends, rekindle the flame with a past lover, or start a brand-new relationship—the choice is yours. Every road you take leads to a completely different path.

No choice is without consequence; paths collide, and the choices you make impact everyone and everything around you.

Indulge in uncensored sexual relationships and savor each moment with your partner of choice. Behind closed doors, everyone has their own secret desires.

summary.핵심플레이: 연인을 잃은 남성의 이야기를 따라가며 선택지를 골라 진행한다. 옛 친구와 다시 연결되거나, 과거 연인과 관계를 회복하거나, 새로운 관계를 시작하는 등 플레이어의 선택에 따라 서로 다른 경로로 전개된다.
summary.특징: 모든 선택에 결과가 따르며 경로가 서로 충돌해 주변 인물과 상황에 영향을 미친다. 무검열 성적 관계 묘사를 포함한다.

name: All New Origins
input:
Small scaled "Mini" Fantasy RPG where you create your own character, remember forgotten spells, find new mystical items, and have the chance to experience multiple paths and endings in the game. All New Origins is intended to be a short played game that can be completed in a few hours in a playthrough however offers much replay-ability, with a new character to make, new items and spells to pick, and different paths and secrets to find. Feel like playing an RPG but don't want the huge time sink and complexity of the great ones? Check out this small project!



STORY:

Your hero awakens in a dungeon with no idea what happened to them. The only thing left is a note from your nemesis telling you how they stole your memory and if you want it back you have to go and find them thus starting an all new origin for this hero.

summary.핵심플레이: 캐릭터를 생성하고 잊어버린 주문과 새로운 아이템을 찾으며, 기억을 훔쳐간 적을 찾아 던전에서 여정을 시작한다. 여러 경로를 따라 진행하며 서로 다른 결말에 도달할 수 있다.
summary.특징: 수 시간 내에 클리어할 수 있는 소규모 RPG로, 새로운 캐릭터 생성, 주문과 아이템 선택, 다양한 경로와 비밀 요소를 통해 반복 플레이를 지원한다.

name: Spires of Morosith: Gossamer Sundered
input:
Spires of Morosith is a tactical tower defense game with a blend of real-time-strategy elements. Allowing you to control the shape of the battlefield and the path of your enemies, Spires of Morosith seeks to deepen the impact the surroundings can have on the classic Tower Defense.

⠀

INVADING GRAINWRAITHS

-
The Grainwraiths ripping into Arborglen through Tears. They want to destroy the Spires creating the Gossamer, then won’t stop until all of Arborglen is consumed.

-
There is a variety of Grainwraith characters, from the small and many Scouts to the rare and horrifying Abhorration.

-
Enemies may spawn as a special type. For example, the Mammoths who draw towers’ ire protecting the smaller Grainwraith beside it. Or the Trojan that on death will create a small Tear, spawning more enemies.

-
The boss wave encounters will stress your strategies and take advantage of defensive weaknesses.

⠀

SUMMONED DEFENSES

-
Conjure from an arsenal of 5 towers, each serves a unique function for defeating the invading Grainwraiths.

-
Towers have one or two upgrade paths that build upon what makes each tower unique, sometimes adding additional effects like burning, vulnerability, or reduced move speed.

-
Summoning Towers influences the route the Grainwraiths will use to reach the Spires.

⠀

SUPPORT STRUCTURES

-
Improve resource generation and harvesting rates with buildings.

-
Buildings wont deal damage to the Grainwraiths but are as important as towers in keeping Arborglen and its Spires protected.

-
Buildings influence the Grainwraith routes, and have larger footprints (2x2) than towers (1x1).

⠀

SPIRES OF MOROSITH AND OBELISKS

-
Active Spires form the Gossamer that keeps the Grainwraiths from invading Arborglen. They’ve been disabled, and now the Grainwraiths seek to destroy them.

-
Protecting the Spires is priority one. When a Grainwraith reaches a Spire it will cause significant damage.

-
Success takes more than survival. Arborglen’s Spires need to be reactivated to heal the Gossamer and keep Grainwraiths from invading through Tears.

-
Once enough Grainwraith Cores have been collected by Obelisks, they may power a nearby Spire. Defeat the Grainwraith within the Obelisk’s area to collect its Core!

⠀

GATHERERS SIMON AND ALLEN

-
The Gatherers can be commanded to collect resources from the map. Gather wisely, resources are removed from the map once collected!

-
Removing resources creates more space for towers but may also open new routes for Grainwraiths to access the Spires!

-
Gatherers may also discover Ancient Knowledge in the forests of Arborglen, adding new Towers and Buildings to your arsenal!

ARBORGLEN

-
Each of the three regions within Arborglen present opportunity to expand your defensive strategies.

-
How will defenses fit in the dense forests? Or control portal connections and limited pathing options of the floating islands? Is there enough time to cut through the deadroot to access the Heartwood Trees?

-
Be cautious when building near the wildlife in the regions, they may try to protect their space!

ADDITIONAL FEATURES

When faced with a challenging puzzle, reflecting on the outcomes will help overcome obstacles in your way. Spires of Morosith offers a few features that help those that look for clarity.

-
Each successful wave generates a report, letting you know how many of the Cores you claimed and any Spire damage that wave.

-
The resources generated per minute, and the wave difficulty stats may be found by hovering over the Wood Bank and Wave displays.

-
While paused, you’re given access to construct blueprints that will temporarily update the Grainwraith path. Helpful for planning intricate maze designs.

-
When feeling prepared, take on the Endless Mode to see how long the Spire stands against an relentless Grainwraith spawn.

summary.핵심플레이: 5종의 타워와 지원 건물을 배치해 침입하는 Grainwraith로부터 Spire를 방어하며, 타워와 건물의 배치로 적의 이동 경로를 유도한다. Gatherer를 조작해 자원을 수집하고, Obelisk로 Grainwraith Core를 모아 Spire를 재활성화한다.
summary.특징: 타워와 건물 배치가 전장의 형태와 적 경로에 영향을 주며, 자원을 수집하면 맵에서 제거되어 새로운 경로가 열릴 수 있다. Arborglen의 세 지역은 밀집한 숲, 부유 섬, 데드루트 등 서로 다른 지형 조건을 제공하며, 웨이브 보고서와 청사진 미리보기, 무한 모드 등의 기능이 포함된다.

name: Jack's Labyrinth
input:
Immerse yourself in the captivating realm of 'Jack's Labyrinth,' an exhilarating video game that combines strategy, action, and puzzle-solving. As the intrepid adventurer, Jack, you'll traverse a series of intricate labyrinthine levels, each brimming with a myriad of challenges and rewards.

Your ultimate objective is clear: collect all the orbs scattered throughout the labyrinth to amass precious points. However, the path to victory is fraught with danger, as malevolent enemies known as 'evil guardians' relentlessly pursue you, aiming to halt your progress. Swift reflexes, calculated moves, and strategic planning will be your greatest allies as you navigate the twists and turns of each level.

Game Features

- Intricate Labyrinthine Environments: Immerse yourself in intricately designed labyrinthine levels that challenge your navigational skills and strategic thinking, creating a dynamic and engaging gameplay experience.

- Strategic Orb Collection: Collect orbs strategically placed throughout the labyrinth, requiring you to plan your route carefully while avoiding relentless enemies that seek to impede your progress.

- Vulnerable Guardians with Power Spheres: Unleash the potential of powerful spheres that, when collected, temporarily weaken and render the pursuing 'evil guardians' vulnerable, allowing you to turn the tables on your foes and escape their clutches.

- Visually Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visually striking world brought to life with captivating graphics, enhancing your exploration of the labyrinth and adding to the overall immersive experience.

- Achievements and Progression: Embark on a journey of accomplishment as you conquer levels, master challenges, and unlock a range of achievements, showcasing your skill and determination as you guide Jack toward his destiny.

summary.핵심플레이: 미로 형태의 레벨을 탐색하며 흩어진 오브를 모아 점수를 획득하고, 추격하는 적을 피해 이동한다. 파워 구체를 모으면 일정 시간 동안 적을 약하게 만들어 반격하거나 벗어날 수 있다.
summary.특징: 'evil guardians'라 불리는 적이 플레이어를 추격하는 미로 구조의 레벨로 구성되며, 레벨 클리어에 따라 도전 과제와 진행 요소를 해금한다.

name: The Chatters Show Free Version
input:
The Chatters Show Free Version is designed for members of the community to create and edit question sets for their favorite Twitch streamers to play using the paid version of the game. Create questions sets for free and share with your community.

- Create any question set you desire

- Share and edit any question set with your community

summary.핵심플레이: 질문 세트를 직접 만들고 편집하며, 커뮤니티와 이를 공유한다.
summary.특징: 커뮤니티 구성원이 좋아하는 Twitch 스트리머가 유료 버전에서 플레이할 수 있도록 질문 세트를 제작하는 무료 버전이다.
